name: Drake's Dealership
editorialSummary: Taproom of San Leandro brewery for house beer plus wood-fired pizza & more in former auto-shop digs.
reviews:
We always have a great time and meal at Drake's! The space is big and lovely, especially the patio, and it's a really fun vibe. The beer is good of course, but they also have fun cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks, and seasonal things like mulled wine in the winter! There's definitely something for everyone!

Their food menu is awesome and diverse, and they've got great seasonal specials like the cor

Drake’s Dealership absolutely nails it. The indoor design is stylish and welcoming, and the cozy beer garden in the center is the kind of space that makes you want to stay longer than planned. It feels lively without being overwhelming, well thought out and executed.

Big practical plus: they have gated parking and they validate the ticket. That alone removes a lot of Oakland stress.

Service was

Atmosphere? Amazing. Service? Incredible. Food? Outstanding. One of my favorite places I’ve been to in all of Oakland. The menu is diverse without being overwhelming, the beer selections are great, cocktails are delicious, and prices are very fair. 10/10.

Beer garden, with extensive outdoor seating set amidst a tree grove, string lights and bonfires — perfect for friends gathering or an intimate date. Wood finishes make for a down-to-earth and rugged feel.

Alongside the beer, the food is equally enjoyable. Tacos, Brussels sprouts and Tandoori Chicken Pizza (with extra tandoori sauce) are true crowd pleasers.

A good option when with a dog.

Beautiful, dog-friendly spot with a great atmosphere! It’s an excellent place for gathering and socializing with larger groups. The Joey pizza was flavorful with a delicious thin crust, and my husband really enjoyed the chicken tikka pizza. The burrata wasn’t the highlight of the meal and could have been better, but it was still enjoyable overall. I’m glad they had a cider option in drinks too

name: Shan Dong
editorialSummary: Buzzing eatery featuring traditional Chinese staples in a bright, straight-up setting.
reviews: Absolutely delicious!! Onion pancake & dumplings were amazing. Chicken was 🔥 too. Noodles were a lil spicy but nothing we couldn’t handle. Ordered on Doosdash & it did not disappoint! 🥡🥢

Came on a Sunday around 5:30 and waited around 40 minutes to get seated.

Loved the string beans- great flavor with a mix of chili oil and garlic, couldn’t stop eating it cause it was so addicting! I ordered the pork chow mein with the hand pulled noodles - HUGE portion (I had leftover that lasted me 2 meals) and the noodles are super thick and chewy which I love, no other place do their noodles l

Food is generally very good here.  The hands made noodles are the best if you can get it.  We ordered the sesame paste hand stretched noodles and they were delicious and flavorful.  We also ordered the pork chow main. It was good but this time I found that it was a bit salty.  I've been visiting this place for years and I'm bummed that they got rid of the Shan Dong steamed meat and vegetables buns

A very delicious place in Oakland’s Chinatown. I had their shandong chicken, dry fried green beans, salt and pepper pork and chicken and they were all excellent. The shandong chicken is your typical orange chicken, but they did something to the sauce that gives it this dark toasted caramel taste to it. The green beans I highly recommend, it’s lightly fried and then stir fried with their sauce that

I've been here a few times and don't really get the hype. The atmosphere is great due to the place always being packed, but honestly the food leaves something to be desired. Their famous hand pulled noodles are unevenly shaped to the point that some parts are cooked while others are inedibly hard. Wok dishes often lean super salty. There are better options in the area.

name: World Famous HOTBOYS Chicken
editorialSummary: Fried chicken with five levels of spice, plus American sides & beers, served in retro-cool environs.
reviews: The chicken ALWAYS hits 🌶💥 The sandwich is huge, the slaw has the right consistency and balance, added with the pickle bites on a soft roll? The sauce is really an extra benefit but crazy good nonetheless! I can't wait to try the etoufee and the b&g!

Beware the hotness scale. Medium and below is what I would go with.

I was hyped for hotboys. The fried chicken sandwich was tasty but with the price point and the seating on the road you are better off going to super duper.

The crinkle cut fries were ok. The chicken tenders were juicy but not out of this world.

The coleslaw in the sandwich was good and the pickles work well to cut the spice. Th

ordered through doordash for two meal and wow the bag was heavy. two people couldn’t even finish it.

the chicken pieces were huge and the seasoning was bursting with flavor. it had a really nice kick of spice too. they were also super generous with the fries.

no comment on the atmosphere or service since i didn’t eat there, but portion wise you definitely get a lot of food.

Good food and great customer service. Outdoor seating only and one gender neutral bathroom available for patrons. Their chicken sandwich is good but I really like the loaded fries. They do NOT play with their spice levels. Take it easy if you can’t handle it. Have some milk on standby if you decide to challenge your palette. Enjoy!

This shop just screams Oakland, y’all. Between the mural, the colors, and the volume of people waiting for their orders, you know you’re somewhere good food is made. Order at the window and wait your turn. It may take around 20 minutes as they are popular and they take their time making those good eats.

The “sando” is offered with dark meat while the “chicken tender sandwich” is white meat, which

name: Yoshi's
editorialSummary: Combination sushi restaurant & nightclub offering Japanese fare & live music in a relaxed setting.
reviews: Fantastic place! We have beard great things about Yoshi's prior to visiting. One of our favorite jazz singers had a show there, so we went. We started the evening with some delicious and fresh sushi. The lychee drink was great! The atmosphere was lively and bright. The desert we ordered was delicious. Great food, great music, great vibes. Visiting again soon!

Food was very mid. I got recommendation from a friend saying the place has good atmosphere and food. The atmosphere part was true, but not the food part: if you like “white people sushi”, then this place is for you. But if you know what authentic Japanese sushi culture looks like, pls don’t come. They don’t even know how to make proper nigiri and maki(sushi roll). The roll came in looking like it

Japanese with Jazz!
Thanks to our friends who introduced Yoshi's to us. The meal and the concert following made for a truly memorable experience. We drove from San Jose to Oakland for it - totally worth the effort!
The package deal includes parking within the structure - unheard of! They validate - so remember to pass by the electronic validation machine on your way out.
Warm sake, sushi, and Jazz

This is easily my favorite music venue in the Bay without a doubt.  My wife and I used to live in Oakland and could walk here.  And we would go once a month at least.  First of all, the food is phenomenal.  Most live music venues are not known for their food.  But the sushi, ambiance and service from this restaurant are top notch.  If you make a reservation for food before the concert, you often g

Yoshi's is a standout when it comes to authentic Japanese cuisine. From the moment you enter, you’re greeted with a warm, inviting atmosphere that sets the tone for an exceptional dining experience. The decor is sleek yet cozy, offering the perfect environment for both casual meals and special celebrations.

The menu at Yoshi’s is packed with options, but the sushi is what truly shines. The fish i

name: Parche
reviews:
This restaurant is truly a little gem of Colombia in Oakland. The service was genuinely nice and welcoming, even though I could tell they were a bit short staff and they still handled everything with grace.

I absolutely loved the presentation and flavor of the salmon ceviche. It was fresh, vibrant, and beautifully plated. I also ordered an espresso martini; it was good, but I personally missed th

We had: CELERY ROOT TIRADÍTO (pure perfection, is was so good that after eat all I keep drinking the sauce) PATACONES (amazing, for sure gonna order again) BRUSELAS EL PRADO (really good but my least favorite). We also have mocktails, they were good and pretty. The service was excellent, everyone super friendly from host to server. The place itself is beautiful, gorgeous decoration perfect complet

We took Mom here for brunch and oh what a wonderful outing she had. Sharing items on the menu is allowed, so we ordered several dishes to get a good feel for their servings.  From the Bruselas El Prado to Arepa De Chocolo with chicken, then through Empanada De Ajiaco, and finally we had Flan De Coco dessert, it was a walk through a taste experience like I have not had before.  Their chef and the t

5 stars across the board. The staff was very friendly and attentive. The food was amazing. They have a good variety of meat and vegetarian options, including some vegan, and the whole kitchen is gluten free, although you wouldn’t necessarily notice. The design of the space is also beautiful and joyful. Delicious cocktails and mocktails too!
Amazing brunch! Every dish was delicious and we found ourselves literally licking some plates clean. Service and suggestions were on point. We can't wait to come back for dinner!

name: The Lake Chalet Seafood Bar & Grill
editorialSummary: Basic seafood, cocktails & Lake Merritt views are found at this renovated boathouse with a patio.
reviews:
Came here for a work dinner recently and while we overall had an enjoyable time with a stellar atmosphere, the food itself was a bit disappointing.

The service itself was great. It’s never easy to handle a big group and our wait staff was patient and helpful. We were quickly seated outside and had a lovely view of the lake.

Atmosphere is definitely what you’re paying for when coming to this rest

We went there for a lunch, party for 7, celebrating the wedding of my sister in law.
The food was great and the atmosphere was great, but the most important part there was a issue and my mother in law was very disappointed, but they really make it happen, they were very good solving the issue and all the family was very happy.

For me that kind of things matters more.

100% recommended

I ordered the SESAME SEARED AHI BOWL, and it was below average. The tuna was overcooked, everything in the salad was okay. I told my server about the tuna and he said "I'll let the kitchen know", and that was the last time I saw my server. Another server brought me the check. Beer was good, though, although they didn't have the one I would have wanted to try, even though they make their own beers

We came on a Saturday morning and immediately knew something was off. The host stand was unattended. A man waiting there told us he’d been rudely instructed to stand there and had already been waiting 20–30 minutes with his child…without anyone returning. He finally gave up, took his kid, looked at us and said, “Good luck,” before leaving.

We waited another five minutes. Still no host. A server e

Great service and great atmosphere. That's why I gave 4 stars.  Lovely seating everyone was nice . The food  was pretty average. I enjoyed the appetizer the best calamari was fresh and fried just right. I order a dish without fish and the cook decided to replace it with another fish. Can't hurt him for trying however the fish would have nearly killed me 😆. The manager was ultra nice about it. Kev

name: Two Pitchers Brewing Company
reviews:
Two stars. The burgers and fries are only worth 2 stars in terms of taste and quality. about the level of McDonald’s.
On a Saturday evening, the café wasn’t busy, which says something. The beer was nothing special, just average quality. It’s also self-service.

Love this place. Amazing atmosphere. Always busy and lively! They have amazing beer, kind staff, and overall just a nice vibe. Oh and don't forget, they have $3 beer!! They partner with Lovelies which provides food, the line is always super long but worth the wait!

Two pitchers is really great. It’s a little loud and lively and they seem to have trivia, but it’s such a cool vibe, it’s in a fun part of town and there’s great indoor and outdoor seating. It’s great for big groups or small and even if it’s packed there’s seating. The beer, wine and fun drink category is soooo big how can you not be happy getting a drink here. If you get hungry walk over to the c
Fantastic patio, killer chicken sandwhich, good variety of beers on tap along with guest taps, makes this a standout brewery in Oakland.

Reserved one of their spaces and wasn’t aware we wouldn’t have a dedicated server. Because the space was outside, anyone who wanted a drink had to walk to the bar (mind you there was a big line for food) and order drinks individually. This was so inconvenient for the guests and myself. Like who pays $600 to reserve a space but get no special waiter? This guy. SMH never coming here again

name: Aburaya
editorialSummary: Funky Japanese nook cooking up creative fried chicken & seasonal plates in an artsy, compact space.
reviews: After meeting up with Billy White Shoes Johnson at his flop on Webster Street we decided to have lunch before heading down to the Larry Flint Center for the Performing Arts to see the Wonderful Fantasia preform her spectacular 3 Women Lumberjack show..it's an amazing experience...but not as amazing as the fried chicken we had at the Aburaya restaurant...Now that was truly amazing!  5 ☆☆☆☆☆'s!

Enjoyed my dinner here. Stopped by before a concert in downtown Oakland. It’s a busy spot with not enough seating inside for the crowds.
I enjoyed the chicken I got, cooked well. Was nice and juicy. I ordered their bbq sauce and it was very tangy, hard to describe. I’d definitely try out other flavors before getting bbq again. The bland salad and cabbage didn’t seem needed either.

There was a very long line when we went there and the place was crowded/loud. Ordering online and picking it up is much easier. Since the weather was nice, we ate by the lake instead of eating indoors. Everything was delicious. I just wish there was a little more sauce on the chicken.

Really great place, super conveniently close to my office! Staff are amazing and fast, seating is plentiful and comfy.

Food is 90% amazing, my main complaint is with the Okayu sando. It's really gross. Like it's floppy and the egg salad I sent look right. The sauce is spicy wasabi in a way that I do not enjoy. I also think I'm not the only one because the person taking my order literally clarifie

Everything is SO GOOD!! I eat gluten free and am so glad to know this a GF kitchen with truly delicious food. I had their chicken sandwich tonight- it was comically large, probably half a pound! The GF bun held up very well, the chicken was juicy, and the slaw and pickles were SO tasty. I love coming here!

name: Original Pattern Brewing
reviews: A pretty cool and noisy vibe place. Of course they have the giant beer vats in the background and lots of cool beer drinking folks in there. There's a small outdoor area with a railing next to the sidewalk but it's more of a daytime venture than at night. Personally I'm actually not a beer fan so I can't really rate their beer but just mostly rating their vibe.

Great brewery! Always a good selection of hazies, IPA'S, and WC IPA's. Always at least 1 sour and sessionable beer on the board. A lot of indoor seating, cutie covered patio (pet friendly) and their resident pizza pop up is Citizen pizza. It's a really good pizza, we go there just for the pizza sometimes! Bonus, everyone is really friendly.
The staff is friendly and helpful! I sat out on the patio and there was a great vibe and atmosphere. I took a mix 6 pack of beer to go and will definitely be back!!

Really nice space- lots of seating- indoors, outdoors, upstairs, downstairs, near windows or dark. It’s really got it all!  Good beer selection. And the attached pizza is good but expensive. Overall would recommend!

Man I really want to like this place. I’ve tried probably a dozen times over the past three years or so but the recent decision to go cashless was the last straw. Like how hard does it have to be to just get a beer? So i decided to write this review. It seems it was removed, so I'll edit it down and try again.

This place needs to choose a vibe. They often have really loud techno or emo rock blast

name: Dave's Hot Chicken
reviews:
Stopped by Dave’s Hot Chicken in Oakland and had an awesome experience. The food was great. It was perfectly crispy chicken, flavorful seasoning, and heat levels that actually deliver. Everything came out fresh and hot.

Big shoutout to our servers Arianna and Irirn.  They were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made the visit even better. The conversation was genuinely great, not rushed, and mad

The food was delicious. The staff member Irving was friendly, introduced the dishes to us, and helped us complete our order. His attitude was very kind. Thank you to him for giving us a pleasant dining experience.

Irvin & Jimena were so nice and sweet. Really great service and great food.
The honey is really dank, shoutout Arianna and Michael

Dave’s is my little brothers favorite. This is the only location I’ve been to, but we’ve been more times than I can count. The food and service are always consistent. The employees do a great job of making you feel welcome. They make sure the place is clean and have a great attitude. I don’t know the manager’s name but I like him :).

Dave’s Hot Chicken never disappoints! The food is always fresh, hot, and full of flavor. The chicken is perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, and the spice levels are spot on. The sliders and tenders are my go-to, and even the sides like fries and mac & cheese are consistently great. Everything comes out fast and well-prepared.

What really made this visit stand out was the cust

name: Lovely’s
reviews:
WHEN: Thur @4pm

I wanted to come here at opening time for a few reasons:

- PARKING: It’s downtown so not sure how parking would be.  But lucky for us, we found free parking just around the corner!  When we left around 5pm, more opened up!  I’m guessing it’s because the auto repair shop was closing.

- THE CROWD:  This place is popular and there is usually a line.  Though they have a great amount

Got the Westerner burger and fries for this trip.
The wait is pretty standard for your food, but it's WORTH IT. Crispy edges on the patty and perfectly toasted bun. It has texture without it being dried out. Highly recommend stopping by, maybe ask for light salt on your fries, they have a heavy hand for it here.

Lovely's offers a quality of burgers and service!
I say big plays where you go with your family go out to eat, they have also a bar, You could be outdoor or indoor enjoying your meal! Great place got to go again.

Only complaint, it takes a while to order your food everytime I’m here there’s a line and it takes a while, BUT I think it’s for a good reason. The burgers are made to order and delicious and I think they limit the speed to ensure quality.

I’ve only gotten the burgers here and they are so bomb. They’re fresh great, simple, and they knock it out of the park. I take friends here all the time and ev

The vibe is great, the food and beer is great as well.  The only issue is the the line to order food can be very long.  We were there yesterday and the line wait time was over 30 minutes..  which means somebody in your group has to be away for that long to just get food.  My wife brought me a beer while I waited in line and she watched the kids.  There has to be a better way to handle the food sit

name: Square Pie Guys
address: Dr Huey P. Newton Wy, 499 9th St, Oakland, CA 94607
editorialSummary: Laid-back eatery offering Detroit-style pizzas, sandwiches & salads, plus outdoor dining.
reviews: Square Pie Guys sits right in the heart of Old Oakland, an area that’s perfect for wandering and grazing across different shops and food spots. Inside, the vibe is casual but energetic with an open kitchen lets you watch the pizzas come to life, while a blazing blue neon sign highlights their signature square slices. There’s a steady flow of locals grabbing their boxes to go, mixed with small part

I had been wanting to try Square Pie Guys for years. My wife and I had the day off together and we ended up in Emeryville for some errands. I decided that we should come and try Detroit style pizza. Street parking was easy to find right out front. We opted to sit outside because it was a nice day in Oakland, but it was like 1pm on a Monday so the streets and shop were pretty dead. The inside of th

I’ve always been a deep dish type of gal. I can’t help myself, I like my pizza thick. Definitely liked my service tonight. The same guy that rang me up was the one who brought my food over, which was sweet. He was also the one to get a to-go box for my pizza and container for the leftover salad. The follow-through was peak. It was nice. Glad I don’t have to go far for good pizza. I’ve already conv

Well...I was picking up a delivery and the atmosphere was nice...the servers were attentive and wondered how the pizzas tasted. As I waited...and waited..they kept assuring me the order would be ready soon. After more time I received the order but the manager gave me a personal pizza. It was delicious, the sauce and ratio of cheese and pepperoni was on point! Check them out! I pick up for delivery
This was our first time here. Great pizza and great cheesy bread. The staff was super friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back before we leave for home.

name: Clio’s Books
reviews: A nice bar and hangout hidden inside a bookstore. Yes it’s a real bookstore with a full bar. They serve wine, and delicious craft drinks. Lots of unique seating areas for a day drink date or to chill with some friends. Even to have a solo quiet evening with a good book. Loved the theme here. Such a good vibe.

So grateful to have Clio’s in the neighborhood 🤩 the owner, Timothy, cares about the community and fostering a welcoming space over extracting a profit.
He rents the space out for very affordable prices and it functions as a great event space!
The seating is very cozy and the drinks are delicious - great for date, hang out, or the like.
Go and support this unique bookstore bar and bring friends!

It's a great book store and bar! Good combination of alcohol with intellectualism!
Great decorations with books and ornaments.
All books are for sale! Amazing atmosphere with responsive service and welcoming host.
It's a full bar with all sort of cocktails and drinks. No food just bar snacks / plates.
Great for couples and or dates.

A friend of mine introduced me to this spot, and it's such a cool idea! We definitely need more places like this that mix books and a bar vibe around the bay. I'm really over going to bars and seeing folks glued to their laptops on a Saturday night! Seriously, what's so urgent that you need to work on a Saturday!? Clio has a no-laptop policy, and it's honestly so nice to step into a place where pe

This place is so cool! Has such a nice vibe and i love the concept of what they were going for. I came here for a quick stop before dinner. Seeing $10 drinks was a nice surprise, especially for the bay. The mezcal Manhattan hits. I read some of the other reviews about the manager which is unfortunate. Would love to see a place like this thrive with positive energy.

name: Jong Ga House
editorialSummary: Classic Korean dishes plus all-you-can-eat BBQ offered in a homey interior with traditional decor.
reviews: Authentic Korean barbecue with bold, traditional flavors and high-quality meats. The grilling experience at the table makes it interactive and fun, and the banchan selection really completes the meal. Service was attentive, and the overall atmosphere made it a very enjoyable dining experience. I’d definitely come back.

Very delicious, authentic, and affordable Korean food! I ordered the beef stew and friend got fried fish, both of which were amazing! The service was also fast and professional. Located in a convenient location with plenty of street parking. So much variety on the menu as well! I want to come back to try the other dishes for sure.

We got the all you can eat and the staff was friendly and responsive. We did have to ask for one thing a couple times… but there were soooo many things and it was a busy Friday night! The food was yummy and fresh. The House wine was nice. We walked in at 7pm and got seated immediately.

Absolutely amazing!!! I've come here ever since I was a little kid, and it's really good. This restaurant is a truly authentic kbbq, the waiters do speak fluent Korean. Came here recently around lunch and there was no wait! Me and my plus twos were seated rather quickly. We ordered the all you can eat, which is pretty worth it. Keep in mind that you have to finish eating in 2 hours, and that if yo

Food was good but not out of this world for Korean bbq. I give this a 2 star because where I was sat, the bus boy had to get me out of my chair to get thru which was a horrible experience. And this went on at least 3-4 times. Sometime he would just bump me as if I knew to get up from the back. I don't have eyes in the back of my head.

name: MAMA Oakland
editorialSummary: A modern, welcoming nook serving seasonally minded, three-course Italian dinners & thoughtful wines.
reviews: Had a fantastic anniversary dinner at MAMA Oakland. The food is fresh, flavorful and clearly made with care. While it’s Italian, it has a modern spin and beautiful presentation. We had the entire Restaurant week menu and has only led us to come back again. Its atmosphere is warm and a perfect spot for dinner with friends or a relaxed date. Staff is welcoming and attentive (big shout out to Chris -

Setting: Outdoor Patio / Parklet Dining

The Damage: ~$43 per person (Base 3-Course Prix Fixe Menu)

The Vibe: High-energy neighborhood Italian gem with genuinely warm service.

The Starters: Comfort on a plate
House-Baked Focaccia & Accompaniments: ($6 add-on). This is an absolute must-order for a proper Bay Area restaurant review. The bread features a beautifully airy, high-hydration crumb with

Every dish managed to be both surprising and deeply comforting. The apple–leek–pork belly soup was layered and elegant, and the truffle tagliolini with egg yolk was just amazing: rich, creamy, and intensely flavorful without ever feeling heavy. Sitting at the chef’s counter was fun and impressive to watch the precision and care behind each plate. Service was attentive throughout. Looking forward t

Mama stays winning. 🍝
Exceptional prix-fixe dinner with some of the most thoughtful wine pairings I’ve had in a long time. It’s cozy, authentic, and perfectly executed. Pro tip: Book your table well in advance!

This may be the greatest restaurant in the entire world! You wouldn’t know it just by walking or driving by, but this Michelin star establishment has some of the best food in the entire world! And, it’s a three course meal, but it is extremely accessible in terms of price. The staff are incredible, and the environment is very welcoming and cozy. We literally go here to celebrate every major event

name: Beeryland
editorialSummary: Bustling, dog-friendly beer garden hangout with a variety of grilled eats & a relaxed outdoor patio.
reviews: Great Oakland vibe. Excellent food and beverages. Love that it’s dog friendly. Looking forward to more sunny days on their large outdoor patio. But they also have fire pits for those colder evenings. Perfect spot for First Fridays.

Beeryland is absolutely fantastic. I've been coming here for the star trek trivia for almost two years. The adult slushies are yummy, and so is most of the food. I don't know if the kimchi grilled cheese is still on the menu, but it's a divisive item. My friends like it but I despise it. Use caution. As you can see by the state of my AmInal Fries (yes the spelling is correct), I am one happy custo

When we arrived, there was some kind of clothing swap events. We ordered a kono and fade 2 black and split an order of small fries. Delicious! Very juicy burgers. Recommend eating the burger over the fries to function as a sauce for the fries.

My burger was big enough to be satiating but not overly large to the point of overeating to the point of discomfort.

Quite possibly one of the best cheeseburgers I've had in a long long time. If they ask you how you'd like that meat done -- don't bother.  It's all medium.   I don't know why they ask. Still juicy though.  4 on food just because of that.  A little pink would have made that a 5

Beeryland in Oakland offers a remarkable dining experience that should not be overlooked. The food is exceptional, showcasing a thoughtful menu that highlights both flavor and quality in every dish.

What truly elevates the experience is the outstanding service. Nora, the bartender, exemplified professionalism and attentiveness, ensuring that both my dog and I were well accommodated. Her dedicatio

name: Mama's Boy
reviews:
By far the best pizza in the entire Bay Area! Better than Tony's in the city. Santos and de rest of the staff are extremely welcoming, helpful and attentive as they are hard at work at the same time. Lovely ambiance!
Outside there's two tables if you like. Conveniently located three business down from Broadway and W. Grand on the right hand side. Inside you can sit on one of the two tables or on t

Mama’s Boy is hands down the best pizza we’ve had in the Bay. We drove all the way from San Jose to try it and it was completely worth it. It honestly beats every place we’ve tried in NYC.

We got slices of pepperoni, cheese, burrata, and white. We also grabbed the garlic knots and the chocolate chip cookie and everything was amazing.

The owners were super kind and even let us add the garlic knot

Happy to have the chance to try Mama’s Boy pizza today. It has been talked about by my coworkers and I have seen it gone viral on social media. Expectations were high, and it definitely met them.

The pizzas I got were the garlic slice and grandmas pepperoni. I also ordered a side of garlic knots that comes with 2 or 5.

The garlic slice was great. It was very tasty. If you like the thin slices, t

Genuinely some of the best pizza I’ve ever had, and exactly how a good slice should be.

The burrata slice was perfection. Great touch of honey, high quality crust, and fresh burrata.

Very good pizza. Staff is always great and pizza comes out quick. Pizza is probably the best slice you can get in the Bay Area that has an authentic NYC feel. My only qualm is when eating inside the restaurant sometimes the music can be oppressively loud. Not an enjoyable sound level, but a “eat as fast as you can and leave” loud. Maybe that adds to the experience!

name: Sobre Mesa
editorialSummary: Tropical design touches & plants outfit this chic cocktail lounge with Afro-Latino small plates.
reviews: We enjoyed the DJ and the music selections were amazing! Food was very limited...I think the kitchen was close to closing time... so we ordered off of the not main menu but the happy hour. Beef Empanadas and the stuffed Plantain which was yummy. We had 3 Caribbean Pineapple Old fashions and I am not a newbie to Old Fashions and have an understanding of mixology...When I say strong I mean strong. T

Sobre Mesa is a refined and welcoming restaurant that offers a memorable dining experience built around great food, elegant ambiance, and warm hospitality. From the moment guests enter, they are greeted with a stylish and thoughtfully designed interior that creates a calm yet upscale atmosphere. The lighting, seating, and overall layout are carefully planned to make every visit comfortable, whethe

The menu is so beautifully conceived, but the execution is mid. Basic items like the black beans were very under salted. We tried about 60% of the menu items, and there were some good flavors. But almost everything needed more salt. The cocktails are good, and the service was solid. The plantains were great. But for expensive small plates, I’m gonna need the flavors to pop a LOT more.

Sobre Mesa 10/10

The food was amazing top quality cuisine with every dish done right. The drinks were just as good, well-balanced and crafted with care. Chef Nelson came out to greet us, which added a personal touch that made the experience even better. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the bartender surprised us with smoky shots that were a standout. Good selection of music. I will be re

Great experience.. The drinks were great esp the Sobre Mesa. The tapas were good. We liked the warmed brioche, empanadas, goat cheese,adobo chicken pinchos. The service is great and the ambience and the decor is unique and we really enjoyed our evening here..

name: Sheba Restaurant -مطعم سبأ المطعم اليمني
reviews: My husband and I were searching for a halal place to eat while we were out working and came across this spot — and we’re so glad we did! The food was absolutely amazing. The presentation was beautiful and everything tasted incredible. The servers were also very friendly and welcoming. It was such a great reminder of how much we appreciate and enjoy the amazing foods from different cultures. If you

amazing experience at Sheba Restaurant. The food was fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. The mandi rice, fresh bread, hummus, soups, and sauces were all delicious, and the strawberry drinks were excellent. Everything came out hot and well prepared. The portions were generous and perfect for sharing with family and friends. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, and the staff were very kind and r

Scrumptious food. Hit all the spots with authentic flavors. The lamb was tender and delicious. And to top it all, their hospitality was commendable. Kid friendly and treated kids with kindness. Will be a go to spot from now on.
Worth the drive. Lovely service and staff. Foood was amazing !!! Highly recommend , we will come here once again for lunch /dinner to try their other amazing menu. SUPER CLEAN!
Went here for the hundredth time and you never miss always the best quality the best flavour authentic Yemenie any food? Yemenie  food one of the best in the world

name: Champa Garden
editorialSummary: Known for its sample platter, this bustling, modest eatery supplies a range of spicy Asian dishes.
reviews: Been going to CG for years. I'm stuffed and sleepy so short review.  All the food at CG is good you can't go wrong.  Get the sampler  plate that sausage will change your life the crispy rice that's a meal and a deal. I need a nap.

I used to frequent this place when I lived in the Bay Area, so when I have the chance to go back, I took my friends here. We waited over 40 min for 3 people on a Friday night. Unfortunately, most of our dishes fell flat - it was on the bland side and nothing spectacular. Even the sampler dish was just ok - nam kaow rice was not crispy enough nor was it well seasoned. The only dish we enjoyed was t
Great food, menu has many options, Laotian and Thai selection, the food I got was just a bit sweet for me. Lovely service and food came quick!

I recently tried the chicken Khao Piek at this restaurant, a flavorful rice noodle dish reminiscent of Bánh Canh for those familiar with Vietnamese cuisine. While I was slightly disappointed that it did not include pork blood cubes, the dish was still enjoyable, enhanced by a generous amount of chili oil that added a pleasant kick. The service was warm and attentive, and the cozy atmosphere made t

I’ve loved this placed for so long. Finally came back and promptly left my credit card. When I came back in to get it they were so kind in helping to find it, and then when I ordered to go food with my toddler who was being a handful the server brought it out to my car. Totally didn’t have to do that and it was sooo so kind. Great food. Good people. Couldn’t ask for much more.

name: Portal
editorialSummary: Stylish & innovative eatery with varied menu of bites, patio seating & bottomless mimosa specials.
reviews: The food was amazing, the vibe was great and the server was amazing. The serve was nice and very helpful, the food was a 10/10 try everything, nothing disappoints. The vibe is great and you can see the lake while you eat.

Great place to have dinner! Absolutely enjoyed the trivia night they had. The garbage bread is a must try! The penne pasta is delicious. The burgers are perfect! Let’s not forget the chips and the salsa. Everything was great! Service was superb.
Definitely made my family happy to eat here before we headed out in the morning.
We will be back next time we come out here.
Fun, brunch, lunch and dinner spot. Fun, diverse, quirky trivia nights on Monday. Great service. Cool menu items.

Had lunch here with my sister and we shared the steak and eggs which both were cooked to perfection! Came with a side of smashed home style potatoes which were crispy on outside and soft inside! Also had a side of the garlic knots which were okay but a good snack! Beer flights was affordable and perfect and pineapple mimosa was delicious! Would definitely be back. Also close to lake Merritt so bea

Portal Oakland is a cozy and welcoming place where you can meet up with friends, relax, and simply enjoy the moment. The atmosphere is laid-back, vibrant, and full of positive energy, making it an ideal spot to unwind after a long day or spend quality time with good company.

One of the most remarkable aspects of Portal Oakland is its diversity. People from all backgrounds, cultures, and walks of

name: Tacos Mi Rancho
editorialSummary: Unpretentious Mexican staples such as tacos & burritos, including veggie options, from a food truck.
reviews:
Went in with zero expectations and left planning my next visit.

Stopped by Tacos Mi Rancho near Lake Merritt and honestly didn’t know what to expect. From the outside, it looks like a straightforward taco truck, but wow was I surprised.

I ordered the Carnitas Super Taco, which came loaded with lettuce, cheese, cilantro, onions, sour cream, and guacamole. Everything was fresh, well seasoned, and

This place is very, very popular and is a town Hit. Now with that being said. Make sure the lady on the right side makes your order correctly?  It tends to be a bit busy and they might miss half your meal or even a couple drinks due to the heavy influx of crowds. So when you go to that second window on the right, make sure the lady checks your order thoroughly. Check your receipt. Make sure you go
Was excited to try this place. Tacos were very average. It just doesn't compare to some of the other great taco spots in Oakland.
Hard to find carne Asada fries around Oakland decided to try this place and they did not upset. Presentation and flavor was amazing. First timer and they gained me as a regular customer.

1st time here. Looked really good, smells good, meat taste good, but it's really dry. Even with the two different cheeses and sauces. I wish the meat and cheese was melted better with the fries, then maybe it wouldn't be so dry.

name: Cam Huong
editorialSummary: Casual storefront featuring a lengthy menu of Vietnamese sandwiches & comfort-food entrees.
reviews:
Cam Huong Cafe Deli, Oakland ✨

Cam Huong Cafe is one of my favorite go-to spots for their fried rice and banh mi in Oakland's Chinatown, it was very convenient since it was by my old workplace, unfortunately, that location closed down.

Eventually, they decided to keep the original location in "Little Saigon" open and they also have a small parking lot for their customers.
I usually order their B

Cam Huong has been offering good Vietnamese food to the local community for decades. Their French sandwiches and spring rolls are yummy to say the least. I especially loved their taro drinks. However, it has been out of stock for several weeks recently. Please note: the price has gone up significantly during and after the pandemic. You can easily spend $60 to $100+ if you're not careful about what

This restaurant has the best Vietnamese teriyaki chicken sandwhich I have ever had. I've been to countless Vietnamese restaurants, and this particular one has something special about their sandwiches. For the last decade, I have been traveling through Oakland each time I'm in the area for the sole purpose of buying one of their Gă Teriyakis. The bread has a great crunch, the vegetables are balance

When a place serves really good food, it sucks to make a better review. I ordered 44 minutes ahead of time to prep me for the rush on my call. Customer service told me your bond meets will be ready in 15 minutes I arrive and then they told me your Von these have not been made. You have been put in the priority list. You will be the next one that we serve and I told them that that's not what they m

BBQ pork and shrimp chips!

This is the best bahn mi in town in my opinion. A beloved establishment in Little Saigon, I’m grateful it’s been around for so many years, and the quality has always been top notch through and through.

name: Pho Huong Que
editorialSummary: Pho, spring rolls & other Vietnamese specialties in an unpretentious counter-service eatery.
reviews:
On the better end of pho restaurants around Oakland.

Prices are very fair with the portions you get. They’ve have an extra large option we tried and it’s huge !

Broth is very good and rich. It’s deeply flavored but still clear and not murky so you can bet it’s authentic.

The noodles can be improved tho, the noodles were cold and clumped together, makes me feel noodles pre prepped and they let i

Very delicious, loved the pho it came with a perfect amount of garnishes, the place had these really nice sweet pickles and extra spicy sambal and Sriracha. The tea was not served in a tea cup which I thought was a bit funky lol. The pho flavor had just the right amount of complexity, not overly distinct on any particular spice, just the right blend. There was a nice amount of meat served with the

The main reason for the 3-star rating is because it's not very sanitary. Our server was a young man with a silver earring on his left side who came to work obviously sick with a cold. He kept rubbing his nose with his bare hands while serving people. I kept a close eye and he never handled our food. He was restocking utensils with his bare hands touching the mouth side of all of them. Thankfully a

Good stuff. Small little parking lot. Staff super friendly and chill and nice. Drinks and smoothies tasted good. Pork a bit dry but that's a vibe kinda. Overall food came out fast and experience was pretty standard. Thanks.

The food was absolutely delicious and the staff were super friendly. It’s definitely one of those spots where you can tell they really care about the food they’re serving. We’ll definitely be back soon. Highly recommend if you’re in the area.

name: Comal Next Door
reviews:
a really really good restaurant.
the food is high quality and the presentation impeccable, while portion sizes vary with the dish you order! the picture here is of the bar nachos, these were enough for 3 adults basically
The place itself is really big and not too crowded, the drinks are good too

Staff was really friendly and recommended the carnita bowl when I asked her favorite bowl. It was absolutely delicious. When it came out I did think at first it was a salad and that I maybe ordered the wrong thing. But the bowl is just topped with very nice looking fresh greens.  The chips were extra but when I tried them it made sense. They were fresh and I assume made there, really good!

Everyt

Visited this place with my friend after a bad experience at a wine spot. We just walked and found it while looking for another wine spot. This place is very cute. I loved the employee that greeted us, her hair, her glasses and her overall look. It was very chic. She was very warm and welcoming. She slay provided nice small talk.

They have a Happy Hour that begins at 4 pm, but we were too early. W

A great new locals spot in the old Barlago space on Grand Avenue overlooking Lake Merritt in the Adams Point neighborhood. Outdoor seating for those with dogs and continuing concerns regarding Covid. The Mexican cuisine is excellent as are the specialty cocktails. My favorite beer on tap is the Fuerza Lager. Friday evenings with renown World Music DJ Jose Ruiz is going to create a meetup scene unl

Their veggie burrito is just a bean n cheese stuffed with zucchini and green peppers. The zucchini and peppers are not cooked well and are very slimy and tastes bad. I’ve been here twice and both times it was not good or flavorful in the least bit.
This is the first time in years I couldn’t finish my food. It tasted like slime, water and cheese. Not worth the prices or food.
Thumbs all the way dow

name: Pho King RESTAURANT
editorialSummary: Small, no-frills restaurant serving Vietnamese classics such as noodle soups & egg rolls.
reviews:
Pho King, Oakland

It’s been awhile since I’ve came to this location, I’ve always gone to the original location on International Blvd but that location is alot smaller. This place is pretty spacious and there was outdoor dining.

The place wasn’t crowded so we got seated pretty quick. The staffs were nice and friendly.

What I ordered:
42. Shrimp, Squid, Ground Pork, Fish Ball with Clear Noodles.

I’ve ordered “bun cha Hà Nội” togo.  The pork cakes are so dry & burnt.  The bbq pork slices were dried & salty as well.  I haven’t been here for awhile and I think my to go experience wasn’t meet my expectations & the price has gone up too.

Not sure what happened or maybe went on a bad day.  Ordered grilled beef over rice and XL pho tai chin togo.  5 thin grilled beef slices over rice and 5 raw thin slices of beef for XL pho.  My dine in experience here 3 months ago was good but this is extremely discouraging me to come back for my Vietnamese food fix :/

Pretty good overall. I appreciated that it was easy to pull up and park here, even on a weekend. Portion sizes were solid; really loved the vermicelli bowl. The pho was solid, but might have had a bit too star anise in the seasoning for me, since it tasted a tad more licorice-y than I usually see. A sweeter broth, less complex in flavor. Still pretty good though- I loved the texture and bounciness
Been going here 12+ years, since my oldest kid was in kindergarten. The pho is consistently great, along with all the rice and vermicelli dishes we've tried. Generous portions. A real gem.

name: Philomena
editorialSummary: Neighborhood pizza place with hearty American dishes & drinks served in hip, industrial-chic digs.
reviews:
I normally don't leave bad reviews. So the fact that I'm bothering with this should go to stress how awful this pizza was.

A simple margherita. Shouldn't be hard to get it right, no? No char on the underside. No gluten development, crust is completely deflated. Mozzarella is overcooked and rubbery. Tomato sauce was flavorless. My partner had their mushroom pizza and it was just as bad. Both pizza

Love Philomena! The mushroom pizza and Miss piggy are delicious! But if you love pesto… there are some yum options, too.
I always keep a bottle of Phil ranch in the fridge and use it at home for all sorts of things.
Okay… and then there is the meat lasagna. I swear a little old grandma made that sauce. With cheese, garlicky toasty bread.
I usually want to eat the whole thing but try and put half i

I’m a bit confused. At one point in time I felt like Philomena was easily the best pizza in the bay, and from the photos in others reviews it looks like things haven’t changed, hence my confusion when my order arrives and it is soggy, oily, bready, and the ingredients taste cheep. Do your toast deliveries come from a different kitchen? If so, the quality isn’t up to what I’ve come to expect.
For n

Philomena's is an absolute gem that delivers on every front!
The pizza, top tier, hands down! I ordered the Mushroom Pizza. It has persillade sauce and green onions. I added the Italian sausage, so good. Some of the best pizza ever!

Special shoutout to Rico and Kyle—these two are best in show! Their energy, kindness, and attention completely elevated the experience. It’s rare to encounter such ge

We’ve lived in the neighborhood for over a year and I can’t believe we hadn’t visited here sooner! Before moving to Oakland, the wife, cats, and I lived in Chicago - where there is all sorts of good pizza, not just deep dish. Anyway, Philomena is up to par and has delicious pies, as well as beer and kombucha on tap. For this visit, we got the Miss Piggy with gluten free crust, which was great! We

name: Phở Ao Sen Restaurant
editorialSummary: Vietnamese eatery for a range of classic meals & bowls of pho in an unpretentious space.
reviews: I have up my 3 stars to 5 stars because they are adding more noodles to the pho again. Maybe that stingy chef left? Idk Lol To me Pho Ao Sen is the best Vietnamese restaurant in Oakland maybe even the bay area.  Everything here is delicious. I have tried almost everything here except the coconut noodles cause I don't like sweet food. The pho broth is so good I only add jalapeño and herbs, no other

Really enjoyed this spot. The pork rolls were fresh and had nice chunky texture, and the vermicelli bowl with pork chop and shrimp was super satisfying — the pork chop was juicy and nicely grilled. The pho was also solid, flavorful broth without being too heavy. Overall just really comforting, tasty authentic vietnamese food and generous portions. Cant wait to come back to try fish dishes next tim

The food was so good that I completely forgot to take photos 😅
Everything we ordered was delicious — genuinely not a single miss.

The grilled pork spring rolls were especially impressive and full of flavor. I also really loved the combo rice set — you get a little bit of almost everything, and the whole plate felt super well balanced and satisfying.

Definitely a spot I’d come back to again.

The food is SO good here! I've had the #2 and the #36, and both were amazing (and all the appetizers and side dishes are good that I've tried). I'm going to keep trying different dishes each visit, and I doubt I'll be disappointed.
The atmosphere is very welcoming and nice, with beautiful lighting and plants lining the walls. The staff is pleasant and the food always comes out relatively quickly.

Phở Ao Sen Restaurant serves up solid Vietnamese food with generous portions. I ordered a vermicelli bowl and pho—both were satisfying and flavorful. The restaurant is surprisingly spacious, though the mix of various light fixtures gives the decor a slightly odd feel. Service was efficient and everything came out quickly. I’d definitely come back for another meal.

name: Brother's Deli & Co
reviews: A coworker recommended this sandwich shop and wow the sandwiches were so good! Ordered the hot boy and garlic chicken panini for delivery. They were still hot when I got them, could be the delivery driver, but I’m excited to go in store to try them fresh. The sauce on the hot boy was really good. I love that they used a roll instead of slice bread for their paninis! Want to go back to try their ot

Ordered an Italian sandwich, got a lot of bread with a little filling.  Maybe Italian just isn’t their thing but this sandwich is very disappointing.  Where’s the meat, where’s the mountain of lettuce?  I see photos of sandwiches from a year ago with tons of filling which just isn’t the case anymore.  Better to raise prices than shrink the goods.

Amazing Sandwich and friendly staff. I got a build your own turkey sandwich on Dutch crunch with all the fixings. The turkey was fresh, tender and juicy. The Veggies were fresh crunchy and refreshing and the bread was soft and fresh. The amount of Mayo and mustard was just right. Definitely a hidden Gem. I highly recommend this Deli.

The best sandwiches in the Bay area so so so so good. The Italian slab is amazing. They stack the meat on all their sandwiches. They don’t skimp out on the meat. That is the most important part of the sandwich to me. They are masters at sandwich making their extremely delicious mouthwatering sandwiches I love going there and the people working there. The brothers are awesome.

Twice ordered via the web, once via phone for pickup. In every single experience, I arrived 20-30 minutes later and the pickup order was still in queue and took and additional 20-30 minutes to prepare. Twice I had to flag down the staff to "remind" them I had a pending order. Kitchen staff were disorganized, passing order tickets back-forth, questioning each other about tickets. 60 minutes to make

name: Rockin Crawfish
editorialSummary: Cajun seafood, including oysters, crabs & crawfish, served alongside beer & saketinis in chill digs.
reviews: Came by for the daily 1$ oysters and stayed not just for that but for everything else! The oysters were fresh and delicious, the fries and calamari rings were super crispy too! Wonderful service, great vibes overall. Absolutely recommend this place and we will be coming back!
Super fresh and delicious food at a great price. Service is also really attentive and fast. $1 oysters were fresh and hard to beat. will definitely be back.

Omggggg Affordable DELICIOUS SEA FOOD..... they give you a good portion size for the amount of dollar and they're located in Oakland not far from Lakemerrit. Their food has 3-4 different spice levels as well as a Rocking Sauce and garlic sauce, they also sale Buffalo wings, chicken strips, Cajun waffle fries, and sweet potatoe fries for none seafood eaters, they're a MUST GO TO IF IN THE AREA. CUS
The $1 oysters are limited to three dozens per table and it was so worth it!
$1 oysters all day every day, how could anyone not love that? Happy Hour deals are killer, too. Great seafood boil and gumbo and rice. Right by Lake Merritt.

name: ADMAS RESTAURANT
reviews:
I had such a beautiful dinner at Admas Ethiopian in Oakland. The injera was perfectly fermented — soft with that signature tang — and every item on the platter felt thoughtfully prepared. The lentils were rich and comforting, the beets vibrant, the split peas creamy, and the collards seasoned just right.

As someone who really appreciates plant-based cuisine, I could taste the care and tradition i

Authentic East African taste reflective of expert usage of spice and availability of imported injera. High-quality ingredients (down to the use of olive oil and not seed oil) makes for an even better experience.

Quanta Firfir and Veggie Combo are both rock solid. In a city of so many East African options, Admas is a top contender.

Friendly and attentive staff. Contemporary paintings on walls fro

Admas is exactly what you want in a neighborhood Ethiopian spot. Unpretentious mom and pop vibes with Ethiopian music videos playing on the big screen behind the register and some nice art on the walls. We rolled 17 deep for a friend’s birthday and the staff handled it like pros.

We went with the combination platters, and these things are massive. Beef, chicken, lamb, kale, salad, beans, lentils,

My family went for Mothers Day and had a wonderful meal. The wait staff was very kind and the meal was delicious. Exactly what i was craving. The jebena coffee is great too! Its a lot of coffee, so just know that as well. Overall really pleased with our experience. They even have ful which is awesome, as an arab myself. Love seeing more restaurants open that offer non-american food. Good luck to y
Admas is my favorite restaurant in Oakland. I feel at home whenever I’m there. Stop in, eat delicious food, and connect with the wonderful owner.

name: Tijuana Restaurant
reviews: Went on a rainy Saturday and there was several spaces of parking in the lot adjacent to restaurant. Upon entering, the interior and layout feels a bit hodgepodge with the cashier in the center of the restaurant. The lady who took my order was friendly and verified my order along with the total price before I paid. I ordered Menudo and Lengua Burrito. The Menudo had the option of containing pata/fe
The food is good I'll be back. That hot sauce is way toooooo hot.
The spicy shrimp was a 7 out of 10. Shrimp were not peeled so it was messy and time consuming to eat. Food got cold.

The food wasn't good. It didn't taste authentic Mexican food. The dish that I ordered was Chilaquiles, and it was one of the worst I ever had. The place looks somber and not inviting . The service was ok, but there was a language barrier since the servers only speak Spanish or very little English.  I will not return to this restaurant.
Shrimp 🍤 16/20 scallops and octopus 🐙 with buttermilk 100x100🤤🤤🤤

name: Cholita Linda
editorialSummary: Casual cafe offering Latin American street-food favorites, from fish tacos to Cuban sandwiches.
reviews: It’s an order at cash register and seat yourself atmosphere. The food was mid…. Yuca fries are over cooked and dry… and when i asked for a side of pico de gallo and a small side of cabbage i was charged almost 9$ on top of the 50$ we paid for food. The young black woman was super nice and asked the Latina expeditor about the side and she told her she must charge me for a full salad. Then brought m

Honestly, I’m not sure it lives up to the hype as much as I’d hoped. While the vibe and decor are as bright and inviting as the welcoming staff, the quieted Cuban flavors left me wanting a bit more.

I had the fried pollo cholita plate, but the chicken thigh was overcooked and unfortunately tough and stringy. The beans and rice were excellent though, and I loved the plantains. It’s possible I just

Always looking for great local food when I travel. This was outstanding! Ordered fish, pollo and carne asada. Wow! Juicy. Flavorful. Service was quick and easy. The space was so bright and the back seating area outdoor was perfect of enjoy the weather and food. Highly recommend

Love Cholita Linda! Their Baja fish tacos are only $4.25 each, so I get 2 and they are so fresh and filling. Everything on the menu is excellent though. The cubano is 😘👌 chef kiss so good! I often go here with friends, before walking to the nearby alley for ice cream.

Our go-to place for fish tacos, they are light, crispy, very well spiced and inexpensive for the Bay Area. We always get rice and beans and plantains. Onlt the plantains are sometimes overcooked in my opinion. Top that with a fresh fruit drink and lunch is complete. The place is clean, lively and colorful with great music.

name: MENSHO
reviews: First time here and I got to try their new Spicy Hotate Ramen! Honestly my favorite one :)! The broth was super flavorful but not too heavy. And the flavors get deeper as you mix all the ground beef and spice together. Would definitely get it again!

Best Ramen ever! And their starters are amazing too! If you’re visiting Oakland, you must try this. We love the Spicy Garlic Ramen, and the chips. You have to put your name down and there’s usually a wait, but definitely worth it. Plus, there’s tons to do around the restaurant while you wait, a bookstore, a theater, a wine store and ice-cream.

We were excited to try this place, but we had to wait in a long line for a table. After about 70 minutes, we finally got seated. We ordered a variety of dishes, including corn wings, chicken karaage, vegetable tantanmen, kani tantanmen, A5 wagyu shoyu ramen, and their classic Toripaiten wagyu ramen.

The ramen was a standout dish. It was different from other locations and had a unique flavor and s

Mensho is hands down my favorite ramen spot in the Bay Area. The moment the bowl arrives, you can immediately tell this is not ordinary ramen. The flavor profiles are unbelievably layered, balanced, and intentional. I had the Signature Smoked Toripaitan and the broth was one of the richest and most complex I have ever tasted. Deep smoky notes blend into a silky collagen rich chicken base with an a

I ordered the Vegan Garlic Knockout ramen and the broth is one of the best I have had in the USA. I highly recommend it. I also loved the enoki chips with the pepper sauce. Please be prepared to wait for at least 30 minutes, but the wait will definitely be worth it.

name: doña
editorialSummary: Contemporary Mexican plates, plus cocktails & aguas frescas, offered in spacious, rustic-cool digs.
reviews: Well well well. I finally tried it. I have been told Dona’s is the place to try. And it didn’t disappoint!!!! Great friendly service, no waiting, and the food was superb. Jose recommended everything I loved and it was my first time. Felt like he just read my mind. And when someone no need to mention names made a small error, manager stepped up and fixed it immediately! Churos are to die for and th

Delicious! I was stuffed and could have easily shared my chicken bowl and the chips but I was really hungry. I loved the different salsas they offered. My favorite was their cucumber-tomato salsa (house speciality!)
It is just so delicious . Vegan and GF options are labeled clearly

$100 including tax + tip for everything pictured. This is a self-serve restaurant, order at the counter, get your own water, etc. My friend literally had a bird shit on her while we sat under their patio so we moved inside lol. I liked my chicken tacos and churros

Doña is a great place to experience quality Mexican cuisine. The atmosphere was pleasant, but getting used to the cafeteria-style service is not something I've seen much of. Nevertheless, once I had observed the customs, we eagerly dove into the food, which looked so pleasing. The flavors delivered a top-tier experience. A very nice touch was the vegetarian option for the bowl. Overall, I feel gre

name: Kitava
reviews: My friends and I stopped by Kativa in Oakland, and I’m so glad we did. I went with the build-your-own bowl, crispy chicken, cauliflower rice, sweet potatoes, and brussels sprouts and it was absolutely delicious. Everything tasted fresh and well-seasoned, and I loved that I could customize it exactly how I wanted. The space has a really welcoming vibe with its modern, clean design and friendly staf

OMG! This place was a unique discovery! For those of us who are mindful of our diet, it's hard to find places like this where everything is good. I tried the bowl and the cauliflower rice was amazing. I can only give it 5 stars because otherwise I would give it 10 stars. Highly recommended!!
The meal I ordered was amazing. Fresh, good portion size, and flavorful. A nutrient dense delight.
Incredible gluten free and seed oil free restaurant!!! Amazing food, tons of great options of bowls, salads, sides, even breakfast!

I stopped in today as a first time customer looking for an affordable and healthy meal. I'm glad the Google search led me here. I ordered the build your own bowl but honestly any one of the already prepared recipes would taste just as delicious. Great portions, flavor, fresh and real food. I enjoyed every bite. The atmosphere was chill and lots of natural lighting added to the ambiance (I went in

name: Timeless Coffee
editorialSummary: Cozy cafe & full bakery serving house-roasted java & homemade vegan/vegetarian dishes & pastries.
reviews:
This place is amazing and a go to favorite. It’s 100% plant based vegan / vegetarian. Before I was vegan I’d come for their Peruvian roast drip coffee. We’d buy beans from here. Now that I don’t drink coffee I get yummy matcha drinks.

But it’s their food that is the best. In the fall the pumpkin roll is just insane. I buy them and freeze it for a treat months later. The chocolate croissant is so

Timeless did our wedding cake - and it turned out amazing! Everybody was raving over it, we didn't have a single piece uneaten, and people were shocked it was dairy free. The timeless bakery team is amazing and we would recommend them to anyone thinking about wedding cakes!

Disappointed for the second time.
Chocodile had a decent taste but dry.
Tiramisu cake slice - very disappointing, excessively sweet, 3 of us couldn’t finish it.
Cappuccino - my friend felt like spitting it out.

The cheesecake here is amazing! This was my first time eating cheesecake since going dairy free and I had to keep reminding myself it wasn’t dairy because it was a little bit hard to believe. The coffee was also really good and I like the flavor options they have. The inside is decorated very nicely as well and I love how many tables they have outside.

I love everything at Timeless. Not only everything is delicious, it's also 100% plant based. It gets very busy and I doubt all the customers are vegans or plant-based. I bet most of them don't even realize Timeless is all plant-based. They come here because the coffee and pastries are awesome. As a vegan, I have to get on the freeway and drive here to get my vegan baked goods. Where I live lacks v

name: Temescal Brewing
editorialSummary: Casual gathering spot for housemade brews & popcorn served in a bright interior & outdoor patio.
reviews:
Casual place to grab a beer, a hot chocolate, and even some food. Great outdoor seating area and good for kids and families too.

Fun trivia on Wednesday's at 7 PM as well.
I didn't expect it to be so busy on a Wednesday, but it was fun! the fire pits are nice, they have blankets in case you get cold, and the beer was great!
One of my Fav Breweries and go to place in Oakland, solid selections and amazing vibes here

I found this brewery through the eventbrite website during their Oktoberfest celebration. I was pleasantly surprised at how cute and cozy this little venue is. The beer is really good and I love that they have great events happening every week and its a different theme every night and good music. The menu items are tasty too! I heard the owner "sharing" with a customer that they have different pop

Temescal Brewing was founded in 2016 on the values of Quality, Community & Vibes. During a recent trip to Oakland, we visited on a Saturday and I legit felt the good vibes and community whilst enjoying a flight in their beer garden. I saw with my own eyes several groups of friends happily congregating, and some even brought their toddlers and canine companions. Service was friendly and of the four

name: Moo Bong Ri
address: 4390 Telegraph Ave Ste K, Oakland, CA 94609
editorialSummary: Noodles, fried chicken & other Korean classics in a modest counter-serve venue set in a strip mall.
reviews:
I really wanted to try Blood Sausage Soup after hearing my friend who just came back from Korea, say she had it three days in a row. Luckily, I found a place tjhat serves it!

I ordered the Spicy Blood Sausage Soup, which came with blood susage, broth, offal and meats. I would say the blood sausage had a really interesting texture, chewy but soft at the same time. I don't fully get the hype around

We were seated immediately for a late Monday dinner. We ordered the spicy rose rice cakes and bulgogi. The banchan was served right away after we ordered which was great. Service was good all around from start to finish. Highly recommend when you’re in the area!

We ordered the dumpling rice cake soup for our kids, the naengmyeon, and fried chicken. All were excellent! The bottle of mustard is legit so go with less before adding more. I’m super glad we ate lunch here today. We arrived around 11:20 am on Easter Sunday and there was no wait.

Our food came out fast after ordering. We ordered the soy garlic boneless chicken and I was drooling. The picture doesnt do it justice but it’s really good. We also got rose teokbokki and the teokbokki was the perfect chewiness. Would recommend coming here!
돼지국밥, 매운 순대국 had pretty warm spicy broth. Awesome place, I’d definitely come over again for other stews. One of my besy pick Korean restaurants in east bay.

name: Ohgane Oakland
editorialSummary: Place for Korean BBQ cooked on tabletop mesquite grills, plus stews & other dishes.
reviews:
Best all you can eat korean bbq in Oakland. Huge selection on meat. Yummy ban chan. Very reasonable price for their quality. Service could be slow and inattentive depends on how busy they are.
They also have a huge parking lot so its very convenient!

Food was excellent. But the service was slow. Both myself and my date ordered cocktails and didn't receive them until our meal was almost over. Aside from that, it was an excellent experience. I would definitely go back.

We have gone to Ohgane a few times and loved it each time. Last time, we considered doing al la carte instead of all-you-can-eat, but it quickly became apparent that we would spend way more by doing that. Pretty much everything is delicious. The condiments are great. Atmosphere is fun. Service is a bit slow at first, but it is really busy. We also sensed that, as you near 60-90 mins of eating, the

The servers are very busy, I feel. I asked for gochujang, 3 times, the server would say yes.then oh i forgot.. then i never mentioned it again and it never arrived. Didnt update me if they have it or not.

Having a screen to put your order in is very convenient, downside is it takes 7 minutes to put an order. But if you look at the timer on the screen, the countdown takes 2-3mins for it to move do

This restaurant is always very clean and the staff attentive. The meals are very generous and delicious. I enjoy the beef potstickers, dol soy bibimbob, and the large variety of Bandhan. I also tried my friends mackerel and tofu soup. Both were fresh and tasty. I highly recommend this spot.

name: Kansai
editorialSummary: Sushi bar with a range of rolls & Japanese dishes in a contemporary space that's open late.
reviews: The presentation was beautiful, the portions were generous, and the seafood tasted incredibly fresh. This place deserves so much hype. The flavors were rich but balanced, and everything paired together perfectly. Honestly, this dinner made me so happy.

Tasty and good portion. Servers are really friendly, checked in on us multiple times. Tiger wood roll is surprisingly spicy (has a good kick in a good way.) Children plate has chicken teriyaki, tempura, gyoza, rice and miso soup for ~$15.

Came for happy hour right after 9pm, it wasn't too busy and we were sat down right away. Server came with our water and we asked for straws and our server looked at us like we just spoke gibberish. When we were ready to order, the server said they couldnt take our order because they were training. But the order was all marked on the happy hour menu. We waited for someone else to take our order and

Came here for happy hour as this is one of the only restaurants open in the area after 10 PM

Got the Katsu chicken plate and edamame and it came with a side of miso soup

The edamame was fine, but they could’ve steamed it a little bit longer

Katsu chicken was a little heavy on the breading and one piece of it was slightly undercooked, but overall decent

I pointed this out to the server who came

I've been to Kansai for a total of 6 times. Unfortunately, I found a hair in my to-go sushi last night. Despite the long wait times, I was willing to wait over 35 minutes for my to-go order. I don't know what went wrong, but the rice seemed more wet than normal and the piece of hair was just right there. Now I need to think twice if I ever want to come back.

name: Ebiko
reviews:
All the food looks amazing! Unfortunately, a most of the fishes on the nigiri was kind of tasteless so it's hard to distinguish between the pieces. I didn't like the fish eggs because it was slightly fishy - this might be my personal palette though. The eel with avocado and cucumbers was really tasty.
Note, I suggest looking at what you're purchasing because the fish pieces might slightly differ i

Who needs overpriced omakase when you can get an Ebiko spread at home.

I've been visiting Ebiko for years, and the quality is consistently amazing. This hidden gem is a sushi deli selling a small but very satisfying selection of rolls, nigiri, sashimi, chirashi, and vegetarian-friendly options, along with a handful of Japanese grocery store items.

There's also a kaisen hand roll party tray avail

Extremely delicious and high quality sushi! Was pleasantly surprised since take-out sushi doesn’t tend to be this good. I believe they use real snow crab for the California rolls. Prices are also extremely affordable.

I’m obsessed and will definitely return!

Had gotten this recommended online so I ordered delivery via (Uber Eats) - it’s a takeout spot so I didn’t expect much. The taste and quality was amazing. Value for the selection and choice was so unexpected.

My sister and I went on a little fridate and stumbled upon this place while looking for somewhere new to walk around and try. We’ve heard of Ebiko in SF but never had the chance to go since it’s usually packed, so we were excited to find the Oakland location with much less of a crowd. The prices were really reasonable, especially considering how fresh everything was. We absolutely fell in love wit

name: Pizzaiolo
editorialSummary: Contemporary pizzeria earns fans with wood-fired pizzas & seasonal Italian eats in a lively setting.
reviews: Excellent service and tasty food! The amaranth porridge (gluten free) was such a comfort food for my soul and the breakfast sandwich burger my friend got was the bomb. Good portion for the price. The servers were super sweet. Will come back again!
It's been a while since I've been here, and the food is as wonderful as I remembered. Fresh ingredients very well prepared. I'll be back!

I’m trying to describe how good this meal was without swearing. The fried chicken was uniquely good—not just the chicken but the whole dish was so well balanced and thoughtful. The banana toffee pudding is something that I’ll remember for a long time. I think our server’s name was Ryan and she made the whole experience incredible. It’s a really special spot and I’m grateful for the curation that g
Had a lovely experience. Food was high quality and delicious. Wasn't fond of the salty olive oil gelato, but the happy hour spritz cocktail was refreshing.

Such a beautiful dog-friendly patio and truly exceptional service—some of the best we've experienced in a long time.

My husband loved the pepperoni pizza, and I really enjoyed the pistachio pesto pasta.

A couple of areas for improvement:
-The pasta portions could be more generous.
-It would be great to see more vegetarian pasta options on the menu.

name: Brenda's Oakland
editorialSummary: Counter-serve cafe for breakfast fare, fried chicken & po' boys, plus milkshakes & a kids' menu.
reviews:
Brenda’s Food in Oakland was a great experience overall! The fried chicken Benedict was the highlight crispy, flavorful, and really well done.

The sides of potatoes were a bit soggy, and the beignet was slightly over-heated, which took away from the texture a little.

Even with those small issues, the flavors were good enough that I would still come back. Friendly spot and definitely worth anothe

One of my favorite spots in Oakland for brunch.  The food is always delicious and doesn't disappoint.  In highly recommend the freshly baked beignets.  Service was great and the server checked up on us a few times throughout our meal.  The place has a relaxed vibe inside and really nice patio outside.  So, if you haven't been, check it out!

Go to Brenda’s for an absolute feast! Brenda’s is legendary for a reason, and we definitely hit the high notes of their menu, indulgent, and soul-food energy.

If you’re looking for a brunch that feels like a warm hug (followed by a very necessary nap), Brenda’s French Soul Food is the gold standard. Our recent spread was a deep dive into the best of New Orleans-inspired comfort, and it did not di

The Oakland food scene is alive and well. This is one of those must visit spots in city with ever growing culinary scene.

Brenda’s is a great mix of Cajun and country flavors in one place. Everything from breakfast to dinner is done with taste bud enhancing fair.

Our group tried a great mix of Brunch, and no one left unfulfilled. Standard country breakfast of bacon and eggs was good, the home ma

I ordered Breakfast. Although it was affordable, there was nothing special about the breakfast.  I ordered scrambled hard cheese eggs, they were a little burnt. My scrambled should not be brown. The bacon was too crispy. My Ube Beignet was not soft. The cheese grits was too runny and the cheese just sat on top, not mixed in. The Catfish had a lot of flavor but was fried too hard. I really felt lik

name: The Wolf
editorialSummary: A charming neighborhood brasserie offering French-Californian fare & wine in modern, airy quarters.
reviews:
Solid spot serving seasonal fare.

Pickletini and the don’t call my name Cilantro were some standout drinks.

Panko Halibut was fire.
Steak was tender and the butter really elevated the dish.

Staff was very friendly and welcoming. Server had solid suggestions and was well-informed of the menu.

Will definitely be back to try the burg.

It's an American fusion semi-fine restaurant with full bar and good variety of cuisines and drinks.
Food was fresh, delicious and presentable.
Bar seats, indoor and patio/terrace seating.
Small private room available for events.
Parking is a bit challenge but still plenty in street parking, parking lots.
Great for date night and occasions. Not good with kids.
Steps up entry not easily accessible.

We had dinner at 8pm on a Thursday night and the restaurant was packed to the gills, which made for a lively, fun atmosphere.

Food was better than I expected and the fried octopus was fantastic!! Popover, however, was very dry and definitely not worth $7 for a single popover. Burger was tasty and cooked well, but the fries that came with it were overcooked, dry and tasteless. I didn't taste the h
Amazing food. Lots of vegetarian options. The service was good. We had a great window spot.

I celebrated my birthday at The Wolf in Oakland, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The steak dinner was absolutely amazing—perfectly cooked, flavorful, and easily one of the best steaks I’ve had in Oakland. The quality of the food, attention to detail, and presentation exceeded my expectations.

The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it the perfect place for a special

name: Homeroom
editorialSummary: A variety of imaginative mac & cheese options, salads & sides in a relaxed locale.
reviews: My waitress was horrible, I was dining alone and she pretty much ignored me entirely while being kind and chatty to other customers. She didn't give me water as she did every other table, she got my order incorrect, and didn't check on me at all during the meal despite checking on the table next to me. At the end she offered me a free dessert, which was a kind gesture but did not make up for the b

I have never left a bad review for a place before, but everything has a limit, and the service at this establishment is absolutely horrible. The only redeeming quality was that the food was wonderful; however, the servers are completely untrained to answer questions about the menu. Whenever I asked them something, they would simply say they didn't know and then walk away, ignoring me. The menus ar

I've been hearing about this place for 10+ years, and FINALLY got to try it! We went on a Wednesday around noon and it was empty. Sounds like on weekends it can get packed, so plan accordingly.
