Can't even start this review without a shoutout to our waitress Bridgette-- she was so full of joy and made us feel welcome. It was literally like getting served by family.

The mac... THE MAC! So flavorfu

Got the garden pesto Mac to-go, and chose the heat at home option. It came with the proper instructions to heat in the oven, and I loved it! The pesto flavor was great and the tomatoes made it nice and juicy.

So glad they had vegan options! We ordered the basic vegan mac with gluten free pasta and added fried onions! It was fantastic. Great portion size and the plate came out sizzling. The staff was so friendly! It was a bit busy but definitely worth the wait. It was our first time eating here and surely won’t be our last. Thanks so much!

name: Mariposa Baking Company
editorialSummary: Gluten-free bakeshop for sweet & savory goods, from pastries to croutons, plus a daytime cafe menu.
reviews:
My GO-TO bakery.
For like EVERYTHING.
For 7 years straight.

My faves: the fruit/cheese danish, the cheese scone, the buttermilk biscuits, the cheesecake, I mean, my bday cake was from here.

Kinda pricey, ngl. But very worth it. If you are gluten-free & want tasty baked goods.

They also now have a stuffed bacon, egg and cheese bagel that’s amazing.

Follow me on IG: @freshdotdaily

I had not been at Mariposa for a while and I was reminded how good it always is! 🙂 Ideal for my diet restrictions. Besides the California sandwich on open baguette (shown in the picture), it is hard to resist to chocolate croissants, bagels and other pastries!

The prices have like everywhere increased quite a bit! $6.50 for a chocolate croissant is ...... luxury! To be noted, senior discount bei

3.5⭐️ Selection: insane, prices kinda high even for gf but not atypical..but doesn’t match the taste, which was only ok.

There must be over 60 different gf items in this bakery! Some are other packeged brands, most are theirs.

We tried a few things and they were ok good but nothing I need to return for. I’m a decent cook/baker so I know how good gf bakes can taste. I will say the vibe and settin
I love this place where everything is gluten free! I buy fresh, hot food & get a bag of goodies to go home with! This location is so much easier to find & get to than their ferry building location!

I was craving a sweet treat and couldn’t resist the gluten-free cinnamon roll! It was so good—generously sized and perfect for sharing. The bakery offers a variety of gluten- and dairy-free options, which is rare in the East Bay. I’m happy that Mariposa Baking Company exists and has a great selection of dairy-free and gluten-free treats.
.

name: Joodooboo
reviews: I recently picked up a lunch order from Joodooboo in North Oakland, and the entire experience was fantastic from start to finish. I placed my order online a few days in advance, which was incredibly easy and stress-free. When I arrived, the pickup took literally seconds, and finding free, easy street parking right around the corner made the quick stop completely hassle-free. The clerk at the count

It has been on my want to go list for a while, and I finally had the chance to check it out. The restaurant has a casual atmosphere, but the food presentation feels very thoughtful and artful.

I ordered the Nori Acorn Noodle Bowl and also tried the Fried Dooboo Set. I liked the acorn noodle bowl more; the chilled noodles, nori vinaigrette, kimchi, and pickled mushrooms made it super refreshing an

A spot in Oakland that I’ve been curious for a good amount of time and finally got the chance to go to! They serve very healthy/traditional Korean meals and some of their banchan. Taking one star off because it is a little pricey for the portion they give you ($24)

I got the fried dooboo set which comes with fried tofu as a main and a couple sides of banchan (rly loved the spinach one on the top
Amazing food and a very warm welcome every time I visit. Everything is delicious, and the staff is always kind and friendly. Highly recommend!

This is unpretentious, delicious fresh food. Everything is simple and beautifully presented. I had the set menu, which included a salad, mushroom soup, kimchi, fried tofu, vegetables, and rice. While each dish is light, the sum total is a perfect amount for lunch. Can also add additional banchan sides.

name: North Light
editorialSummary: Intimate neighborhood nook for coffee, cafe fare & cocktails, plus retail books & records.
reviews: Cute little spot in Temescal area. Lovely cocktail menu with a solid but semi limited food menu.  Happy hour (before 6pm) menu saves a few bucks.  We got the tots which are fantastic, as well as the sesame ginger salad- also delish.  Service was outstanding, back patio was comfy and super cute.  Great experience overall.

The things I really liked about this bar was the friendly staff, had a nice variety of drinks, and the food, like the garlic fries were really good! it's not a super large space but is nicely located in the Temescal, Oakland neighborhood. We were disappointed by the slow service, however. It would take a long-time between drink / food orders, which may simply be a result of not enough bar tenders

This was a perfect place to gather with a few close friends when returning to the Bay area. Cozy and friendly vibe, funky and eclectic indoor space and beautiful patio with booths and tables. The cocktails were excellent and my friends enjoyed the food.they tried, the burger and a salad. Great addition to the Telegraph neighborhood.

I couldn’t love this place more.
It’s all about perfectly crafted cocktails and a lonely indie atmosphere.
They a little library with great titles that you can borrow or buy. Definitely a conversations starter. The drinks are like no other and they use only high quality ingredients, come to try some creative drinks spin on your classics and have a cute time. Very friendly and nice, the service is

Great cocktails!!!  I love the record player driven tunes, the book store, and the food is really delicious too.  It's a cute place but when it gets crowded as it often does, it can be really loud.  I take everyone I can here who hasn't been because it's such a high quality spot.  Nice crowd too.

name: Zachary's Chicago Pizza
editorialSummary: Employee-owned since 1983, stuffed or thin-crust pies are made to order with a special tomato sauce.
reviews: We went on a Monday afternoon about 3:00 and it was practically empty, so we received ROYAL treatment. First time there, and it did not disappoint! Pizza was about 30 minutes, but I appreciated the heads up! Amazing! Also, please try the Dill Ranch if you order a salad. Wait staff was what it should be—friendly and happy to be serving their customers. Only bummer part….we don’t live here! We’ll be

Delicious pizza! My husband went 6 years ago and now that we are both visiting the area he brought me and I can confirm it's absolutely exquisite! We ordered a Zachary's special. Staff was super nice even on a Monday at 8.30. Will definitely come back soon

Finally tried this gem!
Must try the stuffed mushroom and spinach. The crust and sauce are too good to be true!
The chicken barbecue is also so good and I liked how it still had some marinara and went well with the sweetness of the barbecue sauce.
2 mediums was too much for 2 people but having this pizza for 3 days sounds lovely!
Lovely place and staff!

I’ve visited Zachary’s Chicago Pizza a few times, and this time, my friend recommended the pesto pizza, which was absolutely delicious. The College Ave location definitely felt fresher compared to other spots I’ve been to. Our server was fantastic—super friendly with a big smile, which made our experience even better.
However, the cashier wasn’t as pleasant. She was a bit rude and seemed to ignore

Zachary’s Chicago Pizza at 5801 College Ave in Oakland is a must for any pizza-loving tourist! Their Chicago-style stuffed pizza is unreal—thick, cheesy, with a buttery crust and chunky tomato sauce that hits all the right spots. I got the Zachary’s Special with sausage, peppers, and onions, and it was pure comfort food heaven. The vibe is cozy and family-friendly, with cool pizza-themed art all o

name: Kitchen Story Oakland
editorialSummary: Down-to-earth chain outlet dishing up a fusion of Californian & Asian specialties.
reviews:
This was a cute restaurant! The prices were reasonable (for the bay).
While I'm not a coffee drinker, my partner rather enjoyed it and described it as strong. I am a tea drinker however, and while the tea was good, I rather wished there was a better way of serving it, as the hot water in the clay tea cup made for rapidly cooling tea before it could steep :/

The service wasn't BAD persay, but coul

Wanted to try something different for Sunday brunch. The noodles with the egg, bacon and pork had just enough savory flavor to knock your socks off. The service was ok. The waiter forgot to process my order so I had to ask about my food after watching other people around me get seated and served before myself. He was apologetic and did comp my meal so he did make it right. Just disappointed becaus

Phenomenal brunch flavors are worth the wait (and sore bum)!

Kitchen Story is an epic brunch spot. If you're planning a weekend visit, I definitely recommend making a reservation, or be prepared for a bit of a wait.

I met a friend here for Sunday brunch, and we ordered an assortment of plates and beverages to share. Everything was delicious and repeatable, but here's my order of personal prefere

Kitchen Story is a great spot for brunch, offering delicious food and generous portions. However, reservations can be hard to come by, and if you walk in, be prepared for a potentially long wait. The food quality is excellent, and the menu features a variety of tasty options to satisfy different cravings. The outdoor seating is a nice bonus, especially on a pleasant day, providing a relaxed dining

Yummy yummy food! I split the chicken and waffles as well as the salmon benedict on a date and it was sooooo tasty. We also ordered the matcha tea latte and a lychee tea.

The drinks were yummy and well presented!

The fried chicken was crispy, but light and delicious. The waffle was yummy too. I loved the syrup as well.

The salmon benedict was absolutely super delicious. The freshness of the fis

name: ACRE Kitchen and Bar
reviews: We had an absolutely amazing experience and cannot wait to return. It's my new favorite restaurant in the Berkeley area, we came in for a college grad celebration and they were so accommodating with a large group and changes to our reservation, and they wrote all 6 of the girls handwritten cards. It was SO special and the food and wine were absolutely incredible and so fresh. Will absolutely retur

What a PERFECT New Year’s Eve celebration. I took myself out to dinner alone and I was seriously convinced no one was possibly having as great as a night as I was lol! The drinks, the food, the atmosphere…absolutely perfect every single time, but especially tonight. I have to mention, I was so impressed when my bartender must have noticed me babysitting my drink and at some point just poured it in

Loved this place! The food is fresh, innovative and delicious! The mood is open air and relaxed, with great people- watching window or patio seats. There is also a beautiful dining room upstairs. The only negative is that the mood was so relaxed that the 4 people in the service area waited entirely too long to give us the check so we hit traffic on the way back. The location is fun, tucked in a cu

The host went out of his way to accommodate us when we arrived 30 minutes before our reservation. We sat at a table in the bar area and our bartender/waiter was attentive and professional. The fried olives were excellent but brussels sprouts were no better or worse than any other establishment. My Caesar was outstanding--you could taste the anchovies and the twist to use different greens and feta

We had a good time here. The cocktails were tasty and the food was pretty ok. Wife liked her fish entree and the olives appetizer. I found my burger (and the bun) to be a little dry and not especially flavorful but not terrible. I enjoyed the ice cream with olive oil and sea salt, it was one of those surprisingly good combinations.

name: The Monk's Kettle
reviews: The Monk’s Kettle is my new favorite restaurant in Oakland. This is definitely a hidden gem, and a MUST. We came here to eat the Lamb Shank we once tried and that stuck in our memory forever. And yesterday we realized it was even better than we could remember. The lamb shank was so tender that it could separate from the bone effortless, we did even need to chew it. It was laid on a bed of marinate

Unsuspecting from the outside but full of charm inside.

From the old wood bar/tables to the glasses behind the bar, you'll feel welcome.

They have cute kettles sprinkles throughout.

Seating is first come.

Did I mention they have a lot of veggie options and piny the elder on tap?

Server was patient with our group of 5.

Recommend for a spot with brews n food.

Legend has it that the carved wood encasing the shelves behind the bar once framed a (pretty spectacular) fireplace.

A remarkably dynamic selection of beers, foreign and domestic, are served in complementary glassware.  If you enjoy your beer as much as I do, you'll appreciate this level of, well...  appreciation.  🤔
The fare is outstanding as well.   *Try the special*

Good food, I'd probably give 4.5. Solid chicken burger, meat was juicy and the sauce was really fun. The moussaka was also really good. The impossible meat was super soft in a way I haven't seen done before, and the eggplant and crust went really well together. It was almost too salty, but I liked it. I think none of the dishes were mind-blowing, but just exactly what you'd expect, done right. I'd

Decent food and nice ambience but the service was rushed and almost non-existent. Stopped in for lunch today as I was craving for a burger. Been wanting to try this spot out ever since it moved into the neighborhood.

When I walked in, the place was empty but it was fairly early (before noon). Cute rustic feel with lots of tables, booths, and a nice corner bar. Wouldn’t say that I was greeted warm

name: Millennium
editorialSummary: Vegetarian restaurant for inventive, locally sourced dishes in a rustic-modern space with a patio.
reviews:
Millennium has reopened! After closing their doors about a month ago, they have returned with an updated concept. You have a few dining options to choose from: enjoy the covered and heated patio while eating from the three course or five course fixed menus. Or relax at the bar and order off the a la cart menu.

I choose the former, three course menu. I started off with a non-alcoholic beverage, ve

Last time I was here about 18 months ago the food was just ok.  Amazing surprise this evening in a good way.  As a non vegan the food has to be really good to make
an impact.   We had a great  meal and so many good flavors.  We will be back

Ok we have to talk about the dark chocolate tart, it was the best! The drinks are unique and the food was delicious. Loved the risotto. We come here quite often and enjoy the unique rotating menu. If you love vegetarian food, this is the spot.

Delicious vegan restaurant with a fantastic selection of starters and truly outstanding desserts. The flavors are well balanced, the presentation is thoughtful, and every dish feels carefully crafted. A great spot if you’re looking for high quality plant based food that doesn’t compromise on taste.

Millennium Restaurant in Oakland offers an excellent vegan dining experience. We loved the flavorful starters and well-crafted main courses. Desserts were just okay, but the cozy ambiance and overall quality made it a very enjoyable meal.

name: Wood Tavern
editorialSummary: Californian-inspired menu of sustainable fare plus wine in a modern-rustic setting.
reviews: Arrived about 3:10pm, after lunch before dinner service, not a full menu available. I tried their pastrami sandwich which was really tasty and fries. Everything was good. Nothing blew my socks off though. Will be back to try dinner. Make your reservations ahead of time, the place is small, I thought it would be bigger. Some paid parking available along the street.

We got to the Oakland restaurant right before they opened for lunch and were greeted warmly by the staff. They gave us our choice of a table right by the window or a spot further inside the dining room. We picked the window, which turned out to be an awesome people-watching node while we looked over the lunch menu.

Our waiter was incredibly friendly and helpful. We ordered the pastrami sandwich a

Probably the best New American restaurant in the East Bay. Their steak never misses—perfectly cooked, delicious, and big portions. Rotating dinner menu (except steak and pork chops) and even the veggies included differ depending on what they have available. The scallops and risotto are always so good when it’s on the menu. Bonus: complimentary bread and butter.

It’s always packed and busy, even o

The menu is pretty limited. I tried the Hot Pastrami sandwich. It was too fatty for me. I couldn't finish it. Their bar didn't handle sangrias, so I ordered the spritzer which was made with a pinot. Not bad, but not great either, and not cheap by any stretch. Four of us at lunch had two drinks and 4 entrees and the bill was around $170. That seems pretty steep for a very limited menu and bar.

Our
We think this is one of places pre and post pandemic. Our day server was a bit sparky, the night staff amazing. They make incredible food and cocktails with no pressure.

name: Yimm Oakland
editorialSummary: Homespun Thai food, rice plates & salads in cozy, minimalist surrounds with an outdoor patio.
reviews:
I've been wanting to try this restaurant for a while, and I finally got the chance to check it out!

I started with the Tom Yum cocktail, made with rum, apple juice, lime, chili, and lemongrass. It was refreshing, flavorful, and delicious.

For the entrées, we ordered the Avocado Green Curry and the Pad Kee Mao. We asked for spicy, and they delivered! The Pad Kee Mao was packed with flavor, and th

Beautiful restaurant and amazing food. Each dish was very delicious.

Our favorites were the beef salad and the pumpkin slices. Surprisingly the pumpkin was the star. Very crispy and the sauce that comes with it is a nice tough. Great appetizer you should get.

Beef salad hits all the notes a Thai dish should hit. Would recommend this as well.

Vibes were great here. Great music and they have a fu

Overall decent Thai food at Yimm. Both their flat noodle to pad kee mao/drunken noodle and the side thin noodle were well cooked to give the al dente chewy texture. Another highlight was the seasoning of the pad kee mao - tasteful and right-on-spot spicy.

That being said, there's plenty of room left to be desired. Both the chicken and beef we ordered were well overcooked, dry, rubbery, and plain.

Not bad, really appreciated how it was not as oily like many other Thai restaurants. Would say the curries are spicier than the usual Thai places here, which I liked.

However, the portions (especially the soups) are on the smaller side for the price. Also I saw people recommended Lord’s noodles but it was honestly kind of average, the pork belly was dry and flavorless. But the avocado green curry

Cute, bright spot for a quick and flavorful dinner.

This place came highly recommended and it didn’t disappoint. The food was great and came out quickly — it was perfect, as we were getting close to our showtime at the Berkeley Playhouse.

I had the praram plate, a delicious peanut-curry-chicken dish (and the closest thing I’ve found to Massaman curry here in the Bay!). Would highly recommend. Th

name: Mẹ Và Con Vietnamese Kitchen
reviews:
Decent Vietnamese food. The service wasn't quite up to par; they didn't deliver our food without a reminder as we saw the later parties (who arrived after us) got their food while we waited over half an hour. My water cup had a crack in it.
Food wise, I recommend their spicy shaken beef pho and sizzling brisket. Their chili hot sauce has a kick but tolerable.

We were delighted to discover Me Va Con  : Mother and Daughters Vietnamese Restaurant, on Telegraph Avenue in Oakland. I ordered tgeir chicken salad and it was delicious! The dining room was spacious. They have a large parking lot and the service was fantastic!

Good Vietnamese food along Telegraph road with plenty of parking spots. We ordered 4 different food and their broth is good as expected.
They make your food as you order to ensure freshness, so be patient.
Enjoy !

The service and atmosphere were both great — very Instagrammable. However, the food was just okay and not exactly cheap. I ordered the beef pho and Vietnamese spring rolls. The spring rolls were average and didn’t leave much of an impression. The beef pho left my mouth feeling dry, and the flavor was quite bland.

What a fantastic find! Such  fresh ,delicious Vietnamese food that tastes just like a home-cooked meal, with a little something extra. The friendly service makes you feel right at home. The sizzling short rib was absolutely delicious—while it had a bit more pepper than I'd prefer, it was still a great dish
❤️pancake dish

name: FOB Kitchen
editorialSummary: Hip, turquoise-&-tropics-inspired stop offering classic Filipino fare plus island-style cocktails.
reviews: While the food here is good, the service is even better. Diego and crew are exceptional. Our group of thirteen  enjoyed our appetizers, mains, and dessert (halo halo) but found a number of the dishes to be underseasoned. However, this is preferable to overseasoned. The eggplant salad with sea beans and rice  crackers was the standout dish. The Shanghai lumpia was delicious. The vegetable lumpia wa

Went her for Oakland Restaurant Week. The location is easy to miss because it is in a small corner plaza. Parking is very difficult because it shares the small lot with five other places. There is minimal street parking around the perimeter. The staff was great, they were excited about the menu and restaurant week and explained all the different options for their special restaurant week menu. The

The lady and I hit this place up. I've never done Filipino cuisine before. I don't stray too much from cheeseburgers and nachos. But I's like "aiight". Plus, we saw it on "Bay Area Check Please" and had it as a place to check out. She had the pork adobo and plain rice. I tasted a chunk of pork with the gravy and rice. It was tasty. Nah'mean!?? For me, I got the fried chicken and a bowl of garlic r

We saw FOB Kitchen on Check, Please recently and had to try it! What we wanted to try were the Vegan items as well as the other Filipino items!
I had the Longanisa Benedict for a Sunday Brunch, what a tasty meal! The vegetable Lumpia was a good appetizer and the Kabocha Squash side also very tasty.

We recently dined at FOB Kitchen, a Filipino restaurant located in Oakland's Temescal neighborhood, and overall, it was a flavorful experience.

Dishes We Tried:
* Shanghai Lumpia: Crispy, bite-sized spring rolls filled with a savory mix of pork and vegetables, paired with a tangy dipping sauce that elevated the dish. Personally, I think there should be more meat. The garlic rice was amazing!!!
*

name: A16
editorialSummary: Upbeat, contemporary eatery pairing pizza & Southern Italian plates with a lengthy wine list.
reviews:
Chef Yosuke and his culinary team made our night very special.

Simple and delicious food, beautiful restaurant, great selection of Italian wines, and delicious cocktails.

Dolce Whisper or Dolce Whisperer? I can't rememberbthe name 😁, but that cocktail was so good.

100% recommended!

I ate here yesterday with my husband for the first time and it was very tasty.

We marked close by in the neighborhood. It was easy for us to find. I’m not sure what people are referring to when talking about windows getting smashed in a parking lot? But I did see broken glass in the library’s parking lot next door? FYI.

The food though was excellent. We got the fried olives, beet salad, pork cho

Almost every time we're in Berkeley, we come here as a family to eat. We had two college undergraduates, and typically end up celebrating most occasions here. Lots of options including vegetarian, vegan, friendly dishes. The salmon is perfectly crispy, moist, flavorful on a bed of vegetables. The pizzas, and specifically the pizza dough, are perfectly light, chewy, and flavorful. This place is suc

Fried olives were so good I almost choked to death, pizzas are good, just go ahead and order everything. Salmon was my fave! Finished with strong coffee and tiramisu. Drinks are all tasty as well. Staffs all super cool and the art they have up is dope!

A16 is Southern Italian food meets California. In a good way! The pizzas are excellent, with the true Neapolitan oven, especially recommended is the Montanara pizza which is briefly fried before being put in the pizza oven. Excellent also the appetizers, especially the squid with fried beans. And outstanding choice of Sicilian wines.

name: Cactus Taqueria
editorialSummary: Mexican spot serving signature crispy chicken tacos & a variety of salsas from the counter.
reviews: The orgasm in my mouth was electric from bite one. Thankfully was sent by a friend to try the CRISPY shrimp taco. The details of salsa, the lettuce was chefs kiss perfect. The homemade fresh salsas, dulce de leche, and flan was too die for. Another taco heaven!

Decent place. Interior was clean. Clean rest room.
Pretty standard Mexican food in terms of selection and taste. Some salsas were well done. They provides additional ones when we asked. Sides were a bit pricey I thought.

As a Mexican who has been struggling to find decent taco places around, this is not bad at all! Prices are below average despite everything being so expensive in the Bay Area, quality and flavor are great (similar to what you’d get in Los Angeles). The asada and pastor tacos are delicious. I ordered online and everything was so throughly packed I was left with a great impression.

The atmosphere i
Carnitas burrito had very little carnitas. They loaded it up with rice and beans. This is a good location in Rock Ridge I was hoping the food would be better.

The staff was very racist and upcharged because of my skin color. When I asked for a receipt or a refund because they charged me 25 for a regular burrito they said they couldn’t. When I tried to cancel they refused and they kept saying it was a machine problem. They simply looked at my skin tone and charged me more. I felt like what I said was made to feel like I was being intense. They made me fe

name: SAFFRON KITCHEN, RESTAURANT & BAR
address: 5940 College Ave Unit J-I, Oakland, CA 94618
reviews:
Tasty and delicious food. Perfect for a good afternoon. Portions are plenty.

Great service, attentive, kind and always smiling. Timing was perfect, there were no big gaps.

Location was a walking distance from our hotel. Lovely walk to the city centre. And they have indoor and outdoor sitting.

Amazing grilled kabobs! We got the qourma and kabob sampler platters and were satisfied. The sabzi tastes just like my mom makes it. The lamb chops were my favorite. I would recommend if you’re looking for some traditional Afghani cooking!

This was such a delightful find. The atmosphere is inviting with many options both inside and outside. The staff were very welcoming, knowledgeable about the menu and very attentive. The food was so good, fresh ingredients, tasty and seasoned to perfection. The optional red, green and yogurt sauces were fun and added a nice kick if you want it. The spinach was amazing. The Greek salad was yummy. T

Authentic Afghan restaurant with great variety of cuisines. Full bar with bar seating, high tables, indoor and odor seating and space for private party. Service was quick and responsive.
Foods were delicious and fresh. Combination plate has all sort of kababs with delicious ghabele polo (seasoned rice).
Good for groups, couples, date night, meetup and kids.
Accessible with ramp, paid and free stre

I have been wanting to try this restaurant for a while now and finally had an opportunity. I am sorry I waited so long.
The food was delicious. Everything I ate was seasoned just right. The flavors of the ingredients were allowed to shine. Every bite was a delight to my senses.
The staff was very attentive to my dietary requests and I was able to modify the dishes to be gluten free without a fuss.

name: El Pollo Loco
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain outpost known for Mexican classics made with fire-grilled chicken.
reviews: I ordered a delivery and though it was going to be 'fast food'. I was so impressed with the quality of the ingredients and flavors in all the dishes. Better than my home cooking. Delivery was fast and tidy. I wish all fast food was this healthy !

Decided to stop by here to pick up food for later for work. Didn’t realize until now (5hrs later) that they forgot to give us the churros we ordered.
Should have checked after they forgot to give me my drink n I had to ask for it! They sure did charge us for it though. I tried calling and they don’t answer the phone.

Got the Grande Avocado Chicken Bowl, Chipotle Chicken Avocado Burrito, tacos al carbon, quesadillas i think, and Chicken Avocado Burrito with a side of mac n cheese which was a lil too cheesy for me 🥴 the cashier girl was pretty friendly and it was very clean! The tacos al carbon where a little dry as all the ingredients were inside a white tortilla! i loved my avocado chicken bowl, very filling

I love El Pollo Loco. I've been coming to this unit since it opened maybe 15 or more years ago. They specialize in training a great staff to make and serve their delicious food. The store is always super clean too. It's well worth your time to visit here.

Staff had a good sense of humor
Service was quick
And the food was great
Play Ariana grande

name: Tacos Sinaloa
editorialSummary: Walk-up food truck doles out classic tacos, burritos & other Mexican comfort eats at the counter.
reviews: How the mighty have fallen this place used to be spectacular. Some of the best tacos and burritos in Oakland. Really disappointed in the fact that I spent $17 for a regular burrito. Just a little bit bigger than my small iPhone. Service was good. Just sad I couldn't use the bathroom. The only thing that I could say is the same is the flavor. It is still really good but just so upset that the burri

Disappointed with the food, drove pretty far to get here.  Surprised that they had a line...
Customer service was good.
They are apparently known for ceviche, and it was sad, it was not that cold, flavorless, and not good at all.
The tacos were okay, I've had better.

Very quick, they accept a variety of payments.

Tacos are amazing. Best I’ve had in the bay for sure. They are reasonably priced. I’ve been a customer of Tacos Sinaloa for years and they always deliver. 20/10 would recommend. Great food, great vibes.

Y’all be lying 🤥. I looked up who’s got the best carne asada burritos in Oakland and these guys pop up. I sent my boyfriend and we got the super carne asada. They sent it with absolutely no salsa. This was the most dry burrito I’ve ever had. We spent $30 on the burrito and agua de piña (yellow cool aid) It was not even pineapple it was cool aid. The “carne asada” was ultra tiny chopped fried beef
The best tacos I have ever had point blank period!! But there is a cost mentally going to get these you will see some uncomfortable situations on your way there. But still you have to go.

name: Banh Mi Ba Le
editorialSummary: Counter-serve location offering traditional Vietamese sandwiches stuffed with meat & tofu.
reviews:
I only eat #2 here.  Huge portion, taste better than other shop in Oakland, good price when paying cash. However there are some Downsides:
1) the neighbourhood is scary, lots of trash & homeless problems in the back streets.  In front of the shop is filled with garbage & dirty.  This location is worst for parking as well. Watch out for your cars.
2) the male cashier (owner) is rude & looks down on

As always, be careful when you’re in the area. I used to come but it’s been the first time since Covid because I thought it was worth it but this time, I got the grilled pork Bahn mi but it wasn’t slices of grilled pork, but rather, pork sausage???

Then as I was mid way through the Bahn mi, there was a plastic bit????

Suffice to say, I won’t be coming back here. Kind of creeped out.

Bánh Mì Ba Le is a must-visit spot for anyone craving an authentic and delicious Vietnamese sandwich experience. Located in the heart of the city, this casual eatery has earned a reputation for serving some of the best bánh mì in town. The sandwiches are packed with fresh, flavorful ingredients, from the perfectly crispy baguette to the savory meats like grilled pork, chicken, and even tofu for a

I had been wanting to try Banh Mi Ba Le for a while, but their extremely limited hours made it tough to make happen without having to deal with an extreme wait. They're only open Friday through Sunday from 7:30 a.m. to 3 p.m., so I finally made the trip out on a Friday and arrived around 9:30 a.m. It was already fairly busy, and it only got more packed while I waited for my order so I would strong
So yummy. The baguette is crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. The ham and had cheese are yummy. What else can I say?

name: Quinn's Lighthouse
editorialSummary: Seafood spot in an 1890-built landmark featuring patio dining, marina views & a lively upstairs bar.
reviews:
We had a terrible experience at Quinn's Lighthouse. The oysters we were served were clearly bad. After we sent them back and told staff we would not be paying for them, we overheard employees discussing whether the oysters were still good.

Extremely concerning food safety issue, especially for raw seafood.

The restaurant was also very cold inside because the heat appeared to be off, and many of
The fish and chips were very good, and the staff is always friendly.  Great atmosphere and some awesome views of the water.  Outdoor seating as well!

Food was pretty good just nothing too inventive, the service was a little intense and nothing too great about it and the restaurant was nice, we just had to take an alternative route from the dock. One thing that was a little shocking was that the condiments were not cooked and were even a little warm the only cooled condiment was the ketchup while the ranch was just left out in the warmth.

I went for an event and enjoyed a great show and food. The wait staff was really friendly thought it took them a while to acknowledge me. Would definitely attend again. Good for a solo thing, girls night or a couple thing.

Came here wanting to try Cioppani and i was not disappointed.
The restaurant has good view and ambience. It was quiet and nice in the day for a solo dine-in.
Service was fantastic.
Cioppani was peppery marinara sauce with loads of seafood. Definitely a bargain for the amount of seafood given for its price.
Nice spot to give it a try.

name: Cambodian Street Food
reviews: SO FIRE!! Know that you are going to order and wait, so be patient if you want to try this bomb food! We did two 4 Way Plates ~ choice of rice or noodles, choice of chicken wings or ribs, choice of Chicken or Beef sticks & 1 egg roll. Our favorites were Beef stick, garlic noodles & egg roll!! Will be back to enjoy more! Thai tea is a MUST!

PHONE ORDER AHEAD. I wasn't prepared to wait over an hour for my food and honestly I think there might have been a mistake. BUT with the reviews and willingness of other guests to wait the time suggested by the person taking orders- I had a strong feeling it would be worth it. Just before I went full on Hungry Diva mode I finally received my bag of food... and it was a heavy bag. Look. Don't come

love to see my culture get so much love, and it’s well deserved here. Drove down from OR and knew I had to stop by. Got Steak and Prahok, garlic noodles and pineapple prawns, and 4 beef sticks. Totaled around $58 with card. They said it was gonna be a 30 min wait and they were right. Everyone there was so nice and could tell they really appreciated all their customers coming by. Community felt str

I ordered the beef sticks, chicken cha-kreung, beef salawmachu, and mama wings. Everything was delicious. The chicken cha-kreung is a flavorful ground chicken dish with hints of lemon, and the beef salawmachu is a sour soup that reminds me of Filipino sinigang. This dish was my favorite. I don’t think you can go wrong with the menu. The wings were extra crispy and unique from other fried wings I’v

Cambodian Street Food, Oakland

I’ve been coming to this location when it was owned by Howard (RIP), it used to be “On Luck” Chinese food. He used to sell Dried Fried Ribs, Shrimp Fried Rice with Lobster Gravy Sauce, the classic Beef and Broccoli, Sweet and Sour Chicken or Pork, and so on.

When Cambodian Street Food first opened up, they had a quiet grand opening. They wasn’t sure how people woul

name: Pupusería Rosita
reviews:
This pupusa food truck is a gem. Three friendly, helpful women run it, and the pupusas are worth every minute.

I ordered two, chicharrón and revuelta. Both were delicious. The ingredients tasted genuinely fresh and the flavors popped. The cabbage curtido was crisp and tangy, and the “spicy” salsa wasn’t actually spicy but was packed with flavor.

The fried plátanos were tasty but not my thing. I

Pupuseria Rosita is one of the best taco truck in Oakland.  The service is fast,the people are super nice, and the food is just plain delicious and has tons of flavor.      Theres an area to the side with a tent,tables ,and chairs if you want to eat your food then and there.  Usually they have 3 flavors of aguas frescas daily so dont miss out on that to go along with your order(last time we ordere

As 2023 presses on I continue to try new places to eat. Today I stopped here for some tacos. The parking was fine (due to the fact it was mid day). It's conveniently next to a local liquor store just in case you want additional snacks. I purchased 3 tacos (beef, shrimp and chicken). The shrimp was the best taco though it was 2 dollars more. The only downside to this place is that they don't sell c
This is my first time here I got two tamales. This was what was inside of my tamale. One piece of meat.

Simply the best! Their pupusas are so delicious and fresh and they have so much variety! Tamales, quesadillas, platanos, and fried chicken plates! Very much a fan, and they also run a super friendly and clean operation!

name: Ramen Station
reviews: Tried Ramen Station for the first time today and it truly exceeded my expectations! The broth is rich, flavorful, and full of depth. The spicy ramen has the perfect kick—super satisfying. The chashu is thick, tender, and melts in your mouth, and the seasoned egg is cooked perfectly and absorbs the broth beautifully. Inside decor are super cute too!

Ramen Station is the ultimate spot for a solid solo meal when you want zero human interaction. I first spotted it from the 880 highway near the water in Oakland and stopped in for a bite. It totally feels like Japan—you order at a machine and everything is automated, so you don't even see the staff!

The indoor solo booths are perfect for a quick, independent meal. Space inside is a bit limited, b

It's a very quiet and very "hands off" in terms of contact with people. You order from a touch screen. They prepare some fresh ramen in the back and in a couple of minutes,  boom! Delicious ramen! They hand it to you through a small slat, say enjoy, and you take it to a booth or outside, facing the bay. It's nice and it's convenient. It's awesome.

I've been here a few times now, but I still can't resist coming back for ramen at Ramen Station in Oakland, California. Although there isn't anyone there to serve you, it's a self- service station. It makes you feel like you're in a Japanese train station, which is pretty cool. 🚆

I ordered the Deluxe Tonkotsu Ramen, it comes with 3 slices of in-house made Chashu Pork, Half Ajitsuke Egg, and othe

The Deluxe Spicy Tonkatsu Ramen is edible silk. It is truly the most luxurious food I’ve ever eaten. The presentation of the food was incredible as well, so I was not surprised at how good it was! Absolutely delicious and perfect on a rainy night with a cold coming on.

name: El paisa taqueria
reviews: We came to this place because it had good ratings. The people are really nice, service was great, employees were attentive. Visiting this place felt like as if you were visiting your uncle and grabbed some food. The place seems to have history, it does seem a bit old, has a lot of wear and tear on the tables/chairs/walls/utensils. Food was good, seemed a bit bland, lacking some flavor. They do not

Been here alot for many years and their food is good quality and price, needs more recognition!!
I love the old atmosphere as if you were at home eating ya parents cooking, people are friendly and yall need to give this place a go and recommend the menudo big portion on it 😋
I believe they barely started doing zelle which is nice it was cash only before

Drove all the way to the east side on a recommendation... Sauce was good, presentation 👌 but the meats were chewy. Lengua and Pork were tuff. No free refills on Aguas frescas, and the drinks on the machine tasted funny, not the best recommendation for Mexican food.
Super delicious food authentic Mexican food.. ordered some fish tacos and they were freshly made. The service was great. Good to make note that it’s cash only but ITS WORTH WVERY PENNY.. coming back.
I've eaten here 3-4 times.  It's always tasty and generous.  Last time I parked at Goodwill across the street and got my wife a leather jacket cheap.

name: Mom's Pho & Banh Mi
reviews: Solid banh mi at a reasonable price and fast. The bread is warm and crispy, while the meats are tender and juicy. The store is small but comfortable, and at lunch times chances are good that you could meet that home renovation contractor you were looking for.

The young man that works the counter is the sweetest and most cheerful employee. His service made our dine in experience even better. The sandwiches were good for the price really loved the banh mi bread, not sure if they make it in house but it was delicious soft yet chewy. And the Vietnamese coffee was on the sweet side for me I had to fill up the rest with water. Other than that it was good

Excellent banh mi, love the French roll in particular.

And you absolutely cannot beat the $7.50-8.00 price. I get all around the Bay Area for work and this is the best lunch deal I've found.

Will definitely stop in again to try a rice or vermicelli plate next time I'm in the area. They've got some stiff competition nearby but this place is great.

Super clean place, warm stuff and delicious food.
I tried it for the first time today, I got the Pad Thai and 3 spring rolls (two shrimp, one veggie).

My food was made in ten minutes, the Pad Thai had peanuts, scallions and tofu. I added some lime and it made it perfect! Very tasty!

The spring rolls herbs and shrimp were super fresh and served with a side of delicious peanut sauce, perfect sweet
This place has delicious food and kind, attentive service at a reasonable price. I recommend the fried tofu banh mi and chicken vermicelli salad (pictured). My date loved the pork banh mi as well!

name: Taqueria El Paisa
editorialSummary: No-frills neighborhood spot serving up informal Mexican grub such as tacos, burritos & tortas.
reviews:
Getting here right after opening is the best move if you want to beat the massive rush this place gets later in the day. Plus, I managed to snag free street parking right around the corner.

There was practically no line when I arrived, so I only waited about a minute before the gentleman behind the counter took my order. The ordering area itself is incredibly festive—stepping inside genuinely mak
The best tacos in the bay. Friendly & fast service! + they have a salsa bar. The Al Pastor & Suadero tacos were my favorite. The horchata was also veryyyy good!

I was very disappointed with my burrito and tacos. The chicken was super dry and overcooked. The beef brisket was also dry and tough. The parking lot is basically Costco and inside is hectic. The staff are incredibly nice. I was looking forward to a good experience considering online reviews but the only good part was the tortilla and grilled onions. Also my burrito had a few chopped up chicken bo

Some of the best tacos in Oakland! Don't sleep on the chicken taco, my go-to is usually 2 or 3 tacos: chicken and carne Asada. Highly recommend taking a moment to enjoy the space and eating there, the food will be warm, fresh, and delicious.

don’t often feel at home unless I’m actually back in the giant, restless sprawl of Mexico City. But stepping into Tacos El Paisa gives me a small reminder of it. The smell of meat on the grill, the shine of puddles on the pavement, the cumbia drifting through the air, and the steady chop of the cleaver on wood all pull me straight back to CDMX for a moment.

I come here about once a month for the

name: Tacos El Gordo
reviews: Decent Mexican food truck with many meat options. Prices are a little high and the area is not very welcoming. There are a few parking spots behind and they are open late. Give them a try if you’re in the area!
I usually like them but they gave me a burnt churro cheese cake and then didnt out sour cream or cheese on my tacos when I asked for everything.I'm disappointed.

As a travel nurse, I’ve worked all over the state and this was by far one of the best Burrito Pollo Deshebrado I’ve ever had. It was huge, packed with meat, incredibly flavorful, and had the perfect amount of spice. I just moved here two weeks ago and already found my new go-to spot. Honestly, it hit exactly what I needed at 1:30 AM after a long shift. Definitely a late-night lifesaver — I’ll be b

Those were one the best spicy pork tacos I have even had. Despite their neighborhood, this place made one of the very best authentic Mexican food. They were very generous with their meat. The meat was supper juicy and flavorful. The fresh radish, grilled small onion and Jalapeno were my favorite sides for tacos. Their taco sauce were also supper yummy, not too spicy. The chocolate flan were good t
Tried this taco spot and it didn’t disappoint. The tortillas were fresh, fillings were flavorful, and everything tasted well-prepared. Simple place, but really good food. Definitely coming back.

name: GO! Gas & Food
reviews: "I had a great experience at GO! Gas & Food in Oakland. Their gas prices are some of the cheapest around, and I was able to get in and out quickly because the service was fast and efficient. The staff was incredibly friendly, helpful, and welcoming. My cell phone wasn't connecting to the internet, and they were kind enough to let me use their Wi-Fi, which really helped me out. It's not often you f

Cheapest gas in the Bay Area,, I always stope by to fuel up my gas but the only I don’t like about this gas station that they don’t have any Window Squeegee, Window Cleaner…The all customers will really appreciate it that if they have put some Window Cleaner. Because a lot of Uber and Lyft drivers stop by to fuel the gas but the want to clean the front.
Consistently the lowest gas price in the area. Busy lines but fast service inside. Car wash, pressurized air and water all available. No squegies to wash car windshields.
Cheapest gas station in Oakland. Very busy and it can be frustrating. I recommend going as early as possible because it is always crowded.

It's a such a great low price gas
Very popular and very busy all the time

name: Ruth's Buka
reviews:
The food was amazing! This was my first time trying Nigerian food and the food did not disappoint. I’d give the food a 9/10 everything was full of flavor.

Service was decent, it’s more of a grab and go family restaurant. Which mean the atmosphere is basic as well. I will definitely go back for food.

My best friend and I stopped by Ruth’s Buka on April 11, 2026. It was a rainy day, and we were craving West African cuisine. The restaurant is tucked inside a small grocery market, with a tiny cafeteria-style dining area. We ordered egusi soup with fish, jollof rice, fufu, and plantains. The egusi soup was flavorful, hot, and smoky, with a texture and flavor reminiscent of bitter melon. The portio
Delicious food! Our group got a mix of jollaf rice with chicken/fish, plantain, egusi soup, and fufu. 12-3pm $8 special was especially worth it! Highly recommend and the staff is also very lovely :)

The egusi was very tasty, the beef was a little too stiff for me personally. I do believe for the price I am paying portions could be better. If you could also see in the photo the egusi wasn’t filled all the way up in the bowl which is a little disappointing.

There was only a couple tables but we had the chance to dine in. Although I think it's half a supermarket so alot of other customers were taking food to go as well.
Egusi soup with chicken was flavorful and hot. Came end of day so there wasn't much okra soup left so it was slightly warm but I was able to get it mixed with Efo Riro soup and beef. Chicken tender literally fell off the bone and they

name: Tortas Ahogadas Mi Barrio
reviews: Great location tortas ahogadas are my favorite. They don’t put any spicy sauce so you can add it to your perfection.there service  was great and the server was on top of all my kids needs 😂😂
tried the Tortas Ahogadas and Tacos Dorados and it was delicious. The flavors were really good.The price was a little higher than expected. I would definitely come back again.
The best spicy salsa if you want to eat Friday tacos and the delicious  tortas ahogadas .. I definitely  recommend this place

Try the Tortas ahogadas. They are Pork sandwiches drenched in a delicious broth topped with fresh onion slices. Beware of the red salsa on the table it is NOT your ordinary salsa. They also serve Potato tacos topped with onions.

Wow! I can't believe I've never tried this place. I got a steak burrito for $15 which to me is an average burrito price. However, that burrito was anything but average.

There's been a lot of skimping on the meat lately and the ingredients and overfilling with rice in Mexican food lately. This place makes burritos like I used to remember them. Mouthfuls of cheese and every bite, visible mountains

name: Tacos Guadalajara
reviews: The taco salad here is absolutely amazing! [1]I stopped by Tacos Guadalajara and ordered the taco salad with shredded chicken, and it blew me away. Everything about it was incredibly fresh and flavorful. The shredded chicken was perfectly seasoned, juicy, and packed with flavor, not dry at all.The shell was perfectly crispy, and they didn't skimp on the fresh toppings. Every bite had the perfect m
Went for a late night meal on a weekday. Hours are perfect, food was great quality. The super burrito size was huge!!! I definitely recommend. This is definitely my new go to for Mexican food.

I gave a 2 star because this truck is hit or miss. Tasty food but every time I order here I never get what I actually order. Today I ordered a steak burrito with everything, light beans. What I got was a steak and rice burrito with light cheese, cilantro, and onions. I would've just bought a taco if I knew I was getting this.  14 bucks for a dry and tasteless burrito.

Salsa on the side was wack. Burrito was dank. They threw in green onions and those delighted my tongue. The picked jalapeños tickles my jalapeños. And lastly, the one singular of radish cooled my palate. Enjoy a delicious burrito.
There was a truck nearby that was blasting music from the truck nearby. This reduced the atmosphere score. I prefer mariachi or something similar to that but the music w
Personally, the shredded chicken super burrito is the best I’ve ever had and never disappoints. I’ve been coming here for many years.

name: iLava Hawaiian Barbecue
reviews: Based on the reviews I was expecting this place to blow other Hawaiian bbq in the Bay Area out of the water, which isn’t honestly a very high bar. But it was overall very standard fare. I got the bbq mixed plate. The beef was tender and tasty, but the chicken was pretty dry and I only got one thin, stringy short rib. I found the flavor to be pretty lacking overall. But my biggest complaint has to

Damn, why didn't anyone tell me how good this food was.... look, I finally had iLava Hawaiian Barbecue for delivery and WOW--this food showed up like it had something to prove. Everything arrived hot, fresh, and smelling so good I forgot I was supposed to plate it. Straight out of the container and into my heart.

The portions are MASSIVE. Like, "this box feels heavier than my responsibilities" ma

My first time having iLava and it was AMAZING! From the ambiance, to the service, to the food itself, all 10/10, would recommend to anyone. They let you customize your combo order, so I had to try their chicken katsu as well as their lau lau, which both exceeded my expectations. And I saved the yummy Mac salad for the end! 😋 to top it off their smoothies are great too. I got the Hawaiian sunset.

I’ve been a few times the food doesn’t disappoint and their customer service is good, I think the portion size might be a little skimpier than I’m used to. Especially for paying almost $20 for a combo plate.

Omg this place is absolutely delicious me and my are truck drivers and we were stuck at our drop spot so we decided to come here for food and when I say we was not disappointed at all man they are very cheap they give you alot of food and they even put cabbage at the bottom of the plate we had so much meat on our plate I wish we woulda brought extra to take with us but we definitely will be return

name: El Huarache Azteca
editorialSummary: Colorful cantina known for its homestyle Mexican fare, including lamb barbacoa on weekends.
reviews: Hadn't been in a long while. I felt like having a pambazo and a quesadilla de huitlacoche. Both were tasty, especially the pambazo with the perfect toasted bread. To drink I ordered the orange with papaya água fresca, that I highly recommend. We also tried the chilaquiles. They use different thicker chips. They were a bit over fried, but the salsa was good. We'll be back to try some more.
Delicious food and incredibly well priced. This restaurant has been around for a long time. Support this family run restaurant.
I order a camarón de cóctel nasty then I order supposedly it’s agua fresca tamarindo it’s tasted like it been 2weeks old  look at the picture no ketchup table was dirty

Great place!! Always looking for authentic Mexican food!!
Went back in time with every bite!
Micheladas flavor was perfect

I’ve ordered from here several times. I’ve had the chile relleno, flautas, pollo en mole, guisado de carne and most recently a taco de barbacoa. Together with the rice and beans, each dish has been delicious with a definite homemade charm. The prices are fair, and they take Apple Pay. Definitely my favorite Mexican restaurant in the Oakland area. Food is delicious, the staff is attentive yet gives

name: Jack London Square
editorialSummary: Restaurants & bars surrounding a lively 1800s waterfront, plus a bike trail & kayaking.
reviews:
Jack London Square along the Oakland marina is one of those places that quietly grows on you over time. Years ago, this was part of my regular Capitol Corridor commute — a transfer point between sides of the Bay and just another stop in a busy schedule. Coming back now with a camera in hand, it feels completely different.

The marina has a calming rhythm: boats gently rocking, reflections on the w

February 6, 2026 was the day of my uncle's Funeral Service which took place in El Cerrito, CA. Following the Funeral, we were invited to attend lunch at Scott's located at Jack London Square in Oakland, CA. There is a parking garage right by the Restaurant and Valet parking is also available. The restaurant is by the water and the view is spectacular and so was the food, the desserts, and the serv

Jack London Square is a nice place to visit. Especially since they've added the FREE water taxi that bounces between Alameda (there's a playground and parking around behind Target) and JLS on the Oakland side.
There are lots of shops, restaurants, an a Bayview walking paths on both sides of the Estuary.

Went here on short trip to Oakland! The place was ok nothing much to do over there but we went before 5pm and didn't know nothing was open before 5pm. Was trying to eat and enjoy the views but restaurants were closed so go after 5pm. Beautiful area tho.

Visited this area during a short trip and enjoyed the beautiful views and atmosphere. We arrived before 5pm and found that many restaurants were still closed, so it’s better to visit later in the evening if you want food and more activity. Overall, a nice place to walk around and relax.

name: Scott's Seafood Grill & Bar
editorialSummary: Upscale eatery, one of a small chain, pairs a large menu of fish-focused fare with wine & cocktails.
reviews:
I've been to Scott's now for dinner and for their new Jazz Brunch and both have been nice! For dinner we had calamari, very delicious oyster Rockefeller (endorsed by my mother in law from New Orleans), seafood sautee and my husband had crab stuffed salmon with lobster sauce. Bananas foster bread pudding was also really good. We also sat by the window and had a beautiful sunset!

For brunch the sel

I had a wonderful experience at Scott’s Seafood in Oakland. I used to visit their Walnut Creek location often, so I was a bit sad when it closed—but this location definitely lived up to my expectations.

The restaurant is beautifully situated near the bay, which creates a relaxing and scenic atmosphere. The interior design is elegant and inviting, making it a great spot for both casual meals and s

Great food, tasty drinks, awesome service even when I didn’t have reservations and sat at the bar. Tried the raviolis and the lobster filled salmon. Salmon cakes and clam chowder to start. Everything was tasty, they brought sourdough bread and parm cheese separately but it was a nice touch. 10/10 will be back again. A little pricy but worth it.

Scott's is one of my favorite restaurants in The Bay. Everything about it demonstrates excellence. I like to go early (4:30ish) to easily park, beat the dinner rush, get a great table, and get a lot of attention. I also love the background music. The food and beverages never disappoint.

The food was delicious. Our server was excellent but we were disappointed with the seating. We were a party of 10. Reservations were made well in advance. When we arrived the hostess made the seating situation confusing in that we had to sit at 2 separate tables, not close to each other at that. We inquired as to why when we had a reservation for ten people. Next to us there was a table set for 10

name: Buttercup
editorialSummary: Local, family-owned chain serving American fare from omelets to steak in a homey setting.
reviews:
​"Pleasant Service, Disappointing Flavor"
​The service here was genuinely cordial and attentive, which was the highlight of the visit. Unfortunately, the food itself was quite unremarkable. Everything we ordered was notably under seasoned, resulting in a very bland experience overall. There was nothing on the plate that would make me rush back. An average meal, saved only by the excellent staff.

I love the shrimp and grits and key lime pie. I get the shrimp and grits with no bacon and no tomato, but I'm sure if you like those things, they are even better. It's very well seasoned, grits are cooked to perfection, and it comes out piping hot.

The area sucks so you have to make sure you dont leave any valuables in your car. But other than that, the food and service are both excellent.

Wow ya'll, everything about this place is absolutely amazing!!! The food is great and large portions. Our server was excellent and food was just scrumptious...check out the photos...breakfast all day too...we also help celebrate another customer who turned 5 years old and Hubby and I blessed her with some birthday money...awesome.

My wife introduced me to Buttercup a few months back and she knows that I'm very picky about where I eat, because I know how to cook. My expectations are high, because if you are in the business of selling food, you should be really good at it. So with all that being said, I had  French toast, eggs, and bacon. I always order my french taost well done, because cooks seem to think that it's OK to so

Took the family here for breakfast, the best thing is that you are able to get an adult beverage here for breakfast, which is always a plus.  The food was decent but not great.  My wife and son enjoyed their meals but noted how super sweet the pancakes and waffles were.  My eggs benedict was good but not great.  Services was good.

name: Popoca Oakland
reviews: We went there on a weekday to celebrate my birthday and what a birthday it was. We loved everything we were served, so flavorful. The server and the manager, both were very graceful. They also suggested how we eat every item for the best taste. They had a seafood chowmein special that night and it was so good. We had a foodgasm after that. We couldn't finish and took it to-go but the next day it t

Went for a birthday. The food was amazing. Ate family style so we could try a bit of everything. There wasn’t one thing I wouldn’t get again. Standouts were the pupusas and pollo en chica. The quesadilla dessert was the perfect way to end the meal. Our waiter was also great and very knowledgeable about the menu. Will be back again!

We went to Popoca for my birthday. As a photographer and visual branding expert, I’m very visual and was excited to try something new—Salvadorian cuisine. It did not disappoint. I definitely eat with my eyes first, and the food looked beautiful. The ambiance was wonderful, and the staff was super friendly.

I originally planned to try their fixed-price dinner, but after spending way too much time

As a Salvadorean trying Popoca for the first time, I was genuinely impressed. The food was delicious and deeply satisfying, with flavors that stayed true to all the traditional Salvadorean tastes I grew up with. Each plate was beautifully presented with thoughtful, eye catching combinations that complemented the dishes perfectly. I loved the variety of textures and colors... blue pupusas?! Yes, PL

Good Salvadorian food. In general the items we ordered were all delicious. The portion sizes is also good. The outside seating is well heated and doesn't feel cold.

Tres leches is very good. The flan has a punch but good.

name: NōKA Ramen & Bar
reviews: This is easily my new favorite ramen spot and it's not even close. Great ramen selections or build your own adventure to flavor town, tikki drinks inspired by your favorite anime, dog-friendly patio for my hotdog Disqó aka @oaklanddachcam, and outstanding service. The team goes above and beyond by dressing up like anime characters. That spicy Miso broth, over level 9000 out of 10🤌🏾Thank you so m

Went here with my fiancé and we both got the Tempura Ramen and got a plate of Gyoza to share. The Tempura was very good and the broth was amazing. Absolutely loved the broth although I tend to not like some broths and the Gyoza was good but especially with the soy sauce it made it amazing. The plating looked very nice and the environment looked very comforting and lovely. It had fake plants that l

Had a good lunch on a chilly, breezy day with exceptional service.
A waiter opened the door as I approached the entrance and welcomed me in with the rest of the team echoing and got me seated quickly. A waitress gave me water before I scanned the QR code for the menu. I ordered the spicy miso ramen - good portions and flavor that left me warm and satisfied without feeling like it was heavy, even a

All the food here is great! The ramen is excellent. The pork belly melts in your mouth and the egg is so flavorful.

The place is very nicely decorated and the anime theme is great! Staff is very nice.

A fun, amazing place not necessarily but especially if you are an anime fan. Servers are friendly, and their smiles will make this places’ atmosphere even better. Food tasted great, however, a bit light in portion.

name: Oakland Grill
editorialSummary: Homey hangout with tin-roof awning & bare brick walls serving hearty breakfast choices & sandwiches.
reviews: Came here for breakfast and ordered the French toast combo with a banana milk and a hot cocoa. The French toast was really good and filling, and the drinks hit the spot — especially the banana milk, which was a nice treat. The overall vibe was casual and comfortable for a morning meal. Service was solid and the food came out fresh. Definitely a good breakfast spot overall I had a really nice exper

Visited Oakland for a show and woke up hungry so we scanned numerous breakfast places and their reviews. We decided to walk from Marriott hotel to Oakland Grill and we were happy we did. The food and service was TOP tier!!  The staff were so super friendly!

Really enjoyed my visit to this breakfast spot. The food was fresh, flavorful, and came out quickly. You can tell they put care into their dishes, and there were plenty of good options to choose from.

The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it a nice place to start the day. Service was friendly overall, though it took a little while to get checked on during the busy hours.

Overall, a great

Recently realized they are open until 8 for dinner. I got a tasty club sandwich with avocado. My companion got the fajita scramble as breakfast is served all day. We were there on a Friday night and it was not crowded. Perfect spot for tasty food and not a long wait before seeing a movie nearby.

Quaintly located in Downtown Oakland's Jack London square this restaurant grille has an old world family feel. Great family spot with a bar sitting option, staff was quick and polite . I had the crab Benedict plate with  belgian waffle. Absolute must try!!!

name: The Fat Lady Bar & Restaurant
editorialSummary: Cozy, dimly lit restaurant dispensing American grub, wines & more in sultry, Victorian-style digs.
reviews:
We came here around Christmas looking for a festive dinner and it was exactly what we hoped! Every inch was completely decked out in the best way, and I could tell even in non-Christmas times the decor was cool.

Food was great as well! We had the pate and onion soup for appetizer and for our mains a ribeye + baked potato and a caesar + added steak. Everything was well seasoned and the steak add p

I recently had my engagement photos taken at The Fat Lady, and it couldn’t have been a more perfect setting. The restaurant has so much character and such an incredible atmosphere—it made every photo look amazing.

After the photos, we stayed for cocktails and dinner, and everything was outstanding. The fried zucchini is an absolute 10/10, and honestly, nothing compares to the dipping sauce that c

House salad is not a standard fare in a good way with spicy peacans and strawberries. I added avocado which made it even better. The French onion soup is good and had House made cookies for dessert. Daughter had a steak which she enjoyed.

4.8/5

It was such a delight to eat at the Fat Lady! I’ve been meaning to try it for the longest time as I’ve heard it is a must try Oakland establishment.

The food was outstanding - we ordered the steamed mussels and the hot spinach salad as our appetizer. Each of us also got the prime rib plate that’s available on Fridays and saturdays as our entrees. All the flavors and seasonings were done pe

This place is simply amazing and the atmosphere is so nice. Excellent vintage beer signs and awesome stained glass goes along with plenty of paintings on the walls just give a great place to enjoy a meal and lovely cocktails. The Greco Lamb was amazing! French Fried Zucchini was delicious and I cannot wait to come back for some more awesome cocktails and delicious food. What a great experience her

name: Oeste - Bar
editorialSummary: Daytime eats, multi-cultural dinner plates & drinks in chic, comfortable digs (& soon, a roof deck).
reviews: I spent a few hours at Oeste on Sunday and probably needed to leave after an hour. Wait, I should have left sooner because my bill ballooned because I ordered so many drinks.  The drinks are amazing.  The food is excellent. Only feedback that is constructive is one drink was made completely wrong which may have been a new drink to the bartender.  I’ll go back again. Such a cool place with nice mus

Loved the atmosphere here. They had great music and the vibes were fun. The interior was charming, and the staff brought the fun with their excellent service.

The food was good. My favorite was the fried fish. I enjoyed that a lot. The buffalo wings were on the saltier side, but the lemon pepper was great. The burger was your traditional decent burger. I felt their ketchup was housemade, and I li

The cocktail menu was surprisingly small. The NA cocktails were nearly the same price as the regular cocktails. Counter to the reviews, I did not find the brunch staff to be friendly or attentive. The biscuits & gravy were respectable & surprisingly spicy.

The atmosphere as amazing! I walked in late at night the vibe was good. The rooftop was closed for a private party. Staffing seemed limited as there was no host for a little bit and took awhile for my server to come to the table. Once he came he was amazing. I couldn’t decide on just one thing so I ordered Mac and cheese with shrimp and the catfish/red beans and rice. The Mac and cheese was full o

I ordered a drink that included sweet vermouth as an ingredient. I was told they had no vermouth. Apparently the bar manager has reason not to stock vermouth. Pretty standard at most bars and restaurants in the world. How bizarre is this? Very very bizarre indeed.

name: Lana's
editorialSummary: Ice cream parlor & cookie bakery dishing up many flavors in a spare, modern space.
reviews: We were at a convention staying at the hottel and Lana's was recommended it was great the burger was juicy and flavorful  the Cajun hot tots were crispy and great flavor. The nachos cheeses had great flavor great to dup the tots in. Had the mint ice cream was great creamy full of flavor the staff was great

The place was kind of cool and the girl taking orders was really friendly. The smashed burger was okay. The bread got a little too soggy for my liking but it could have happened because I had to take it away instead of eat it there. I liked the taste of the fries but those were soggy too. Maybe everything would have tasted better had I dined in.

I looked for a burger joint by googling" burger joints near me"
I live at Marina Village Yacht Harbor and the first choice was Lana's. It was close so I went.
Put it into Maps and was there in about 8 min. Pulled into head in street parking right in front .
Lana's was clean and new, Large front windows . Simpl and  very freshly  renovated it seemed . I appreciated the new use of an old space. The

This was my first time here. I got the deluxe burger and the hot tots with cheese. It was absolutely amazing. The ingredients were fresh and tasty. The meat patty was perfectly cooked and delicious, along with the hamburger bun. The only problem i have with this burger place is that I didn't know about it before!

Come buy this fast while they're still not mainstream. Cleanest, quietest little gem. I apologize for the sloppy cross section, I had to chug half of it down in a bite (I had no choice).

The okie and the classic are out of this world! (maybe the rest too, didn't try yet).

Their fries are fried in tallow!!!

They have amazing real ice cream for dessert too!

I went to my church today, it was clos

name: District Oakland
editorialSummary: Extensive whiskey & wine offerings plus eclectic, gourmet small plates served in a modern space.
reviews:
Great spot for diver and drinks. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. Our water glasses were always filled; never empty.
The fried chicken sliders were tart and so were the Brussel sprouts. The devils eggs really stole the show.
Of all the drinks, the Port Authority was the best. Highly recommend it. The old-fashioned was good and so was the Bluegrass.

I really enjoyed going to the district. We went after the Lake Fest festival. I was happy to see that there was plenty of good seating and the wait staff was very attentive. They have a DJ that starts at 9:00 p.m. so it changes the mood and it's an excellent old-school R&B vibe with a touch of Hip Hop classics. The crowd is more mature and very into the culture. I ordered the oxtail tacos along wi

Nice vibe in the downtown Oakland area. We came in for dinner on a Saturday evening. The space is dark with high open ceiling and a large U shaped bar that appears to be a big draw. There were a couple good sized parties on one side when we came in. They seated us at one of the high tops on the other side. Seating is pretty equally low tops and high tops here, plus the bar. Our server was ok. Noth

Great place, 1 of my FAVS but the Cigar smokers are killing the vibe. Though they are outside, all the smoke comes inside the building in which there is no adequate airflow. Who wants to eat in a smoked filled space? Not me.  Hopefully management can figure out a solution. 💞🙂

Tucked away in Old Downtown Oakland, this fantastic spot perfectly captures a classic-meets-modern vibe, blending traditional pub charm with a wonderfully chill atmosphere. The service is consistently outstanding—attentive, fast, and genuinely welcoming from the moment you walk in. The food is great, and you definitely have to try the cocktails—the bartender Aaron makes an absolutely mean margarit

name: Nation's Giant Hamburgers & Great Pies
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain featuring oversized burgers, all-day breakfast & lots of pies in a retro setting.
reviews: Came in one morning and Rosalinda was alone but she still had a great smile and moved like it was 10people working in the back. Every time I come she has is so sweet and efficient and honestly one of the reasons I still come down to the Oakland one. Give her a raise and get her some reliable help. Thank you

*SEE UPDATE AT THE BOTTOM*
The food is standard Nation's, which means the burgers are good, the fries are good and the pie is amazing.

This review, however, was inspired by the staff.  I don't come here often, but when I do, it's usually late night...so I've seen them put up with a lot over the last few years.  They always have a GENUINE positive friendly attitude with ten times the patience with
Came to Nations today amazing service. Rosana was so sweet and food is delicious. Make sure you try a pie!

Ordered via DoorDash delivery, I was looking forward to The onion rings but they were so badly over-fried and rock hard that I almost broke a tooth. They were not edible. I couldn't even chew them. I won't be ordering them again. They were not fresh. Very disappointed.

I had a really good experience at Nations in Jack London Square. My server, Rosanna, was great — friendly, attentive, and on top of everything without being overbearing.

The food came out quickly and was hot and fresh. No long wait at all, which I appreciated. She made sure I had water right away, and I was able to use my rewards to grab a slice of pecan pie, which was a nice bonus.

Overall, sol

name: 7th West
reviews: I had a great time with family and friends. Delicious food. Great service. I really liked the outside space with a stage. Comedy show later on in the evening. So much fun. Great tasting Beer!! Check it out, I recommend it.

Went here today for the first time. It's a neat venue with a ton of indoor/outdoor seating and several old and vintage pinball machines.

The food was okay, but extremely overpriced - the burger was $16+ and didn't even come with fries/chips.

The service was SO slow. We were literally  four of the 8 people in the venue and it still took forever to get our order. You can't order drinks directly at

This place is pretty chill with good music...they serve drinks and there's food but i didnt try any of the food...they also have arcade games which i wish were free instead of paying quarters or tokens..but other then that place a great hang out..they did have a 20$ cover on sunday which i dont know if they always have a cover..
Fun indoor outdoor venue with drinks and yummy food!  Come when there are dance events for an added good time!
Cheap drinks. As far as night clubs go it has plenty of space which is nice. Didn't get a chance to try to the tacos. They seemed good.

name: Daughter Thai Kitchen
editorialSummary: Place for upscale Southern Thai street food with spicy options in chic, modern quarters.
reviews: I’m back once again at Daughter Thai Kitchen and it was spectacular! Our server, Joy did a fantastic job serving us by being bilingual knowing Chinese, Thai & English. The food and drinks were well presented, filling and big portion sizes. Definitely coming back next time!

This is hands-down, my husband’s and my favorite Thai place. We have enjoyed meals here many times in the past few months. Most recently we celebrated our five-year wedding anniversary and they took such great care of us. The food is fresh and delicious. We will continue to share our love for this place with our friends and family.

Daughter Thai Kitchen is one of our favorite Thai spots in the Bay Area. The food is fresh, the presentation is beautiful, and they offer wonderful flavors you don’t often find at Thai restaurants in the U.S. — like the Miang Kum Tiger Prawns, which are a must-try. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the service has always been attentive. If you’re looking for an authentic Thai experience bey

I’ve been really excited to try Daughter Thai Kitchen, and Christmas lunch felt like the perfect time to bring my family. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with purple wisteria at the entrance, and the courtyard feels romantic and serene. Inside, the ambiance continues—very elegant and upscale, immediately giving the impression of a fine-dining Thai restaurant.

Most dishes average around $3

I enjoyed dining at Daughter Thai Kitchen in Oakland. The Ahi Scoops (sesame-crusted, seared ahi) were a standout: crispy outside, tender inside, super tasty. Most dishes were solid. The papaya salad was a bit too salty and sour for me. Prices run on the high side, but the quality shows. Overall, an easy 5 stars.

name: Montclair Egg Shop
editorialSummary: Veteran diner known for eggs Benedict, plus an eclectic lunch menu & a display of model trains.
reviews: Came here on a whim with my bestie who lives in Oakland. We actually walked here from her house. The restaurant was in a cozy shopping area of Montclair. Lots of busy patriots all in the area, shopping and lining up to be seating for their fave restaurant. There is only all street parking so good luck. We waited about 30 plus min. It's easier and faster wait with only two people. The restaurant it

A brunch that is filling but not oily! Challah French toast is pillowy pairs well with syrup whipped cream and strawberries. The welsh scramble with potatoes on the side is fresh gently cooked and comes a little underated but you can adjusted at the table with shakers.
