Love the open kitchen they really take the time to make food taste great!

This place is great! The food was delicious, the staff was great, and the venue was really nice. The Blackstone Benedict was my favorite. It was an egg’s Benedict with bacon. They are so good at marking breakfast items here. The waffles and omelets were also delish! The only downside was the restaurant had only one bathroom so there would sometimes be a wait to get in.

First time here, just traveling g through. I enjoyed the Eggs Benedict & my husband had the scrambled Chorizo and eggs... Pretty darn tasty! Place was packed, yet service with a smile was fast! Love the fun rustic atmosphere too... If we lived here we'd definitely be back 👍

I’ve been to this place twice and always got the pesto crepe. The first time, the filling was a bit more generous. The taste was okay, but it wasn’t exactly mind-blowing. I went back with some friends a few weeks ago, and the filling was about 15% less than the last time I had it, which was around 2-3 months ago. Overall, I’d give it a 6/10, especially since you have to wait a bit during brunch ho

name: El Agavero Restaurant & Tequila Bar
editorialSummary: Classically styled & festive family-friendly spot offering Mexican standards & full bar service.
reviews:
Ordered for takeout.

Got 3 red enchiladas and 1 enchilada with mole sauce. This order was all a la carte.

Very yummy!
Looking forward to having leftovers. 😃

My friend and I came to El Agavero Restaurant & Tequila for dinner today. We arrived before the rest of our group and let our server know that we wanted to order first because we had to leave early. We also asked if we could have separate checks.

Instead of trying to help, the server immediately said no and told us one person had to pay for the entire table and then we could split it ourselves. W

I had the carnitas enchilada lunch special.  I liked it! For a meal, I thought it was missing vegetables. A serving of salad would have completed it. They served the usual chips 'n salsa before they brought in the main meal.
As for the ambiance, it did feel like a Mexican restaurant, with vibrant colors of decor. All in all, it was a positive experience!

We stopped here as we were walking past on a whim.  The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was nice, too.  Oh, and the food was the best.  I sampled the shredded-chicken, crispy-shelled taco my friend was having, and it was marvelous, with great flavors.  Then I had a chicken burrito, which completely satisfied my cravings.  The portions were very generous and could have probably been share

I’ve lived in the area for about a year and haven’t managed to try this place out yet! A wonderful sit down experience, perfect sized restaurant too. Staff were very nice and even sang to celebrate someone’s birthday near us.  We ordered a spicy chile liquor drink and it was definitely a strong drink. Street tacos and red enchiladas were absolutely amazing, major compliments to the shrimp tacos as

name: Italian Colors Restaurant
editorialSummary: Long-standing osteria serves up classic Italian comfort eats in a homey, family-friendly atmosphere.
reviews:
You would never know such a lovely restaurant was tucked away here. The staff were all so friendly, the atmosphere was amazing, and the food was decent. Our sever Laura was so sweet and made sure we had a wonderful experience.

Honestly, the Focaccia was one of my absolute favorites things here. I cannot say enough how wonderful the person who greeted us, the person who brought our water and bread

Lots of parking on a Saturday,  at 6:30pm.

Sat outdoors, heaters would come on, if needed.  We didn't need it 2 weeks ago.

My group of 3 ladies, celebrating a birthday of one of them. All food choices fresh, flavorful,  hot/ steaming. My chicken picatta, with mashed potatoes, grilled vegetables, perfect. $25. Had left overs.
My companions entrees , of salads, pizzas, enjoyable too.

Went here with my sister and brother in law on a Friday night. The food was splendid. We started with calamari and it was one of the best calamari I’ve had and it’s my go to at most restaurants. I had the fettuccine pasta with shrimp and it was delicious my brother in law had a taste and he wanted to order himself a plate. We had a mushroom pizza which was tasty and my sister had the lasagna which

I recently made a reservation for a large group. They were very responsive and they made the reservation very easy.

Unfortunately half of our group couldn't attend due to family matters. I felt terrible, but the staff was very understanding and accommodating. Our server was wonderful, I wish I got his name. (The evening of 12/10/23)

The cocktails are classics with an upscale twist, as well as an

We've been to Italian colors a number of times now and every time it is absolutely perfect. The food is wonderful, the service is great and the atmosphere is fantastic. The live music from the guitarist is a wonderful touch. I'm so glad they're such a great restaurant for me to go to. I will always be going back to this place

name: Taqueria Las Comadres
editorialSummary: Cozy taco shop in a old-school space serving tacos, burritos & nachos with patio seating.
reviews:
What an underrated amazing Taqueria.

They put so much heart into their meats Chili Colorado, Carne Asada, Pollo Asado, Chile Verde.  They are all so tasty. I
f you are in the neighborhood, check out this hole in the wall Taqueria. You will love it!

In line I felt be aura of the burrito. So much flavor. Wow. I couldn't help but sit in my car in silence and awe of the tastes that were dancing in my mouth. I felt like the mouse from ratatouille when he mixed the grape and cheese and the food critic who instantly got a flashback to his grandmas cooking even thought l'm not Mexican at all. Or have a grandma. My first bite felt like that of a moth

Excellent food with plenty of options, there is a few seats avaliable inside and outside but otherwise you have to carry out.
Food was really good!
Was about 14$ for a super wet burrito though so keep that in mind.
Huge portions, even let me eat when my Venmo was sabotaged by Chevron,  I was able to pay after though

Burrito was very wet (maybe from lots of beans ?) and ingredients were warm but not hot. Shrimp didn’t have much flavor, flavor I’d reliant on the salsas you add from salsa bar.

Has a long line so maybe we just a bad day. We did a normal super burrito with shrimp, everything it it.  Also note super burrito is $18 pre tax and tip.

name: Himalayan Curry House
address: 6112 La Salle Ave Ste 3, Oakland, CA 94611
editorialSummary: A casual, simply outfitted gathering spot serving Nepalese & Indian cuisine, plus beer & wine.
reviews:
The chicken tikka was bomb, the service was so friendly and sweet, and the prices are fair.

However. I gotta talk about that garlic naan.

This is transcendental garlic naan. This ks the naan that ends wars and ensures world peace. Every grain of wheat grows up praying to be made into this naan. It's fluffy, hot, crisp, chewy, a little smoky and just the right amount of garlicky. It is far and ab

The restaurant is located inside a complex with a lot of other shops. It's hard to find unless you are in the complex or know about it.
We went here for lunch and ordered curry and naan. The food is tasty and the portion size is good for 2 people. Not sure if this restaurant only caters to Uber eats or other delivery services because no care or thought is put into the interiors or the ambience. It

We order take out from Himalaya House frequently. Their palak paneer, tandoori chicken, CTM and lamb curries are crave-able. We always get garlic naan and raita too-- and if our sons are around, we also love their pakora and samosas. Consistently well made and the people are very nice. Excellent chai tea if I'm there for lunch as well. It's a tiny space so not much for dining in but we love it for

Just wasted my $50. DD said they cant help. Reviews were decent so I decided to order. Chicken tandoori was burned. Other dishes were below par. And please change the rice. Don’t even feel like writing long review.

Tired of bay area Nepali restaurants, most of them are hit or miss. Pls visit restaurants of Texas or NY, eat there for a while. If they can why can’t you guys do it here????

And pls
My new Indian go-to take-out in this area. Their Paneer Tikka Masala is one of the best I’ve ever had, and Aloo Paratha and Saag Aloo was a perfect meal. Love this place!

name: TGI Oni Sushi
reviews: Lovely little sushi place with very friendly staff, delicious sushi with generous portions and reasonable prices. Everything we ordered was fresh and really hit the spot. Lots of standard options plus some interesting, innovative rolls as well. Kid-friendly place, which is helpful for families. The only tricky part is parking but that’s a Montclair issue, not the restaurants fault.

The salmon avocado roll is delicious here. They added a big chuck of salmon and the rolls were thick, not wimpy like at other restaurants. Happy I stopped by for a quick lunch. Plus, the woman working here is nice.
So sweet, quiet and wonderful, brought the kids and we had a great experience. The rolls are full of fish and very large!! Will be back! 🙏

This is a local authentic sushi place. Chef is friendly and good listener if you have special inquiries. Sushi are freshly made to order with generous portions.
Good varieties of sushi, nigiri and sashimi plus non-sushi items. Ask staff for veggie options but some are clear through menu.
Place is clean and organized with responsive waiter.
Atmosphere is good for groups, meetup, seniors (flat floor
10/10 recommend this spot! Got take out and it tasted delicious and was also so pretty to look at 😋 personally got the geisha roll, jessica roll and a couple temakis!

name: Kotobuki Japanese Restaurant
reviews: Food and service was just excellent. They gave us complimentary tempura + eel roll and seared salmon. Delicious food we sure will be back thank you!

This might be one of our new spots in Montclair Village!

To preface, when we first moved to the east bay we ordered delivery from this restaurant our first night in our new house and were a bit disappointed, so we effectively left it off our list of places to go… this was our mistake!

The restaurant is no frills, but there’s seating for bigger parties  and partitions between tables so it feels r

Best customer service. They let their food and actions do all the talking. Right when we were seated, they provided us with complimentary spicy tuna & miso soup.

We ordered the agedashi tofu, dragon roll, alaska roll, and uni. House wine and beer.

Cute little spot with holiday decorations ❤️
Been going to Kotobuki since it was on Piedmont Ave.  The food is always good and reliable.  We like the restaurant because its good for families and are able to accommodate our family dinners of 8.

The staff are incredible, in particular the sushi chefs, however my wife and I can confidently say, we have not found more fresh and delicious fish. We literally order 2 combination dinners (sushi + sashimi) at least twice per week.

I’m writing this review as I’m here choosing to wait(with an Asahi and edamame) for my to go order because of how much appreciation we both have for the quality of th

name: Kakui Sushi
editorialSummary: Creative Japanese fare highlighted in a small, contemporary dining room with a high ceiling.
reviews:
We’ve moved to the area and have been looking for a local sushi spot that’s in east bay and would definitely recommend this place.

We made a reservation and were seated right away. The restaurant was not busy when we went ( 6pm) but as the evening progressed it filled up ( it’s a cozy spot, so seating is limited) but never felt cramped.

We ordered the shishito peppers that were probably some of

The food was just okay and definitely not worth the price. We waited about 15 minutes before anyone came to take our order, which already made the experience frustrating.

We ordered the premium omakase ($64 for 10 pieces of sashimi), but it was not even cut in proper sashimi style, which was very disappointing. At that price point, you would expect much better quality and presentation.

We also o

This is my new favorite japanese spot. It’s on the nicer side, great for a date night or a celebration. The food is delicious, from appetizers to mains and rolls to desserts. We’ll be coming back for sure!
Last night we ordered sushi to go and it was excellent. When we eat in, it’s always fresh and delicious but this take out was as well.
Friendly service. Tasty sashimi with good oil flavors. The miso dashi fries was surprisingly addictive. Good relaxing atmosphere.

name: Perle Bar
editorialSummary: Compact, modern cafe with an expansive wine list plus cheese, charcuterie & Mediterranean mains.
reviews: This place is amazing! I come to Montclair a few times a year and am always looking for great food. This is by far my favorite restaurant in town. The bahn mi is delicious and fresh and comes with amazing pho broth. Also great selection of drinks. And the service couldn’t be more friendly and inviting. Perfect for lunch, dinner, or drinks!

I dearly miss the Perle French wine bar but I am also a fan of the chef’s SF viet restaurant, Lily.

I must say the Vietnamese flavors did not hit here at Perle bar. We got the dinner special for 2.
The Cha Ca was good! crisped well but was missing a good fishy or funky sauce to eat with. ( I did dip it in the pho and the pork juices once I made a lettuce wrap, but it still was missing something)

Came for blues brunch and was quite impressed. Great food and a good value for $35. The citrus supreme salad was huge and loved the shrimp Louis.

Very nice wine bar with great food. Really enjoyed the devilled eggs and tartare with bone marrow. Only issue is the wines are all pretty pricey. Would love it if there some sub-$10 glasses.
The pork Bánh mì on the lunch menu is outstanding!  Full of fresh flavor. I also had the non alcoholic jasmine honey tea which was excellent.

Perle is an excellent place to have brunch!  They were so accommodating for a larger birthday by adding another table to fit the reservation.

The food is excellent. I was able to order the deep fried oysters with deviled eggs as my first course along with a croque madam.  I am extra interested in their burger for my next visit that comes with a small cup of French onion soup! The oyster shooters

name: Jupiter
editorialSummary: A 2-story venue & beer garden that serves up wood-fired pizzas plus handcrafted beers & ales.
reviews: Great vibes all around. The place feels welcoming the moment you walk in, and the energy is just right lively but not loud. The pizza tasted clean and fresh, which made it super easy to enjoy without feeling heavy afterward. The beer selection was solid too and paired perfectly with the food. Overall, a really good spot. I’d definitely go again.

What a hidden gem in Berkeley!
I was in the mood for good, authentic pizza — and as someone from New York, I’m definitely spoiled — but this place really impressed me. The pizza was amazing, and the manager, Sami, went above and beyond to get us a great table and make sure our food and drinks were perfect. I really appreciated his friendliness, and even our server mentioned what a great manager he

Decent pizza, lots of options and a nice restaurant and outdoor patio space. Extensive beer selection but unfortunately they were out of the first three I wanted so I settled for a fourth option. Note that they can't split checks which is not a big deal. Just plan accordingly.

Came in for pizza and beer here because this used to be my husband's favorite place when he was in college at uc berkeley!
We were a large group and took some time to decide on the seating and the menu - and the server was so patient with us🙏
We got four pizzas and they were all so good! If I had to pick a favorite, it would probably be Circe. The outdoor space was heated and wonderful.

We’ve been coming here for years and always leave happy. The outdoor seating is beautiful, with heaters to keep you warm, and the atmosphere is lively. They recently added a Garden Menu, we tried the lamb and it was delicious. I’m not usually into veggie pizzas, but here they’re really good. We’ve tried most of the pizzas and almost all have been great. The wings are tasty, and the dips are good b

name: Cornerstone Craft Beer & Live Music
editorialSummary: Expansive, multi-faceted beer hall & American kitchen with live music, ping pong & outdoor seating.
reviews:
I went on 3/7/26 to see Expendables.  Great show and great venue we had a great time overall but only one negative thing happened.

I added a photo of a guy who was a creep. I was with three girls and this old man was really drunk and making any girl he could get next too super creeped out . I had to tell him to beat it a couple times. Eventually security got involved but decided it was the girls

This was my first time at this music venue and gastropub. We were only there for the show. The interior was nice and new, though a bit bland. The menu seemed ordinary and I'm not into craft beer. I wasn't familiar with the facilities layout, but I later found that you enter the venue by going to the back of the restaurant and turning left. We only had drinks at the bar inside the venue. It was qui

First let me just say. This spot has it all. Great food. Awesome bar and socializing locations. Outdoor fire pits, indoor tables, counters, couches. And the music venue location is awesome 😎 And the staff here, is super cool. 🤘🏻😮‍💨💨

My wife and I brought our son to see Wax, Jarv, and J Lately. We had never been to Cornerstone before so we came early and ate dinner and had a couple beers pre show. I got the Chicken Pot Pie and my wife got the BLT Salad. My son got the grilled cheese and fries. Beer was great, food was great, and Michele the hostess, waitress, runner, security person, was there to take care of us the entire nig

It's a large venue with full bar and restaurant with many screens and projectors around. Great for sport watching, groups, casual hangouts and meetups.
There are big runs for private parties with screen in the back.
Not kids friendly on busy game days but could still be nice on regular days!
Service is great with many responsive attentive staff.
Foods are pretty good American style. I'd recommend

name: Saul's Restaurant & Delicatessen
editorialSummary: Pastrami & other Jewish soul food staples bring the New York deli experience to the West Coast.
reviews: Fantastic authentic jewish and Israeli cuisine in Berkeley! Definitely recommend checking out Saul’s if you are missing your Bubbe in Brooklyn. Of course you are paying for the authenticity ($26 for a sandwich w/ side), but that feels like a given in Berkeley. It is what it is. Don’t let it stop you from coming to try Saul’s. I recommend the corned beef reuben. You can skip the deserts and the lat

I really wanted to love this place, but the food was sub-par, though I did have a nice and attentive waiter, and the atmosphere was fine.

At least 1/3 of my pastrami sandwich was inedible fat & gristle (see posted pic).  While I never love picking that much fat off a sandwich, I especially didn't love it when the sandwich costs $26.95.  While, I wouldn't call the meat portion skimpy, I also would

Large open space, clean, tidy and well-attended. Thursdays there may be a Farmer's Market out front at noon, or one (weather permitting). We happen to be here on one of those less amenable weather days.
One visit only, so no in-depth review here.
Great Bagels and Smoked Salmon.
Well worth visiting and getting to know this place.
Staff are friendly, helpful, and try to keep my modifications from co

I have loved coming to Saul’s for lunch/brunch with friends and family for 10 years. And even with the ownership change, the experience and food remain top notch! The pastrami is the best I’ve had. Get the knish, French fries and pickles. Do not sleep on their Bloody Mary as it is one of the best in the East Bay. Honestly can’t wait to go back

Great food and lots of character.
The pastrami sandwich, kenash ( baked potato), cappuccino and the mint-cucumber soda were great , and the house salad

name: Gather in Berkeley
editorialSummary: Locavores come for creative Californian fare made with seasonal ingredients & West Coast wines.
reviews: What a wonderful restaurant l! We we walked in Just a few minutes before 2 pm and they graciously welcomed us.  The service was outstanding during our whole meal. There were accommodating to ourparty of four including a wheelchair.. I asked them for recommendations on dishes to eat and all of the dishes they recommended were spot on.  We enjoyed the hamburger,  Quinoa salad with chicken,  cauliflo

Im not sure if it was just a fluke but the wait for our food was entirely too long. Usually when I go out to a restaurant, im in and out in about 45min give or take. We were in there for over an hour. The check came faster than the food.
Our drinks were decent, though my grandmother prefers her water for tea to come from a fountain from hell. Im not too sure what that "honey" was, but it had a clo

This spot in Berkeley has a playful and unique feel with both indoor and outdoor seating available. The sandwiches are filling without being overwhelming, and the pricing feels fair for the area. It is a great place to stop for a meal while exploring the nearby campus or checking out the modern art museum.

Went there for brunch and thoroughly enjoyed the meal, ambience and service.  The space is beautifully decorated and we sat out in the patio with our dogs.  Breakfast was delicious - good mix of fresh, healthy ingredients  (quinoa, beans, etc.) and with sauces and flavorings to make it very satisfying.  I always appreciate the creativity from chefs using healthy ingredients rather than just using
slightly expensive burger but cute atmosphere and even cuter avocado toast. eat outside if u come for brunch its definitely worth it!! outside patio is super cute!!!

name: Comal
editorialSummary: Modern design & Mexican cuisine meet at this eatery known for its cocktails & vibrant outdoor area.
reviews: Creative mexican option. Delish cucumber and jicama salad - tangy and slightly spicy. Shrimp ceviche disappointing albeit very fresh. Soup excellent. Fishtacos very good.

To be honest, this restaurant was very disappointing. We started with the shrimp ceviche, which didn’t taste good at all. It felt more like shrimp covered in chimichurri sauce and served with cold chips than an actual ceviche.

The cod tacos didn’t taste fresh, and while the carnitas were edible, there was absolutely nothing memorable about them. I also had a margarita, which was just okay.

Overa

This upscale Mexican restaurant has amazing vibes and delicious food. We sat inside, but there's a really pretty shaded outdoor bar area with heaters that looked really nice too. The service was attentive, the food was very flavorful and felt like just enough to feel satisfied, but not so much you're struggling to finish.

Had a lovely dinner there last night. Our waitress was very attentive. We had the whole roasted chicken and it came with lovely tortillas, beans and rice. Cocktails were yummy too. I liked the ceviche, though there could’ve been more shrimp. The Tlayuda was very good. Also, there were a lot of adorable children running around, which is always a plus.

Was pleasantly surprised by the atmosphere of the back area of Comal. From the front, it doesn’t really look that big but once your inside they an elegant sit down interior and then their back area has a tall ceiling and a very earthy vibe with a bar connected. The food itself is authentic. Especially their hand pressed tortillas. The prices are a bit steep but it’s worth it for a cute dinner date

name: Berkeley Social Club
editorialSummary: Lively spot serving eclectic Asian-American fare with beer & wine in expansive quarters.
reviews:
It was a Thursday Ladies Luncheon.  5 friends nurturing their friendship.  Berkeley Social Club had very good reviews that was the deciding factor. Very unique menu selections with a Korean twist. Service was fast the food came out fast.
Two of us ordered the Bolgogi (sirloin steak) Bowl was excellent.  I eat red meat once a year and this was the best choice I ever made. The beef was so tender and

We came for dinner after a Berkeley graduation and did not know what to expect.  The menu is more Korean fusion and food is delicious.  We had a large party and got a bit of everything.  All was delicious.  The service was a little slow, but that may have more with how busy it was due to graduation and little to do with what is the norm.  Definitely recommend

We had breakfast delivered from here and it was pretty good! We ordered the BSC scramble, the Blackstone Benedict, and a side of fruit. Everything tasted delicious. I love how much variety of fruit was given. I would love to try this place in person!

Stopped here for lunch after walking around campus. The place was crowded, but we did not have to wait long to be seated. I had the Buttermilk Pancakes with Berry Compote, and my companions had the Bulgogi Bowl, and the Koren F.C. Avocado Salad. No complaints whatsoever about the food - all was delicious! The pancakes were perfectly cooked, but the berry compote took them to the next level! I coul

This place has literally been on my bookmarks for years now and I finally made my way here. We made reservations a few days in advance and had to change last min, they had plenty of open spots for reservations. The vibe is very Berkeley. Cool, non pretentious and just chill. We were seated promptly and our server approaching us within minutes with water. When you're dining with kids, these things

name: Eggy’s Neighborhood Kitchen
reviews: We had a few hiccups with our order and food arriving to the table at different times. Also, the line was super long and the wait too, however, they passed out free Mimosas while we waited in line, and everyone absolutely loved their food! The music is loud but you can still talk to others at the table and you can move your body to it! The decor is cute and nature like, however, all the chairs are

DO NOT SKIP! Great service! Great outdoor terrace!! AMAZING FOOD!!!

The chicken and waffles benedict were the best I ever had: the perfect crisp on their original recipe waffles, paired with delicious spiced chicken. The chilaquiles were also out of this world. Delicious freshly squeezed orange juice was the cherry on top. Our server Arnold was wonderful!

TLDR: just wait in the line, it’s worth

This  was my 2nd time at Eggys. The food 😋 was delicious and the service was great! The first time I went on the weekend so there was a bit of a wait. But this I went during the week for lunch with a old friend and the atmosphere was everything.  The service and recommendations we're just right..and the sangria amazing!!!

If you're planning a weekend visit, be prepared for a long line! Despite the wait, the food was a delicious experience. We sampled the French Toast, the Fried Chicken Egg Benedict, and the Harvest Egg Benedict, which was by far the absolute winner of the meal. While everything was good, I wasn't a huge fan of the slightly heavy waffle used beneath the fried chicken. They should consider getting an

The day after being disappointed about Fat Apples, I came to Eggy’s, a new Berkeley breakfast place. I had the chicken and waffles bene, and it was amazing!  Reviews said it was worth standing in line, and I definitely agree!  Plus the water had a very light refreshing cucumber taste!

name: Eureka!
editorialSummary: Hip dining spot serving elevated burgers, craft beer & whiskey in industrial-chic surrounds.
reviews:
One of the best dining experiences we’ve ever had in Berkeley. Everything was fantastic and happy hour / hoppy hour is a MUST. Especially the truffle cheese fries, great deal, and delicious.

Most importantly, our service was exceptional. AJ SPECIFICALLY was beyond professional, and an above and beyond host for our table. Walked us through suggestions, gave honest recommendations, and kept us ente

Service was a 10/10. Jack did a great job. He was helpful and consistent

Ambiance -  10/10 nice and versatile, you can come here for a nice date night or to watch a game with boys.

Food - 8/0 the food is good specially the mash burgers and apps.

Also they have great cocktails selection.

We had dinner tonight, and it was crazy busy, but the male host was awesome! People just kept coming in and he was obviously busy, but kept a great flow and smile. A lady came to help assist and same she was also amazing at making sure everyone was helped. Our waitress was Grace and she was quick and awesome, even though it was hot and busy tonight! Food is always good of course
Cellarmaker: Coffee and Cigarettes Porter. Best beer I have ever had! Food was pretty tasty. Server was great. No complaints
I went for happy hour service was good. I ordered the steak frites and a drink called the wild child. It was as I requested medium well and the drink was crafted nicely.

name: Rose Pizzeria
reviews: If you’re just looking for a reliably good pizza place, this spot definitely delivers. They’ve got a really nice dough, tasty cheese, and a sauce that pulls everything together into a pretty satisfying personal pizza. They also have some nice drink options and a good range of wines if that’s your thing. Overall, it’s just a really nice place to grab a good pizza.

This place is so special! I am not sure if it is the size of the establishment or the taste of the exquisite pizza, but Rose is a great place to bring friends or go on a date. The ambience is loud but warm and friendly. The service and staff were extremely timely and professional. I had a great dinner here with friends, and will be back for more. Parking is a sore, but what is new in Berkeley!? 10

*For context, this review is largely for vegans (3.5/5 stars).

Had a reservation on a Friday evening on the back patio. Beautiful weather for the back patio. I had emailed the restaurant in advance to check on vegan menu items, and they assured me that most of the menu items can be made vegan. There seems to be some confusion between the staff and management though since when I came to the restau

Highlight:
Delicious vegan-friendly pizza in a spotless space with a patio you’ll want to linger on.

Restaurant:
This cozy Berkeley pizza spot takes pride in crafting high-quality pies with fresh ingredients and thoughtful flavor combinations. The atmosphere is relaxed yet well-kept, and the charming patio is the kind of space that makes you want to extend your meal just to soak it all in.

Servi

Our pizza aficionado friend had told us about this place. It delivers!
Ambiance: The outdoor seating in the back is chill and a great place to hang out and enjoy.
Food: We ordered a red sauce pizza and a white sauce pizza. Honestly I normally prefer white sauce but the red sauce at Rose is next level tasty. The crust was superb and the pizza was great with their house red wine.
Service: friendly a

name: The Butcher’s Son Vegan Delicatessen & Bakery
editorialSummary: Charming, industrial-chic bakery & vegan deli for pastries, coffee & creative vegetable-based mains.
reviews: We were recommend the Butcher's Son by my sister-in-law and it delivered! I had the "lobster roll" and the combination of lobster mushrooms and palm hearts was so delicious and the texture was amazing (not soggy at all and had a great mouth feel). The "something fishy" jackfruit was seasoned well and the flakey texture of the jackfruit worked perfectly for a fish alternative.

Their garlic fries are sensational! Blueberry lemon zest cheese cake also very tasty! Outdoor seats in the backyard are lovely. I didn’t like the ruben sandwich but could be I don’t like meat imitations

Their portions have gotten a lot smaller over the years but they have great options on their menu. The deli doesn't seem to have has many choices as before either but the bacon is still good. I had the lobster mushroom roll and found the flavor a but strong (mind you, I probably wouldn't like a real lobseter roll for the same reason. Also ordered home fries with bacon, cheddar, and avocado which w
The portion sizes are large. The fries are great but a bit oily. Don't expect the sandwiches to taste like the meat equivalent.

Hits the spot when you're craving vegan American food. The dishes can be heavy but that comes with the territory. Brunch is my favorite but I'm also partial to a good pancake 🥞 Sit in the back patio area for the best experience 🌞

name: Angeline's Louisiana Kitchen
editorialSummary: Serving gumbo, beignets & jambalaya, this casual eatery brings New Orleans flavors to Berkeley.
reviews: Everything was delicious,  just as our server warned.  I had the fried catfish,  which was served with potato salad on a bed of hush puppies.  The fish was delicate and flaky without being over cooked.  The breading was seasoned but not over-powering. Others in our group enjoyed the buttermilk fried chicken.  Impressed by our mains,  we decided dessert was in order,  so we had the chocolate cake,

I've been here a couple of times now. The first time I had high expectations from having enjoyed great food while in Louisiana.  Angeline's didn't quiet feel the same. It's definitely a great spot in the Bay when craving Louisiana food, but it still doesn't come close to the bold flavors I've had during my visit.

Apart from that, they have very good service and ambiance is cozy as well.

These ar

Total rip off they super skimped out on the catfish nuggets, I paid $18 for fish batter. It's friggin catfish not like it's a super pricey fish especially nugget form. Never coming back here no wonder it wasn't busy.

This was some of the best food I have ever had!!! I used to work at a New Orleans spot in ATL, and this was top tier! Best hush puppies I have ever had, great sweet tea (for not being in the south) and great service despite it being empty! Shoutout to our server Mel, she was great!!

I visited Angelina’s Louisiana Kitchen in Berkeley and overall had a solid experience, with some clear highlights and a few areas for improvement.

The restaurant has a cozy, quiet vibe that works well for medium-sized groups or a casual date night. The Mardi Gras–inspired décor (greens and golds) is fun, though the space feels a bit dark, even during the daytime. Service was courteous but not esp

name: U :Dessert Story
reviews:
On Saturday, June 20, 2026, I ate at U :Dessert Story for my birthday.

We went there a little bit after 5 pm. The place wasn't busy at all. There were a few people eating there.

Here's what we ordered. The Salted Egg Yolk Brick Toast, Chocolate Volcano Bingsu 🌋 and Mango Stick Rice Bingsu. The Salted Egg Yolk Brick Toast was hands down one of the best desserts I've ever eaten. The orange Egg cu

I came with friends for dessert one evening, but it was a bit disappointing overall.
When we arrived (a little late), all the toast items were already sold out. The staff didn’t inform us beforehand and just let us sit down, which felt quite unprofessional.

The regular cakes were average — nothing special. The shaved ice (bingsu)was less sweet than I expected, which was actually a good thing for

Their packaging changed recently and it’s bad. No more sealed drinks. They packaged my drinks in a to-go bag. When I was already gone, I noticed the bag was dripping. They spilled. They don’t put any cup holders in the bag to hold your drinks… The worst part is…
The boba was UNDERCOOKED. It was HARD.

Disgusting.

Attentive service, great ambiance/vibes. Cant believe it’s open until 1am some nights!  I’ve only tried the mango sticky rice Bingsu, which was good, but I didn’t realize how big it was! Definitely could share between 2-4 people.  Main reason I won’t be able to come back often is the high price point. Our desserts were more expensive than our dinner earlier that night.

We came here for dessert and we got the ube milk with boba and the thai tea crepe cake. The ube milk had a great flavor and this was some of the softest boba I have ever had, which I really enjoyed. The crepe had a great thai tea flavor and it was moist. I am excited to come back and try more of the crepe cakes!

name: Tane Vegan Izakaya
reviews: Cute small restaurant, it’s really convenient to go to the theater or just to walk around downtown Berkeley. The menu is diverse, and the food is flavorful. I don’t go to vegan places that often, but this was definitely one of the best I’ve tried. Next time I’ll try the ramen! The potatoes were probably my favorite followed by point Rey’s roll. The mocktails were also really nice! All in all recom

As a vegetarian, the sushi’s are a must have! Unbelievable that it’s all vegan. I feel like I’m cheating and eating real sushi. Omg 🤤 so good! Servers were friendly and accommodating. This will be a repeat for sure! Only minor caveat is the place is quite small not enough seating during peak hours, so reserve ahead of time.

Wow! You will love this place!! It’s rare to find vegan sushi and even more rare when it’s so exceptional. The Pacifica was the perfect amount of crunch, texture, flavor, and layers! The Monterey had a smoky undertone. I wish I could have ordered the whole menu!

Tane was nothing short of excellent.  Creative, beautiful and cooked perfectly was the theme of what we tasted.  We absolutely can't wait to go back.  My roll was still crispy 2 hours later, and each piece was topped with mango salsa.  I completely forgot to take pictures,  and we had eaten so much of it when I remembered.   We loved the simplicity and bold ginger of the pot stickers.  The amazing

Excellent vegan sushi place. A bit on the pricey but kind of worth the experience and ambience.

Host was nice and recommended we try a soft and a crunchy sushi so that we get to experience both varieties. We tried a few crowd favorites and liked the eggplant tempura sushi the best overall hands down.

Chill and cosy ambience. Appointment recommended as it gets pretty busy.

Bonus on the menu is a

name: Mezzo
editorialSummary: Bustling counter-serve destination for hearty salads & sandwiches served in friendly environs.
reviews: Mezzo is a Berkeley staple. This place stays busy all day and for good reason. SO many of their options and items are baked or made in house and it really makes a difference. Most of the staff is extremely friendly, quick, and helpful as they usually have quite a long line. Tip, you can skip the line and order drinks at the counter as well if you are just looking for an espresso drink and no meal.

MEZZO!! LET'S GO!! What a delicious delicious experience here. I came in when it looked a little slow, and I honestly had no clue what to get. I decided to do the BLTA on some kind of whole grain bread with the works, pickled jalapeños added, extra pickles ots, and the chipotle aioli on the side. The shorter man with a mustache who took my order made me the most delicious sandwich ever! It was gen

We went there Tuesday morning for breakfast and coffee. Service: The young lady at the register was doing the best she could, without ANY support. We gave her a great tip for enduring the situation. We only purchased ☕ after observing these two gentlemen. One (red shirt) scratching his head and the other wiping his face, both working without gloves on. You can clearly see the food in his hand, jus
My favorite restaurant in Berkeley - healthy, incredibly good and super friendly staff! Went there so often during my trip

Massive portion sizes and fresh sandwiches and salads. I got the combo w the half sub and soup. The sausage and lentil soup was okay, but the BLTA was fantastic. You can tell that the ingredients are pretty fresh. The back patio also has pretty nice seating.

name: Noodle Dynasty
reviews: Found this gem through Yelp and waited in line for about 15 mins on a Saturday afternoon to get seated. This place usually has a long line of people queuing up, and understandably so, since the food was totally worth the wait! We each got the cabbage and fish noodle soup along with wontons for the table. The pickled cabbage rendered a nice sourness to the otherwise rich meat broth. The noodles had

I think it was good but not great!

Service is fast and efficient. You order on a tablet and pay immediately and then get your food (which comes out quickly).

Portions are large. I got the beef noodle soup (not bone-in), and I could barely finish half 😭 The meat portion was generous. The soup was good! Though i feel the noodles felt a bit disconnected from the soup? Like they felt like an after

*Fyi before leaving a review I do try places 2 times prior to making a review* Love the noodle soup here. Everytime I am in Berkely I always stop here hungry or not. Its a small hole in the wall restaurant with very small tables that are cramped together. Its a nice place but the lack of room takes away from it. Wait times vary depending on what time you get there. Also, customers are very close b

How amazing is it to have a place like this right next to the university! Honestly, you should come here with two stomachs, because you’ll want everything at once. The portions are huge — like the chef personally decided, “You’re a student, you need to survive.” I’ve already been here twice, and I’ll definitely be back again, because the food is so good it makes you want to applaud with your spoon

Wow wow wow this place was so good!!!! They have one clearly labeled vegetarian noodle dish and it tasted so good. Full of vegetables and the noodles were perfect. I’m definitely going to come back multiple times here.

name: The Smokehouse
editorialSummary: Charbroiled burgers, hot dogs & malted milkshakes in an old-school spot with outdoor benches.
reviews: So today I went into the smokehouse for the first Time. My son goes to ABA therapy around the corner and we decided to try this place. Let’s start off by saying the customer service is amazing. The cashier made us feel welcome. Second of all best milkshake I’ve had in a while. I’m definitely going back to try a different flavor.

For a $7 hamburger, I should not be served with cold staled buns, shredded lettuce that was very sloppy put together.  Other than easy parking, I most likely will not eat here again!  There are plenty of other good eat places around.

I came to the Smokehouse with my gf after a long day at work. Girl, they have veggie burgers and non-dairy milkshakes! Take your vegan friend! Everything is delicious! CHEESE FRIES! And the cheese had a little kick to it- exactly how I like it. This was an absolute blessing!!! What a great way to end the day

The double cheeseburger was laughably small. The patties, not the buns. The patties were completely overcooked and dry. I wonder if I just got a bad batch.Because mine looked nothing like any of the pictures that other people have posted. Also, it didn't come with lettuce, tomato or anything.

Wow.... I mean Wow.......So I dont know why the place has or had bad reviews. I stopped by on a whim because the place looked interesting. There is a little cart outside where the fella takes your order. There is a menu on the wall and it says certain toppings are free like Chili. I wasnt in the mood for chili so I just got a regular cheese burger with a drink. It was like 11 dollars. The price wa

name: Baker & Commons
editorialSummary: Relaxed cafe with a neighborhood feel, serving brunch standards, sandwiches, coffee & scones.
reviews: Our daughter introduced us to this wonderful restaurant! I had their corn salad with feta, my wife had their tuna salad and our daughter had their egg sandwich on a delicious looking biscuit!

Got my salad to go and when I opened it - no egg and about 10 garbanzo beans. Pretty expensive for a small container of greens. Pistachio Bundt cake was very dry. The management immediately reached out and tried to make it better. Impressive service!

Mostly enjoyable and a repeat experience for sure. Came in here on a busy Sunday afternoon for a coffee and a biscuit sandwich.

The salted maple latte was excellent - full of flavor and not very sweet. They do serve it in a handleless cup, which is quirky and maybe takes a tad bit getting used to.

The biscuit with egg bacon and cheese was very good. I think it’s one of the better ones in the Eas

i’ve been here on five occasions now and i highly recommend this cafe. it’s a cute neighborhood joint with delicious pastries and good drinks—what more is there to ask for? i highly recommend the early grey cake, the cardamom cake, the passion fruit tart, and of course the biscuit (both standard with butter and jam and the sandwich form).

Great brunch spot! ☕️
I tried the shakshuka and it was delicious. The eggs were perfectly cooked and the tomato sauce was rich and flavorful. Paired with the toasted bread, it was a really satisfying dish.
The café has a cozy atmosphere and the staff were friendly. Prices are reasonable for Berkeley, around $10–$20.
Definitely a nice place to relax with coffee or brunch. I’d love to come back and

name: Raleigh's Pub
editorialSummary: A casual, convivial tavern for American eats, wine & beer served in spacious indoor & outdoor digs.
reviews:
Cool inviting atmosphere right at the entrance. Fresh contemporary decor with high ceilings and lots of seating spaces indoors and outdoors. We ordered chicken nachos and it came loaded with chicken and every ingredient possible on this dish. The dish was enough for 3-4 people when they’re very hungry! It’s a huge plate.
Next door Mezzo that’s a sandwich shop is connected from the inside.
Happy co
Eyasu was so welcoming and efficient. Food suggestions by Morgan were awesome. The place is so spacious and they have such a cool patio area! Loved it here! Thank you guys.

Great place to hangout basically everyday at anytime. Solid study spot, elite happy hour spot, and taco Tuesdays are a peak event. Food is also really good. Great portioned classic bar food. Most beers on tap worth trying.

Raleigh’s holds a special place in my heart as it is cozy, beautiful, and just immaculate vibes. Always enjoy coming here to watch a game or to just get a drink. Also good for lunch or to hang out with friends at night. The nachos are huge and good to share.

Classic college pub. Have offerings like Taco Tuesday, is only a 5 minute walk to the Cal campus and has a huge variety of beers to try as well as cocktails, ciders, etc. Their food options are pretty good for a bar. A great place to watch sporting events, whether Cal or any other bay area sports team. They have a great outdoor space and is such a vibe whether you are a student or not

name: Kiraku
editorialSummary: Busy izakaya-style Japanese tapas eatery featuring locally sourced ingredients in a modest setting.
reviews: Super busy izakaya but they somehow make each dish super flavorful and well balanced. The prices are on the high end for the amount you get but the quality is unmatched. The beef tongue was super tender and not gamey! The corn tempura and beef okonomiyaki are really good too. The mini kaisen don was really small so I would probably skip it unless you are craving sashimi. Definitely a special treat
Great food. Authentic Japanese food. Some of the dishes are very adventurous. Highly recommend to make a reservation if possible. It will be a long wait if not and also has a time limit for dinner.

Amazingly fresh fish. Excellent cow tongue.

Would go back in a heartbeat. Best with group of 4 or more so you can get little bites of many items. Reservation recommended.

Nice happy hour. Got a free fried fish app and even fried, it was melting in your mouth!

Fast service. Fair warning: they do maximize seats in the small restaurant.

Hidden gem with soul - this is where Japanese food feels right.
Every dish at Kiraku is crafted with care, precision, and that rare sense of warmth that’s hard to find outside Japan. But what truly sets this place apart isn’t just the taste - it’s the consistency. Year after year, the quality doesn’t fade. It actually improves.

The staff? Always kind. Always attentive. The atmosphere? Casual but

Went here last November and absolutely loved it! Me and my cousins got a little bit of everything instead of getting one order per person which I definitely preferred. The place was packed but it was no biggie. Overall, everything was great and would definitely love to come back!

name: Gordo Taqueria
editorialSummary: Burritos stuffed to order & other Mexican standards in a simple, modern outpost.
reviews:
An ok 3.5 / 5 experience.  Rounding up to 4 🫥

I understand that carrots and zucchinis in your taco burrito can throw people off. On the other hand if you want more veggies in your Mexican food, this place would be a blessing. I think they should do bell pepper and onion fajitas, instead of carrots and zucchini.

I got the chicken soup burrito, which came out to $15 before tip

The chicken was a

Just like another reviewer, I had started with Gordo’s on Clement St. when I moved to East Bay, the college Ave location was the tops.

It had been 20 years since I was in the Bay Area, and was so happy to nothing changed.  Just delicious burritos.

I think Gordo’s secret is steaming the tortilla with the cheese.  Get it all melt.

I hope it won’t be another 20 years; but if it is Gordo’s: please

I came in. As I am ordering my burrito, with what I want and don't want. I told the girl no sour cream. The cook had made it, and saw him put sour cream. The employee responded with, "you didn't tell me, and we won't make it again. . ."
I work in food and service. So I know how annoying it is when things are not communicated. So I made sure I did communicate well. She kept gas lighting me. Screw t

I had an order delivered. I wish I could send it back and get my money 🤑. Donatos were horrible the burritos were actually soggy how do you make a tortilla soggy???? Almost $50 for it to go in the trash! Totally missing my Tex-Mex food right now..

Gordo's is a Berkeley institution. Two locations - Elmwood and Albany on Solano Avenue. It's not gourmet, not "healthy" (c'mon, fried and grilled meat with high fat beans, guac and sour cream?), not "authentic" Mexican, but tasty and inexpensive. The lines out the door at mealtimes are all the evidence you need. Limited seating, no atmosphere, except that of a brisk counter pick up place, with bus

name: Humbowl
reviews: My favorite restaurant. Humbowl is the go-to. It’s healthy AND incredibly delicious. Lots of options, yet so simple and easy to order. Very kind people working there. I recommend this place to my friends, family, and you.

Highly recommend Humbowl in Court in San Rafael! We had dinner there before a movie and were super impressed.
I had the Thai Curry Bowl with shrimp and my husband had the Wellness Bowl with legumes.

We are hard to please so this 5 star rating says a lot.
Flavors were balanced, not too salty, or spicy.  Lots of veggies and just the right amount of rice to complement.  The shrimp were fresh and coo

Then ...she goes on and on about the Humbowl and how great the food is, she must gave said "Spectacular and Amazing" a dozen times! On top of that she described everything she's eaten there, in detail.
I finally said..Look lady all I want is a haircut okay!  She must be related to the owner because that's the only reason a normal person would go on about a place to a total stranger, but in the end

We ordered a group meal from Humbowl for our elementary school teachers, and the whole experience was fantastic. The food was fresh, healthy, and exceptionally delicious. The team was incredibly accommodating, customizing everything to our needs. Communication was smooth and easy from start to finish.

Humbowl cares about the community. They advocate for neurodiversity people and provided meals fo

We were looking for a quick, healthy place to eat, and Humbowl hit the spot. The bowls were large and packed with healthy veggies. The proteins were fresh, and the sauces were really what took it to the next level. The service was friendly, but the location itself isn’t that comfortable. I would order to-go next time.

name: Gypsy's Trattoria Italiana
editorialSummary: Fast-food outfit with late hours provides Italian comfort dishes to a student-heavy clientele.
reviews: Classic student friendly pricing, this is the spot for Italian food. Lunch special is the way to go , the portion sizing is on point, easily sharable. Godfather’s favorite is what I ordered and it was bomb. The side salad is a nice touches. I would def return here and try more of the menu. The calzone’s and pizza looks great as well. Paying with cash is the pro move to avoid surcharge.

Food was good and satisfying at an acceptable price point. Service was super friendly, kind, and deserving of a generous tip. The restaurant was clean; seating was very tight (not their fault that they are popular). Each pasta was cooked to perfection, not mushy. Sauces were flavorful, and meats were fairly tender. Portions were the perfect ratios of carbs, protein, veggies. Love the roasted garli

Absolutely love this place! I can see why there are plenty of students here! The food here is very filling and comes with huge portions! I do have to say the salad needs a bit more dressing as there's not enough. Nonetheless it's still a 5/5.

Always a good choice!  We've been going here for years and the pasta has always been yummy.  All of us got their fruit de marie and it came with mussels, squid and shrimp.  It was delicious!  It has a cozy feel inside.  I recommend bringing cash to pay.  They charge more for card.

Food isn't very high quality but it's close to the bars so its price for quantity is good value. Discount for cash and extremely packed on a Friday night so food takes a while.

I got their pesto calzone for $15. Huge, but not very good (I got sick of it after a few bites) and took over 20min for a takeout place.

The pesto was oily and a bit bland. Chicken and the thick dough tasted cold and very

name: Zachary's Chicago Pizza
editorialSummary: Branch of a pizza chain serving both deep-dish & thin-crust pies in a room with customer artwork.
reviews:
I've had A LOT of pizza, in a few different states in my lifetime.
Let me tell you...
Nothing compares.

The sauce 😲 is so flavorful, not sweet, super chunky roasted tomatoes.
You can taste fresh garlic.

The crust was crispy, flaky.
Not so much doughy so you don't get filled up on crust in one piece!
Even in the middle where others are usually soggy from all the sauce & grease!

We had tradition
The thick crust pizza is one of the best if you like tomatoes.  It takes around 30 minutes to cook. Very flavorful and filling.

The menu has many delicious options.  Your can order just one slice or any size pizza you want with a variety of scrumptious toppings. My small mouthwatering pizza  was a hot, cheesy, saucy offering with sausage,  pepperoni,  mushrooms and spinach. There was plenty left over to take home for two more meals. The service staff are super friendly and knowledgeable. The ambiance is great. I loved the

Forgot to make a review a year ago when I revisited. After a decade, I’m happy to say that the delicious taste of this deep dish pizza is still the same as before! There’s no place like Zachary’s, I highly recommend it. If there thin crust pizzas are anything like I remember, those were also really good. I also love that all locations have art pieces of Zachary’s in different media, it’s very fun

Supposedly this restaurant has been open since 1983, I’m not sure how they survived for that long if their pizzas were like what we had eaten. The place was still relatively crowded near closing, and was decorated with nostalgic memorabilia. Caesar salad was pretty good but standard and on the heavier side. The two pizzas we got were the thin style Rustic Italian and the Chicago style Zachary’s sp

name: Korean Superette
reviews:
At first, the menu felt a bit overpriced, but after trying the food, I understood the pricing.

The bossam was very tender, and the banchan paired with it really well (I especially liked the mushroom and seaweed). The jang pasta was also excellent and felt quite new and unique to me.

One downside was that both my partner and I had no internet signal inside the restaurant (we use different carrier

If you’re looking for a spot to grab amazing food and totally calm your nervous system, this is the spot. The back patio is the most gorgeous place to unwind and enjoy the lofi ambiance of chill music, lights, and plants. The bulgogi comfort bowl was exactly what my body needed to replenish, a perfect savory broth, mildly spicy,  and complimented by their delicious banchan 💖

Restaurant and Korean mini-mart that has a wide variety of Korean fusion foods. Recommend their Jang Pasta, but they also have an amazing lunch special.

Portions are rather large, so one dish could possibly be good for two people.

They have both an outdoor and indoor space and the restaurant gets quite crowded around 6 PM, so watch out for that!

Service is fast and they do a good job refilling

Delicious dinner on the wood and leaf covered patio! We ordered the rice cakes and silken tofu, and it all tasted fresh and homemade. The portions were generous and enough for leftovers. The service was also very kind! We went on a Tuesday night, and there were plenty of tables available without reservation, but given what a positive experience we had, we’d love to see the place be more full. Now

You're pretty much guaranteed that the food is going to be decent if the restaurant is on Solano Ave. I liked the concept of the items in the store also doubling as decorations to look at while you are dining. The people were also nice and welcoming.

name: Sichuan Style
reviews:
OMG! What delicious vegetarian food!
Highly highly recommend the Tomato Omelette soup. Every dip was soothing and flavorful!
The oil spilling noodles were unique but could have had more veggies. Note that it’s also a little spicy.
Will definitely be coming back to this place for more 😋

*Authentic* and delicious food with generous portions and great value. Everything we ordered was flavorful, and the service was excellent! We couldn’t finish all the food, and the leftover packing was done very thoughtfully. Highly recommend!!

The best Sichuan cuisine in the East Bay area. The quality, portion size, location, and cleanliness are well worth the higher price compared to restaurants in Oakland Chinatown. We have dined here many times and have never been disappointed. Every dish is delicious, authentic, and fresh. We enjoyed everything we ordered, and the portions are so generous that the leftovers easily made two more meal

I recommend and have been 3 times. Green beans are perfect, potsticker wrappers are homemade, scallion pancakes are fried, and fried rice has excellent flavor and lean bits of pork. We usually get sweet and sour chicken but have also had kung pao chicken. Everything is great and I even eat the leftovers which are delicioso. 😗

Like most Chinese restaurants Sichuan style has a very large menu. The restaurant has lots of seating and is rarely full, which is nice. Most of what I’ve had here has been excellent, but I was not as big a fan of the fried rice. It was heavier with stronger flavors than I typically like. The staff was very fast and helpful, and the portions were huge. And they give kimchi!

name: GIOIA Pizzeria
editorialSummary: This spot serves up NY-style slices & tops them with innovative, Californian-style toppings.
reviews: Tucked into the side of your average street in Berkeley is the best pizza we’ve had in the Bay Area. GIOIA is serving up some VERY good pizza out of what feels like a hole in the wall. Beware that parking may be hard to find as it’s right off the street although there is a lot just down the road. The inside is very bare bones, which in this case is a good sign. The smell of the oven and dough just

I’m rating Gioia five stars on the pizza. I love it. Love it. And I love the style which is the New York style way. You order your slices which are pre made pies. Then they heat them in the oven which makes them hot and crispy. Several topping choices to choose. No indoor seating. Other than a bench there’s really no outdoor seating either. But the pizza is so good. And it’s nice, shady outside. D

There is the original location in Berkeley and then another location in Hayes Valley in San Francisco. We passed it all the time so we thought we would come in and try it. They are crust is incredible! Nine out of 10 in that category. They have a very interesting sauce, it’s almost on the edge of a pasta sauce, but not quite. I think honestly if they slightly changed up their sauce, the pizza woul

YUM. I’m so happy to have found this spot. This is some of the best pizza I’ve ever had, and I’m a former New Yorker.

The crust is perfectly chewy and the toppings are absolutely delicious. Our favorite is the Julian, which I’m pretty sure is perfect. The cheese and sausage are so yummy and they are generous with the garlic and lacinato kale. So delicious and dare I say healthy too?

The fact tha

Good pizza. They have a lot of staff there, yet they’re surprisingly slow to respond to customers and not very friendly. They do heat up your pizza to a warm temperature. I prefer hot so I do have to ask for extra time in the oven. No indoor dining just a bench outside to sit on by the tree. They do have a pick up window in the outside so kind of sucks when it rains. Pizza slices have gotten a lit

name: Gordo Taquería
editorialSummary: Burritos stuffed to order & other Mexican standards in a simple, modern outpost.
reviews: I’ve been coming here for 40 years, and they truly have the best burritos in the Bay Area. However, for the first time in four decades, my experience was a letdown. I ordered two Super Burritos to go with guacamole and sour cream, but when I got home, both were missing the sour cream. Worse, the flavor was off—some bites were completely bland while others were hit with way too much salt. I’m reall

It used to be great here.I've been coming here for 25 plus years always had great service. Always had great food and always look forward to visiting the Albany location. When I was in town, designate my parents this last time. Was different? The guy making the food had no personality. Didn't really say much. Then, when I asked 4A burrito with just chicken and rice, he gave me a ton of rice, hardly

I’m a native of San Francisco, having lived in San Pablo for two decades, and now a resident of Martinez….
There are great places and bad places all over the county. However, there’s no greater “Mexican” food in the CoCo County area than this one.

The food was good but customer service ZERO 0. Very rude servers. A bunch of tios speaking about me and I can literally hear everything they been saying. Bad business. Will never comeback here as someone who values customer service.

My husband doesn't speak Spanish and his first impression... this place needs to change their name to Flaco's! (Flaco means skinny Spanish).

I'm Cuban but my family who's been here since the late 60's knows plenty about ordering and eating tacos and burritos. 🌯 I was beyond disappointed in this place. Why are El Cerritans and Albany neighbors recommending this place so highly on Nextdoor? It's b

name: Bowl'd Korean Rice Bar
editorialSummary: Busy Korean spot featuring a large menu specializing in hot & cold rice bowls with vegan options.
reviews:
Fantastic First Experience with Korean Cuisine!

This was my first time trying Korean food, and as a vegetarian, I was quite skeptical. However, I decided to give it a shot and chose this place—and I’m so glad I did!

The dishes were absolutely amazing. The kimchi fried rice and kimbap were beyond delicious—so flavorful that it’s hard to put into words how much I enjoyed them. I was thrilled to fi

I felt really let down after going here. The bibimbap was kinda bland and the portion was smaller than I expected for the price, my freind said the same about her bowl. Service was slow even though it wasnt that busy, which is frustrating when youre on a lunch break. Definately not somewhere I feell like going back to anytime soon.

Haven’t been to this place for a long time. They renovated the entire restaurant and seating spaces are not crowded as before. Food quality is good and I love they always have variety of vegetables in the sushi roll and also buckwheat noodle salad. They provide variety of side dishes too. Good service and friendly staff too :) The special multi grain drink is also a traditional Korean drink which

Food is delicious. Got a hot spicy pork belly bibimbop with mixed grains. Unbelievably yummy, although careful with the hot bowl!
You also get soup and small dishes (like tofu) with the food.
Service was great. They were quick, efficient, and considerate staff!
The inside aesthetic is relaxing, my only complaint it the floor is SLIPPERY. Just the floor material makes it hard to grip in certain sho

Honestly I just realized, I forgot to review my favorite Korean restaurant in the bay. They just really make my 김치찌개 Kimchijjiggae differently.. I could say it taste like how my grandma used to make it. Their staff is really nice, Portions are great. Must try their seafood pancake and or Mungbean pancake. Even their chicken is great ❤️

name: Benchmark Pizzeria
editorialSummary: Rustic pick for artisanal Neapolitan pies, starters, pastas & soft-serve ice cream plus beer & wine.
reviews:
The Benchmark Pizza was very good. Sauce, crust, all of it. Delicious.  We also ordered the chopped salad and spicy carrots and a pasta dish that I can't recall the name of.

Overall the experience was great. If you have more than two people, order a second pizza.

Benchmark continues to be one of my favorite spots when a serious pizza craving hits. Last night, I stopped in specifically hoping to try the eggplant pizza, but unfortunately they were sold out. Since the only other pie I’d previously had there was the brown butter sage — delicious, though I’ve learned lemon on pizza simply isn’t my thing — I decided to go with their classic Benchmark margherita

This place serves the best vegan pizza I’ve ever had—worth a visit for that alone. Highly recommend! I also loved their sparkling red wine; we thoroughly enjoyed it. The lemon pizza and the sage pizza were excellent as well.

A few small suggestions as feedback: it would be great to see some vegetarian pasta options added. All the appetizers leaned on sweetness, which wasn’t quite our preference—h

The crust here is hands down the best! perfectly chewy with just the right amount of crisp and char. You can really taste the quality in every bite. Their pasta is also solid, always cooked just right and full of flavor. And no visit is complete without ordering the sundae ice cream! it’s a must-have! Creamy, rich, and the perfect way to end the meal. Highly recommend this place if you’re craving
Worth the drive for Napolian pizza. Go early for dinner.  Wait can be to be 30 minutes on a busy night.

name: Talavera Cocina Mexicana
editorialSummary: Casual corner spot serving tortilla soup, a variety of tacos & tamales plus other Mexican standards.
reviews:
Good portion sizes, quick service and delicious food.
We really liked our nopales and chorizo burritos. The chocolate flan was super tasty too!

Taqueria Talavera was good! I’m a burrito person and decided to try a different type of burrito instead of my regular carne asada. I decided to go with the specialty Mole burrito and it was spicy and flavorful, I was shocked how good it was. They had music playing also, so while you wait for your food you can could enjoy the music. The service was fast and efficient although I showed up close to c

Huge menu, awesome food! I love Talavera's breakfast burrito and mole enchiladas. I always have enough for leftovers too. While I usually do to-go orders, I always hit the fantastic salsa bar before I head home.

I am a Gordo's burrito girl through and through, but occasionally I have to get my Talavera fix. It's a little pricier than my go-to burrito spot down the street but the options at Talave

Its restaurants like this that causes me to constantly question how does an establishment like Taco Bell exist in the Bay Area? This isn't to diss your preferences if you love Taco Bell. But I am saying is Talavera Cocina Mexicana is not only affordable but almost criminally priced because it's truly that good.

The burritos and nachos are sublime. This restaurant also makes great pastries. I have
My favorite Mexican place in Oakland! It’s always good, the lady working the register is super kind and helpful, the food is fast and is always fantastic.

name: China Village
editorialSummary: Bright, convivial venue boasts an extensive menu of Chinese dishes, including spicy Sichuan fare.
reviews:
I had dinner here tonight. I ordered pea shoots and spicy fish fillets.
The pea shoots were fresh and full of garlic flavor. They are my favorite vegetable—healthy and delicious.
The spicy fish was really tasty. It’s the best I’ve had in the past one or two years.
The restaurant provided tea and side dishes. The environment is comfortable, and the service was nice and thoughtful.
Highly recommend!

My parents have been coming here since before I was born and I grew up eating here. I 100% would say this is my favorite Chinese restaurant ever. The quality of the food is always top tier and super delicious every time. The staff is so friendly and the service is always fantastic!
This is our go-to place to get tasty handcut noodles, hot and cold salad and spicy pork shoulder. Love this place!

Great food. Rice🍚 is delicious and any order comes with good tea. Mongolian beef 🍖 is great. Tender, very soft and flavorful. Food was well-priced. Chow Mein was delicious and my kids loved it. Sizzling rice soup was great, although I found that it didn't have enough shrimp 🦐, but the broth was good. Service was also good.

This is one of my favorite Chinese restaurants. The food was absolutely delicious, and every dish was full of flavor. The service was excellent from the moment we arrived, and we especially want to thank our waitress, Suby, for her kindness, attentiveness, and outstanding service. It’s definitely the perfect place to enjoy a great meal with family or friends. We will definitely be coming back!

name: AKEMI
editorialSummary: Inventive, farm-sourced menus range from sushi to Japanese small plates at this stylish bistro.
reviews:
Great food. Guests loved all.
Ordered a lot but was so busy eating that I only remembered to take 1 picture !!:)
Service was great but just a little understaffed when busy…understandable
Relaxing ambience; loved those whole piece wooden long tables - very special!
One note - the bathroom lighting is way too dark (in my opinion) and can be hazardous for older people.

This place was fantastic. The service was 100%. The restaurant ambiance was five star. I really liked this restaurant, but I didn't think that cost was accurate for the  taste.  I thought the food was good but everything else was incredible. I love how they do their sake set up too!

Excellent. I’ve been here several times since 2022 and this was the best. The okonomiyaki is crunchy and amazing. The salmon plate is always great. Salmon is super high quality. The tempura is light and delicious. The only thing I would change is slightly brighter lighting.

This restaurant serves delicious Sushi. The fish tasted fresh and the service was good.

The service might be a bit slow before dinner but I'll be worth it.

Had a mixed experience here. The sweet shrimp quality is excellent. The okinawayaki is excessively oily and salty, exacerbated by the sauce. The black cod is alright, but the overdose of okinawayaki makes it a bit overwhelming. The karaage is good, but the overall discomfort caused by the excessive oil and salt, particularly in the okinawayaki, impacts the overall experience.

name: Cactus Taqueria
editorialSummary: This taqueria serves traditional Mexican fare in a warehouse-style space with colorful accents.
reviews: Absolutely loved this restaurant! The flavors of authentic Mexican dishes were amazing and everything tasted fresh. The prices are fair and the service was quick so we did not have to wait long for our order. The place has a bright and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for families. I was also happy to find great gluten free options on the menu. Parking can be a bit tight in the area, but the food and

I've been eating at Cactus Taquerias both in the Rockridge since that first opened many years ago, and North Berkeley when it opened. Sometimes I would park at Rockridge BART, grab a burrito And take it with me over to San Francisco for a Giants game.  Took a friend and my sister to the Solano avenue Cactus, and they were both blown away last night. One had the Caesar salad and a taco, and my sist

I have visited here 10 times and find the food fresh and light, not lardy, and reasonably priced. The environment is acoustically hard and the noise from the fans of the open kitchen are a bit loud, so its ok for a quick bite but not to take friends for a social meal

Restaurant has a moldy odor. I Got a super burrito which was small. Tortilla was still raw. Toppings were such small portions I thought they'd forgotten. I bought a scoop of fresh salsa and was stunned at the $4.35 cost of the dressing cup portion.
Dissatisfied with my $23 experience.
Never again

Terrible place. No authenticity, bland food, and couldn’t even put the salsa In the bag. Horchata taste like milk and ice with hint of cinnamon like salt bayed the cinnamon in the horchata.This embarrassment to the Bay Area and please pick anywhere else as this place is a waste of money and time.

name: Barneys Gourmet Hamburgers
editorialSummary: Upmarket counter-serve with all-natural beef & vegetarian burgers, salads, shakes & more quick eats.
reviews: I go here like 4 times a week because the food and service not only consistently GREAT, but the food is also super healthy for a restaurant (They have grilled chicken versions of all their different burger combinations). I regularly order different menu items because I love trying new things. I think I've tried almost everything on the menu and for a few rare exceptions, it's all absolutely amazin

Felt like burger. So we came here. This is brother in law favorite burger joint. We ordered to share: Steak Fries, truffles fries and sweet potato fries. We also ordered: Barney’s burger, Maui Waui, and Baja Burger. Omg. Their burgers is thick, huge and juicy. Not only was the food good, their service was awesome too. We would definitely come back.

Delicious curly fries and burger!! Prices are high, but prices are high everywhere these days. Big portions with extra dipping sauce which is a nice plus. The burger definitely is delicious as well. I work in the road all over the world 365 days a year, finding local food spots is a must for me. I would definitely highly recommend Barney’s for a special burger and fries treat!!

On our most recent visit there were these tiny flies, like fruit flies, buzzing around our table and surrounding the restroom and back kitchen door area. This is Completely unsanitary for a restaurant of any kind, especially at these high prices and none of the employees seem to care or want to do anything about it.
We had to deduct more stars on this review from a restaurant we used to love going

For the cost, you shouldn’t have to assemble your own burger or have to pay for fries. Very bland, flavorless burgers. The string fries were over cooked and for $1 for the garlic flavor it was half a teaspoon provided. Tables are disgustingly sticky.

The bus boy provided better attentive service than our waitress that cursed very loudly to the her fellow colleagues. Will never recommend to others

name: Solano Junction
editorialSummary: Relaxed cafe focusing on being eco-friendly while serving American breakfast & lunch staples.
reviews: Ordered a omelette/scramble and fresh squeezed orange juice. The taste and quality was great for my Sunday brunch craving. Made it in time before it was a wait or really busy.

My cousin loves this spot and brought me along — now I see why! She swears by the eggs Benedict and says it never fails her. I had a bite and for my first time trying eggs Benedict, I genuinely enjoyed it too!

Her kids ordered the “mini pancakes,” which were definitely not mini 😅 but still super delicious. I got the breakfast sandwich, which was also really good — hearty and flavorful. The only

This was my second time at Solano Junction, and once again, it was absolutely amazing! The breakfast was absolutely delicious—from the perfectly seasoned crispy potatoes to the fluffy pancakes, fresh eggs, juicy sausage, and a refreshing fruit bowl.
Topped it off with a smooth mimosa and warm, friendly service. Cozy atmosphere, great food, and consistent quality. Definitely a favorite spot—highly
Delicious Breakfast. Awesome customer Service. We were seated immediately. Street Parking.

Great first impression. Had French toast and wildcat egg Benedict both were good. I really enjoyed the egg Benedict hollandaise sauce was delicious it stood out seemed authentic to the restaurant. Potatoes were seasoned correctly. Cooks pay attention to detail for example English muffins in egg Benedict were toast just right. The coffee was also great. Customer service was outstanding. Over all gr

name: Kim's Café & Sandwiches
reviews:
Had a tasty Lemongrass Chicken Bánh Mì style sandwich with a good amount of chicken.
Very quick service.
Inside seating and a street parklet.

I went to Kim’s Cafe and Sandwiches for the first time yesterday and had their Turmeric Noodle Soup. It was one of the best soups I’ve ever had, and I can’t wait to go back. Customer service was great and there were many open tables available. Thank you!

Came to try the lemongrass chicken banh mi.   The bread was mildly crunchy, and not as airy as I like. The chicken was good with some sweetness but not very lemon-grassy.  I’m not sure it’s worth $11 but I think that is the going rate unless you drive farther out.

There is a covered parklet you can eat on, or you can eat inside but it’s rather dark inside.
.

Secret spot ( ha ha) I think this place is hidden and away from the main traffic which is a nice change. The place is modern looking on the inside. The menu is tradition with an influence of the current community. You order at the counter and then take a #. It's self seating, front, back, and the tiny court yard. The food is so Saigon. Lemon grass chicken vermicelli has chunky chicken well balance

I ate here last Saturday and ordered the beef noodle soup. The soup was clean-taste and refreshing. I looked for a clearer instead of full of spices or denser soup, so it was the right choice for me! Tender beef with still some bite and a good amount of noodle to fill me up. The staff was friendly. A nice place to sit alone and enjoy a bowl of soup during a cool evening ☺️.

name: O2 Eatery
reviews:
ABSOLUTELY LOVED MY FIRST TIME‼️

We had brunch here. The Spam bowl is MASSIVE 😄 - was surprised by it... but it was GOOD! I had the Garden Scramble and enjoyed it as well... potatoes were tasty. The Croffle was fabulous and a nice balance to the rest of our meal. This is now a new FAV for us on Solano👍🏽. Can't wait to come back 💯.
