My wife and I recently visited O2 Eatery one morning when we were looking for a nice, comfortable place to enjoy a good breakfast. We wanted something fresh, peaceful, and worth the trip, so we looked this place up and saw that it had great reviews. When we arrived, we were lucky enough to find parking right in front of the restaurant, which made the visit start off smoothly. The outside looked cl

I really liked the attention to detail and the presentation of the food — everything looked beautifully decorated and thoughtfully prepared. The check-in process was also fast and efficient, which made the experience smooth from the start. However, the cappuccino and matcha were pretty average and didn’t stand out compared to the overall ambiance and presentation.

When I tell you this place gets packed quick I mean GET HERE EARLY if it’s the weekend/holiday! Now the MAIN CORSE —> The food was so flavorful I sat down & ordered 2 meals the avocado toast with the bacon And the number one go to after working long hours after work, Ramen…. I’m sleepy like a new born baby so yall get the point….. CATCH A VIBE @Q2Eatery because I know I did!!!

Service was lovely, the atmosphere was charming and beautiful dried flower arrangements hanging and flower vibes. Love the wooden tables and most importantly the food was outstanding. Sorry some pictures are already half way through the meal lol I will definitely be back and share this new gem with friends and family. 10 out of 10 ding dong they nailed it!

name: Mainichi Sushi
reviews:
I had a really cool time here !!! The chefs are amazing so kind and understanding. I was losing my voice and he was very patient and the second
Chef was really fast . I think this isn’t favorite sushi place now ! The staff really looked out for me and I don’t think they k pa
How much it meant to me . Sometimes I show up  places  and people  treat me  negatively for no particular reason but I felt

Ordered Pink Lady from Specialty, Rock n Roll and 2 maki s for lunch. Rolls had good amt of fresh sashimi in them and were tasty. Staff was very helpful with recommendations and nice. Ambience wasn't fancy but perfect for lunch

Great sushi place! Free miso soup and orange slices. I recommend getting a few rolls and splitting them with a party. Our server, Mika, was great. I like to get the orange blossom roll with lemon slices on top instead of tobiko. It’s delish. I highly recommend.

Fun local Japanese restaurant for a quality and balanced dinner or for some small bites with drinks. Theres a great deal for the 2 item bento course and our food came with complimentary miso soups and cold orange desserts at the end.

My partner and I enjoyed our late lunch here! The layout of the restaurant felt very open and airy because of the huge windows that were open. We ordered three different rolls- the lobster, spider fantasy, and spicy crunch roll. While we were waiting, they brought us salad and miso soup which was really nice of them. Two of the rolls were HUGE and everything tasted fresh. The lobster roll had lots

name: Pizza Twist
reviews: I love this place. We stop by whenever we're in town. There are so many tasty pizza flavors to try and they can sub vegan cheese instead of dairy cheese if you ask. The vegan cheese is really good. Love that they're open so late. The service is also really friendly and helpful.

Amazing pizza did not expect to like fusion pizza so much. The butter chicken pizza was sooooooo good. The wings were fire they baked it not fried it was way better than typical wings because it was actually cooked to the bone.

We went there and randomly tried the achari paneer pizza, and omg it was sooo good 😭🍕 The achari flavor had that tangy, spicy kick but still felt comforting. And the paneer was soft, not dry at all. Everything just blended so nicely.

We honestly didn’t expect it to hit that good. Now we’re already talking about going back and trying more from the menu 😂✨
The pizza and fries were fantastic.The service was also really good. My friends and I came here after school and were treated very nicely by the staff. We will definitely be coming back here again :)

I don’t usually leave reviews, but after a long day at work I decided to try this spot that serves Indian-inspired pizza, sandwiches, and wings. I normally go for Mexican food at dinnertime, but their pizza menu caught my attention.

Nate — who I believe may be the owner — helped me out and provided excellent guidance. I ordered a half Butter Chicken / half Achari Chicken pizza, and it was phenome

name: Ole's Waffle Shop
editorialSummary: This no-frills area diner offers an extensive American breakfast menu, plus steaks & sandwiches.
reviews:
I enjoyed it. Service was decent. Was it worth waiting in line outside ? Thats up to you.
Breakfast was good, especially the waffles. The fried chicken I wasn’t too impressed. Cooked well but lacked flavor. I will go again.

This place is legendary!! The food was amazing and so was the service! Our waitress Jennifer was kind and attentive. There was also this guy walking around with a coffee pot keeping everyone's coffee filled up. We loved every bit of our meal and would definitely return if we come back to this town.
9.3 💥. This place is legit, I stepped in for breakfast.   The food, service and atmosphere was amazing.  There was a line but got seated quickly.  If in the area be sure to check this place out.  👊🏽

Came here on a Sunday late morning. All street parking so took awhile to find a spot. Waited about thirty minutes in line for five people. There is two sections of this place but it's super busy so there was a wait outside. This place has been here since I was in grade school. Nothing has been upgraded. Felt homie though. Old fashion seats. They have some bar seats to see the action in the kitchen

Consider this review a 3.5, rounded down. Found this place through social media and decided to try it out. Brought the boyfriend here for an early Valentine's day breakfast (his favorite type of food) and grabbed the last parking spot in front of the restaurant at 6:45am. He had the French toast combo while I asked about the chicken and waffles. Coffee for both of us, which was good and overflowin

name: Cholita Linda
reviews: Excellent place to get Cuban American food. Sandwiches, plates and drinks! Plantains and fried yuca appetizers were awesome.

2nd visit and I really enjoyed the consistency of flavors with the food. Pescado plate is my favorite and must not forget to mention the 🍋‍🟩 margarita.After late lunch you still have time to browse the classic storefront shops.

Always love this place, from the tacos to the sandwiches! Tried the salad recommended by a friend and it was delicious and filling :)

Would recommend trying the yucca fries too!

Food is ok, the chicken rice plantain plate was very good, tacos were a bit anaemic. The sweet potato fries were soggy unfortunately.

This is a place that asks for a tip after ordering when in reality you sit down at a restaurant that makes you order at a counter then get your own water and clean up after yourself. $44 for 2 people for all the food and 1 drink pictured including tax + tip.

Last Sunday I ordered some food to go from Cholita Linda in Alameda. I've eaten at the Oakland location years ago and it was really good. The tacos I ordered at the Alameda location weren't good at all! I ordered the chicken, Carne asada and carnitas taco. The chicken didn't even taste like chicken. It just tasted like very bland mystery meat. It had no flavor! The Carne asada tasted old and chewy

name: La Penca Azul
editorialSummary: Long-running, family-owned Mexican restaurant offering an extensive menu including margaritas.
reviews: A friend invited me to eat there; she said she had smelled the food from there and that it was wonderful. The first time I went, the food really was wonderful, especially the cactus salad. The second time wasn't as pleasant; I ordered the same food as the first time, and the tilapia was soaked in oil, and the beans didn't taste very appetizing. But even so, it's worth a visit for anyone who just w

La Penca Azul has the best Mexican food In Alameda. I come here to eat with my family and friends and I enjoy my dinner every time. I usually order the street tacos, or tamale dinner. Good flavor In the steak tacos very authentic and the Tamale plate has a very good green sauce on it, love the beans and rice too. I would say maybe work on the service, no utensils one time and are waitress was not
Omg, YOU MUST take your friends here! Lovely cantina style, generous portions, and right on Park Ave for a post dinner walk. I loved my steak tostada dish!
The mariscada is very basic... they give u, Two sauces on the side, cocktail n garlic butter... had better... drinks ok.. service from the bartender was awesome tho.... very over-rated

If you are dinning in you can get a decent meal. If you are getting it to go, it's a different situation; seems meals to go are not prepared with the same love. 🤔 It's been tried and tested three times! Yesterday was my third time and I've had enough! 🤷🏾‍♀️ If you tell them they will generally make it right but consistency is everything, quality is why you come and gas is expensive!! The beans

name: Fikscue Craft BBQ
reviews:
I tried their food when they were selling it in Facebook marketplace around 2020. Their fusion of Indonesian and Texas bbq was really cool, and the first dish I tried back then was their brisket soto, which was truly amazing and creative. When I heard that they were opening a brick and mortar in 2023, I had been wanting to go, but insane hype made it nearly impossible to go to, until now.

For two

We arrived 40 minutes early on a Sunday to ensure we had good position in line. Everyone in line was treated to a delicious sample just before opening, very kind!

We ordered 2x dino ribs, brisket, beef cheek, jalapeño sausage, nasi goreng, lumpia, rendang, and a cendol. Everything was very delicious and the service was great!

Only critique is - where is the heat?! Please offer sambal or a spicy

I drove a long way specifically to try this halal BBQ steakhouse — and it was absolutely worth it! Finding a halal steakhouse is so rare, and this place did not disappoint.

I ordered three cuts: Brisket, Dino Ribs, and Beef Back Ribs. As a foodie with a trained palate, here’s my honest breakdown:

The Brisket was well-cooked with good flavor, but leaned a little on the lean side for my personal t

Fikscue Craft BBQ popped up on my social media feed, and the concept of Indonesian cuisine with a BBQ twist immediately caught my attention. I stopped by on a Saturday afternoon before 2 PM, fully expecting a long wait after hearing how busy it can get—but to my surprise, it wasn’t too bad.

One thing to note is that there is very limited seating at Fikscue itself. However, there’s a beer spot nex

Best BBQ and it's ALLL HALAL! Alhamdulillah! A must for those who love a great  brisket! The jalapeño cheese beef sausage was a hit!. We tried practically everything since Fikscue was on my husband's bucket list. Beef back ribs, Beef cheeks & fried chicken. The Rendang was full of flavor and the coco-pandan soda gembria was delicious! Everything was YUMMY! We're definitely going back to try their

name: Speisekammer
editorialSummary: Quaint German restaurant & bar offering classic dishes, lots of draft beers & occasional live music.
reviews: The Speisekammer in Alameda is a delightful German restaurant that never fails to impress. I recently visited after a long break since the pandemic, and I was pleasantly surprised to find that their culinary expertise and friendly staff have remained unchanged. The food is still as delicious as ever, and the staff is more than happy to guide you through their extensive menu to find the perfect dis

My wife and I were craving German food and so we checked out Speisekammer.  Wow, what amazing food!  We ordered the German salad combo which was filled with pickled veggie goodness.  This paired well with the heavier jager schnitzel and spatzel (fried chicken cutlet and dumpling style pasta) we shared. The chicken was super tender and juicy despite being a thin breaded chicken breast and the spatz

Good for those who drink, it's a great place to have a beer. I don't drink, but the service was excellent. I noticed the waiter seemed a little upset that my friend and I didn't drink alcohol. We had dinner, and I can say the food is formally German. I have some of the highest-rated German restaurants on my resume. I can say that Parabara is passable, but as a truly typically German restaurant, it

We come to Speisekammer every year in December! Despite the comments from another reviewer, they have traditional Christmas decorations up, gluhwein, and other Christmas specials posted on sign boards and on their walls. The food has remained consistently good and is a favorite of my mother’s.

Great beer list with good food. After A Spaten lager which was great when paired with the soft pretzel with delicious cheese sauce. I had the sauerbraten, tender and tangy tri tip, served with pickled red cabbage and spatzel (noodles). The sauerbraten and cabbage were delicious and a big serving. The room felt like we were in Germany and the bar area had good energy. There is also a nice outdoor s

name: Hayashi Japanese Cuisine
reviews: Sushi is fresh, portions are large, staff is friendly and the food was delicious! I got the mango crunch roll, it’s a little sweet with a kick. My husband had the rainbow roll and it was also very tasty, fresh and bigger than expected.

Hayashi was such a great experience! A hidden gem of Alameda! The sushi was delicious and fresh. Spicy garlic edamame was 10/10. The tuna tataki was the star of the show. Emily was such a great server; super nice and funny!

Love it, the food so yummy, great service everything we were needing, they helped us, and dessert is free, yes you read right   when we finished the ice cream that they give us, one woman came to the table and give us moshi ice cream to try it. We love this place. It's from 2 hours away from my house but I will be back. Thank you so much!

Came in on a whim with a friend and ate our weight in rolls and appetizers. Came back again solo after a rough day to “treat myself”. Both times the food was excellent, the wait staff is super friendly, and the clientele seem to be pretty fun and joyful while dining. Come in if you want oof food from a local spot 💕

Hayashi is just a delectable hometown delight. Giving hope to the strong tradition alameda businesses. We had a large group and order a lot off the menu. They were able to accommodate all of our needs.

Fresh seafood. Tempura was light and airy, rolls were well constructed. The shrimp skewer Devine. Come in and taste greatness!

name: Julie's Coffee & Tea Garden
editorialSummary: Teas galore plus sustainable veg-driven fare featured in a charming space with a patio garden.
reviews:
Julie’s Coffee & Tea Garden is one of those spots that instantly wins you over with both its charm and its energy. Yes, it gets very busy on weekends—but it’s popular for a reason, the service stays fast, attentive, and genuinely warm even during the rush.
Food-wise, everything felt fresh and thoughtfully prepared. The avocado toast was solid and satisfying, but the real standout was the Julie bre

Love this cute little place. Healthy food, coffee and tea, cute outdoor garden, dog friendly. I got the grain bowl with quinoa and crispy black lentils and it was delicious. Also got cappuccino with oat milk and it was great. I would totally come back and highly recommend!

I ordered the orange beet salad and added the $5 chicken add-on. They threw some cold, chopped chicken (food not look like the slices in the picture at all) on top of a bed of spinach, a couple beet slices, and some red onions. The blood orange vinegrette was completely tasteless. It was like they just put olive oil on it and called it a day. For a $20 salad, I might as well go to Mixt Greens and

I have a feeling that the staff dislike me as they serve my tea with an uncleaned strainer(there's like literally 1 inch thick of tea leaves left over in it) and without milk (I need to ask for it...). And when I asked for the milk she sorta has this weird reaction... and the whole time with very little eye contact. But just a feeling though. The scone was great and with Devonshire cream??! Will g

It’s such a cute spot with really fresh & delicious food! The garden area in the back is so nice & relaxing. My friend & I started with an Oatmeal Coffee Cake and a Blueberry Muffin which were both so moist & flavorful. The Ginger Lemon brew (iced) was very refreshing & my friend’s Iced Vanilla Latte w/oat milk was so yummy! I also had to try the Baked Eggs w/ a side baguette & it was absolutely s

name: Tahina
reviews:
As an RN in Alameda, I often have short breaks, so getting a quick, delicious meal is important. Tahina never disappoints! My go-to order is the Cali Bowl with added salmon and feta cheese. The ingredients are always fresh, the portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable.

The cashiers are friendly, service is fast, and they get my order right every single time. When you’re on a tigh

Delicious food! I've eaten here a few times and I'm never disappointed. I got the vegan falafel pita pocket, but swapped the pita for a lavish wrap. So much better and it's huge! The eggplant dip with the pita bread is also super good. A great side dish 😋💚
Fantastic place for lunch or dinner. Big fan of the chicken shawarma wrap and the cali bowl. the falafel is really good. Fantastic harissa sauce and seating outside, which is communal for the area.

Consistently delicious food.  Everything I've had is great; I especially love the frozen yogurt and the shawarma wrap.

Closed on Sundays!

Tahina is an absolute gem when it comes to delicious food! Every bite is packed with flavor, and the quality is outstanding. Their menu is well-crafted, offering some of the best dishes I’ve had in a long time. The customer service is just as impressive—friendly, quick, and attentive. The only downside is that there’s no seating available, so it’s more of a takeout or grab-and-go spot. However, th

name: Monkey King Pub & Grub
editorialSummary: Upbeat haunt serving Asian fusion pub plates, along with unique cocktails & draft beer.
reviews: The young man with a beanie and shortish hair in the front was really sweet! The portions of the food was humongous with us being able to take home food. Really great spot and will be recommending it to people in the future.

The food I ordered was, chicken chew main and pepper lemon chicken wing, they both were very salty and I mean 🧂 I tasted one noodle because of how it looks it was soaked in sauce.  I brought it to there attention, and the server had the nerve to say they can't make remake the 2 orders because I didn't let them know, but I had just did and never got my lemonade 🍋 drink as well.  I noticed they ne

The service here is nice and food is served in a reasonable amount of time. There's about a dozen or so tables here. The atmosphere can be a bit loud if you're looking for a much more quieter dining experience. The food here is okay. I had the Honey Walnut Prawns, Ginger and Green Onion Crab Fried Rice, and Chicken Laab. The portions are generous, but lacks the more traditional South Eastern Asian

Great place. Chill and the food is unbelievable when it comes to flavors. Very happy to have been ref here by fambam. Calvin is a great host and the whole vibe of the place was welcoming and laidback.  Korean wings-mongolian chowmein- salt pepper wings-monkeyking fried rice- chicken skins- lumpia!!!!!!! Crazy delicious!!! Couldn't order just one had to try a variety!!!! Highly recommended!!!

The food is AMAZING here! I went for the first time the other day and ended up going right back 2 days later 😭 I tried both the chicken and the shrimp fried rice, the beef and broccoli, garlic noodles, the salt and pepper wings w/ fries (wasn’t cooked all the way so I ended up bringing them home and putting them in the air fryer), black pepper beef and their spicy crab fries. I have a video/ pict

name: Yojimbo
editorialSummary: Miniature Japanese eatery serving udon & sushi amid pop culture artwork & anime on TV.
reviews:
Solid Japanese comfort food done right. Super cute decor inside with TVs playing Anime and small figurines everywhere. Danny Yuen and Neo from Matrix was in my corner. 🔥

The chicken katsu curry hit exactly how it should: crispy cutlet, rich curry in a separate bowl on the side, fluffy rice, easy to finish.

The Wakame salad was served in a large portion. The 49ers roll was simple and great, salm

I loved this place and am grateful I got enjoy it. If you're into Samurai, art, and collectible figurines, then you're in for a nice bonus as well. The food was smelled so good that I ate immediately and forgot to take pictures of it. I definitely recommend the Sobba roll of you're not scares off by eel. It was DELICIOUS! All the food was delicious.  I did manage to walk around like I was in an ar

✨️ Yojimbo and Gallery 🖼

I've been wanting to come to this new location since it opened. I had always eaten at the old location on Park Street, it's a hidden gem. Too bad they closed that spot, but I can see why they are keeping the new location. 💎

This new location is bigger and more spacious. All the art pieces and figurines that were in the smaller location are pretty much here and spread o

Great spot, a little difficult finding street parking tho.  Interior is whimsical with lots of anime figurine display and black ink drawings on the walls.  Food is fantastic, tho on the pricey side.  Service was good, not great, especially if you catch them on a shift change like we did.

Love coming here, one of my favorite to stop by it’s like my 10th time

Friendly staff and lots good options.
The complimentary peanut salad and the cream puffs.

I saw new items added and looks good to try out.

name: The Star on Park
editorialSummary: Subs, salads & Chicago-style pizza in airy digs with exposed-brick walls, chandeliers & a full bar.
reviews:
Seriously some of the best pizza I've had in quite a long time! All made fresh to order and I really wanted to try the Detroit style pizza but the family wasn't feeling adventurous but we did have the Detroit style cheesy bread which was phenomenal!

Our favorites were the chicken pesto and the carbonara! But seriously, everything was good!

If we ever move to Alameda, The Star on Park would be my favorite pizza restaurant! We were looking at homes and while walking around, came across the charming Star on Park, that used to be a bank!  Our waitress was lovely and everything we ate was delicious!

Delicious pizza with crust made to perfection! Beautiful decorum, prompt and friendly service (thanks Lewis for taking such good care of us!) This was our first time here, but I'm sure we'll be back again!👌

What other pizza "joint" do you know of that has chandeliers with a solid dark wood ceiling and a marble wall with 2 vaults. This place has taken it up a few notches.

Got the thin crust pizzas. Favorite was the all star with a side of anchovies.

They had issues with their wifi and some of the ticket orders were delayed.  Employees were very apologetic.   They handled it the best they could.

The deep dish is super tasty. The crust is really good. Vegan cheese available. I’ve done both dine in and take out. They have a good salad + pizza deal for dine in. Fun restaurant atmosphere. Nice staff.

name: Sidestreet Pho
editorialSummary: Vietnamese noodle soups, rice porridge & other classic staples offered in a contemporary bistro.
reviews:
A long-time favorite that never disappoints!

The Food: Massive variety and phenomenal quality. The bomb wings are a must-order every time, and the Bún Riêu is packed with flavor. We also tried their current limited-time special menu and absolutely loved it—it definitely deserves a permanent spot on the menu.
The Service: Outstanding. Our server, Duke, was highly attentive and took great care of u

I’m sad that I live too far from this place to be able to enjoy it whenever I want because it’s that good, and I am not exaggerating. The food is delicious and every single item is packed with flavor, served fresh, and tasted better than you could even fathom. I came with my best friend who’s a vegan and she was able to order so many items like king mushrooms, spring rolls, fried rolls, and tofu.

The shaken beef plate with garlic noodles was top tier, I will be back for it no doubt. The oxtail pho was a little difficult to get the meat off the bone for me tbh. Service fast and excellent on a Friday night! $90 for 2 people with tax + tip

It’s been a while since I’ve been here, I try to go to Oakland for Vietnamese food. Didn’t feel like leaving the island and thought I’d give Sidestreet another try. I won’t be coming back. The bun bo hue and was lacking flavor, not spicy at all, and worst of all the noodles were chopped up - the worst BBH I’ve ever had. Hubby got a grilled pork rice plate and it was ok.

5/5 for the Food and drinks, it was spectacular, great serving sizes and good variety! The variety of beverages and the cola’s they had!

Rating 4/5 for Service since I can’t speak to the service when it’s busy, but it’s spectacular when it was not so busy. Food came out quick and they checked up on us often.

Atmosphere 4/5, again it wasn’t busy so can’t fully speak to the vibe of the restaurant.

name: Wild Ginger
editorialSummary: Unpretentious spot for noodle soups & Szechuan street food served in contemporary environs.
reviews:
I have to say, I’ve really fallen in love with this place. The owner and the staff (the lady who’s always there) are such wonderful people. They’re so kind to everyone, and their warmth and kindness never fail to touch my heart.

The noodles are absolutely delicious. My husband’s favorite is the Spicy Cumin Lamb in Sauce. Mine is the Spicy Hot-Oil Seared in Sauce. I’ve lost count of how many times

We absolutely loved your experience and food at Wild Ginger tonight. The owners were very friendly and service was great.

Hand pulled noodles were fresh. Sauces had tons of flavor. We will definitely be back! The cold noodle dish was very yummy as well! We will definitely be back.

The overall experience is 1.25 stars. The environment looks nasty/dirty. Bros, please spends extra more time to clean your shop. The food is not specifically good, at least I dont' feel that way.

Also not recommended for big group (5+). It is a super tiny shop.

Until then I cannot recommend this to others.

First time and last time to go there.   Kid wanted to get noodles which they did but,  not as good as other places.   The server have water with lemon in it,  we didn't want the lemon yet,  they still didn't offer to swap out.

Great small restaurant that a coworker recommended me. I really enjoyed everything they had to offer. The hospitality of the staff is great. They are very attentive and giving. I assume she was the owner, we were given a free cucumber salad in their signature chili oil sauce that they make and sell separately.

The hand pulled noodles were great! I can’t complain about anything on the dish. The po

name: Scolari's Good Eats
editorialSummary: Compact go-to for stromboli, burgers & Buffalo fries with optional delivery to the bar next door.
reviews:
I got the Nahsville Hot Chicken Sandwhich with Parmesan fries. The sandwhich reminded me a lot of the sandwiches I'd get when I loved in TN and the fries were the right of amount of greasy, but not too greasy.

Overall a chill place to hang out in the outdoor seating area to enjoy some food.
Great burger joint, friendly staff. No seats inside but there's parklet tables or you can eat inside the bar nextdoor.

I was craving a light sandwich and the B.A.T hit the spot! The chicken sandwich was ok. Not pictured were the truffle parmesean fries and they were delicious! $48 for 2 sandwiches, 1 half fries, 1 soda.

The blueberry burger is insane. So unique and flavorful. I'm also a sucker for blue cheese so it doesn't hurt! We also had the korean chicken sandwich and garlic fries, both were excellent. I love that you can order the food and they'll bring it to the bar. An ideal setup really.

The food is phenomenal and they have both vegetarian and vegan options available. Super small space with a couple counter seats inside, but otherwise tables available out front at the parklets. I had a vegetarian "Good Ol' Boy" and a half-order of Buffalo Fries, both of which were super tasty and extremely satisfying.

name: Alley & Vine
address: 1332 Park St Ste D, Alameda, CA 94501
editorialSummary: Country-chic restaurant offering cocktails & dishes using seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
reviews: Absolutely delicious! From the get go, very nice staff, attentive but not overbearing. We were tucked into a cozy corner table and the environment wasn’t too loud or busy. The food was absolutely to die for - the salmon was perfectly cooked and the butter elevated the entire dish. We also tried the maple chive biscuits to start - not a pairing I would’ve ever conceived on my own, but quite good. T

While documenting restaurants for Alameda Restaurant Week, I spent time at Alley & Vine photographing their standout offerings. I was impressed by their tomahawk steak - probably one of the best steak deals I've seen anywhere. The place is surprisingly family friendly despite its upscale appearance. They maintain a great wine selection that complements their menu perfectly. What's interesting is h

Tell you what, if you ever decide to grab a good dessert, this might be the place. Along with the good wine selection and excellent cocktail bar displays offers a wide variety of sweet goodies to complete your dinner. I dropped by just to please our sweet tooth, and we were pleasantly surprised with multiple ice cream and cake choices. Along with that we got our favorite drinks and left as pleased

New Management, New Menu, Not the Same Alley & Vine

My fiancée and I revisited Alley & Vine, curious about its new management and updated menu. We were the only ones there when we arrived at 4:10 PM on a Saturday, so we settled into the patio with our dog.

The service was slow, although we appreciated our server's helpfulness with my fiancée's allergies. The menu seemed basic, with typical dishe

The best thing about this place is the service the staff is friendly and attentive. Unfortunately, the food has been consistently disappointing. I’ve tried several different menu items on multiple occasions, and many dishes were overly salty and greasy. Considering the quality, the prices are too high. I would recommend taking your business to Trabocco instead.

name: Boulevard Cafe
editorialSummary: Diner with a bar cooking up comfort-food favorites like cheddar grits, mac 'n' cheese & meatloaf.
reviews:
Nice friendly environment with great staff couldn't have asked for better service. The team was very attentive, making sure that we had everything that we need.

The Food-
The Bread!  It's was warm and the butter made it amazing.

Schwan ribs.  These were tangy flavorful and cooked perfectly I could have eaten nothing but this and been happy.

Boneless buffalo wings. Good size wings, very tender,

I haven't ate at a diner in a while and heard good things about Boulevard so had to give it a try today. Service here is very fast our food was out probably in less than 10 minutes. My corned beef hash tasted great. Portions aren't too big where you can't finish and the price is, well I guess normal in today's economy.

The staff got our ridiculous to go order ready correctly and quickly . It’s a cute and clean place with lots of natural lighting . The parking isn’t  great and I’m between some really busy streets . I feel like their menu has a lot of choices and they’re willing to accommodate any dietary restrictions .  The chicken was moist and flavorful . My Sonoma salad was excellent .  Great place for a secon

Fun old-school vibe, quick service, tasty blueberry vodka cocktail. Loved the calamari and patty melt. Onion rings were crispy and huge. And where else can you get dinner with a giant squeeze bottle of mayo on the table?

Well, if you like a Googie style eatery they got you covered. If you like frozen reheated food they got your standard Sysco chicken fried steak, pancake mix and ok coffee. It tastes like every other cheap diner using Sysco products. If you like a bathroom that smells like a festival portapoddy after a week in the sun, check. Very off putting!  Parking lot is a disaster, food mediocre and catching

name: Tselogs
reviews: Fantastic spaghetti!!! Family oriented restaurant with delicious food and lots of friendly smiles. I've only been here a handful of times but they always treat me like i've been coming there for years. Great place to bring your family for lunch after church on Sundays. There's also live entertainment on the outside deck. The spaghetti here is far better than jollibee 😋 The crispy pata and buco pi

We ordered lumpia, Palabok, Dinuguan, spaghetti, garlic rice and the tapsilog. The lumpia was very good although quite small. I really enjoyed the dinuguan and the tapsilog with the garlic rice. Although I wasn’t quite sure why the dinuguan was black, it was quite tasty for my first experience. It has a nice hearty and savory flavor and the tapsilog was very yummy and sweet to pair with the rice.

This was an impromptu dinner choice after some back-and-forth, and we landed here.

As soon as we sat down, we were informed of an automatic 18% gratuity for parties of 5 or more. Normally not an issue, but since this is a self-service setup (order at the counter, grab your own utensils, etc.), it felt mismatched with the level of service provided.

We ordered several rice plates and sides. Highli
Salamat! I loved the crispy fish and all the rest of the order! The staff is very hospitable, the interior design makes me feel like I'm in my mother's homeland, surrounded by bamboo and warm vibes.

Tselogs remains one of my top tier authentic, casual Filipino comfort food restaurants in the Bay Area. It is the perfect place to visit with a group of friends because the menu is built for sharing and hitting every major flavor profile.

Their Lumpia Shanghai is a mandatory appetizer—incredibly crispy, gold-fried, and addictive. For the main plates, the Chicken Sisig Silog is a solid solo or eve

name: Spicy House 川香小館
reviews: This restaurant is amazing. The owner is nice and friendly. I’ve been there one time about 2 months ago, and after that every time that i want to treat my friends,  i would take them to the spicy house, the flavor is well adjusted, for me as a Chinese, it would remind me of my hometown and for my friends, the flavor is also acceptable and they all love the food from spicy house. If you want try Ch

I ordered my favorite spicy seafood noodle so many times and had numerous issues with it. Its either, too salty or bland, reduced fish portions, etc… They’re calling this dish as spicy seafood combination noodle soup but its only made up of fish and shrimp, and nothing else. This should have been called fish and shrimp combo noodle soup, not seafood combo. As a seafood lover, this dish gave me a f

Lop Cheung fried rice, dry fried chicken wings, black bean fish, eggplant potato with string beans, pig ears and vinegar shredded potatoes! Everything was flavorful. Chicken wings were spicy but good. The portions were good. They gave a generous portion of pig ears! Other places give less! The place is clean and the people were very nice. I didn't wait long for my food. Will go back and try other

I ordered takeout from this place and brought my own reusable containers to reduce singleuse plastic. They were kind enough to accommodate my request, which I truly appreciated.

The food was delicious as always, and their willingness to support small eco-friendly actions really means a lot. Highly recommend this place, not just for the great food, but also for their thoughtful service! Me and my

In the top 10 Chinese restaurants I've been to. Service was impeccable and friendly. Our server was intuitive and was genuinely kind. The food is amazing, and I'm blown away that they don't charge more for their dishes. We got a large spread of food from shrimp dumplings to soup dumplings, scallion pancakes to mapo tofu, and extra rice. We had won ton in chili oil and only spent $60, which include

name: Top of the Hill
reviews: The fresh smell of Donut is a dream come true! You can count with Top of the Hill for good quality pastries, once you try one, you will want to come back for more. 🍩🤍

After completing the Lake Merced loop, we were craving donuts and unfortunately went to George's on West Portal based on the recent hype (don’t go there). Since it was lunch time, they only had donut holes and were a 15-minute ready-to-order wait. No thanks. Went to yelp to find a no frills donut shop nearby and thanks to great yelpers, we landed at Top of the Hill Cafe and were not disappointed.

I have been here many times mainly when I am craving for a doughnut or when I am in the area where I am in need of a quick bite. They have a wide selection of fresh doughnuts made daily, sandwiches, coffee, refrigerated drinks and much more. The staffs here are very welcoming, well trained and understanding where I never had encountered an issue during any of my visits. You can dine in at one of t
The very nice lady behind the counter slipped in a few extra doughnuts for me.  Kindness like this has gained a customer for life.  Thank you!!  The BEST service a doughnuts in SF

2026: My stomach wasn't quite full from eating at a nearby cafe. Top of the Hill Cafe has one of the best selection of breakfast sandwiches in this area. My order was an egg cheese croissant $8.75. It came out within five minutes. Good job staff at Top of the Hill Cafe.

2022: Top of the Hill Cafe is a spacious old fashion doughnut shop. It is too bad they only have a few tables because the cafe i

name: Gateway Kitchen
editorialSummary: Long-standing eatery features a range of traditional Filipino fare in a compact bare-bones interior.
reviews:
I have not been to this place in a long time.  This used to be one of my cousin's favorite spots to eat.  For 1st timers, I will let you know this place is CASH only.   There are no ATM's nearby especially since Walgreens closed down.
I used to go to this place after school, long before it has become the popolar place it is now for Silog plates.  The menu has changed a bit, it's a lot simpler but

An absolute SF / DC gem. Amazing food at unbeatable prices and it just hits the spot each and every time. Whether you want some fried pork chops, tocino, or some fish, they always have each order come with fried rice, fried garlic, and an egg. Check it out if you’re in the area, you won’t regret it.
Omelet is good. And the meal size is good enough for woman. Panini is OK, pretty common one. If you want to have a early morning breakfast here it will be a good option. No much service here.

Got take-out from here, and it was a great value!  Whole fried Tilapia fish 🐟 over rice with one egg 🍳 for $7.50!  My wife had the HK pork chop, huge portion, over Rice 🍚 for $7.00!

The food was hot 🔥 & fresh!

Doesn't offer dine-in, so carryout only.

This place offers take out only after COVID. Tastes delicious and good price as usual.
Call and order before you go there to avoid waiting.

name: Kings West Coast Pizzeria
reviews:
The food here was absolutely amazing! I had a delicious Hawaiian pizza ✨ I also highly recommend their housemade red dipping sauce with the pizza, it was yummy and took it to another level.
The atmosphere was also fantastic, its very friendly here and the owner and staff were very kind. I definitely plan to return!

An incredible dining experience from start to finish. Every dish was packed with rich, vibrant flavors that truly stood out. The team’s passion and dedication were clear in every detail, from presentation to service. The staff made us feel genuinely welcome, and the quality of the food speaks for itself.

Found this place by reading Google and Yelp reviews, and everyone was right, this pizza shop is amazing.
Lots of creative pizza options, but we went with the meat lovers. I love that it also has grilled chicken, it really made it even better. Crust has a crisp bottom and a nice chew. All around a perfect pizza.
Plenty of seating, very clean, and it looks like they offer lunch specials and lots on

Randomly stopped in walking down the street one night around 8pm. Pretty good spot. Good selection of pizza and drinks. Dude up front was cool and pizza came out quickly. Cool vibes, playing Biggie and 2Pac. Will be back
Loved this place, the food is served warm and fresh. The price is great and the atmosphere is so pleasant. Had a great time with friends and family.

name: Tomo Sushi & Teriyaki
address: 1901 Junipero Serra Blvd # G, Daly City, CA 94014
editorialSummary: Straightforward pick for a large variety of creative rolls & hearty portions of classic Asian eats.
reviews: I’ve been coming here a few times a year for several years and they’ve never disappointed. Today I tried a roll that had crispy salmon skin inside and it was one of the best things I’d ever eaten. Shoutout to Viviana (hopefully I spelled that correctly). Her smile and genuine personality made it extra enjoyable.

Solid Japanese food.  The spinach salad was very good.  Flavors really work.   I had the hamachi sashimi and really can’t go wrong with that. Portions are very good.  bf had the pork bento and he said it was very tasty.

Loved this place for being what it is. If you want a hearty Japanese meal without breaking the bank, this is the place. Not a lot of fancy, ornate dishes, but the price also reflects that. Parking is easy which is a big plus. I really enjoyed the food, the service and the convenience.

We were very disappointed with this place.  We went for lunch and all three of us had their lunch boxes.  The miso soup was really salty and with very little other flavor.  The teriyaki salmon was just two small, really thin pieces of salmon.   The teriyaki beef was made of a really cheap cut of meat that looked like it belonged in a gyro place, or a cheap cheesesteak.  The tempura was passable, a

I'm more a meat & tater guy. But I was pleasantly surprised at Tomos. Staff was cordial, patient and helpful. The eats were very palatable. Prices were reasonable. I'd return. Big plus for this location was that it was a hop, skip and a jump from the movie theater!

name: Ben Tre Restaurant
address: 398 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: Hearty Vietnamese staples including pho & meat dishes served in an easygoing venue.
reviews: My go-to spot for pho—it never misses. The broth is clean, simple, and hits every time, making it my ultimate comfort bowl. Portions are generous. Service is quick and attentive. The ambiance leans more fast-casual, but honestly, the food does all the talking.

First time trying this pho restaurant. The beef pho was decent. I was really looking forward to the tomato crab meat noodle soup, but it was disappointing—it tasted mostly like ground pork and didn’t have much crab flavor.

Service was average, but the restaurant itself was clean. Overall it was an okay experience, but I expected more from the tomato crab noodle soup.

April 2026:
Dropping to four star ⭐. Ordered the chicken pho with breast meat. Was not satisfied with my meal. Soup was lukewarm. Broth was not flavorful. Sriracha sauce was not the Huy Fong type. Color of the sauce was not the fiery red that I am used to. Would not get the chicken pho again. Soup needs to be HOT.

November 2025:
First time trying this restaurant. My friend, who is Vietnamese, men
This is the best place you can come to eat and enjoy with your Family if you visit SAN FRANCISCO  don’t Skip the  Ben tree restaurant

Extremely disappointed. I found a large piece of plastic inside my food while eating. This is a major health and safety hazard. I’ve always enjoyed the food here, but this is unacceptable. Please be careful when ordering from here.

name: Brothers Cafe
address: 382 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: Casual, modern spot using locally sourced ingredients in elevated versions of American comfort food.
reviews:
Food: 4/5
Service: 3/5
Ambiance: 3/5
Portion to Price: 4/5
Overall: A very good option for brunch.

The extended review...

Food:

Banana Foster's French Toast - 4/5 - A very hearty portion and good flavor.  Like some other places, this french toast is does it just taste like bread.  Thankfully it does not and the toppings were plentiful.

Service: 3/5 - It's a pay at the counter table service mod

Food: Really good. I got All American breakfast sandwich and a Cappuccino. The playe as you can see was very heavy on calories and Protein. Coffee was very decent too.

Service: The staff was friendly but I personally don't like order first and pay before getting the table. Had to tip them before I got Service or Food.

Atmosphere: Very friendly.  You can come here with family and friends.

Went to get brunch on Thursday and it was delicious. Each plate is $19.95 and the add ons for the pancakes is $1.50 ea. So 2 sandwiches, an order of pancakes (3) with banana walnuts cooked in to it (worth it), and a coke came to $75. Very pricey but it was worth it. The place is open and cozy. Parking kinda sucks but you'll eventually find some. I wish 3 pancakes and 2 toppings wasn't over $20.

Nice airy open café & eatery where can get almost anything your taste buds fancy.
I had the Angel Hair Pasta with Shrimp and a mimosa.  Delicious & filling. Enough for a to go box. The staff are friendly and attentive. Cheers!
Parking lot is close by. Service was fast and friendly. Food was hot and fresh and delicious. Decaf coffee was not fresh as usual. Overall nice experience.

name: Hidden Spot - South San Francisco
address: 303 Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: Industrial-style bar serving generous burgers, sandwiches & chicken wings, plus veggie options.
reviews: It's a great burger.  Beer selection is fine.  Burger & Tots were fantastic though.  Bartender was also super cool.  Definitely going back.

After 10 days in the USA, countless meals, and just a few hours before flying home, we finally found it: the best burger of the entire trip.

We had two burgers, the garlic fries, sweet potato fries, and some seriously good dips. The burgers were absolutely fantastic — juicy, flavorful, and exactly what a great burger should be. The fries were just as good.

My girlfriend had the sweet potato frie
Found this place on TikTok and it’s definitely on the comeback list. Best wings I’ve had in a long time. Burger was perfect. Get the tots! Bartender was very helpful and friendly. We will be back!

Sunday morning Burger was fire!
🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🤌🤌🤌🤌🤌
Finished it soo fast that the server was even shocked 😂. I just have that kind of appetite.
Feel bad for not getting the servers name but she was short asian that wore a hat/glasses with blonde highlights. She did a great job handling the place, serving drinks and food.  Great attitude & service.  👏👏👏👏👏

The lady at the restaurant seemed real friendly. Along with having a regular customer there that liked to have conversations with her, the hot wings were Soaking in its own sauce, which left me excess amount of sauce to the point while I was dipping my tater tots in. I didn't mind having conversation and she aerated my beer pretty well with getting the fome out.  From from the top and letting some

name: 47 Hills Brewing Company
address: 137 S Linden Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
reviews:
On 5/21, We decided to check out another local brewery that showed a great beer selection on tap....when we arrived, there were only three options available...the American Lager, Kölsch, and an IPA.   This was due to mechanical issues in the back.

The Lager and Kölsch were OK.   Nothing great and pretty standard.

The food smelled and looked amazing and there is a row of pinball machines.  We had

Chill brewery with a couple of TVs to watch different games. Has pinball machines and a great wagyu burger with truffle fries. Would slip the garlic fries since the garlic is chopped not minced when it comes with the fries. Bathrooms are ALWAYS clean.

$32 + tip for a burger, fries and a beer. :o They only had one house beer which was surprising to me. I'm an IPA guy and they only had 2 guest IPAs and they were pretty mid/eh/mild to me. Like ordering a regular ale lol. Everyone was so sweet though and there are lots of families here and the vibe is cute but it's just a bit too expensive for me and the burger is "good" and tender ofc but just a b

3 beers on tap and none of them were from the actual brewery? Also it somehow cost $22 for 2 beers, pretty wild. On a positive note, the space has potential and the food looks good. If they brewed their own beers and had more than 3 available, I might be interested in returning.

Came in on a fairly busy weekday evening in May on a layover at SFO. Cool atmosphere and was happy to wait in line for a pint. However there was only 1 person behind the bar, pretty slow service and they had 20 tap handles but only one beer left on draft.. for a place with massive tanks in the back and pallets of cans and keg shells everywhere, it’s pretty sad that they only had 1 beer option. Eve

name: Zazpi at the Basque Cultural Center
address: 599 Railroad Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: Traditional Basque cuisine delivered in family-style portions amid group-friendly surrounds.
reviews: One of my friend's wife's co-worker recommended dinner at Basque Cultural Center. This was great meal. Everything was flavorful. We loved how they have daily prix fixe menu items. Saturday's prix fixe items are cod fritters as the appetizer and Roast New York as the main dish $48. It starts with a pot of butternut squash soup at the table. There's bread and butter to dip onto the soup. If you ask,

Though I was there as a guest I'm glad I didn't pay for the food; but someone did!  The servers were very courteous and helpful where they could.  The length of time in between each serving was way too long.  The salad was tasty but the lettuce was soggy.  The bread(which I believe was to compliment the meal) was cold. So spreading butter on that was a challenge.  When the main house arrives. Afte

Lovely place for family gatherings. Excellent service.. the only thing was we had to wait first few minutes for the staff to get a table ready inspite of having made a reservation.
That aside, the salmon was really good. The soup was also good. In all well worth your money. In about 40$, you get a whole meal with salad, main and dessert. The flan was really good! Definitely going to go back again.
Had lunch here today with my friends. All the food was outstanding and so was the service. I had the tomato soup, the duck and the basque cheesecake. Delicious wine as well. 5 star restaurant!

The food is great. The lamb is magnificent. 5.5 stars. Service is good, should be 4.5 stars. Atmosphere 4.5. It can be bit nosy, they need some acoustic absorption material, however the facility is very nice, very clean and has fresh new look to it.
This the third time I've eaten here in the past five years and it has been consistently good.

name: Dumpling Empire
address: 216 Cypress Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: A range of homemade dumplings are the draw at this tiny Chinese outpost with a laid-back atmosphere.
reviews:
Little place
Home made dumplings and home made noodles
Orders spicy beef noodles and Xiao long bao. They were both good. Loved the salt pepper pork chop. See the pics you don't find this kind of pork chop anymore

What delicious food! The service was quick and options were authentic and delicious. We loved their hot and sour soup and the pan fried soup dumplings. We got sesame balls for dessert on the house. We even left with more food than originally ordered and some extra good fortune!
Plastic drape door and eight tables of holy goodness these dumplings are delicious. This is a great place with clean food. I had tendon and noodles and it tasted like mom’s pork from 1977!

I was surprised at how yummy the dishes were since I'm pretty picky on authentic Chinese food. We ordered string beans, chive and egg box pancakes, pan fried bao and sour spicy soup. Each dish was cooked in perfection. Except they forgot to put black sesame and green onion on the pan fried bao. (Too busy catching up with my friend. Next time I will tell her.) And she gave us free sesame ball for d

Very simple little place tucked into a little side street off of Grand Ave. Decided to check it out after seeing good reviews—we got pan fried soup dumplings, beef pancake, garlic string beans and chicken chow mein. Owner surprised us with fried sesame balls filled with either a bean paste or black sesame seed paste—absolutely delicious. My favorite dish was the beef pancake—the Chinese black vine

name: Antigua Coffee Shop
address: 437A Grand Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
editorialSummary: Warm, laid-back coffee shop serving caffeinated beverages plus sandwiches & baked goods.
reviews:
Such a great little stop! We came in for coffee and cake and ended up really impressed. The coffee was amazing,
perfectly balanced, smooth, and beautifully made (the latte art was a nice touch too). You can tell they really care about quality.

The cake was fresh and delicious, just the right level of sweetness and a great pairing with the coffee. The whole experience felt cozy and relaxing.

Defi

It was my final day in San Francisco, and my son was staying behind for his internship. I felt quite sad, but as soon as he opened the door, it felt warm and inviting, like home. Although I don't celebrate Christmas, I appreciated the decorations; they really showed the passion the staff has for creating a welcoming atmosphere, which I think reflects their love for cooking delicious food. My latte

Highlights for me were the beautiful Christmas decor - must’ve taken a whole day for staff to put up but it was so beautiful! Also, liked the food menu.

The cashier in particular (didn’t get her name but had glasses and was working AM Sat 11/15), no smiles, no warmth, just there to do her job. One other lady was smiling and the gentleman clearing our table of service items was polite and friendly

I ordered a medium green living smoothie which consists of orange juice, apple, banana, kale & spinach with a power protein breakfast (egg whites, grilled chicken, spinach, avocado, vegetables & potatoes). Love this coffee shop with the beautiful atmosphere and the staff are always so friendly & welcoming. Everyone must come here if they’re in the area. Highly recommend this cute coffee shop.
Splented place to visit and very unique. Service was nice and helpful. Iced coffees were not very flavorful or sweet at all. 1st time here, hope it was a off day.

name: Amami San
address: 310 Linden Ave, South San Francisco, CA 94080
reviews: Great sushi spot with really impressive fish quality and solid pricing, especially compared to what you’d normally pay around San Francisco. We ordered the Lover’s Boat (about $50) and it was a great value for the amount and quality of fish you get. The portions of fish were generous and they definitely don’t skimp — you can really taste how fresh everything is. The fish was super clean and melt-i

The food, the service, and also importantly, the beer all was amazing. The beer was served very cold, which matters a lot, and seriously, one of the best fish and sushi I've had. Kelly served me, and although it was a busy night, she took the time to tell me about the menu and make great recommendations. I had the hamachi sashimi, the sake nigiri and melted in the mouth roll. Definitely recommende
Sushi was made with fresh ingredients. Attentive service. Really small dinning area. Seat about 50 people max.

Nigiri was fresh and came out quickly. I ordered the sushi deluxe special and got a good variety of options. It was quite affordable with 9 pc. chef's choice sushi, rock and roll, and miso soup for $30.

I'm really baffled by the reviews for this place. I'm calling it Japplebee's. All of the apps are reheated Sisco products. Nothing but over battered unidentifiable "flavors" The "fresh fish" was dry and flavorless. The service was high volume get in, get out, on a Tuesday! The windows and walls were greasy and foggy with kitchen grease. There's a dead plant in the front window next to the door.

name: Porridge & Things
editorialSummary: Unpretentious Chinese eatery with live seafood tanks offering porridge & other traditional cuisine.
reviews: 2026 update: Weird thing happened. We wanted to try the "fried with garlic & hot peppers" lobster $35. There was some confusion when my lobster arrived. Apparently, the waitress changed my order to ginger and scallions lobster without asking us because she felt it would taste better. LOL. We didn't want to wait for them to remake it so we swallowed our pride and accepted the dish. Other stuff we o

Environment ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆
Clean and comfortable.

Food ⭐⭐⭐⭐½☆

* Seafood Congee ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent—very fresh and flavorful, with a thick, comforting texture.
You can customize it with vegetables and add fried dough (youtiao), which makes it even better.
* Pork Ribs ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆
Sweet and sour style—on the sweeter side for me.
Works best when paired with the congee.

Excellent food.   Can get very busy late evening, so please do come early.  This place cook authentic Chinese food. We ordered  rock cod  steam fish which was extremely fresh and not too salty.   They have live crap and fish in their aquarium as well.

I heard from friends in Hong Kong that this restaurant is delicious, so I came to try it.

We ordered create your own one porridge, and we chose the topping by ourselves. We chose fish fillets, beef and mushrooms, and it was delicious with fried dough sticks.

Other dishes like  seafood fried noodles and beef tofu were pretty average.

The less happy thing is the service. I asked for pepper and he

Our Cantonese friends say this is one of the better places in the area. All the dishes were very good and satisfying. Sauteed frog was scrumptious. Shrimp and crab porridge was enough for 4. Fried rice was perfectly seasoned and garlic cabbage was cooked perfectly. Service was very attentive. Expect a wait weekend evenings. Also recommended is beef chow mein and roasted goose.

name: Yuanbao Jiaozi
reviews: 3.5 stars overall. We have been here a few times but this last visit we noticed a few issues. The pan fried dumplings were good but inside was lukewarm at best (thought about returning but did not). The beef tendon was tasty but feels like much smaller portion.  The beef noodle (good texture) and no issues.
Dumpling is amazing. I ordered the beef lamb and fish one. The appetizer is okay, less salty than I would expect, but it is good enough. Considering the great dumplings, I would give it five stars.

December 2025:
Stopped by for lunch and tried lotus root salad, mixed salad, soup dumplings (zucchini, shrimp and egg), and beef pickled cabbage noodle soup 🍲.

Everything was excellent. Super tasty.

Service was friendly. Will be back again for more delicious food!

This is our second visit in about a year.  The first time was in a rainy cold evening and this time was just a cold evening.
The pickled vegetable beef noodle soup hit the spot this evening-hot, spicy, chewy noodles, tender beef slices, and a spicy broth.
We’ve also had the chicken corn dumplings, fish dumplings, xiao long bao, and a couple of appetizers.  The wood ear fungus salad was a hit.
Our

Got the house special beef noodle soup, beef xlb, chicken corn dumplings in chilli oil, and napa cabbage pork dumplings. The star of the show were the noodles.

Beef was tender, soup had a lot of flavor and depth, and noodles were great be cause it absorbed the soup flavor. 9/10

The beef xlb super nice and flavorful. 8/10

The dumplings dough texture was bouncy and how they were wrapped were grea

name: Little Lucca
editorialSummary: Locals line up for hefty specialty sandwiches & deli eats at this compact counter-serve destination.
reviews:
Huge fan (and sandwiches!).

In a field with so many competitors (e.g. M Stop, Two Son's, Molinari, AK Subs ... and the list goes on), you'd think that anything that could make your sandwich stand out would be gone. That green pesto (?) sauce though was damn good. It's so simple, but paired with the garlic, it truly completes their sandwich with a unique touch.

Was also glad to not have to pay th

BBQ Beef Brisket sandwich on sourdough! Wow! It was so delicious that I couldn’t resist leaving a review. The staff was fantastic. They only offer takeout, not seating, but that didn’t matter since I was only in town for a short time. This place was the best I’ve eaten during my visit.

Long line, but efficient. The sandwiches are huge and an amazing value. I thought the sandwich was great, the only issue was that we ordered muffaletta sandwiches and they forgot to add the olive spread (which is the whole point). I think it was just too busy and it slipped his mind because he did the garlic spread already.  I would go back, but maybe when there is a shorter line.

Only Giving 5 Stars due to the Portion. It's 2 proper meals. Got the BLT+A on Dutch Crunch with a Bag of chips for over $22. Steep! Quality sandwich, it was served cold, the cheese clean extra $1.75.. it's a nice sandwich and extremely filling. However not worth a line or worth going out of your way for. I
With the portion size it's a decent value I suppose.

Great counter service. Had a late lunch, so no wait at all. The roast beef sandwich was huge. It was more than enough for my wife and I. The sauces they use are tasty. I've also had a BBQ beef sandwich. The Dutch crunch is hands down the best

name: Han Sang
reviews:
I heard a lot about Han Sang in Millbrae before, a solid Korean place. And my experience was indeed really great, everything we ordered hit, there were no bad dish at all! I went around 8pm on a weekday and place was packedddd, but the service was impressive. All of our dishes came out all at one, within 5-10 minutes after ordering.
What I had:
Yuk hwe (beef tartare with pears and egg yolk): If yo

On a business trip and stumbled upon Han Sang amongst a sea of Chinese restaurants. People often think Korean food is BBQ but I grew up on soups and stews so Han Sang was comfort food for me. Food was very good…really hit the spot after a day of travel. Service was also friendly and modern decor.

Korean family run restaurant with authentic Korean dishes their lunch menu has good value $15 for the cold noodle and spicy noodle $20 for the spicy tofu and $23 for the galbi tang. They also provided ban chan like Kim chi, radish and fish cake!

2026 update: Another great meal at Han Sang. We had the beef short ribs w/extra meat plus cheese $100 and tofu soup $25 again. This time, we wanted to try the braised pork with vegetables $58. Service was awesome. The food tasted great. No wait on a Tuesday evening at 6pm.

Original review: We came to Han Sang for their galbi jjim (braised beef short ribs w/extra meat, plus cheese $100.) The resta

Bossam is great - pork belly is flavorful and not too oily. They also check in and notice when you have finished one of your banchans and ask if you would like a refill. The spicy bibim naengmyeon probs not for me it was a leaning a little too sweet for my preference but maybe that's just how it is supposed to be.

name: Ben Tre Restaurant
editorialSummary: Hearty Vietnamese staples including pho & meat dishes served in an easygoing venue.
reviews: Visiting San Fran and stopped in for some Vietnamese food near the airport. Service was prompt and felt like a family restaurant. Food was amazingly fresh and appetizing. The beef carpacio is in a sweet fresh sauce that we couldn't get enough of. The broken rice and grilled pork were fragrant and tender. Viet crepe was good ss well. Items were reasonably priced. Would definitely come again.
Most food was delicious. The salad lacked flavor or spice, but everything else (tofu, spring rolls, crepe, and fried rice) hit the spot. Definitely try this place

Food here is great. I had the pork chop rice and the pork chop was juicy and flavorful. Definitely one of the better Vietnamese food options in the Bay Area.

Portions were satisfying and everything tasted great. Would come back again.
Tried the food at both locations ssf and milbrae, all good. I just don't really like the fish sauce, it's way too sweet for me

I ordered the beef stew with steamed rice. The broth was quite tasty, but unfortunately the stewed beef was not tender, rather tough. I've visited many Vietnamese restaurants and have had this same dish. The other restaurants generally serve this stew with much more tender beef chunks. Otherwise the spring rolls were quite good and so was the service, fast and friendly. Atmosphere wasn't so great,

name: wonderful
editorialSummary: Snug space serving Hunan-style Chinese eats such as smoked pork & noodles in contemporary surrounds.
reviews:
Really great food, nice waitstaff, and the atmosphere was great!

Highly recommend their house “smork” if you can get some for the day! It’s really unique and you can taste the smoke off the meat!

Portion sizing is really nice. We also got some staples like the mayo tofu and green beans. No notes to be left :)
So you are wanting to try something different and want some spicy Chinese food. They can do it. You can request them to not make it spicy if you prefer that. Very good food and tastes wonderful.

Authentic Hunan home style cooking, the smoked pork here is a specialty and highly recommend it with the garlic leeks. The Chinese burgers are fluffy and the meat is not dry. The picked green beans with chicken gizzards is sour and spicy. I appreciate the staff helping to pack the food for us. The service is quick but they do not rush you.
Not busy on weekday lunch. Good noodle texture on beijing jah jang. Recommend lily with kabocha squash for interestingly subtle dish. Everything else was also good, including the tea.

The hostess was too nice & fluent in English :D She asked us right away if we wanted the sesame bread since it was made to order (takes a while to kook). It was thick but super layered & had a nice chew; yet surprisingly light. The boiled fish was yummy but not very spicy. Cauliflower smoked pork belly stir fry +1 (house smoked). She even bagged our leftovers at the counter. Definitely deserved th

name: Fiddlers Green
editorialSummary: Serving traditional Irish eats and pub-grub classics in a lively environment.
reviews: Food was delicious. I had a party melt with fries, and my partner had a shepherd's pie. Both turned out to be fantastic. Just wish their was bread that was served with the shepherds pie. Also maybe an au juis served with the party melt would've really blown my socks off. The service was meh, I believe we had one server for the entire restaurant. The atmosphere was okay, a tad bit crowded for me. B

As a former Dublin resident, I was pleasantly surprised at how similar this pub was to the ones in Ireland: the wooden decor, the friendly service, and the food and the drinks. To be specific, the Guinness pint was pulled properly and the fish and chips were equally proper. This is the closest you can get to feel like Ireland without leaving the Bay Area
Wonderful authentic Irish Pub with classic pub fare. Service was quick, friendly, and knowledgeable. This was our second visit and both times had an exceptional experience.
Great Irish pub. We enjoyed the Irish stew with fork tender beef. Fish and chips are awesome as well. Burgers are large and flavorful. Guinness flows.

Had an amazing lunch here while watching the masters. Hubby had the Spicy Irish Sandwich and I had the shepherds pie, both were amazing. They have a wonderful beer, wine, and bourbon selection, plus many more, that was just what we were interested in. The atmosphere was great and service was excellent. Don’t sleep on this restaurant!!

name: Ipoh Garden Malaysian Cuisine
reviews: Best Malay cuisine we’ve found in SF and the peninsula. It took a while for our food to arrive but it was worth the wait – everything we had was delicious! The chicken satay and nestum fish were the standouts. Can’t wait to come back and try more!

Ive been here far too many times over the past 6 years, but I’m only getting to writing a review now. This is one of the best Malaysian food restaurants and I travel from SF just to have it, so thats saying a lot. The dishes pack flavor, portion sizes are large and the food comes out very fast. I’m not vegeterian but prefer veggie forward dishes and even the meat dishes include them, which is a bi

I grew up in Singapore and visited my grandparents in Ipoh, Malaysia 2-3 times a year and this place has decent food but is far from authentic.

Cereal shrimp and curry mee were a must order, belacan kankung was decent but oily, hainan chicken was good but didn’t taste like what we have from Singapore.

DO NOT ORDER THE BAK KUT TEH. This dish is usually made with pork ribs, but for some reason we

I rarely leave bad reviews, but I am profoundly disappointed with this restaurant. As a Malaysian with an authentic Malaysian palate, eating at this Ipoh restaurant was a massive letdown.
First of all, I seriously wonder if they even know what Nasi Lemak is supposed to be—because what they served was absolutely not it. The cucumber and acar (pickled vegetables) were incredibly stale. The meat port

We have been to Ipoh Garden quite a few times over the years and the food has been consistently good. My favorites are Kang Kung (water spinach), okra belachon, roti canai, and basil chicken. The food is very flavorful without being too salty. The coconut rice was a great accompaniment to balance out the flavors. The char kway teow isn’t quite as tasty as the ones I’ve had in Malaysia but it’s pre

name: Curry Hyuga
editorialSummary: Compact, unpretentious restaurant specializing in traditional Japanese curry dishes & sides.
reviews: The best Japanese Curry in the Bay area for sure! Better than most places in Japan even! I had had the karaage curry and was blown away by how juicy and delicious it was. I finally made the connection about Hyuga ... Hyuga in Miyazaki! Miazaki is famous for its chicken nanban, and the sauce for the karaage was the same delicious sauce used in the best chicken nanban! Everything about the entire di

Authentic and delicious Japanese curry rice served here! The curry has a good spicy kick to it. The signature pork katsu is tender and thick, portion is good. The potato salad also tastes good. The beef om-rice is not as expected but also thick but meat can be more. Definitely would not go wrong if you order curry!

We found Curry Hyuga on Yelp and hen looking for a place to eat Easter Sunday night. Right as we walked in we were greeted with excellent service from the staff. It was fairly busy, but we were lucky enough there was a free table and were seated right away. On every table they have a ringer that alerts the server when we were ready to order or needed service, making service very quick and easy! We

Can't go wrong with 6-hour boiled curry, but the restaurant interior is quite cute with a brick facade and seating area! They're known for their katsu curry, which I found was well-flavored with a good curry to rice quantity!

Service is fast, and they have small buttons on the table to request service!

Ordered the corn potato soup, Karaage Curry, tonkatsu teishoku. Everything has a mild flavored. If you want the food hotter there were several condiments on the table to choose from. We also order a Tonkatsu Curry pork. Very good flavor and well prepared. The place was already full and some people waiting for a table..

name: Plucky's Cafe
reviews: This is cool concept of a cafe and went to check it out w my friend but w soy milk and tip two lattes were $20 served in a tiny very pretty but tiny cup; only to learn that most board games are not free but $5 per hours. There is a small shelf with limited free options. Daminos were missing pieces and tiny cup of pumpkin latte which didnt hit the spot to begin with became cold very quickly since i

Now not so new but still fairly new to Broadway. The food quality is good and the atmosphere is uniquely refreshing. Good air circulation as the ceiling is very tall. It’s perfect for large groups and gathering

I’ve been coming to this café for a while specifically for the yogurt parfait served in a ceramic bowl with fresh fruit. It was one of the reasons I would drive here.

On my recent visit, I was told by an Asian gentlemen to “grab one from the fridge.” The refrigerated version is served in a plastic cup and looks very different from the freshly made one I used to order. When I politely asked if I c

I frequent many coffee shops, but this is the first time I’ve encountered such a strict and, frankly, unfriendly policy regarding laptop use.
While I understand that businesses want to prevent "camping" and keep seats moving, the enforcement here feels quite harsh. I visited on a Saturday morning when the shop was mostly empty with plenty of open tables. I opened my laptop just to quickly reply to
The coffee is excellent, and the food is truly delicious. It's a wonderful spot to enjoy a tasty breakfast and start your morning off right. Highly recommended🤩

name: Mokutanya
editorialSummary: Casual spot with sunken tables & a romantic vibe serving Japanese grilled mains, ramen bowls & sake.
reviews: An awesome place to go to with friends or coworkers. We went here on a Saturday night for a work party and it was a great experience. The food is well priced and the wagyu was delicious as hell. The sakes as well were very well priced and were STRONG. Will definitely be going back.

I haven’t been here in about 3 years and could not wait to eat here again. Last time it was quite the exquisite experience. This time however, was woefully miserable. We immediately got a table when we arrived for our reservation, and everything started out normal, but then we were left waiting a long time after we got our miso soup. The next set of food came out and then we were forgotten again.

What a cool experience! You sit on the floor with a sunken table and be prepared to take your shoes off and set them nearby. Our waiter Gary was great! He Explained everything we had questions on and we could tell he's excited about the whole concept. They have some amazing beef and chicken skewers! Gary Explained they use a very hot charcoal to get the sear. Open pretty late too when we went whic

We did not know what to expect going in but  this was an amazing experience. Having just come from Japan weeks earlier - the food and service were what we came to expect traveling through Japan.  I could list everything we ate from the ramen to the salmon wrapped with bacon. Nothing missed. And my daughter loves K-pop so the music worked out for us. Maybe not everyone would want that but being a l

Came to try the ramen. Not bad, but I guess this must be a pattern in the US - Instead of focusing on bringing out subtle flavors, like, in this case, the umami of the beef in the soup, there's a tendency to overpower with either garlic or pepper, rendering the taste buds paralyzed.

But the akagyu was definitely tasty!

Great service too!

name: Himali Bistro
reviews:
My wife and I live in Monterey and were heading to Mexico for a week at an all-inclusive resort. We wanted one last great meal before the trip, so while charging our EV near the airport, we searched for something different and stumbled across Hemali Indian Bistro. What a lucky find.

From the moment we walked in, we were impressed. The decor was beautiful, the service was warm and welcoming, and t
Super satisfying! Great spice! Amazing flavors! I recommend the cauliflower and the tandoori shrimp! Mr.Nepali is so nice. The space is gorgeous. Do not skip this place! Go right now if you can!

One of the best Nepalese restaurants in Burlingame. Authentic food with great people. Staff are very kind and very approachable to their customer which we think one of the most important things and the food presentation is really a plus, they don’t just bring out the food you ordered but they bring it out in the best way they could and they are  always ready to explain whats inside their menu. Hig

My wife and I visited on a mid weekday afternoon when it was virtually empty  which was great.  The interior was a bit tight (long and narrow) but it wasclean, freshly painted and generally was pretty nice for a quick bite type restaurant.

The food was really top-notch and felt authentic (Napali-Indian fusion). We ordered the chicken lollipop, Momos, Samosa and Achari fries. The prices felt of va

Flavor-packed noodles , juicy chicken tikka, perfectly steamed momos, and crispy Gobi Manchurian - every bite hit the mark. 😋
Paired with genuinely warm and attentive service, Himalayan Bistro made a lasting impression.

Simple, delicious, and worth repeating.

name: Society Restaurant & Hookah Lounge
reviews: Tonight, after a long and tiring day at work, I visited Society Restaurant & Hookah Lounge to relax—and it was the perfect choice. The place is beautiful, calming, and has such a great vibe with relaxing music. The staff were amazing: very kind, welcoming, and truly hospitable. They offer both indoor and outdoor seating; I personally love sitting outside, but since it was raining, I chose to sit i

Amazing atmosphere, delicious food, great Turkish tea, and really good hookah. Everything we tried was fresh and flavorful, and the vibe of the place was very cozy and stylish. Our waiter Ayaz was very friendly, attentive, and really listened to our preferences and requests. Definitely a great spot for a relaxing evening

We enjoyed a really nice evening here. We had the Anna Paul’s Turkish Pasta, Manti turkish dumpling, Kunefe for dessert and a bottle of White wine.
The food was great and atmosphere was relaxing. We did not use the hookah lounge. We
Would god back for sure.

Unexpected great find.  Was early for a dinner reservation elsewhere, and decided drop in for a drink at the bar.  From the moment we enter, the staff were extremely welcoming. Bar tender Uniss was super chill.  I like my drinks "full bodied" and he was generous with the pours yet balanced.  The Manhattan and Last Word were delicious and aesthetically pleasing. Definitely coming back for more.

the place is definitely beautiful, the waitstaff are very attentive, and the food is absolutely delicious. however, it's hard to understand the management staff inside. especially if you go early, i think the guy who runs the place is constantly yelling at and scolding the waiters.

not only does it ruin the atmosphere, but if you're supposedly so concerned about maintaining a peaceful environment

name: Broadway Prime
editorialSummary: A storefront steakhouse & full-service bar serving NY steaks & dry-aged prime rib in an airy space.
