reviews: so this is a tough one. my girlfriend and i decided to try this prime rib place 2 hours away from where we live excited on valentine’s day. my experience was pretty great, i got the select cut of the new york steak with creamed spinach and a loaded baked potato. everything was really solid except for the baked potato it was a little cold and the toppings weren’t the highest of quality but i didn’t

Overall a decent experience. But charging HOPR prices ($5 cheaper)is a little steep if you’re not delivering HOPR quality. I got the broadway cut medium rare English cut. Was definitely medium after it cooked on the plate. Not sure why the plates are so hot. This only happened to mine.

Would recommend for the kids cut.

Prime NY Steak was flavorless, al the food was 4/10 fine but would not recommend. No flavor everything kinda sloppy and put together. Service was great!
Atmosphere was ok. Will not be coming back.

Ate here years ago and price was reasonable and cuts were larger. Now it's a little pricier as noted on menu and meats not as large as it used to be. Sides were good. Half spinach and corn . The popover and house salad was just average. The meat is medium rare as per requested and tasted good and tender. Service was great. We ate at 5:30p and beat the dinner rush. As we left the place it was almos

My brother wanted to eat meat. It was his birthday. So we decided to come to this location since we haven’t been here for a long time. Our go to location for bringing family from out of town. We ordered: the broadway cut prime rib , and it came with its house salad ( the dressing was a little bit salty for my taste), with cream of corn and mash potatoes. The meat was good and the sides too , but t

name: Ristorante Rocca
editorialSummary: Italian cuisine with Californian influences served in a high-ceilinged, mural-adorned dining room.
reviews: A old school, classic Italian restaurant with authentic Italian dishes. Great cocktails too! Street parking can be challenging in peak hours but otherwise very easy to park. My first time here and I would definitely go back.
The food, service, and atmosphere was perfect.  House made lasagna was very tasty, with the cheese taking it up a few notches. 🔥😋😋🔥

Very basic Italian place.   The ravioli was kind of bland.   Sauce was good.   Salads were tasty.  Excellent Italian dressing.   Dessert was bad.   Zero taste and fell apart like it was in a frig for a while.   I’d pass on the desserts.

First time dining there, though members of our family have been there before. Warmly greeted and seated. While waiting for the rest of our group offered beverage menu and bread etc. Food and service were great. Would love to go there in the future! Entrees were large so leftovers were taken gladly! Enjoyed desserts also!
The food was delicious, but the portions of steak and salmon were significantly smaller than before.

name: Maverick Jack's
editorialSummary: Upmarket burger joint with thoughtfully sourced ingredients, light fare & a family-friendly vibe.
reviews: The burgers were pretty average. Defiantly not the best I’ve ever eaten but not the worst either. The service was okay but things are definitely way too over priced. They played the FIFA World Cup which was a good way to chillax.

All in all a good experience. People are very nice. Food is a solid 3 1/2 stars. The burger was cooked good, but could have used a little more seasoning. I really cannot complain. I would definitely return

Maverick Jack's is a great place for lunch. I found the hamburger I ordered extremely delicious. The fries are some of the best I have tasted in my life. I also had strawberry lemonade, which was very refreshing. The atmosphere is relaxing. The service is friendly and the food came fast. I will certainly be back in the future.

Had a great experience here and would highly recommend this place. Maverick Jack regular burger was excellent! Cooked perfectly, fresh bun, fresh vegetables, and so like the flavor of the Maverick Jack’s sauce. This was a quality burger all around. The fries were fine and tasted hot and fresh…but honestly nothing worth remembering. Good fries - but nothing out of the ordinary. The burger was much
Loved the gluten free bun option! Great staff and space, and really dog friendly! The train stopping by is the only downside for me since it’s noisy. Fun vibes.

name: Broadway Grill
editorialSummary: American restaurant in a former bank delivering meaty fare from a wood-fired grill, plus live jazz.
reviews: I hosted two events at Broadway Grill: entire upstairs space for a surprise birthday party (25 people, 10/2025) and entire restaurant for a baby shower (55 people, 6/2026). The owner was incredibly helpful and communicative throughout the entire process. The staff were efficient and attentive. The restaurant itself is beautiful and gives a modern classic vibe. The space and restroom are clean. We

Service was friendly and welcoming.  Food was fresh and delicious.  We tried the French Onion Soup, Fish and Chips, and Affogato for dessert.  Yum.
We'll be back to try when they have live music.

LOVE the food here (& I am somewhat of a picky eater, so that says a lot)--& my husband does too.  Also appreciate the fact that there is often live music with usually quite talented musicians.  Top it off with reasonable prices (at least for a decent restaurant in the Bay area) for most of the food, friendly servers & owners, along with cool ambiance and it's a no-brainer for a great dining exper

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Absolutely Perfect Celebration Experience!
We recently celebrated a birthday at this restaurant with a big group of 55 people, and I can’t say enough good things about the experience. The restaurant was reserved just for us, and everything—from the organization to the food and service—was flawless.
The owners are incredible people. They didn’t just help us plan the menu—they brought the

Good for families and small groups. There is plenty of seating in a well lit hall. People usually come for the live music at night. Brunch menu is pretty standard - omelets, salads, sandwiches, and Benedicts. They have a good wine menu and some cocktails, too.
Would recommend the Benedicts and omelets. Crab Benedict was good, though crab portion was a bit small and crumbly. Fish n chips were fresh

name: Mr Teriyaki Sushi
editorialSummary: Buzzing, pint-sized spot in a tucked away locale popular with locals for sushi rolls & Asian fare.
reviews:
Amazing sushi spot tucked away in a little known building. The sashimi here is super generous and flavorful. The salmon sashimi we ordered were THICK slices and great quality.

The rolls were great as well. My personal surprise favorite of the night was the Hamachi Kama - grilled to crispy perfection but still juicy! I love the sake selection here, there’s a good amount of cold options. Ask your s
I got there around closing time. The place is small and modest. Very relaxed atmosphere. The people are very welcoming. And the food was VERY good.

HARD to find but well worth the adventure! This little hole in the wall was EXCEPTIONAL! Our food was fresh and tasted delectable..... DEVINE! I highly encourage you to give it a try! I will make this my go to stop each time I'm in San Fran near the Airport! I repeat this was excellent food and service!

Atmoosphere is a high 3 for me because it’s a small place and not the easiest to find at night!

With that said, you know want they say about a “hole in the wall”
The Service was great and the food was excellent. My 15 year old daughter and I were looking for something to quick to eat at 8:30 pm and close to the hotel. This place didn’t disappoint.

Quaint clean hole in the wall, tucked back in a business industrial park. Staff is friendly, attentive and the food is of quality with plenty of selections for anyone. I liked it so much I went for 3 evenings in a row, ate and drank something different every time. I went right when they opened at 5pm, go early, fills up quick on some nights! Worth it.

name: Cafe Figaro
editorialSummary: Long-running stop for homestyle Italian dishes & an extensive wine list in a warm, cozy setting.
reviews: You know an Italian restaurant is good when Italians are dining there. Café Figaro is truly a gem. The service is impeccable, the food is excellent, and the portion sizes are just right. They also have a full bar, so don’t hesitate to ask for a drink even if it’s not on the menu. I started with a margarita, and surprisingly, it was one of the best I’ve had! Definitely a spot worth adding to your r
All of our meals were exceptionally delicious and perfectly cooked. The staff were friendly and attentive. A full selection of spirits. Reservations are recommended.

Excellent tasty food.
We had the beef carpaccio lasagna and  Cioppino.
All very good!!

They were insanely busy on a Sunday night but accommodated us quickly. The owner was on the floor coordinating the team like a conductor. Family love exuded as his son helped behind the bar. The food was amazing. Old school joint worthy of being open since 1989.

If you are looking for a dining experience that feels like a true "gathering" rather than just a meal, Cafe Figaro is a remarkable find. The Kurdish owner brings an extensive cultural background that informs every pairing, creating an extraordinary culinary synergy between the food and the world-class wine program.
The commitment to excellence is evident in their selection of high-quality ingredie

name: Yangon
editorialSummary: Warm, narrow Chinese eatery serving an extensive menu of classic dishes in casual surrounds.
reviews: I met up with a friend of mine for dinner at this restaurant (halfway between SF and my town) and we were glad that we found this place. It's a very welcoming, nicely decorated restaurant with super friendly, kind and helpful staff. The food was very delicious, they have multiple vegan and vegetarian options. It was not too busy on a Wednesday afternoon, so we could chat in a quiet environment. We

Yangon Burmese and Mandarin Cuisine in Burlingame offers solid, flavorful dishes at a very reasonable price point. The menu features a good variety of Burmese and Chinese options, and the portions are generous, making it a good value for anyone looking for a satisfying meal without spending too much.

The food is well-prepared, with standout items like the tea leaf salad, garlic noodles, and curry

A small neighbourhood restaurant, simple decor but good and friendly ambience.  Service was excellent and so was the food.  The sesame orange beef we ordered was soooooo delicious!  Really enjoyed my meal there.
Loved our food. Great atmosphere. Service was fantastic. The place was full,  everything was still perfect and fast. Hope they keep up the good work. Rice was just cooked to perfection.
Delicious food, friendly family and a great place to have a meal. It's been a few years since I've been here because we moved, but this place hit the spot. Still great!

name: Royal Donut Cafe
editorialSummary: No-frills, circa-1968 hangout for donuts, pastries & coffee plus locally made ice cream.
reviews:
This place offers a varied breakfast menu with something for everyone. The interior is simple and welcoming, nothing too fancy, but it does the job. The food? Delicious! From the eggs to the pancakes, everything tasted fresh and flavorful.

The only downside was the longer-than-usual wait time, but to be fair, the place was really busy—so it’s probably a sign they’re doing something right.

One sm

This is a must for breakfast, if you’re staying overnight or here for a visit start your day off here!!!
I’m staying at a local hotel, they offer breakfast that was typical and way overpriced so I looked locally.
This gem has traditional and southern foods available for breakfast. Top top it off; amazing donuts and treats.
It has the classic diner appeal, and the people here are authentic & welcom

Solid breakfast burrito. The wrap was crispy and instead I wish it was soft and homemade but the ingredients came together well.

Classic diner vibes and everyone was friendly.

5 Stars — Plus, Plus, Plus!
Royal Donuts on Broadway is hands down one of my favorite spots. The customer service is top-tier — always friendly, fast, and welcoming. I absolutely love getting their pancakes and hash browns — perfectly cooked and full of flavor every time. The coffee? Hot, fresh, and delicious — exactly how it should be. Shoutout to Terry and David — both are simply amazing! David

Delicious breakfast. I ordered the fajita burrito, it was priced reasonably. A nice sized portion, made to perfection. I arrived Sunday morning about 9:30am, a popular local spot with about half the tables available at the breakfast rush. David took my order and was knowledgeable about the ingredients. I also like the open kitchen design, it really lets you see and or hear the masters as they crea

name: Mykonos
editorialSummary: Greek specialties, wine & cocktails in a warmly decorated, snug eatery with outdoor seating.
reviews: Mykonos Meze is a wonderful, family restaurant with fantastic food in Burlingame downtown. We were looking for a place for dinner, heard rowdily happy noises from what looks like a parking lot, and found a Greek restaurant with large family groups inside and tables outside under an extension with floral decor. The place is quite pretty. We opted for a small table outside , which is much quieter. O

I’ve been dying for months to try this place. It’s absolutely amazing! I will definitely be going back and bringing my family. I went in the middle of the day, I was immediately. It was so beautiful inside, the atmosphere was nice. I tried the sampler platter for the spread with the fresh pita. The spreads were amazing. I could’ve just sat there and ate those the whole day. I also got the calamari

Mykonos Meze is one of the best dining experiences on the Peninsula. The food is consistently fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish we tried was outstanding, from the meze plates to the grilled specialties, and the quality of the ingredients really stands out.

The atmosphere makes you feel like you're on a Greek island, with a lively yet welcoming vibe that's perfect for date ni

Mykonos is our favorite restaurant in the Bay Area, serving the best Greek food I've had in the US. Everything on the menu tastes great, we've probably had almost everything there is by now. It's most fun to just order a bunch of small plates to share. You should definitely try the appetizer platter (which isn't on the menu), we get that every time. And the baklava ice cream is something you don't

An amazing recommendation if youre around SF and the Burlingame area! But get in quick because the place filled up swiftly after 530pm... and it was only a Wednesday?!
Food, exceptional Greek options that you must not miss:
Octopus
Meat dip plate
Ouzo Mussels
Cocktails... spicy Marguerita was a hit and the aviator was terrific, both options suggested by exceptional staff.
Food and service was quic

name: Twelvemonth
reviews: There is not a nicer restaurant on the Peninsula! It is beautiful. The service is kind, welcoming, and what you miss with DoorDash and Uber eats. We frequent here at least once a quarter to try the new dishes  but with this last menu change, they are really showcasing why they’re celebrating their third birthday! So unique and special. The asparagus appetizer was a-moment(!!) profound, flavorful a

This is my 3rd time here and this season's food selection was absolutely delicious. Some dishes from prior experiences tasted okay, but this time 90% of what we got were packed with flavor! While eating the sliders and lasagna, I also forgot we were in a 100% plant-based restaurant.

Highly recommend:
-asparagus salad app, roasted beets app;
-lasagna, risotto, and campanelle mains.
Skip the falafe

Delicious food! My wife and I love this place. Perfect for date night! We tried the chef’s menu once which was pretty good. The starters are amazing. Risotto is my personal favorite. And the chocolate dessert is the best! Wait-staff is pretty diligent too.

Best part was our server, Sol -- she made the meal so enjoyable and gave genuine recommendations based on her experiences trying different dishes. Ambiance was beautiful, modern, clean, etc. Food was a 7.5/10, just felt like something was missing in each dish. Overall will try again, but the food itself was not to the Blossom & Root or Wildseed standard of nicer vegan dining.

I hate to leave a review like this, I'm happy an all vegan restaurant exists here. The worst part was, the food and service to the tables to either side of me looked great. However, I ordered the chef's tasting menu and was left disappointed and hungry.

To either side of me customers had plates of fried mushrooms, sliders, and lasagna that looked and smelled delicious. The dishes in the tasting m

name: Caffe Central
reviews:
A large amount of selections and I had trouble choosing! Their plate visuals were so cute and helpful to see what I wanted. It was very crowded on Memorial Day morning.

We had a bit of trouble finding a table after placing our order at the register. However, a very kind man (a busser?) noticed us waiting and had a lovely pair who was finished with their meal get up so our group of 4 could sit dow

This was a great breakfast experience. I love the food display which made it easy to pick a dish to order. The flavors were better than the appearance, which was already pretty appetizing. I wish I had tried the chia but didn't see it until finishing my order.

Discovered this place which is just a block away only from my apartment. The place is pretty presentable, the food is excellent though it could be really crowded most specially over the weekend and weekdays as well but it’s worth waiting. The crew are always on the top of their job cleaning and clearing out some table for the next customer who will dine in. My experience from this place is beyond
Busy neighborhood bistro with really tasty salads, sanwiches, breakfast, pastries amd coffee.  All made with really fresh ingredients.

I've been coming for Caffe Central for over 8yrs now and it's always a nice treat! I love their pour over coffee and selection of breakfast foods, especially their oatmeal and pancakes on the weekend. Definitely make it a point to stop by when you're in downtown Burlingame.

name: Rasa - Burlingame
editorialSummary: Indian fare from sustainable ingredients served in a polished bi-level space with chandeliers.
reviews: Rasa is both an homage to your favorite take out Indian dishes and a celebration of culinary technique to elevate classics without losing their wholesome and timeless flavors. This is my second time here, and I have yet to be underwhelmed by anything. The dishes are clever and delightful and perfectly portioned so you’ll debate about getting just one more plate for the table. (Do it, you wont regr

Thank you so much for the incredible experience last night — every moment was unforgettable!

The drink was absolutely awesome, so refreshing with that creamy coconut foam. The corn chaat was excellent, I could not figure out what was added along with boondi to make it airy (rice crisp), the taste was just right, the lotus root kofta curry was soulful and not too rich/creamy (excellent) and the ca

Rasa offers a lovely fine-dining experience with a modern ambience thoughtfully blended with touches of South Indian heritage. The sliders were fresh and well-made, standing out in both flavor and presentation. While the vegetarian options were somewhat limited, they were tasty and well executed. Overall, it’s a great spot for ambience and quality food, and I’d rate it 4/5.

I attended with a group of 6, so my review may not reflect the average experience. We also ordered the "family style" menu with a variety of dishes.

The starter dishes were great - a good variety of flavors and textures, with good presentation and sauces.

The drinks were average - nothing to write home about.

The entrees fell flat - the curries for 3 of the dishes tasted nearly identical, witho
The starters were nice but the main (butter chicken) was too sweet for my taste. Loved the ambiance though.

name: Il Fornaio Burlingame
editorialSummary: Upmarket chain for Italian dining, including freshly made pasta & bread from an in-house bakery.
reviews: Very nice restaurant with attentive, friendly and knowledgeable staff. Beautiful flowers surrounding the building. A variety of seating indoors, including a bar area. Reservations are highly recommended, as it fills up fast. The upscale atmosphere is great to celebrate a special occasion with family. All of the food (pasta trio, meatballs, bolognese, spaghetti pomodoro, insalata di casa, bruschett

Alex is the best bartender in the whole town! His espresso martinis are to die for even though I’m a wine drinker. On Wednesdays they have half off bottles of wine :)) We enjoyed a 2023 Caymus with the Risotto with spinach and shrimp, unfortunately I would not recommend it. It tastes more like over cooked rice than a risotto. However, the shrimp had good flavor. Our waiter was ever so kind in swit

Il Fornaio, located right in the middle of Burlingame Downtown, was an upscale Italian restaurant.  It had both bar, formal dining and private party areas It served quality Italian dishes including appetizers, pastas, pizzas, interesting mains and good wines. Its complimentary breads served with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar was so good. Its deep fried breaded small squids and deep f

An invitation for dinner celebrating their 40 year wedding anniversary was a very good excuse to have dinner at this place. The bread with olive oil and balsamic vinegar was a starter with the fried calamari plate… I had the house salad with the seabass fish and it was delicious and perfect

The weather was absolutely beautiful today, so my husband and I decided to go out to find a place to eat. Burlingame really has so many restaurants with great ambiance—they all feel very romantic. We passed by this place and thought it looked promising. Since it was lunchtime, it wasn’t too crowded. We tried the seafood pasta and the classic tomato and cheese pasta, along with a portion of fried s

name: Urban Kitchen
reviews:
Had a nice breakfast at Urban Kitchen in Burlingame. We ordered the steak and eggs and avocado toast, and both were good and satisfying.

The ordering process is counter service, you order first, get a number, then find a seat and they bring the food to your table when it’s ready.

Overall, solid casual brunch spot with good food.

Delicious, well plated, good portion size, and a good price. Service was fast and friendly. It's fast casual so you can order at the counter, pay, and take a seat which means it's really good for meeting up with a group of folks. The restaurant seating is spacious and looks nice. Ample seating both inside and outside. Lots of other things nearby and right next to the Burlingame Caltrain station.

November 2025:
Stopped by for lunch. Ordered a miso salmon bowl and the chicken katsu sandwich. Both were very tasty 😋.

The salmon bowl was quite a large portion. Dressing was good.

Chicken sandwich was interesting. Black beans added a nice element. Fries were thin and tasty.

Would definitely come back again.

My husband discovered this place where he’s able to order things he likes (great burgers and sándwiches, a good pasta, etc.) and I get to order what i enjoy, the salads and the bowls.  We were welcomed by a friendly staff.  I ordered their Asian salad with a grilled salmon. He ordered their orecchiette with chicken. Our food came within minutes of us finding a table. My salad was well-prepared. Th

We came here with my family for the first time and wanted to give it a try. Honestly, it was better than we expected. All the products were very fresh, the meat was cooked perfectly, and it was tender and delicious. The place was clean and the staff was attentive as well. We had a great experience and would definitely consider coming back again.

name: Stella
editorialSummary: Sophisticated neighborhood osteria serves rustic Northern Italian cuisine in a romantic atmosphere.
reviews:
Went here for our first wedding anniversary, absolutely loved the vibe and the atmosphere. They decorated it a bit more for us. Food was 10/10, had their valentine day select menu which was outstanding.

Special mention for the chocolate crunch cake which was out of this world!

The best Itallian restaurant  ever. The food is so good and worth the price. The taste is priceless, rich and very fresh. The servers is a plus because they are always ready to answer your question and they are all very polite and kind, our server is very patient to entertain all of our questions and very knowledgeable to whats in their menu.  The place  is very welcoming and very pretty. I will d

A nice, cozy restaurant that serves solid northern Italian food in downtown Burlingame. The stewed beef short ribs was delicious, but the polenta that came with it was particularly memorable as it was so creamy and buttery. Everything else (e.g., gnocchi with truffle sauce, salads, and tiramisu) was good as well.

Superb service when I called last minute to make a reservation.
The host and severs were amazing and kind.
Attention to detail was on point. They split our cocktail (we were sharing) without asking when I mentioned it to the server.
The food was superb and rich.
Worth the time and money

My husband and I have been coming here for 20 years (at the prior location).  Food can only be described as outrageously delicious at the same time, comforting in a relaxed and sophisticated environment.  I now take all my girlfriends here and they are equally as impressed. Service is kind without being obtrusive. Everything about dining here is wonderful.

name: Coconut Bay Thai Restaurant & Bar - Burlingame
editorialSummary: Contemporary Thai eatery with patio seating & private dining featuring noodles, rice & soups.
reviews:
Coconut Bay Thai restaurant and bar
@ 1107 Howard Ave, Burlingame, CA 94010

We had dinner here and had a pleasant experience overall. Parking is available outside the restaurant, but it was full when we arrived, so we parked near Safeway, which is just a short walk away.
The restaurant is clean, and I really liked the mini display in front of the waiting area—it was very creative and added a nice

We visited this restaurant for our team lunch. First, I need to start with the extraordinary service - no hiccups at all. The staff was always attentive, cleaned up on time, and the service was quick as well. Unfortunately, there were no cocktails available when we were there, as there was no bartender; only beer was available.
We started with appetizers. The Coconut Shrimp was very bland - just p

Coconut Bay Thai Restaurant in Burlingame was a great experience overall. The staff was friendly, polite, and professional, which set a nice tone right from the start. We began with the appetizer sampler, and it was a fun and satisfying way to kick things off, with a mix of chicken skewers, crab, paratha bread, and spring rolls that worked really well together.

For the main course, we ordered the

Delicious Thai food, reasonably priced and nicely decorated. We ordered the Lady’s Finger for appetizer and Drunken Noodles and Chicken-Pineapple fried rice for main dishes. Everything was so flavorful, freshly made and in generous portions perfect for table sharing. Service was also prompt and warm. Very recommended !

I highly recommend Coconut Bay Thai Restaurant and Bar. We have hosted several large party reservations here, and the experience has been excellent every single time.

The service is consistently fantastic, and the staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming. A special shout-out to Pookie, the owner, who is always so accommodating and hands-on, ensuring every guest is well cared for. Beyond the del

name: Mingalaba Restaurant
editorialSummary: The exotic flavors of Burma, plus some Chinese dishes, draw crowds to this modest spot.
reviews: I travel to the Burlingame/Redwood City area about once a month so I like to try different places to eat. This was one of my favorites. Service was great and very knowledgeable. My server answered all my questions and made great recommendations based on my feedback. (I like spicy 🔥). I ordered the Vegetarian Samusas, Curry Chicken with coconut rice, and Pork Basil stir fry. It was all awesome & I

Had the Pumpkin Curry Chicken and Chicken Curry Dahl.  PCC was slightly sweet and an overall awesome and addictive curry!  CCD had more traditional Indian flavors, basically chicken with daal - still really tasty.  The coconut rice (not sweet) really tied the meal together.  If you’re in San Fran or flying in/out of SFO - give this place a try!

Loved their Burmese coconut chicken soup! Service was great, waiters were really nice and attentive. Ambience was nice and cozy. A room for improvement would be to add a small portion (half bowl?) of white rice with any curry, with option to change to other type of rice or bread for additional cost.

Mingalaba is a solid spot for Burmese food. I visited with a friend and overall, we had a good experience.

The dishes were flavorful and well-prepared — definitely captured the essence of Burmese cuisine. We ordered three dishes along with a bowl of rice for each of us. While everything tasted great, the portion sizes felt a bit lacking. For two people, the amount of food wasn’t quite enough, eve

My boyfriend and I went to Mingalaba on the Fourth of July. The food was genuinely delicious, and the avocado veggie roll was huge and very filling. That said, spending around $30 for one vegetable roll felt pretty overpriced.

I was also disappointed by the service. Our server wasn’t particularly friendly, and the interaction felt a little cold from the start. I which wasn’t a great feeling becau

name: Mediterranean Kitchen Burlingame
reviews:
Chicken souvlaki is surprisingly really tender for chicken breast meat.

Get that above all else.

Also, I think the classic hummus is better than the harissa hummus. The combo plate was a good value, but wasn’t overly impressed by the gyro meat.

While I was looking for a place to eat, I stopped by this Mediterranean restaurant. It was definitely much better than I expected. The doner kebab was especially delicious and fresh. I highly recommend it.

A walk up and order spot where the servers are very friendly and prompt. It was rather cold in the seating area with no heat. Everyone had their jackets on. Unfortunately the food disappointed.  We had a lamb beef gyro wrap, falafel wrap and fries. The wrap were very dry like cardboard and an over abundance of them. The falafel itself was moist and tasty and gyro meat was decent. Fries were hot bu

Fantastic place. Got the red lentil soup bowl, beef and lamb gyro plate, and Greek salad. The portions were very good. We ordered extra pita bread because we are used to our local place giving us none, but they brought plenty. The red lentil tasted different than normal, but add in the lemon they put on the side and it tastes delicious. The beef and lamb was excellent as well. Overall very satisfi

We had the most amazing dining experience here. The food was quick to arrive at the table. Everything tasted wonderful, we had the chicken soup, babaganoush, chicken souvlaki, seafood platter. Fresh, delicious. Didn’t get many pictures of food because we ate that up!

I went to catch up with a girl friend and we totally overstayed for a few hours. The servers were so nice to give us dessert and te

name: Palmetto Superfoods - Burlingame
reviews: I usually visit this spot since it's on the way. I love it here, this specific location is convenient. The vibes, service and of course the bowls and smoothies are amazing. I personally get a custom bowl, since there are so many customizable options! My personal favorites are the acai/coconut base bowls, and the POG (passionfruit orange guava) smoothie. When I'm there, it's usually Ashley who make

Been ordering here for the past few months and they are consistent with their quality, ingredients and portion sizes. Even though i order via Door Dash sometimes, it still arrives as if I went and got it myself from the store and I am very happy about that.

Plenty of parking, convenient location.

I’ve had palmetto a few times before. Tried the bay blend, warrior’s blend, and make your own but the bay blend is my favorite. The bits are always so good at palmetto and really what makes the whole bowl. I’d get a medium next time however since I think it gets too sweet with the honey in a small size.
We really enjoyed our açaí fruit bowls here. Perfect summer treat on a hot sunny day.

Fresh and fun. Had so much fun building my own bowl! The options  are incredible. Finally settled on a blue chia pudding, acai, and mango base topped with tons of fruit and toppings. So good! Love the fun waiting area. The servings are incredibly generous, so be careful what you order. A small made a great meal. Loved it!!

name: SaltYard Restaurant and Bar
editorialSummary: Easygoing restaurant highlighting comfort food meals, including steak, pasta & seafood dishes.
reviews: Really enjoyed dinner here recently. Food was fresh and tasty! Service was so fast but a little disengaged. We tried the burrata, beet salad, chicken entree, and sticky toffee pudding for dessert. Sticky toffee pudding was dry but otherwise flavor on everything was delicious! Loved being able to have my pup on the patio with us and servers were very kind to her!
Ordered some drinks and dessert. Everything was great and the atmosphere was nice for good conversation. Service was constant and they were friendly. The crème brûlée was delicious.

I give a high 3.8 rating.

We had the set lunch of grilled salmon and the mushroom truffle ravioli. For the set price of $25 / pax it was well worth it.

Portions are huge so you can take it home to go! The salads were fresh and tasty, so I love it !

Great to bring a date there or your parents for a Sunday meal!

I came here for the lunch special and had a great experience. They started us off with soft, fresh bread served with oil and vinegar, which was such a nice touch. For my main, I ordered the salmon, which was a generous portion and cooked really well. It came over creamy mashed potatoes that were so buttery and delicious. The salad was fresh, and dessert rounded out the meal perfectly.

Service was

I ordered a Cioppino and Parmesan Truffle fries to go and was very dissatisfied with the quality.

Cioppino: a lot of clams and mussels included were not even open. There were a total of 2 pieces of squid. Shrimp was rubbery and overcooked. Flavor of the soup was very lacking, and basically only tasted of oil and tomato. For the price, I was expecting a lot more. This dish is over $40 bucks, but i

name: Mateo Pizza Restaurant
address: 851 N San Mateo Dr, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews:
A neighborhood pizza place that clearly puts a lot of care into what they make. ❤️ The ingredients’ quality are noticeably good—you can really taste the difference.

The Turkish-style pizzas are excellent. I’d easily give them a 10/10. The flavors are balanced, fresh, and full of character.

Also, don’t skip the dessert station. Some of the desserts are baked by the owner’s mom,  delicious. Always

A True Culinary Treasure on the West Coast!

Yesterday night, I had the opportunity to eat some Turkish food in Mateo Pizza Restaurant, and frankly, the experience far exceeded my expectations. Their lahmacun and sujuk (sucuklu) pide were, in a word, phenomenal.

As someone who has been searching for these authentic flavors for years, I can confidently say that this is the best Turkish style lahma

I must say, this pizza spot is an absolute jewel of an establishment. The fare and the service are simply exquisite. It honestly felt less like dining out and far more like being cordially invited into a dear friend's parlor for a sumptuous evening feast. The hospitality is, quite frankly, unmatched! We partook in the Ottoman and a classic pepperoni pizza, and both are absolute prerequisites for a

Guys, okay I am super picky with my pestos and chicken, but their chicken pesto pizza was soo good!! Almost as if the pesto is made in house!! And the dough of the pizza soo good I even ate the crust!! And the staff was so friendly and helpful giving recommendations. And they are open everdayy until late!!
Really good, will definitely bring my friends and family to come try it.

Absolutely amazing pizza! We stuck to the house favorites and ordered a lot of them. Ordered the meat lovers (2 of them because we loved it so much), the heavenly mushroom, margarita, and bbq chicken delight (also 2 of them!).  Almost all XL’s. Really great thin crust pizza. Nice people and a fun experience to eat at the restaurant. Some outdoor seating available too. Ask for Ilyas. He’s sooooo ni

name: Tuna Kahuna
reviews:
Finally tried Tuna Kahuna in downtown Burlingame and honestly their bowl was BEAUTIFUL, like super super aesthetic presentation, and thankfully it tasted just as good as it looked.

I got the Ginger Scallion Bowl, mainly tuna, salmon, cucumber and ginger over rice. The bowl is very light and fresh, probably because there's no mayo or any creamy sauces are used, only ponzu sauce. The only creamy th

Great portion sizes and very fresh fish. The flavors were excellent and well balanced, though the bowls are a bit rice-heavy. Casual, small interior with outdoor seating available. Not fancy, but perfect for a relaxed lunch spot in Burlingame.
Best poke I’ve had since I was in Kauai! Really fresh fish. Great flavors. Solid portions. Staff was super welcoming and friendly. Will stop in next time I’m in town for sure.

Food bomb. Atmosphere bomb. Service bomb.

The poke bowl was absolutely delicious and packed with fresh ingredients. The co-owner was incredibly kind, welcoming, and generous — he even gave us two extra bowls of soup just because of his hospitality.

You can tell these people genuinely care about their customers. One of the best dining experiences I’ve had in California. Will definitely be back!
Super fresh poke and really good crab salad. Amazing sake selection too, definitely coming back ☺️

name: Kajiken
address: 112 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews:
I came during a weekday lunch because I’ve always seen a line here on the weekends. The service was great and attentive.

I ordered the most popular dish, the spicy minced pork aburasoba, along with the calamari appetizer. The calamari was crispy and tasted good, but for the price, it didn’t feel worth it since there were only a few pieces.

The noodles came out quickly and were very hot. You’re s

The spicy dry noodles "Homura Aburasoba" are incredibly tasty, with a rich, bold flavor that feels truly special and unlike your typical ramen dish. 🌶️😋 The Hiyayakko tofu is another standout—simple, refreshing, and absolutely delicious. 🥢✨

On the other hand, the Wagyu roast beef aburasoba was a bit too greasy for my taste and isn't something I'd order again. 🥩⚠️ The tamagoyaki was just so-so

Food: 5/5
Service: 4/5
Ambiance: 4/5
Portion to Price: 3/5
Overall: One of my go tos for ramen!

The extended review...

Food:

Keema Curry Ramen - 5/5 - This is a wonderful dish with plenty of flavor!  You have an option of egg preparation, I usually get the ajitama.  Don't forget to mix the noodles for 20 seconds!!

Service: 4/5 - Friendly and attentive service.

Ambiance: 4/5 - There is both in

Great chewy noodle texture and very flavourful!! Would definitely come again. There was a line but short wait for the outdoor seating. Chill ambience, the space between tables was reasonable but you could clearly hear your neighbor’s conversations at very loud volume.. we overheard a very spicy and shocking conversation from the table adjacent to us.
At first it seemed like a lot of onions and chi

We had a delightful experience at this restaurant. The food was unique and delicious with a fair price. The energy level in restaurant was lively yet comfortable. Our service from Gabriella was authentic and genuine. She made us feel welcome. I would highly recommend this restaurant and make sure to ask for Gabriella!

name: Gao Viet Kitchen
address: 313 S San Mateo Dr, San Mateo, CA 94401
editorialSummary: Laid-back Vietnamese restaurant whipping up pho, seafood, noodles & meat dishes, plus cocktails.
reviews: I have been to this place a few times now and it a really solid Vietnamese spot in DT San Mateo. It is on the pricier side and the portion has gone smaller over the years but the flavors are still really good. I always get the coconut coffee drink and this time I got the 5 spice chicken pho and it was so delicious! This place does get busy, but worth the wait

One of the most exceptional and authentic Vietnamese restaurants in town. The ambiance is delightful, the staff is courteous and professional, and the food is of exceptional quality. I highly recommend this establishment for those seeking authentic Vietnamese cuisine. I intend to return in the future.

I was invited to try Gao Viet Kitchen with a few coworkers. Beyond the confusion of checking in and standing in line for a table. It was a very enjoyable experience. I chose their Veggie Pho' which was almost more food than I could handle. Plenty of veggies and tofu! Tried the Tequila Pho'ever drink which just by reading how it's made, you'd say no. Nope! I was very tasty and I recommend it even i

Came here for dinner on a Monday as a table of 4 and was seated after 15 mins on the Yelp waitlist. Food came out pretty quick, and most of it tasted good. Portions are large so consider sharing, or prepare to take back leftovers. Recommend the fish sauce chicken wings, garlic noodles, and shaking beef dishes. Prices are a bit higher than other spots for both standard and specialty dishes. It was

Food looks great, but taste is just OK. Prices are not justified. Over hyped and overpriced.

Tried the Chubby Pho ($26) and Bun Bo Hue ($27) and both broths tasted quite bland. They give a fair amount of meat and I will admit that the meat quality seemed high, but the broth lacked flavor and depth, which really takes away from the overall dish.

Imperial roll was too taro heavy and I couldn't tas

name: Pausa Bar & Cookery
editorialSummary: Stylish trattoria for wood-fired pizzas, Italian mains & cocktails, with a chef’s table option.
reviews: Came to celebrate a birthday and had a really enjoyable experience. Service was impeccable! Our server was very attentive, friendly, and paid attention to our needs. Food was delicious and beautifully plated. The bolognese was so good we ordered two of them!Birthday boy even got a small complimentary piece of cake at the end. I would definitely come back again.

The food and service were spectacular. We had a large group - 8 - and our only complaint was that it was too loud to talk to each other. I think a smaller group will not experience that. Our waiter had great recommendations, the food was delish and the staff was friendly. We appreciated meeting the chef.

Came here for a big group dinner and overall really enjoyed the experience. Felt like the appetizers were excellent, and surprisingly the pasta and entrees were good not mind blowing. Ok value for money. Overall, solid for San Mateo but didn’t meet expectations

This might be my 10th time coming back here.
We started with a couple of drinks, then small bites, then dinner date, then Chinese New Year celebration…
This place keeps leveling up. Every time there is something new. The menu is creative, thoughtful, and beautifully presented as always.

Highly recommend the the pistachio cake with cranberry sauce. And the signature grilled bone marrow totally liv

Went after a few years here, this place used to be something different! Being a vegetarian Our previous experience had a chef visit us and give us custom recommendations on what they can do for us since most of the menu is not vegetarian friendly! This was not the case this time. We went there to celebrate our anniversary but feel let down. Drinks were great though. The pizza was better, but the r

name: Taishoken Ramen
editorialSummary: A bustling Japanese locale that offers tsukemen dipping noodles & ramen combos, plus beer & sake.
reviews:
Both the classic ramen and the dipping noodle were great.  The broth was rich and flavorful without being too thick and overwhelming. The tuna tartare and fried chicken were great as well, no complains, the portion was bigger than I expected, so actually got full pretty quickly lol.

The restaurant is popular, even at close to closing hour, it was still full house, so definitely use the “joining w

Taishoken Ramen – San Mateo
We decided to try Taishoken Ramen after seeing a great review on a TV show, and our curiosity definitely paid off.
The restaurant is clean and welcoming, with plenty of customers dining in when we arrived. We were seated immediately, and our server was friendly and helpful, recommending their best sellers.
Here’s what we ordered:
Tuna Tartare – Made with tuna, avocado,

I really like the Taishoken brand, so I was happy to stop by the San Mateo location again. I usually come here when I’m in the mood for their ramen or tsukemen, but this time I wanted to change things up and tried the mazesoba. It ended up being a great choice.

The mazesoba was flavorful, rich, and very satisfying without feeling too heavy. The noodles had a great texture, and everything mixed to

A good option for ramen if you’re mainly focused on the food itself. The space is quite simple and doesn’t have much of a warm or cozy atmosphere, so it feels more functional than inviting.

The ramen, however, is well done. The broth is flavorful and satisfying, with a good balance that isn’t overly heavy. Noodles are cooked properly with a nice texture, and the toppings complement the dish witho

I personally prefer Taishoken's mazesoba to Kajiken's I think the flavor is more balanced. Taishoken's dipping noodles are great, their chicken broth ramen are great, and so it their seasonal items. Recently had their duck dipping ramen with the thin noodles - it was both decadent refreshing. I've come here over the last 5 years many times and the quality is consistent.

name: Foreigner Cafe
address: 60 E 3rd Ave Ste 108, San Mateo, CA 94401
editorialSummary: Hot spot with an industrial-rustic vibe dishing up eclectic New American plates, plus wine & beer.
reviews: The overall food quality was good. The Tuna Melt Croffle was unique and flavorful, with a crispy croffle paired with a savory tuna filling. It's definitely worth trying. As for the Turkey BLT Sandwich, it was essentially a classic BLT with turkey added. It tasted fine but wasn't anything particularly memorable. The house coffee was also good, although it was a bit disappointing that free refills w

This has been my go-to café in downtown San Mateo for years. I come here all the time — for casual breakfasts, coffee meetings, afternoon tea, and meeting new friends. It never disappoints.

Coffee is consistently good. The turmeric latte is perfect during seasonal transitions, and their signature Yema Latte and Cuban coffee are always solid. Food-wise, I usually go for the spinach and mushroom qu

Amazing breakfast spot with unique offerings.  We had a French Omelet and a Berry Croffle (croissant waffle).  The inlet was cooked perfectly and the Croffle was excellent, sweet but not too sweet. The house drip coffee was excellent as well.  Great place to go!

Very yummy breakfast/brunch place. They have pretty good coffee too. We order the Cortada and the red velvet latte. Both were great. Their food also tasted great. The eggs Benedict were especially yummy. We like that they have real food display for ordering but dislike that there’s no price on the food until they ring it up.

I went to this place with my friend for brunch and had a great experience. They had a large selection of sandwiches, wraps, salads, crepes and multiple vegan options. My friend had the all day breakfast tray (loved it) I had the quinoa, oat and fruit bowl. Everything was tasty and fresh. Good coffee and tea. They have free pup cups and they are dog friendly - outdoor seating available.

name: Ox 9 Lanzhou Handpulled Noodles
address: 11 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews:
The noodles here really are quite good. I ordered medium flat noodles in my beef noodle soup, and knife cut noodles in my beef stir fry. Unfortunately, I did find the beef noodle soup to be a bit lacking in flavor, I wish it had more heat and more beefy substance. As a light noodle soup though, it was great!

The spicy wontons were probably my most favorite dish. Plenty of yummy spice! The garlic

Delicious food. Very authentic Chinese noodle and freshly made. We got the following:
Lanzhou hand-pulled noodle, mung bean noodles with garlic salt, spicy ground pork dry noodles, popcorn chicken
And did family style.
Food came out fast

Pretty basic lanzhou noodles. We tried several types and all are mid.

The mala version is probably the worst - it tasted thin and seasoning felt like it came out of a pre mixed ramen packet.

The pickled veggie with beef noodle was good. Their popcorn chicken was so so. The potato salad is way too sweet

I've been to this place before and although it didn't make me a solid fan that I'd want to visit every so often it did leave an impression that it's ok for a quick bite.

I recently went back since I was in the area. The food is just as I remembered. The sauce is slightly overdone but the noodles are good enough. They did offer slightly more variety than I'd expect from this kind of restaurants.

Service was quick and helpful. We got the braised beef soup with pickles and the belt flat noodles, which was a hearty soup with a bit of tartness from the pickled greens. The belt flat noodles were nice and chewy- and filling. We also got the Northwestern lamb soup noodle dish - a lighter soup with less noodles comparatively, but still just as flavorful. The pork buns were also pretty good, with

name: KEITAN Binchotan Yakitori
reviews:
Went right near open with a reservation and was seated immediately. Service was good as you order on your phone using a QR code located on the table. It was a little confusing as we came in a group of 6 and it was hard to tell what we ordered as it under the same list.

The meat was nice and tender, but I felt like it was on pricer side. There is a lot of options as well as some good dishes that a

All their yakitoris were seasoned well and I loved both the salted and soy options. You order through a QR code using your phone so  you won't have any issues with flagging down a waitress whether you're seated on the first or second floors.
Favorite was garlic Brussels sprouts and Rib Eye Steak. Recommend making a reservation. Wait staff were very sweet and gave good tips as to what to order.

Automated ordering, minimal server interaction (water, food delivery, check, take out boxes).  Pretty efficient for just having one server.

Delicious food but portions are small, think of it as appetizers (tapas).  If you dont order enough or want more of something, then you'll have to wait.

Protip: Went on a Sunday evening, beers were BOGO and chicken skewers ar 30% off after 10pm

This izakaya grill is a hidden gem! The food is absolutely delicious—perfectly grilled, flavorful, and authentic. The service is warm & attentive . The ambience is cozy yet vibrant, striking the perfect balance for a relaxed evening. A must-visit spot for anyone who loves great food and a late night diner

name: Taste and Glory
address: 1208 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94402
reviews: I am usually not a brunch person, but I made an exception for Taste & Glory and was not disappointed. I tried their vegan breakfast and it was surprisingly flavorful and satisfying. the pancakes are a must. The homemade fruit spread with the pancakes is yumm ! My family ordered the huevos rancheros, fried chicken with eggs Benedict, and steak, and everything was delicious. The flavors really stand

Popular Asian-American fusion brunch restaurant in San Mateo, known for its creative and unique dishes. The interior is bright, clean, and welcoming. Wait times can vary, and you’ll likely have to wait during peak hours unless you visit right when they open.
The menu is fairly extensive, but the choices are well balanced and not overwhelming. We ordered the chicken croffle, berries pancake, crab c

Every time I pass this place on El Camino Real,  there's always long lines.  I finally got to try the food here. It was around 9:45 am with a short wait.  The atmosphere was lively, bright with all seats filled.  Pretty spacious considering from the outside I thought it'd be smaller.  Service was efficient and friendly.  Once we ordered,  food came out quickly, fresh and hot. I had the Creole Omel

We loved all the Asian fusion options and wanted to try them all. We can adjust the sweetness level to the drinks too, just ask. The service was good and parking l was easy on a Friday morning. I’ll be returning to try other items on the menu!

Pretty good food and service. Wait was of about 15minutes for 2 people on a Saturday.
Expensive but what isn’t around these parts? Definitely worth the visit.
4 stars because the silverware was dirty and we had to ask for new ones. Also, they offer those small little creamers but if you ask they do have real milk.

name: Rise Woodfire Pizza & Rotisserie
address: 2 N B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
editorialSummary: Light-filled, industrial-style eatery with a patio offering wood-fired pizzas & rotisserie chicken.
reviews: This is my all time favorite restaurant! I usually get the Woodfire pizza because that is their specialty and the fresh ingredients elevate the taste. The chocolate chip brownie cookie is so tasty and I love that they have a flourless chocolate cake option. The train coming through is such a fun experience, especially if you come with your family and kids. Also I recommend anything that has burrat

Everything about this place was good except for the loud train sounds (Caltrain station literally next door). The staff were friendly, helpful, and super accommodating for our large group and allowed those of us with mobile orders to sit with folks ordering in the restaurant.

The whole place is HUGE and you could definitely have a special celebration there. I love the indoor/outdoor fusion feel.

Imma day late on this but, you know?!? I saw this place on Bay Area Check Please. The pizza that was shown is what cause my attention . Ish looked HELLA good. Plus, I never had wood fire pizza. The lady an I came here to eat on 11/11/25 at bout 12/1230p. It wasn’t too busy. Was pretty good crowd. Had bout a

Delicious pizza, good portion sizes, great atmosphere, and well staffed. Only can be loud sometimes due to the train. Usually easy parking.

I love the mushroom pizza with honey and chicken parm.

Everything I ordered was delicious (see photos). I am a pizza snob and this pizza did not disappoint! My only issue is I sat at the bar and there was only one bar tender and it was pure chaos for her. She handled the crowd extremely well. I recommend they have two bar tenders during busy hours like the Friday night dinner rush. If you are looking for a solid menu with different options outside of

name: Espetus Churrascaria Brazilian Steakhouse - San Mateo
address: 710 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
editorialSummary: Waiters in Brazilian gaucho attire serve all-you-can-eat skewers of meat in an eye-catching setting.
reviews:
​The food here was absolutely delicious! There were so many sides to choose from, and the meats that came around were pretty typical for a churrascaria and very good. The service was top-notch across the board. Every gaucho knew exactly what they were presenting—they were friendly, engaging, gave generous portions, and some were even really funny. All in all, a great dinner.
​The only thing that t
Fantastic food and service the waiters give you the option of each cut of meat they have. The best thing has to be the top sirloin or the pichana

This place is always a winner. I came here for multiple birthdays and other celebrations and it never disappoints. The food is very tasty along with excellent service. I love all the different cuts of meat and the smoked pineapple is simply amazing. The restaurant is always clean and the layout is very nice and cozy. I think this is one of the best Brazilian steakhouses in the Bay Area to be hones

Came here for Valentine’s Day dates night and despite the enormous volume of people, the food quality and service was 10/10. The garlic steak was hands down our favorite but they had everything from baked salmon, shrimp, bacon wrapped chicken, chicken wings, pork sausage, sirloin, filet mignon, and lamb. The hot and cold sides did not disappoint either. We will be back for more!

I came here with my family in Christmas Eve (did not want to cook!), we had a reservation, and it was packed, for obvious reasons! The place looked lovely and festive, and the food and service were out of this world! We got a table that was close to the buffet and kitchen, which was perfect! My teenage kids absolutely loves everything and we all ate way more than we needed to! Even though the meat

name: Zhangliang Malatang
address: 139 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews: The soup is good here. We had both the bone soup and the Thai style Tom Yum soup. They are better than the place in Stonestown. Our favorite fresh toppings were beef tendons, raw shrimps, scallops, various mushrooms and lettuce stems. Good job staff at Zhangliang. $92 for three people (5+ pounds.)

A very popular malatang restaurant in San Mateo. If I have to rate, this one is a solid 8/10, and probably the one with the spiciest broth among all the malatang spot in the Bay. I have tomyum soup and honestly, it's sooooo spicy. Like definitely a hard kick if you're not familiar with eating spicy. Meat options are limited, but they offers many type of meat ball/ fish ball (with filling), and it'

Located in downtown San Mateo pretty close to the movie theater parking structure. And it is close to ritual tea, Molly Tea and other bubble tea places, very convenient. I like to come here to get my Malatang fix. The traditional pork bone soup is pretty good and it is not as expensive as the other place in downtown San Mateo. Still offers pretty good variety.

Great selection of ingredients and fast service! The mala xiang guo was slightly too oily for my preference but had great flavor. Everything was well cooked and at a reasonable price. I would come back again if I was in the area!

This is spot to go if you want something like hotpot but don't want to cook yourself but still get to choose your own ingredients. I go here when I don't want to do hotpot but want some soup and choosing my own ingredients. This location has a lot more ingredients to choose from compared to the many others malatangs I've been to. That means the things are usually fresh if they can hold such a larg

name: Liuyishou Hotpot (San Mateo)
editorialSummary: Busy restaurant offering Chinese hot pot soups with an array of ingredients in a contemporary space.
reviews: Hands down the best authentic Chinese hot pot around! We ordered spicy mala broth and tomato broth, both rich and full of natural flavor. All meats, tripe and veggies are incredibly fresh; sliced beef is tender and juicy after quick blanching. The DIY sauce bar has tons of options to mix your ideal dip. Staff is warm, attentive and quick to bring orders out. Cozy casual vibe perfect for group meal

First time trying Liuyishou and we are very satisfied ! The Tom Yum & Mushroom hot pot hit just right. Our spice tolerances were challenged but the flavor was worth it ! Great, attentive service too. If you’re hot pot curious, this is a great place to try!

Spent $110 per person, only to be rushed out after 2 hours and 20 minutes with multiple impatient looks from the staff. Next time, please clearly state that dining is limited to 2 hours so customers know not to interfere with your table turnover and business operations.
The meat is fresh. I really recommend the chicken soup. The chicken soup base is the best I’ve ever had, drink it after you finish all the meat and other staff.

If you’re looking for a solid hotpot experience, this hotpot spot is a must-visit. The quality of the meats is exceptional, offering fresh, marbled cuts that cook perfectly in their rich and flavorful soup bases.
​Beyond the food, the presentation is stunning, making every dish feel like a special occasion. Despite the high-end feel, the service is incredibly fast and attentive, ensuring your brot

name: sweetgreen - Healthy Salads, Wraps, and Bowls
editorialSummary: Locavore-friendly counter-serve chain specializing in organic salads & bowls.
reviews:
Quality: 5/5. I enjoyed the miso salmon bowl with spicy broccoli.  The salmon was very fresh and tasty. Bowl quality overall was spectacular and just burst with flavor.

Portion Size: 5/5. Portions were very respectable. Solid portion for lunch.

Service/Atmosphere: 5/5. Relaxing environment with friendly customer service. All the workers held a very friendly and welcoming personality which is awe

Sweetgreen makes it so easy, affordable and purposeful to eat healthy! The ingredients are always fresh and they are locally sourced, which I am a fan! There are numerous salads options under $15 but you can create your own as well (I get my protein from grains and plants so my bowls are usually $11)! This particularly location has the most beautiful sunlight and fits large groups! It’s also easy

This is one of my go-to lunch spots. The service is friendly and quick, even when they have a line. 9 times out of 10 my food is very tasty but every once in a while the dressing isn't as flavorful as usual, therefore, 4 stars.

This place has made eating healthy easy.  I really enjoy the options they offer.  I love the Chicken pesto parm and the sweet potatoes  with hot honey mustard sauce. It's full of flavor . I recommend trying this restaurant.
Used to love Plutos on Irving street in San Francisco. I was hoping to find another place just as good. Here you go. Great salads + other heathy choices.

name: Tong Sui Desserts & Drinks (San Mateo)
address: 250 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews:
San Mateo downtown is honestly the place to be right now—it’s basically the "war room" for AI entrepreneurs. You can practically hear the next big startup being pitched at every other table.

We swung by Tang Sui right in the middle of downtown for a post-dinner treat. If you’re a matcha fan, this is your spot. We ordered a boba drink and a matcha, and both were super refreshing with a really deep

If you like desserts but also a healthy freak, try this place!
A really healthy collection of Asian flavored pudding / drink desserts. Very smartly using 🥥 as a base, then creatively pairing with many flavors. Very low sugar and calories.
Passes healthy freaks like me. 😉

It’s really hard to choose from, basic ones like mango 🥭 , matcha🍵 , slightly bold ones from Asia like Durian. Also creativ
Great atmosphere, crew are all smiling and very welcoming to every customer. Their drinks are all refreshing and healthy highly recommended. Their coconut mango mochi is so good. Love this place.

Absolutely love Tong Sui! The coconut pudding is hands down the best I’ve had — super smooth, rich coconut flavor, and perfectly balanced not too sweet at all. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. Mango sticky rice is also great and very fresh. Will definitely be coming back whenever I’m craving desserts that are comforting but not overwhelming. Highly recommend!

5 stars. The staff here are genuinely nice and really knowledgeable. They helped me pick between Coco Bomb, Coco Papaya, and Matcha Mist, and everything came out perfectly balanced. I always grab the black sesame pudding too. Desserts are very light, and it is easy to find gluten free choices plus clearly labeled vegan options. anyone in the area needs to RUN Not walk to tong sui right now.

name: Happy Lamb Hot Pot, San Mateo 快乐小羊
address: 215 S Ellsworth Ave, San Mateo, CA 94401
editorialSummary: At this Mongolian chain eatery, diners cook meat & vegetables in broth at the table.
reviews: The ambiance here is quite pleasant. The service is good, and the food is fresh. However, the prices are a bit high. I visited this place over the weekend and was charged a total of $94.39 for two people. That’s almost $100!

First time here with friends and was a little overwhelmed by the menu, but the waiter talked us through it and gave suggestions we were all very happy with everything. The marrow broth was delicious and all the various meats (lamb, pork, beef) and vegetables were excellent. I kept losing some of my bites in the broth (noob!), but finding them was half the fun.

We were seated right away, which was great for a family visit. Unfortunately, the service went downhill from there. The waiter who escorted and seated us seemed careless, and throughout the meal we had to flag down other servers just to place our orders or get assistance.

The most uncomfortable moment came at the end. After we asked the busboy for the bill and paid, the same waiter rushed back to
Great hotpot place. All you can eat is the best value I believe. Fresh vegetables and quality meats.

Meat quality's pretty good, gotta give them that.  Service was also quick, didn't have to wait long.  The hot pot soup was tasty too.  Definitely coming back if they keep up the good work.  Hope the quality stays consistent!

Most people when they eat hot pot they use or make a sauce for dipping. This hot pot style recommends that you don't use a dipping sauce but you can make one at the sauce bar

name: New Thai Elephant
address: 200 S B St, San Mateo, CA 94401
reviews: Solid Thai restaurant with a focus on Thai comfort foods alongside classic Thai dishes. We've been coming here for years and it's been a consistent experience. The food can be hit or miss. Our favorites have been the dishes with char siu style (BBQ) pork, larb, and the curries. The duck dishes and stir fries have often been misses. Service can be slow, but it depends on who's working. Interior is

Quick and friendly service. Food was fresh and very tasty! Lots of vegetarian options, my parents loved it. I had the green curry myself and it was excellent but I really liked the pineapple fried rice. Also the Thai tea was standard but extra fun with frozen Thai tea bear! We will all definitely be back!!!

Located in the heart of downtown San Mateo this Thai restaurant is colorful, well lit with natural sunlight, open space concept. Come at night to see the lights, good food and drinks! Parking is a bit hard to find but, well worth it!

The restaurant feels rather mechanical. There is no one at the entrance to welcome you or answer questions. Instead, you enter your name and phone number into a system and receive a text message when your table is ready. Personally, I much prefer being greeted by a human host when I arrive at a restaurant.

There also seems to be considerable confusion on the menu between "vegetarian" and "vegan."

Average Thai restaurant. Not bad, but not great either. The only reason it has so many high ratings is because they provide incentive (free Thai tea for yelp review and free ice cream cup for Google review). Because of that and it's a small restaurant, there is always a line and their always busy. Smart business move, I'll give them that

Walked in on a Fri at 7 pm for a party of 2 and waited 1 hr

name: Seapot Hot Pot & Korean BBQ
address: 1952 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
editorialSummary: Spacious & stylish eatery featuring Chinese hot pot tables, plus a conveyor belt of food options.
reviews:
We were here for the weekday lunch AYCE.
We arrived around 12:30PM on Thursday and it’s not very crowded.
The service was great. Kudos to our service Tara! We ordered the soup base and the first order of meat shortly after seated and she frequently asked if we would like to place additional orders.
There’s a large selection of food, meat, vegetables and seafood. Absolutely worth the price. It’s on

I’ve visited both the San Mateo and Daly City locations, and I personally prefer the San Mateo branch. The pastries here taste fresher and seem to be made with better consistency. The food in general also feels fresher and higher in quality compared to my experiences at the Daly City location.

Another thing I appreciate is the service. The staff are efficient, attentive, and quick to help, making

Overall it was a good experience
The broth and sauce selection, along with the variety of meats and vegetables, were all great. Honestly, the broth flavor was probably one of the best we’ve had.

One thing to note is that it’s not very kid-friendly since there aren’t really appetizer options.

Service was a bit slow, especially for items that aren’t on the sliding tray it definitely takes a while

Had the best time! We booked a room for a birthday and it was a lot of space for a lot of food and it was perfect. Really great service, everyone was really kind especially with such a big, silly group like ours. Will definitely come back!! (We spent a bit more than the average patron including drinks so price per person reflects that)

I came on President's Day 2026.  I like the overall vibe of this place.  It's an all-you-can-eat hot pot + K-BBQ place.  It's colorful, upbeat, and there is a giant screen playing K-pop music videos.  Conveyer belts serve a multitude of free side dishes. $24 for lunch, $35 for dinner.

I thought the service was sub-par.  It took a while for my soup to come out, and each meat order took longer and

name: 人间烟火小酒馆（Dynasty BBQ)
reviews: Came and found parking around the block. Put our names on the Yelp waitlist and seated in about 15 minutes. Despite how busy it was, the tables did not feel crowded. After scanning the QR code and placing the order, food came out pretty quickly and stayed warm ish on the metal plate in the center of the table powered by 5 tea lights. The stinky tofu came out first and luckily the smell did not lin

just top tier
for me the pork skewers are #1
my family also got this white noodle soup which was refreshing and delicious. my mom couldn't stop raving about it 😋

If you love drunk food, skewers, or just a place to chill with your friends late at night. This is the spot for you.

It has a plenty of different meat and veggies options for you to choose from.

The restaurant itself feels a little outdated. Could use some retouching or remodeling. Other than that, we had a great time

I found plastic pieces in my dish. The staff remade it, but the replacement also had plastic pieces. At that point, I suspect they didn’t actually remake it. I really hope they improve their quality control.

Dynasty BBQ in San Mateo is a must-visit for fans of authentic Chinese skewers and hearty comfort food. The skewers are grilled to perfection—juicy, smoky, and full of flavor. Favorites include lamb, chicken gristle, and enoki mushrooms, all seasoned just right. The menu also features standout dishes like spicy noodles and stinky tofu, offering a delightful variety. The ambiance is cozy with a tra

name: Jack's Restaurant & Bar
address: 1750 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94402
editorialSummary: Lively grill serving breakfast, bar food, pastas & American plates in a warm, comfortable setting.
reviews: Love this place. Been here dozens of times and I can’t believe I haven’t reviewed it before. I like to sit at the bar or in the bar area. The corn beef hash is outstanding homemade every day. Had the eggs Benedict today with a side of pancake, which is a must because their pancakes are fantastic. Our server and bartender Saul has been there a long time and is a super nice guy with excellent attent

This is a normal American brunch/dinner restaurant, it’s not outstanding but it does its job. I like the Swedish pancakes a lot, but beware a lot of their items are on the sweeter side. Staff is very nice, and reservations are not usually needed. It’s a nice quick stop to catch up with friends and is not very loud.

This place is easily one of the best restaurants in San Mateo.
Service is always spectacular and food is consistently delicious. I usually go to the bar for Happy Hour so my go to favorites are the lamb sliders with their take on a G&T. It’s hard to find genuine hospitality these days, but Jack’s never fails to provide service with a smile :)

My coworkers and I visit Jacks once a month for lunch. We enjoy the food and the atmosphere. Everything is delicious and presented well.
I also have to give praise to Liz our server. We sit in the exact same location every time we come and she has always helped us. She has an amazing attitude and is always making sure we have everything we need. And as long as she is around we will keep coming bac

Literally had the worst day, and all I wanted was to sit down and enjoy a couple of drinks and some food, but instead I was met with extremely inattentive service, followed with a “stand in” bartender that disappeared.

Empty glass for 17 min. What in the actual!!?

My bill would have been double but I’m going to Cheesecake Factory to finish what I started.
Management complacent.
It’s unreal to ha

name: Pho Element
address: 2216 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
editorialSummary: Airy, low-key spot for Northern Vietnamese pho, rice & noodle dishes, plus veggie options.
reviews: Absolutely love this place. The staff are so kind and friendly. The foods are amazing. Have to go back for the oxtails soup (was sold out when I was there). Definitely recommend when you want pho or soup!

Clean, FAST, great service and food. Hungry and craving for pho? This is the place without having to venture out.

They are known do their chicken pho, but I had their filet mignon pho.  Despite not having bean sprouts or basil, the broth and rice noodles was PERFECT.  Zero complains here and the soup bowl comes out hot.  It really reminds me of eating in Vietnam. Nothing fancy, no gimmicks, just

Food here is amazing, the staff was very friendly, came here multiple times and the food does not disappoint. This time I came in a Friday and the waiter brought to our attention that on Fridays they have a special if you get the ox tail soup you get a free beverage of your choice. The ox tail soup was delicious and I got a free che ba mau (three colored dessert). Win win.

It was great that they opened on Thanksgiving Day even though it was only half day. The noodle soups were delicious. Rare beefs were fresh. Must try their chicken coconut noodle soup. Shrimp rolls were just ok, the wrap was too chewy. Spacious, quick and friendly service. Will definitely come back again!

great place!! i came at around 2:30 and was in a rush on a weekday, and there were few customers. staff seated us quickly and after ordering, the pho arrived quickly. they’re very accommodating and allowed us to order extra limes. pho was great and the broth was amazing

name: Prime BBQ
reviews: Great bbq, both the Chinese and Japanese style skewers are great. The staple dishes like the fried rice and udon were also very good and fresh. They also have some unique drinks from China worth a try.

I came here for a birthday with a party of 7 people. The food is a bit pricey (total bill around 350$) but I think the food was yummy. I mainly had food from the seafood side and others enjoyed a variety of selections. I personally really enjoyed the shrimp skewers they had, they were a great size and very juicy! I also really liked their tofu and corn. Some foods I think were just okay were the m

There's a reason this place is highly reviewed - it's fantastic dining here! The food is scrumptious. Everything was soooo tasty, it was not easy picking a favorite. Service was great. Staff were efficient and attentive. Atmosphere was chill - decor was nice and it didn't feel chaotic in there. I can see parking being a challenge but we were there during non-peak meal hours and found a spot nearby

Managed to get a last-minute reservation and felt quite lucky! The restaurant even followed up to confirm our arrival. The service was excellent—they even poured the sake for us. I loved the heated tray on the table that kept our skewers warm; it’s such a thoughtful touch. The menu has plenty of options, and though the place is small, it feels very cozy and atmospheric. The upside-down umbrellas h

Absolutely loved this place! The food is outstanding — fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The restaurant is spotless, and the ambiance is just perfect: calm, comfortable, and really inviting. It's the kind of spot where you can actually relax and enjoy a meal without the noise and chaos you find elsewhere.
What really sets it apart is the ordering experience — you order right from your

name: Sushi Edomata
editorialSummary: Minimalist spot specializing in an omakase (chef's choice) sushi option served at the bustling bar.
reviews:
A friend invited me to Sushi Edomata for a special celebration, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable sushi experiences I’ve had in California.

There was already a line when we arrived, which honestly made sense once we started eating. The quality of the fish was exceptional, and every piece was prepared with so much precision and care. Nothing felt overly complicated or designed just

A classic spot for San Mateo natives and sushi lovers alike!  We got their omakase and it was stellar. One of the most unique things we’ve had was their sardine nigiri. It was a nice salty delicate fish that I haven’t had before. Their hokkaido uni was also very fresh and clean! We brought our own sake in and they were able to open it for us for a fair corkage fee. Their toro was cut a little unev

You will need a reservation. Definitely worth the expense. Had the omakase, grilled fish collar, and grilled mackerel.

Omakase was ~$80 and included eight pieces, was excellent. They also let you substitute fish. I swapped out the uni for another piece of Otoro.

Grilled fish collar and grilled mackerel were also excellent. You are given a choice of fish collar if available, chose the salmon. Bot

Sushi Edomata is special. It skirts between a premium omakase establishment and an everyday local Japanese cuisine. The food ranges from tasty and reasonably priced tapas to quite expensive sushi. No matter what you order though, you can immediately tell that Edomata means business. They are not joking around, no matter how much they're smiling while they serve you. This is a proper place.

The in

Excellent, high-quality sushi at a very reasonable price. The fish is consistently fresh, the service is warm and friendly, and the space is modern and clean without unnecessary fanfare. Reservations are recommended. Easily one of my favorite sushi spots in the Bay Area.

name: 李面请 大碗刀削面 Li's Knife Cut Noodle
reviews: It’s legit. Really good value for the food you get in terms of pricing and quality. It can be a long wait but they have a good system and where you sign in and share your cell number so you are notified when it’s your table. If you are vegetarian there is only one noodle dish and you have to eat eggs. Their appetizers have good variety though. Not the best for service but hey it’s a noodle store -
