I saw IG post on this restaurant and decided to give it a try. Came here for lunch about 30 mins after opening. The restaurant was already half full. I am seeing this as a good sign. To order your food there is a QR code on the table that you use your cellphone camera to link to. Cellphone reception isn't the best here and there's no free wifi so just be prepared. Water, cups, plates and chopstick

Came on a Sunday around 7 pm and there was a bit of a line and we waited about 20 mins to get seated. It is a bit small inside and we had a party of 7 so understandable that it took a while.

We ordered Dan Dan Mein, Egg and Chive pancakes, Chinese burger, and the lamb noodle soup (forgot to snag a photo). Everyone loved the dishes and they offer free noodle refreshes, which is a great option. The

Ordered a number of dishes, including the dan dan noodles and fried noodles. Both were great, but very surprised by how good the latter was! Also ordered the spicy oil dumplings (紅油抄手）and Chinese beef pancakes. Both were excellent! Also loved their soy milk!

Paid under 100 with tips and taxes included, excellent value for money!

This is a funny play of words if you know Chinese. The actual Chinese name means Li Noodle Please but phonetically it means "come inside." I do have to give points to the cleverness of the name especially if the owner does have Li as his last name.

The place is advertising it's knife cut noodles which is actually my favorite type of noodles. However I'm taking 1 star away because it's not as chew

name: Miss Shang-San Mateo
reviews: Great spot for some unique dishes. Loved the roasted chicken rice. The recommended beef noodle soup was good as well, but the rice dish over shadowed it. I’ll definitely be back to try out more. Lunch time wasn’t too busy.

My family ordered the tangy beef rice noodles, rich tomato beef rice noodle, and skewers. Overall, the food was delicious. The beef was very tender and soft. Loved the skewers. Service was fast and convenient. The staff were friendly and caring to my table. We got complimentary cucumbers for appetizers.

We happened to be in San Mateo and decided to try this newly opened spot, 小香融合料理. The restaurant used to be a rice noodle shop, but now features a completely new menu focused on Yunnan-style cuisine.

There were two of us, and we ordered four dishes: 人生鸡饭, 冷吃麻辣掌中宝, 碧翠响螺片, and 番茄酸汤手打肉丸.

人生鸡饭 is definitely the viral must-order here. The chicken was very tender, the rice was fragrant, and perfectly

I’ve updated my review because the restaurant added back a mifen dish and it tastes as it did before. Although they only added back one mifen dish - I’ll take it! I believe it is their most popular very spicy beef rib mifen. Additionally, they added back the rice and mushroom dish which was a favorite of mine. Note: I was told that these items aren’t available every day, so be sure to check the on

Surprisingly tasty fusion cuisine. The gelato is my favorite. The only downside is the kitchen closes at 8pm and some of the signature dishes take a longer time so I didn’t get to order them. Arrive early to able to order the full menu! Highly recommend it if you are looking for something that sparks joy.

name: Silver House
address: 2224 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
editorialSummary: Understated Chinese eatery offers a range of classic fare in a cozy space with colorful Asian decor.
reviews: Ok it won’t look like much from the outside on ECR and from the rear you park in the alleyway lot and walk past the restrooms and  the kitchen but… this place is the bomb. And the chefs are top notch. I feel bad not having good photos except for one dish which came on mini wok with a burner and a dipping sauce. That’s a special lamb dish with vegetables mushrooms and goji berries. They made some u

After having an amazing whole fried fish at another Chinese restaurant, I have been looking for the same dish at a nearby restaurant. This one met my expectations. Our mapo tofu and curry mixed veggies were good too. The only item that needed improvement was the white rice which was lumpy and too soft.

Every time we get together with families in San Mateo, we tried different kind of food. This time  we visit Silver House, the restaurant that my mom used to like very much.
It's on the main street, so if you're lucky you find a parking spot in front of the restaurant, if not there're a few spots in the back alley or you have to park on the street some how.
The restaurant is clean and simple, it wa

Been coming here for over 20 years.

No soup today and they no longer have the dessert but we always enjoy the food.

We love all the salt and pepper items, chicken wings,  tofu, and fish. All of these are super good and had to get multiple orders of each for 11 people.
Steamed tofu we had to order by showing a picture,  we get 2 orders of this too.

Was here on a weeknight so it wasn’t too busy a

This is a good old Cantonese place.  It has been my family go to back in the days.  Now a day, they don't have that much business.  We do stop by ever so often to get our OG food fixes in.   Some of their servers is a bit rude, but don't mind them.  This is just how they work.

name: Heidi's Pies Restaurant
address: 1941 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
editorialSummary: Comfortable 24-hour diner serving American fare including all-day breakfast & popular pies.
reviews:
Love their mango sour cream custard pie! What a great add! Not too sweet and great
fresh flavor.

My only disappointment is that they were out of a couple pies I wanted on a Friday afternoon. Will have to go earlier!

Nice old fashioned homey atmosphere, friendly staff, and good solid comfort food.

The BEST banana cream pie I’ve ever had in all my time on this earth. Every year for my birthday I want this delectable, creamy heaven in a pie tin. Birthday cake? No, thanks. Heidi’s BCP? I’ll mow you down getting that last slice.

I was in the area with a friend for an early morning run on a Sunday, and we visited this place for breakfast post run -
1. It was not very busy when we went, but got very busy by 10am
2. They have nice coffee ☕️
3. We both ordered Veggie omelette, which came with pancakes 🥞. The food overall was good!
4. The restaurant has a dedicated parking spot for customers

We appreciate the friendly service & delicious pie, please keep going business. Life is tough and inflection is crazy, but an awesome pie 🥧 like Heidi's are the best sweet treats of a day!
Thanks for making pie for all these years!
we ordered the pie to go. blueberry sour pie - HIGHLY RECOMMEND soo amazing and we ordered Banana cream pie which I didnt really like

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
address: 2925 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
editorialSummary: New Jersey–based counter-serve sandwich chain serving jumbo subs filled with cold cuts & toppings.
reviews:
To-go experience:
My first time here and I decided to go with the turkey provolone sandwich. The Club Supreme is probably their most popular, but this one looked a bit healthier and still delicious. We got the extra-large size, which is a great value if you’re sharing with another person, as it’s cut into four small, easy-to-eat sections.

I love how the meat is sliced and how finely the lettuce i

Today was my first time trying Jersey Mikes. I have heard mixed things, but I know some people love it. I went today and tried the Big Kahuna cheesesteak. Honestly, great cheesesteak. Super cheesy how I like em, the meat tasted good too. Tried the rosemary parm bread and enjoyed it. The only reason this isn't a 5 star review is because I got a jalapeño stem in my sandwich 😭 Its big too, I am not

The customer service was very friendly.(Black dude hooked it up🤣)The sandwich was better than last time I had it.❤️ It was hot and fresh. I got the philly cheese steak sandwich on that rosemary Parmesan roll with provolone cheese. I added Jalapeno kettle cooked chips and a drink ❤️👌🏾

What a cool location and build out. The inside seating was somewhat outside. I can tell it is well managed. Clean and the food is consistently good. Get the Philly!!!
See our YouTube channel Coolest Life.

Accidental Visit Turned Into a New Favorite!
I stopped by Jersey Mike’s by mistake—I was actually looking for Subway but ended up in their parking lot. I decided to give it a try, and I’m so glad I did!

The team was super friendly, and while they had fewer ingredient options than Subway, everything was incredibly fresh and clean. I ordered a wheat turkey sandwich in the “giant” size, and it did n

name: The Swingin' Door
editorialSummary: Versatile venue with a pub menu, live jazz, darts, karaoke, TVs for sports & a beer garden in back.
reviews: Great fish and chips and cool vibe! Dont expect an upscale restaurant- it’s a fun dive bar with cool atmosphere and decent food - even smoked a few cigars out back on patio

Tables and the bar are dirty. The bartender never wiped anything down during my visit. The freezer door in the kitchen is so dirty and gross. The cook is touching that,  then touching your food. Nobody asked if our food was good or if we needed anything else. The fish was good. The hot ketchup they used to serve is now ketchup mixed with BBQ sauce (gross). The place has gone down hill since last I

And her name was CASSANDRA! Everyone should be here on Tuesday nights.. the Silicon Stompers rocked the house with their super cool big brass band , the fish n chips are delectable, and Cassandra is the hostess w the mostest! So glad we found this place, it will be our go to when in town…hey Cassandra, see you next Tuesday!!😇😆🫶🏼
This place is so charming!!! Great indoor and outdoor space, the live music is outstanding!

I don’t know what others say about this place, I just went cuz I saw good reviews. Honestly though the vibe wasn’t that inviting. I reached a bit early to meet a friend for drinks , and the place was mostly deserted. I said hi to the bartender and nothing . Then I thought maybe I disturbed them cuz they seemed to be settling the tab or something . I said “ sorry I didn’t mean to distract you “. Ag

name: Sapporo Rock & Roll Sushi
address: 2456 S El Camino Real, San Mateo, CA 94403
reviews: Our new favorite sushi restaurant!!!! We came here at the recommendation of a friend & so happy we did. Fresh fish, great service, and the NICEST, MOST HOSPITABLE sushi chefs and staff of ALL TIME. The hospitality & welcoming vibe were enough to keep us coming back. Sapporo Sushi will be our new go-to sushi restaurant. Btw, everything was absolutely delicious..our favorite rolls: OMG Sapporo, Hawa

Just had an amazing experience at Sapporo Rock and Roll Sushi in San Mateo! 🍣🎶

A big shoutout to Elma and the entire staff for making the night so fun and welcoming. The service was fantastic, the atmosphere was lively, and the sushi was incredible. I tried the Wonderful Roll and the Happy Ending Roll, and both were absolutely delicious—fresh, creative, and packed with flavor.

If you're lookin

Unbeatable lunch price!! Great sushi, friendly service, and consistent every time.
We've been here four times now and it's been solid every time. The sushi is always fresh, with a big variety to choose from - whether you're into classic rolls or more creative stuff, there's something for everyone.
Everything we've tried has been super tasty.
The staff is awesome too. They're always friendly and on

We came in by chance because we were craving sushi, and it turned into an unforgettable experience.
The special sushi was absolutely amazing, and the rolls and other dishes were all delicious as well.

What made the dinner even more special was the sushi chef’s kindness and friendly hospitality- it truly made us so happy !
We’ll definitely be back very soon. Regular spot, officially! :-)

The sushi chefs are beyond amazing, the wait staff (Elma) is very attentive and kind, and if you're gonna get any rolls, you HAVE to get the OMG Sapporo. The clam miso soup and the Baked Crab is also needed. The environment and the vibe is simply wonderful for a fun Friday evening. Give yourself a treat and try this spot, a very solid and simply wonderful sushi spot.

name: MAZRA
reviews:
Mazra in Redwood City absolutely lives up to the hype. For flavor and quality alone, I think it’s one of the best Mediterranean restaurants in the Bay Area.

We ordered:
Double Kebab Plate (chicken kebab and filet mignon kebab): both were juicy, but the filet mignon was the best. It was tender, flavorful, and easily became our favorite dish of the meal.
Steak Shawarma Plate: came with a surprising

I’ve been to Mazra a few times now and it honestly never misses. I brought my stepmom this time because she had never tried Mediterranean food before, and now I feel like I set the bar way too high for her first time 😂. The manager, Jorge, started us off with a complimentary roasted cauliflower appetizer and it was sooo good. I got the mint lemonade, she got the banana date shake, and we both lov

We came here for late lunch around 2 PM and still had to wait about 30 minutes, so it was pretty packed. The atmosphere is great, though definitely a bit crowded. Aside from ordering, it’s mostly self-service since you grab your own water or tea. Ordering is done via QR code, but the servers were friendly and happy to explain the menu.

We started with the hummus and pita, which were both good. Th

This is my first time eating at the Redwood City location and it was good! The food came out hot and fairly quickly. Everything tasted great! It's a very popular spot, but their turnover is very high so the wait is not that long. They have outdoor seating in the front of the restaurant and in the rear of the restaurant in addition to indoor dining. Highly recommended!

What an incredible place! A must visit!!! We were at Palo Alto for 7 days. 5 days out of 7, we chose to go to Mazra for dinner. Omar, Berke, and Nora helped us on different days. Something with the people makes this place very special. They treat you like family!! Food is out of this world!!! You are missing so much if you haven’t tried Mazra.

name: Milagros Latin Kitchen
editorialSummary: Jalisco-region Mexican fare & blue agave tequila served in a vibrant space with a heated patio.
reviews: What a colorful, happy restaurant. Understand, nothing fancy but big presence and delicious food. We loved their steak fajitas, the flour tortilla was unlike anything we’ve ever had. All the ingredients were delicious and fresh. Our waiters were very friendly and attentive. This is definitely one of the best Mexican restaurants we’ve ever been to.

Very nicely decorated and lively location. Went for lunch with the family. Tried both vegetarian and chicken dishes. The food was sizzling hot and tasty. Guac and chips got us started.
Their cocktail drinks were beautiful to look at and very well made. The fried jalapeño poppers were a hit and ordered a 2nd time.
Overall a great experience and will visit again soon.

Came here for dinner and the ambiance absolutely delivered. The lighting is perfect, the energy is lively, and the overall vibes are great.

The Pros:
Drinks: The drinks were excellent. I had the Guavacita, and the guava and coconut flavor combination was delicious and unique.
Menu: There is a really solid number of vegetarian options, which is always appreciated.

The Cons:
The Food: While the dr

and loved the experience. The food was delicious, authentic, and full of amazing Mexican flavors. Great tacos, refreshing drinks, and a fun atmosphere. Definitely a nice place to enjoy with friends and family!”
It is a nice Mexican restaurant with nice portion, variety, people and super colorful - always a nice vibe outside. I had Tacos and Chips and Salsa here and it was very yummy in happy hour deal :)

name: Vesta
editorialSummary: Buzzy indoor-outdoor venue draws crowds with creative, wood-fired pizza, small plates, wine & beer.
reviews: Wood fired oven pizza that BTS went to multiple times while they had their show in Stanford May 2026. They raved how good the pizza is! Recommend making a reservation on Open Table and we even asked if we can sit where they sat. The servers and staff were so friendly and open and very excited to hear fans come and check it out, they even gave us stickers! They said that since BTS came with many pe

We ordered a Caesar salad and a ground beef pizza. The Caesar salad wasn’t anything special, and the dressing had way too much garlic. I probably wouldn’t order it again.

The pizza tasted good overall, but the crust could have been better.

The service was the disappointing part. The staff seemed to be in a hurry. They started clearing my plate while I still had a piece of pizza in my hand.

I al

4 star service is due to the hostess. We had a reservation and arrived on time. Checked in and was told table not ready. We had to keep checking back on table status. Did not feel like the hostess cared.
Our waitress was amazing. Friendly and knowledgeable about menu.
Atmosphere was loud and simple.
The food was tasty. The bread and burrata was amazing. The 2 pizzas were delicious. They were quirk

It was packed but we got seated right away, in the back patio which was nice.

Our server Isai Josue was awesome.  We ordered everything based on his recommendation and it was delicious.

Charred Cauliflower - perfectly charred, dressed in a sweet, savory and mild spicy sauce.  Cauliflower was on the soft side but yummy.

Arugula salad - very nice and refreshing, perfect.

Sausage and Honey pizza
A wondrous inviting oasis for casual dining. Top notch gracious service. A must experience for excellent food.. Be prepared for big surge for lunch service and can get a noisy for conversation.

name: Marufuku Ramen Redwood
reviews:
Known for their hakata noodles or thin ramen noodles, the restaurant boasts the chicken paitan, with only 15 orders a day for the extra. It's a crispy chicken leg served separately and is filled with flavor that I highly recommend.

They also have this new protein ramen that incorporates all kinds of meat with zucchini noodles that I've heard is quite delicious and can't wait to go back and try!

Marufuku ramen is the best. I always have to fast before going to a ramen spot, simply because one bowl contains too many calories, and I could never finish a bowl. And for people like me, Murufuku has a solution - the veg up options. So, instead of eating noodles, you can just replace with veggies and not feel guilty adding 300-400 plus calories. It's just freaking genius, because I can still enj

I was already a fan of Marufuku’s Japantown spot, so I finally checked out the Redwood City location and it did not disappoint.

What surprised me was the Veg Up section on the menu with low carb options. I am not sure if that is new or unique to this location, but I tried the chicken paitan from that section and it was honestly excellent. Instead of noodles, it came with a flavorful broth over ca

It's a really nice modern Japanese Ramen restaurant

They have a few other things aside from ramen

I had the regular ramen extra spicy 4.5 stars. The broth was rich and creamy   All ramen are too salty for me. This one was just a bit salty.

One of our group had vegetarian 4.5 stars

And rice with sashimi bowl 4.5 stars

And veggie bao 4 stars

We recently visited Marufuku Ramen in Redwood for lunch. The service was really good and so was atmosphere. We were little disappointed by the Ramen, but curry rice was tasty and the veggies served were cooked to perfection.

Ringo(Apple drink): 5/5
Yuzhu(Yuzhu deink): 4/5
vegetarian Ramen: 3/5 ( have had better Ramen in Bay area)
Vegetable Curry rice: 5/5 ( one of the best in bay area, easily com

name: Mademoiselle Colette
reviews: French cafe. Pastries looked really great, the food was good and the service was excellent. Only bummer was the espresso machine was down so I’ll have to come back for that. Seasonal strawberry lavender matcha was pretty good though

This lovely Bakery reminds of so much a of a charming Parisian bakery back in France , very happy I came across this lovely place, exquisite taste of chocolate cake and the aroma of freshly baked croissants was so good. Coffee and other pastries available.

Hello, this place was great by the reviews, but honestly, I didn't feel comfortable with the service they provided. It felt like they were in a rush and not very friendly, even though it wasn't that busy. Food was alright, we got the avocado toast and french toast, which were really yummy.

Excellent food with terrific service. I had the eggs and salmon, as well as the Basque cheesecake. Both were outstanding. Also, their London Fog was top notch. The service was great, everyone working here is very friendly. I’ll definitely be coming back!

2026-02: Great cafe for brunch or desserts.
Recommend the Quiche Lorraine and the coffee, need to return more to recommend more. A lot looks good.

name: Gourmet Haus Staudt
editorialSummary: Rustic but festive hangout with garden seating pairs hearty German grub with beers on tap.
reviews: Great German beer house! There’s a large outdoor area and an inside area. The bartenders are super friendly and fun, and so are the waitresses. I love the cozy heat lamps above all tables and everything about the vibe. Great place to hang out with a group! They even have cornhole!!!!
The best German spot in the Bay Area! Food was delicious and lots of great beer selection. Plus a great store with tons of candy and alcohol imports you can only get here.

Employees were nice and helpful! Food was great and the beer especially so. Would come back on a nice hot summer day.

Really liked the shop in front selling an assortment of goods and liquor.

They have great selection of stouts, Marzens and Bavarian beers. The brautwarts were super tasty - great local moms & pops atmosphere with a touch of modern. Definitely put it in my favorites, the staff was genuinely friendly and it looked like a family owns it not corporate.

Great little hole in the wall beer garden.  Authentic german beer.  Authentic German food.  Great schnitzel and brats.  Friendly staff.  And don't miss the German markeet upfront! Fun outdoor area with cornhole. Don't miss out, this place is a lot of fun!

name: Coffeebar
reviews:
I love how you are able to see the staff behind the counter because their coffee machines are all under the counter! Why can’t all coffee shops be like this? Easy to communicate or build a rapport with the staff and vice versa - and it doesn’t look cluttered at all. Looks clean, tidy and open.
I love how there’s a ticker behind the counter reminiscent of airports but it changes to different quotes

Stopped by Coffee Bar and this place delivers.

The mocha was easily one of the best I’ve had rich, smooth and perfectly balanced between chocolate and espresso. Not overly sweet, not bitter, just dialed in. The latte art (see photos) was clean, but more importantly, the taste backed it up.

The space itself has a great vibe too, clean, modern inside with a solid menu, and the outdoor seating alon
Interesting coffee shop.  Really like the unique decor. Friendly staff.   Had an iced mocha that was very smooth and the right balance of chocolate.  Will definitely be back.

This is such a cool coffee shop to stop in at. The location great being right down town in Redwood City. Huge bonus that you can bring your dog! The staff is very sweet and very animal friendly. The service was fast. My only disappointment was that my drink seemed fairly bland/watered down and the pastry I ordered seemed a bit stale for first thing in the morning (we all have our off day). Other t

great lattes, not too sweet like some national  brands. Have been getting a caramel oat latte, which is an unusual treat allowance. Yum. Donut holes too but not this time. Cool place with great latte artists.

name: Angelicas
editorialSummary: American eats served in a lively space with a full bar, a patio & multiple stages for entertainment.
reviews: Went on a Sunday for late breakfast, and was seated in back outside patio.  Server came over after a few minutes, greeted us, and took our drink and food order.  We had steak ranchero, which was perfectly cooked medium, and was seasoned very well.  Also, had chilaquiles, which was very flavorful and chips very crunchy.  Both dishes had pico de gallo and they were freshly made.  There's plenty of s

Wonderful brunch spot on a Saturday morning! The food is delicious and the atmosphere green and cozy with lots of plants and great decor. Friendly service, highly recommended! We tried the chilaquiles and desayuno americano, both were excellent. The capuchino and hot chocolate were also great! We'll definitely return

On a slow Tuesday night, I had a very important dinner. Here at this meal I would be meeting my partner’s family, so it was of the utmost importance. They had chosen this restaurant, so nervously I arrived. We were seated in the back patio area which had a very pretty aesthetic but it seemed like a slow night for them so our service ended up being rather slow as well, however the server was super

We got married here, and I can truly say it was the most perfect place and support we could ever ask for! Our day felt like a dream coming true from beginning to end.

Crystal was absolutely excellent — so organized, calm, punctual, intelligent, and incredibly kind. She brought such peace and confidence to our day. Truly an angel!

Angelical created all the floral arrangements, and it was the most

We came to Angelica's in Redwood City to celebrate my mom’s birthday with a large group, and everything was amazing! The service was top-notch—quick, attentive, and super accommodating for our party size. The food was absolutely delicious, and the drinks were perfectly made. Such a great vibe and a memorable spot for a special occasion. We’ll definitely be back!

name: Broadway Masala Restaurant and Catering
editorialSummary: Indian fare with vegan options are offered at this eatery with a smart red & cream dining room.
reviews:
We had dinner at Broadway Masala on Saturday night. We were seated immediately upon arrival, and the ambiance was nice. The service was pretty good and the pricing is a little expensive.

As for the food, Roomali roti and ghewar were delicious, and the avocado bhel was good. Fig and walnut kofta was okay with large portion size and the garlic naan was fine. Cauliflower manchurian was a bit underwh

Quick and efficient service. Food was great. Gobi mabchurian was crispy. Fig and walnut kofta was the clearly the winner. The staff gave us a complementary dessert to celebrate the special occasion.
Would love to visit again.

The food is the best I’ve had outside of India. I had the lamb chops which was a generous portion and well seasoned. The eggplant we will go back for, spicy and tangy. Amazing breads! We had garlic naan and paratha, so crispy and buttery. We will definitely go back to try other items on the menu- there was a crispy artichoke, a paneer and lots of interesting lentil dishe. The staff was like very a

What an amazing dining experience at Broadway Masala! Every dish we ordered was packed with incredible flavor. The Paneer Tikka, Dal Makhni, and Fig & Walnut Kofta were absolutely outstanding and easily some of the best we’ve had.

The ambience is beautiful—elegant yet comfortable—and perfect for enjoying good conversations with friends and family. The service was exceptional, and a special shout-

We stopped in after a haircut in the area.  We had curry, butter chicken, samosas, Manchurian cauliflower and naan.  All were delicious.  The staff was very friendly and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  We capped off our dinner with some tasty treats.  I would definitely come back here when in the area.

name: Varam Indian Restaurant & Catering
reviews:
We came for dinner experience here, the menu offers a nice variety across regions dishes. Overall, the food was flavorful and well presented,

There’s some dishes that really stood out and are worth recommending. The tomato carrot soup was rich and comforting with well-balanced flavors. The Neptune platter is a great option if you want to sample multiple starters in one go. The Bombay beet slider

Their food here is great! We eat here often and have tried almost everything on the menu. Highly recommend the palak patta chaat and chicken 65 to start with. For vegetarian mains, the paneer butter masala and Banaras bharwaan aloo are excellent. The chicken curries and MPLR boneless chicken biryani are also great picks. Don’t miss the bread basket. It comes with pesto, cheese, and garlic naan.

Every dish we ordered was delicious here. They modified spice level for a kid as well. Dual chicken kabob was perfectly cooked and marinated. Chicken tika masala and goat curry were on point. Dosa was probably the best I had in the bay area. Even the plain rice was great!

Bright orange kitschy accents, vivid seats, and colorful murals – give this restaurant a cheerful, lively vibe. Service was quick, and punctuated with smiles, which made the experience even nicer. The mango lassi comes with an interesting swirl of syrup. The goat biryani has soft fragrant rice, and tender pieces of goat meat that are nicely cooked. The vegetarian platter is generous enough to shar

Had a wonderful vegetarian lunch .The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentically prepared. The variety of vegetarian dishes was impressive, with well-balanced spices and generous portions. The service was friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. A great place for anyone looking for delicious Indian vegetarian cuisine. Highly recommended!

name: Kemuri Japanese Barú
editorialSummary: Modern izakaya restaurant offering creative Japanese small plates, shochu cocktails & rare sakes.
reviews: Such a fun spot! They're always changing up their seasonal menu and I'm always excited to try the next new thing. Everything we've had has been fantastic from the grilled fish skewers to the pallelas. Definitely make a reservation if you're trying to go on weekends. Week days you can usually get a spot at the bar or maybe a table if you get there at opening.

I had the wagyu steak and garlic rice. Was really delicious but little bit on the salty side. But steak was very tender and cooked perfectly. Garlic rice was very tasty. My girlfriend had the unagi over rice. Was a very nice piece of unagi. Was served with a side of dashi stock and small bowl so you can make rice soup with the leftover rice. I tried a little bit with my garlic rice was so good. My

The garlic rice & wagyu steak paella and the katsu are amazing. We also had the octopus carpaccio salad and the udon. All of them are 5/5 stars. Servers are also friendly and not pushy. We really enjoyed the dinner.

The wagyu garlic rice was so so flavorful, and the wagyu was super juicy. The tonkatsu was good but I wished it came with a sauce for the katsu. Overall this place has nice atmosphere and I liked the jazz music that they were playing in the back.

This was my third or fourth visit to Kemuri over the years. I’ve tried different seasonal menus before, and in my memory, it used to be an exciting and satisfying Japanese fusion spot — creative, well-executed, and memorable.

Unfortunately, this visit made it feel like the restaurant is clearly going downhill.

We started with dishes we’ve enjoyed in the past: the Wagyu & Hokkaido Uni Paella, Oct

name: Selby's
address: 3001 El Camino Real, Redwood City, CA 94061
editorialSummary: A glamorous fine-dining & wine venue from the Spruce team that presents American continental fare.
reviews: I can’t express how much I enjoyed our meal at Selby’s. Everything about the dining experience was top notch. Im writing this late, but my partner and I had a Christmas meal here, featuring beef Wellington, and their take on a sticky toffee pudding. I loved every bite of everything though. We also adored the popovers that they serve complimentary with the meal. I wish I could eat more. Our waitres

There was a wait for the bar/lounge area but it was well worth it. The service was excellent; every staff we encountered was welcoming, friendly and thoughtful. I was underwhelmed by the menu selection then pleasantly surprised. Not only was the food delicious, plated aesthetically, the portions were also considered plentiful for a Michelin star restaurant. We opted for the tuna tartare, the musse

Selby's Retrospective Evaluation
Audit Date: October 2021

Arriving at Selby's highlighted the localized transit constraints of the Atherton corridor, as parking can be a bit difficult. I got lucky finding a street space down the street before approaching the entrance. Upon stepping inside, I was instantly struck by the beautiful, old-school feel of the dining room. The interior architecture relie

4.5 stars. This is a sister restaurant to spruce.

Food is excellent. We sat at the bar for light fare and wine.

They serve half glasses of wine so you can pair wine with each course of the meal, which is fantastic.

We ordered:
- Yellowfin tuna tartare
- steak tartare
- burger

The Yellowfin tuna tartare was my favorite but even though I didn't like potato chips as the vessel for serving the tun

Selby's is a phenomenal experience at a reasonable fine dining price. But whether this passes as a Michelin star... I hesitate quite a bit. Now kudos to Selby's for delivering a $125 3-course tasting menu which I believe is a very reasonable price. However, whether this is a single star worthy... hmmm.

Let's get the good parts checked off. Service is friendly, fast and amazing, like any fine dini

name: Capelo's Barbecue
reviews:
The bbq scene here is rough - so when a friend recommended this place I was excited. It was a drive from San Jose but totally worth it!

The beer selection is amazing! They have around 14 talks and I huge cooler with more in cans! The bartender was great with asking questions and offering up some samples. The outdoor area was very nice and there was live music.

Now the food - holy cow the brisket

This place is great, I was greeted by Louisa who is amazing. The price, portions and taste is well worth coming here. Also unlike other barbecue locations that charge for extra sauce, they have a self help area with more than three options of sauce that you pour yourself. The vibe is right for friends family and coworkers hanging out before that commute. But be aware if you come during lunch you m

Fantastic service, food and venue! Five stars all the way!
Brisket was phenomenal with perfect rendering, perfect fat layer and bark. Cheddar&Jalapeño sausage and chicken (dark meat) was also 5/5 - easy!
No doubt I will be coming back and anyone who love Texas BBQ needs to pay them a visit!🤠

Best BBQ on the Peninsula hands down

Staff is great, food is consistently good, fed a family of four for less than a night at most family restaurants with food leftover.

Takeout took less than 10mins from time we ordered until we were back on our way home and food remained hot even when we got back to Santa Clara.

Definitely will be back!

Wow, that was such a great surprise! This place is absolutely amazing, the bbq was absolutely delicious, the staff very nice, the service extremely efficient, the place charming for a very reasonable price. I am definitely coming back for a nice family lunch. We LOVED it!

name: Brew Coffee and Bakery
reviews: Lovely little breakfast was had today. Husband and I tried the iced Vietnamese coffee, Thai milk tea, and two BLT sandwiches on everything bagels. All made fresh to order, fast service. The staff is super friendly as well.

We had such a great experience stopping at Brew today. We were looking for good coffee and my fiancé noticed the excellent ratings, so we decided to make a trip up from Palo Alto.

The young lady who took our order was incredibly friendly and we started out with some excellent coffees, one of which was a Vietnamese type we had never had before.

Then the (extremely kind) owner brought out our croi

I recently visited Brew Coffee and Bakery, a charming little spot with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The hot latte was smooth and well-balanced, with just the right amount of richness without being overly sweet. It was the perfect pick-me-up, made even better by the cozy ambiance.

The real star for me was the egg and cheese croissant. The pastry was perfectly flaky and buttery, with a generous
Their Banh mi is so delicious!!! And a very large one with super reasonable price!

I got an oat milk latte and salmon teriyaki bowl. Wonderful meal and beautiful drink. This will be my new spot when visiting!

The person who took my order was exceptionally kind and upbeat. I came here a while back when it had recently opened and it has grown so much in popularity. I'm so impressed and happy for this business!

name: Cuco's Burritos
reviews:
I’ve been coming here regularly since they first opened, and it’s easily one of my go-to spots. Their vegan burrito—packed with black beans and avocado—is hands down one of the best in the San Francisco Bay Area.

The tortilla chips are another highlight: thin, perfectly crispy, and not greasy at all. The staff is always friendly, and the service is consistently great.

The atmosphere is casual bu

Simply the best burrito I've ever eaten in my life. I remembered it today; it's been over 3 years since I last ate there. When I go back to California, I'll definitely eat there again.

The food is very fresh, very well seasoned, and a perfect combination. The service is very good, and the atmosphere is very clean and cozy.

What an excellent burrito! Had the California with carnitas. Just so slamming. Texturally perfect, moist inside with just the right amount of heat and flavor. No need for additional hot sauce. It’s like going to a pub with no salt and pepper shakers on the tables (bc the food is already properly seasoned). Free sides of chips and salsa if dining in Bigtime bonus. Friendly and efficient staff. Woma

had an amazing experience at Cucos Restaurant, especially with their burrito, which honestly deserves all 5 stars and more. From the first bite, you can tell the ingredients are fresh and thoughtfully prepared—the tortilla was warm, soft, and perfectly wrapped, holding everything together without falling apart. The filling was packed with flavor, well-seasoned meat, and just the right balance of r

Well, the people make the atmosphere, it’s tucked away next to a laundry mat. It’s one the best burritos, hand crafted, every ingredient is made with perfection. When I want a burrito this is hands down where I go. I brought all my friends here and they thank me for sharing this spot. While parking can be tough, it’s so worth dining there.

name: Eskina Breakfast & Lunch
reviews: Amazing brunch spot! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. Everything we ordered was excellent, especially the pancakes and breakfast dishes. The customer service was outstanding—everyone was friendly, welcoming, and attentive. The atmosphere was relaxing and enjoyable. Highly recommend this place, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

An excellent fusion of both American and Mexican cuisine. There is nothing not to love about La Eskina.

The Cafe de Olla has become my favorite which pairs perfectly with any dish on the menu. Love their patio sitting.

Do not miss this delicious experience
First time eating at Eskina today and it was excellent! My husband, daughter and I each got very different kinds of dishes (diverse menu!) and they were all excellent!

Eskina is a warm retreat for breakfast and lunch. I had their savory meat crepes and was not disappointed. The meat was tender and succulent. The atmosphere is cozy and accommodating. The staff made me feel welcome. The café de Olla is a well received drink, even for non-coffee drinkers I recommend it. It is a sweet and warm treat of coffee, cinnamon and piloncillo that's perfect to relax and unwi

The famous chilaquiles were a huge disappointment. The tortillas were completely soggy, the salsa had almost no flavor, and the eggs had a strange texture that made them hard to enjoy. After hearing so many good things, I expected much better. Unfortunately, this experience did not live up to the hype, and I won’t be coming back.

name: La Casita Chilanga
editorialSummary: Tiny, brightly painted sandwich counter dishing up enormous Mexican tortas, plus tacos.
reviews: Heard this was the local spot to get the best torta in town. Street parking was no problem. My order was prepared immediately and came out piping hot. They recommended the Cubana Torta but.......I thought it was just ok. Lots of random salty meat. Very heavy.
Best tortas. I still like better the ones in San jose location,  but this are good too.
Really good tortas/sandwiches. Free parking out front. The place can seat about 9 people.

Simple, cheap, authentic and great tacos.
Highly recommend

As a professional torta eater from Mexico City I can say comfortably that this is a great torta place. I had the classic cubana and it was great. I don't give 5 starts because there is no place to eat inside and no chipotles for the torta. Will come back.

name: Redwood City Barbeque
reviews:
If you’re judging BBQ through a delivery app, you’re already starting on the wrong foot. Respectfully, take a seat. BBQ isn’t meant to survive a 30-minute car ride in a plastic box while you scroll DoorDash or Uber Eats like a self-appointed pitmaster with a Yelp account. It’s meant to be eaten fresh, hot, and without hesitation.

I stumbled into Redwood City BBQ on a whim around dinner time and i

Been here a couple of times in the past. Recently stopped by again and ordered a brisket meal with two sides. Garlic bread is amazing when it’s fresh and warm. Mac and cheese was really good with a nice mild flavor cheese. It goes downhill from here. Baked beans were smoky, not sweet with sauce that was kind of thin. Brisket portion for the meal looks about a quarter pound (3-4 slices?). Brisket w

Meat very tender and juicy with flavor. Ribs the meat fall off the bones. Tritip so soft and juicy, brisket can't even pick up with fork the meat so tender it falls off the fork. Bomb bbq food. I travel all over California and I'm always trying different bbq places and this one ranks in the top ones. Very very delicious

My colleague recommended this spot to me since I was going to be in the area some time soon. On the day of my arrival, I could already smell the aroma from the parking entrance. It was not too busy and I began viewing their menu since it was going to be my first meal of the day. Their menu is simple, it consists of breakfast items, sandwiches, barbecue combos, sweets, drinks, etc. I went big since

Absolutely fantastic BBQ spot! The brisket here is next-level—perfectly smoked, tender, and packed with flavor.

The portion sizes are generous, making it a great value for the quality of food you get.

The craft beer selection is well-curated, with plenty of options to pair with your meal.

Service is always friendly and reliable, whether you’re dining in or taking out.

If you’re in the area, th

name: Sushinaloa
reviews:
We had an amazing time at Sushinaloa! The sushi was incredible, and we especially loved the bacon shrimp roll. The atmosphere was lively and fun, with a mariachi band playing songs at guests’ tables throughout the evening, which made the experience feel extra special.

The service was excellent as well. Our waiter, Erwin, was incredibly patient and attentive with our group, making sure everyone ha

Food is great don’t give me wrong. I want to point it out about the service we order four different plates. One of them was a burrito. I asked for an extra crispy tortilla. She told me that not. The kitchen guys won’t be able to do it because the tortilla it’s gonna break. I never heard that from any other person when I order a burrito.

This place is an absolute gem and such a welcome addition to Redwood City. From the first bite, you can tell the food is made with care, bold flavors, and authenticity. We started with the nachos, which were generously topped, perfectly crispy, and packed with flavor—honestly some of the best nachos I’ve had in a long time.

The camarones estilo cucaracha were a standout: crispy, flavorful, and pe

At first I thought this place was scetchy like sushi and Mexican food? Really? But I’m here eating my own words. This is place has the best ceviche, soups and drinks I have ever tasted. Please come in and try it you won’t regret it. Oh and the sushi is not bad.

I decided to try this place because of all the good reviews. I ordered the Camarones a la Diabla and the Ondeado sushi. I tried the sushi first and it was decent. Then I moved on to the Camarones a la Diabla, which came with only six shrimp, and unfortunately, they hadn’t been cleaned. That was incredibly unappetizing and honestly all I needed to see to throw away what ended up being a $40 meal.

name: Los Carnalitos Food Truck
address: 2907 El Camino Real, Redwood City, CA 94061
reviews: Gordita was like biting a rock, I spit out a few pieces. Birria taco was fine but the consume just tasted like grease. Waited for food for 30 minutes and saw how 5 other people got their orders before me who ordered after me. Extremely expensive for the quality of food we got. Will never go back.

This is my first time at the Taco truck and it was SO GOOD! I ordered the Gringa and a Taco with Sudero. The Gringa was perfect! Heavenly bites and the Sudero Taco was soooo tasty! I'm coming back and HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

VERY MISLEADING MENU!!! I bought panuchos from here 4 of them! And at the end I was expecting a perfectly nice handmade tortilla with beans filled inside but not it’s literally a tostada not a tortilla filled with one pinto bean like what literally 0 stars for this. This is not a panucho just a tostada.

I bought a pastor burrito and a pastor alambre (a type of taco dish). I didn't eat it there; I ordered it to go. When I opened it, I realized that all my food was burned, it was tough, and it tasted spoiled. I couldn't go back because I was already far from the tacotruck. I work and travel from place to place, and I was too far away to go back and return the food.

This happened on February 4th ar

The best carne asada in the area!

​I finally stopped by the Las Carnitas truck, and these carne asada tacos are the real deal. The meat is perfectly seasoned with a great smoky char, but still incredibly tender and juicy.
​I really appreciate that they don't skimp on the portions, and the handmade tortillas hold up perfectly to the salsa and lime. I usually get mine with everything on them, and t

name: El Camaron RWC
address: 2761 El Camino Real, Redwood City, CA 94061
reviews:
Ambiance 5/5
Very cool Mexican vibe. Cool decor and lively music playing (not loud)

Service 4/5
Very friendly but placing order was a little challenging due to we do not speak spanish.

Food 5/5
Guac & Chips were very good

We also ordered 3 fish tacos. Plenty of fish that was served in a freshly fried flour tortilla (only 1 tortilla per taco which was perfect for me)

We also orders the Cevechi

100/10 — absolutely amazing service and even better food. Our server, Andrea, was incredible and truly made the experience! We’re visiting from Phoenix, and this spot was a must for us.

Hands down the best puerco beans I’ve ever had and the best tres leches cheesecake of my life. My husband ordered the aguachile piedra and said it was top-notch—just be ready for some serious heat 🌶️. The oyster

My daughter just arrived from Japan and wanted to eat something she truly missed - Mexican food! It was also Father's Day so my husband wanted comfort food, scrumptious and flavorful. So we googled and Yelped restaurants between SFO and Santa Clara and agreed to try El Camaron in Redwood City. We can't say enough good things about the food, let alone the fiesta-like ambiance and friendly and promp

worst food i’ve had in a while! the guacamole they serve was very old and turned brown within 10 minutes of being at my table. the tacos I got were nothing special and also topped with the brown looking guacamole. worst part of all we ordered the chicharrones and they weren’t even crispy, hardy had any meat on them and when we sent them back we got scolded for sending them back “after trying them”

Absolutely delicious! We had an amazing meal at Camaron Restaurant — everything was fresh, flavorful, and authentically Sinaloa-style Mexican seafood. We ordered the shrimp & octopus cocktail, three different seafood tostadas, and guacamole with chips — every bite was spot on. The flavors were bold and perfectly balanced, and the presentation was beautiful.

Our waitress was incredibly friendly an

name: Fambrini’s Cafe
address: 2500 El Camino Real Ste 105, Palo Alto, CA 94306
editorialSummary: Simple spot offering gourmet sandwiches, salads & desserts, with vegetarian options.
reviews:
Fambrini's Cafe is a popular Palo Alto brunch spot, serving delicious food in a charming environment.

The lines can be long at peak hours, but you order at the counter before grabbing a table. You also need to get your own water & utensils, but the waiters serve you the food & drinks (of course). It doesn't take too long for the food to be ready.

I can attest to the quality of the sweet items. B

Absolutely loved this sandwich spot in Palo Alto! The quality of the ingredients was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly put together. They have a great variety of sandwich options, so there’s something for everyone — whether you’re in the mood for something classic or a bit more unique.

The bread was fresh, the portions were generous, and everything tasted amazing. The service was friendly and effic

We visited Fambrini Café for the first time for brunch and tried the Waffle Tower, Goat Cheese Scramble with Asparagus, Brie and Mushroom Omelette, and the Pistachio latte. We really enjoyed the food and the cozy ambience — everything was flavorful and nicely presented.

However, a few things didn’t go quite smoothly. The menu listed an iced pistachio dalgona coffee, but when ordering we were told

Came here for brunch on the weekend with a group of friends. We didn't realize it's almost all outdoor patio seating, so dress accordingly! They do have some heat lamps, but it can be cold during the winter months.

You order inside and then take a number to your table. The food came out fairly quick and we got there right when they opened at 10:30am. There were so many good things on the menu tha

The food was plated excellently and came quick. Super delicious and huge portions. The water and stuff you had to grab yourself and was quite crowded. Workers kept walking by our table and smushing us in between ( there was alot going on?? ) Overall the food was worth it because the portion was big but for the price it was expensive. Would recommend though because they food was definitely an exper

name: Terun Pizza
editorialSummary: Refined pizzeria with patio featuring Italian eats & Neapolitan pies alongside wine list & full bar.
reviews:
Very good Neapolitano Pizza place, but they have so much more.  They even used some of the jargon around water that you would find in Italy.  Still or bubbly water is available.

The Margherita pizza was very good.  Only critique would be that even with the minimal toppings of a Margherita, the sauce helped all the toppings slide off on biting into it.  The crust was very good and the cook was out

As an Italian I can say that this pizzeria is probably the best in the bay area. What I appreciate the most was the dough quality especially compared to other pizzerias around here, this is up to par with what you find in southern Italy.

Other than the great food, the owner was very attentive and treated us extremely well, so exceptional service.

In case you want to try it, the pizza you see bel

Grilled salad, I was like what? She was like, yeah grilled lettuce it's good, and it was real good :) I liked.  Then doubled down with the beats salad and that was just pleasant.  Had a couple of pizzas and the Margarita was spot on and it was the best one out of the two.  Nice place, employees are very nice as well as the host and the manager, they are all there making sure it was perfect so than

We hosted a team dinner at Terun recently. Logistically, the setup works well as there’s a decent-sized parking lot right behind the restaurant, and they offer outdoor seating with heaters, which is great during the winter months.

Johani was our host for the evening, and he did an amazing job throughout. He was attentive, thoughtful, and professional, and handled the table well. A small but very
I highly recommend the back patio. Great atmosphere! The food was great too! The Gorgonzola and pear pizza was fabulous!

name: Sundance The Steakhouse
address: 1921 El Camino Real, Palo Alto, CA 94306
editorialSummary: A candlelit mahogany dining room sets the scene for Angus steaks, seafood & a 450-item wine list.
reviews: I recently had an incredible dining experience at this steakhouse. We started with the delicious crab cakes, paired with a delightful half bottle of Barolo wine. The prime rib was the star of the show, bursting with flavor. Our attentive waiter, Jason, went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction. As a special treat for our anniversary, he even surprised us with their famous mud pie. I thoroug

​I had an idea of where I wanted to celebrate our anniversary with my wife, but due to a lack of awareness, the restaurant I had in mind was booked. I had to scramble for a comparable alternative. I knew exactly where I needed to go for a resource.
​I would like to first and foremost thank the members of Bay Area Eats (BAE) for suggesting Sundance Steakhouse for an anniversary dinner.
​Upon arriva

We ordered filet mignon, primer rib, scallops, calamari, salmon, crab cakes.

Crab cakes were delicious. Prime rib was great. Salmon was good. Vegetables as sides were okay. Mashed potatoes were great. We have eaten better fried calamari in a lot of other places. Was okay.

Service was fantastic and atmosphere was nice as well.

Came in for a solo dinner while I was in town on a Friday night! Hostesses were lovely and attentive, it was busy but they were able to accommodate me as a walk in! I had Ashley G as my server and she was amazing and so kind! Wonderful service. I ordered the sashimi which was fresh and the sides that came were the perfect balance for the dish. I was eyeing the filet mignon rolls as my entree since

I absolutely love the bar area of the Sundance restaurant. My friend and I had lunch in front of the fireplace in the bar. Cash was our great, attentive friendly waiter. The Aperol Spritz drinks were delicious and the salads great too. I can't recommend this place enough. I used to go more often and fell out of the habit, but I will def be back. The place is a classic!!!

name: iTalico
editorialSummary: Trattoria for charcuterie, pastas & upscale Italian dishes in chic, spacious environs.
reviews: By far one of my favorite restaurants in Palo Alto eve the bay. The atmosphere, the service, the food A++. I always look forward to eating.

My friends and I recently dined at Italico, and I wanted to express how wonderful our experience was.

From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was exceptional. The host and servers were incredibly welcoming, accommodating, and gracious throughout the evening. Their genuine warmth made us feel less like customers and more like honored guests. The hugs goodbye at the end of the evening were such

Good food, every dish we had - gnocchi, risotto, Milanese - was well prepared and tasty, as were various appetizers and desserts. Service was attentive and efficient.
We had the Sagrantino wine from the daily menu and it was excellent.
The area of the restaurant we were in was quite noisy, making it difficult to follow conversations across the table.

Went for dinner. Good Italian restaurant. Didn't like the Negroni, though. The bread was really good (didn't like paying for it, but it was worth it); the pasta was incredible, we liked the pesto one more. The sea salt caramel ice cream was really good too. It's a nice place with great pasta.

Had a great time at Italico in Palo Alto. Delicious food, great ambience, and outstanding desserts.
Highly recommend the focaccia bread, Tricolore pizza, bomboloni, and tiramisu - all were amazing.

name: Izzy's Brooklyn Bagels
editorialSummary: Bagel shop offering a list of spreads & other Jewish deli fare, plus indoor & outdoor seating.
reviews:
We had a really disappointing experience here. The coffee tasted like it had a burnt cigarette flavor—so strong that I couldn’t take more than two sips. It completely ruined the experience for me.
I also tried a triangle cookie, which tasted stale and not fresh at all. On the positive side, the bagel with eggs, avocado, and veggies was actually fine.
Unfortunately, the coffee was such a letdown th
Had a flavorful and well-done bialy, but was disappointed with the lox. The salmon wasn't filleted properly, so I had a couple of bites of bones and skin. Ruined an otherwise nice sandwich.
My 5 yr son's to go places whenever he is in a mood for brunch. He usually likes classic bagel with cream cheese. I like either onion or jalapenos bagel with chive cream cheese

Best bagel shop in the entire Bay Area. I took my girlfriend here and the look of joy on her face when she took the bite of the everything bagel with cream cheese brought even more joy to my face. My own pizza bagel reminded me of my favorite childhood shop in New York.

Happy times here, I love Izzy’s bagels
Best bagel in the Bay area. There's no way I can come to the bay and not get a bagel here. I have been all over the world but still rank this in the top 5 the bagels I have had.

name: Rara
reviews:
We had a fantastic lunch at **Rara**. Great ambience, delicious Himalayan-style food, and genuinely warm, friendly service.

We ordered fried momos, choila momo, fried chicken, and Yakni pulao. The choila momo was a standout for me—served with a smoky, gingery, slightly spicy side that completely elevates the chicken momo. The Yakni pulao was wonderfully flavorful and came with a delicious goat cu

This meal looks like a beautifully presented Nepali-style thali, and it truly feels like a complete, comforting dining experience.

The plate is centered around fluffy, perfectly cooked white rice, surrounded by a variety of flavorful sides that make every bite exciting. The curry appears rich and aromatic, with tender pieces that look well-seasoned and cooked to perfection. The lentil soup (dal)

The place has an interesting old school vibe to it. We saw the great google reviews and decided to try the Nepali food for the first time. We got seated quickly but I would say the service seemed a bit slow. Took them ~20 minutes to get our order even though the place was practically empty.
The food was brought out as it was prepared.
I would say the momo was pretty good. The Bhat Khana set was al

Rara was a great restaurant for a casual sit down dinner with friends. We did wait over 30 minutes for dinner on a Sunday evening, but we were quite a large group so it was understandable. The restaurant’s vibe is sort of upscale casual dining.
Service was polite, friendly and attentive from the get go. In fact our server was great taking our order from two ends of a large group and even came back

Loved the food! If you are looking for “Ghar ka Khaana” and authentic Nepalese food, this is the best spot. 5/5 pm Chicken Momo! Their Non Veg Dal Bhat Khana Set was delicious! 💕 what a delicious goat curry and Tamatar ki chutney ! And the owner Binod ji and Anita ji are amazing - such a cute couple that takes care of you when you enter inside the restaurant and are taking orders smilingly. They

name: Show de Carnes Brazilian Steakhouse
address: 3398 El Camino Real, Palo Alto, CA 94306
reviews: Very legit brazilian food. Their meat is high quality and perfectly seasoned. The place is comfy, welcoming, and I never had to wait for a table. I usually go by myself and they are single friendly. My new fav steak house in the Bay Area

Show de Carne is a polished, well-organized Brazilian steakhouse with attentive staff who make the whole experience fun. The layout is clean, the salad bar and charcuterie spread were better than expected, and there are plenty starters to load up on before the skewers even arrive.

As for the meats, it’s a mixed bag in a mostly good way. The bottom sirloin was on the tougher side, but the picanha

Everything was great especially if you love meat.  And if you don't love meat hopefully you love veggies and cheese because they had a lot of that too.  The default sauces they give are not that spicy but if you ask they'll give you a secret very spicy sauce that tastes like tabasco concentrate with apple sauce texture.  It was great. Would come again, even though they got rid of couples night.

Amazing experience from start to finish. João and all the servers were incredibly welcoming and attentive the entire time. The service was outstanding, the atmosphere was very pleasant and comfortable, and the food was absolutely excellent.

Every cut of meat was flavorful and perfectly prepared. You can really tell they care about giving customers a great Brazilian steakhouse experience. Definite

🥩 Excellent Steak, Good Food:
The quality of the steak at Show de Carne was quite good. The meats were flavorful and prepared well, meeting expectations for a Brazilian steakhouse. The supporting food options were also enjoyable.

crowded Ambiance & Layout:
The restaurant gets really packed, which can make for a high-energy but sometimes overwhelming atmosphere. The layout contributes to this, as

name: Sekoya Lounge & Kitchen
reviews:
Our first visit, and we absolutely loved it! The menu is incredibly unique, and every dish we tried was outstanding. The highlights were the chef’s specials: the scallop crudo, which was easily the best raw scallop dish I have ever had, and the steak with mole sauce topped with chimichurri. The contrast of flavors was exceptional, bold, balanced, and absolutely delicious.

We are already looking f

The atmosphere here is very inviting with a beautifully designed interior that really stands out. The wooden dining table adds a unique touch to the experience. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the service excellent. The food was flavorful and well prepared, and the cocktail complemented the meal perfectly.

Service was great - friendly professional staff. However, the food was frankly below our expectations. Truffle french fries seemed like the ones you get from the supermarket and deep fried. Wish they were hand cut.

Presentation and ambience were great, food was pretty good but pricey, and service was just OK.

We went for Mother's day and there were only two other parties there the whole time, when all the surrounding restaurants were full, which is pretty suspicious. Overall, the food was pretty good, especially the scallops, fried shrimp, halibut crudo, and truffle fries. Scallops and shrimp were perfectly

Favorites: Beef Tongue Skewer and Roasted duck
The food is tasty and they have great selection of wines to pair with your food.
They have limited space of seating inside. However they have some tables outdoor with heaters.

name: INDO Restaurant & Lounge
address: 3295 El Camino Real, Palo Alto, CA 94306
editorialSummary: Modern venue with a breezy patio pairs inventive spins on Indonesian eats with creative cocktails.
reviews: I was here for lunch on Saturday. I really like the atmosphere of this restaurant. It has a high-end feel to it with nice decor. The service was excellent, and the food was tasty. We ordered the Roti Prata that included two pieces of roti, and the Day Boat Scallops as starters, which was well-balanced with the sweetness of the pineapple chutney and red beet puree. We had the Bali Ribs that was coo

Indo Restaurant is a great spot in Palo Alto, especially if you are organizing a team dinner. The restaurant has plenty of space to accommodate large groups, and the service is fast and efficient, which is perfect for business gatherings. The food is very tasty with excellent options for vegans, making it easy to accommodate everyone's dietary needs. It is slightly on the pricier side, but the qua

My husband and I went to Indo to celebrate his birthday, and we were so glad we picked this spot.
The food was just amazing. Chicken satay was so juicy and tender that it was just melting in the mouth. Loved roti parota and the curry that came with it. Mie goreng was flavorful and the complementary coconut pudding was amazing too.
A big shoutout to JUAN who made our day more special with his comme

ADDING IT TO THE "ROTATION"!

We like really extra delicious food. That's what I tell locals whenever soliciting restaurant advice: "what's the most delicious food?"
I only grabbed a Pic of the dessert (graciously offered after seeing us hem and haw about it), but the food here was insane. I said "whoa" out loud twice while eating dessert. Spiced like gingerbread,  one of the most unique cakes we'

Excellent Indonesian / Asian Fusion restaurant. One of the best Indonesian restaurants I have visited outside of Indonesia. Casual dress code. No bike parking but considerable car parking. Google directions tend to have you overshoot the side street of El Camino you need to take to get to the parking lot and restaurant entrance. The chicken and lamb satay were both excellent as well as the Gado Ga

name: Kali Greek Kitchen
editorialSummary: Subway tiles line this buzzy, stylish cafe featuring a Greek menu & patio with blue tables & chairs.
reviews: Delicious, healthy food. The chicken was amazing, and we tried the roasted beet hummus which was great. Definitely recommend. And the street is pretty busy which is a nice vibe.

This restaurant exceeded my expectations! They are friendly, have great service and the food was delicious!
I had the chicken rice plate which came with fresh pita bread, rice and salad. We shared the eggplant dip with pita bread which was very good. My friends enjoyed the beef and vegetarian rice plates. Everything was fresh and tasty. This is the best Mediterranean food I’ve had in the Bay Area.

I would highly suggest going elsewhere. I really wanted to like it and drove from downtown to this spot instead of going to Crapevine. The food here is awful….. the chicken was super dry and so was the lamb. It lacks flavor and the wraps were like salads more lettuce and carrots than meat. What was confusing is the wrap had orange slices and carrots. I have never gone to any Greek restaurants with

The food was delicious. We got a gyro wrap, a salad, and a lamb plate with fries.  The servings of meat were not stingy. The meat was lean but not chewy. The fries were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The dressing was very unique and fresh
The employees were kind and patient. The place was very cozy and clean.

The food here is absolutely delicious. Everything tastes fresh and made to order with generous portions sizes. I found the plates to be perfectly balanced with so many delicious flavors combined into one meal. The restaurant itself is small but has a nice atmosphere and is perfect for smaller groups.

name: MJ Sushi Palo Alto
address: 2305 El Camino Real Ste a, Palo Alto, CA 94306
reviews:
Update: Sadly they changed the cut of the tuna in the chirashi bowl - no longer the fatty cut, and start charging $5 additionally if we were to do all tuna or 50/50 tuna + salmon. All good things must come to an end I suppose.

My overall rating would be 3/5 now but leaving the original rating as they had been good for a while and we went almost every week. Off to the hunt our next haunt.

-------

The sushi/sashimi and rolls are really good - high quality, fresh - the tuna was so good. The place itself is very spare. It feels like a college dining room and there are a lot of Stanford students dining there, but that kind of ads too the ambience. I have gotten takeout from there too, and it is always excellent. I’ve catered a party with them also and everything was perfect. I highly recommend

Favorite place ever, sushi is incredible and I love their miso soup, everything is incredibly reasonably priced and they even have free soft serve!! Like this place should have a full five stars on everything. Literally perfect.

I ordered two boxes of baked rolls at this restaurant, intending to take them away. However, seeing that the restaurant wasn't busy, I opted to dine in.

01. Their server told the chef that the customer had switched to dine-in. Then the chef started swearing, which I could hear even sitting outside.

02. When the food finally arrived, it was in a takeout bag, and it was cold! It looked like it had

MJ Sushi in Palo Alto completely exceeded expectations. Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully plated with creative twists that made each bite memorable. You could literally taste the clean, natural ocean in the fish—paired with unique flavor combinations that made the experience stand out.

We started with the Albacore Nigiri, which was simple and elegant, showcasing smooth,

name: La Bodeguita del Medio
editorialSummary: Trendy sibling of the Havana original offers Cuban fare, cigars & rum cocktails in a colorful space.
reviews: I had been here many years ago with some colleagues. I’m so glad I suggested this to get together with friends. We had such a great time having lunch, even experienced the “sobremesa,” a testament to how Spanish cultures know how to live. We started with a salad, the crispy bananas and the empanadas, all excellent. For mains, we had the Cuban paella mariscos, ropa vieja, the LB of ribs with their

La Bodeguita is such a fun spot and a great addition to the local dining scene. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, and you really feel the energy the moment you walk in. The food is flavorful and comforting, with dishes that feel authentic and thoughtfully prepared. The staff is friendly and attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. It is the kind of place that works just as we
unique spot, they have a smoke room, bar, indoor/outdoor seating. The paella was phenomenal! I just wish there was a single portion of it or a few more menu options, but overall a great experience.

We came for lunch. Food was fresh and tasty. Nothing was bad but nothing blew out minds with flavor. Didn't care much about the shrimp ceviche. It was a bid of a disappointment so wouldn't order that. I would try the sandwiches next time for lunch.  The banana caramel dessert was just ok.

Our dinner was amazing!  The food was very flavorful. The special cocktail with guava and rum was my favorite drink. Everything we tried was delicious. Also, a special thank you to our very attentive, kind,  and gracious server, Victor.  We will be back again.

name: Doppio Zero Mountain View
editorialSummary: Modern Italian eatery preparing Neapolitan pies, pastas & handcrafted cocktails in a stylish space.
reviews: They have an eclectic menu. Appetizers were tasty especially the potato croquettes. Pasta with wild boar was very good. Pizza was ok. A little bit dry with less topping. Drinks were strong. Service was fast and responsive. The outside seating is nice.

Everything we tried was fantastic, especially the pizza, which was cooked to perfection in their wood-fired oven. The pastas were also incredibly flavorful and cooked perfectly al dente.  This is a very popular restaurant, make sure your make reservations.

Being vegetarians, our usuals here are the Broccolini or the Olives for starters, a pizza for the main course, an occasional second of Gnocchi and we end on a high with a Cappuccino.

On our visit yesterday, we ordered the Carciofina pizza. The pizza itself was fresh, soft but crispy with the perfect amount of spiciness coming from the chilies; the cheese melted in the mouth, balanced the flavor o

Unbelievable food and service. Our family has been coming to Doppio Zero for well over 10 years and it is still our favorite spot. Sal and Moises took great care of us. Our water was always refilled before we even had to ask — and they were on top of everything g the whole night.

For food, we had a mixture of the Neapolitan style margarita pizza, lasagna, and the gnocchi.

The lasagna was said to

Recommended by a friend so decided to try it out.

Had a reservation. Initially, led outside (when I had booked an inside res) so let staff know.

Also, super weird placement for staff to have all the outdoor utensils and cups at a high traffic area at the front.

A lot busier than expected.

Two of us ordered:
nectarine salad $14
marechiaro $25
bistecca $42
margherita pizza $19
limoncello spritz

name: Eureka!
address: 191 Castro St Level 2, Mountain View, CA 94041
editorialSummary: Hip dining spot serving elevated burgers, craft beer & whiskey in industrial-chic surrounds.
reviews: I liked Eureka the first time I went, but ordered the fish n chips. They cost $27 and I got 3 small fish sticks and some fries (see picture)... And the fish sticks were very average. Very disappointing. Won't go there again.

Came here right after Cascal. Had the chicken sandwich on a lettuce wrap. My buddy ordered the other dish.  Both dishes were excellent. Had a tap beer. The place was very dead on a late Wednesday night. But the food and beer were excellent so 5 stars from me.

My Fav Restaurant. I love their Wagyu burger, Chicken Nachos, Fish Tacos and for dessert bourbon Cake with vanilla ice cream.
Atmosphere is very good but Customer service needs to be better because after getting our table I keep looking for server to take order.

For lunchner, we checked out the Hoppy Hour (Happy Hour at some places but if we had a bar, we’d call it Hoppy Hour too due to the selection of IPAs that we’d be serving) where a small selection of beers including the Strike Two Seam IPA and Fremont Dark Star Imperial Oatmeal Stout were at $6 each. We also ordered the Eureka! Burger ($13) and the Mac N Cheese Balls ($8) which were discounted durin

They serve good food. Will be back for sure to try other food on their menu. I like my burger with blue cheese. Their fish and chips is one of the best for me. The lavender tea is not too sweet which I like, sweet peach tea is good too. Their selection of beers are good too.

name: Zhangliang Malatang
reviews: Great little place with good selection for hotpot , pick your ingredients and they cook and bring back for you.  Price determined by weight of raw ingredients. I went for the Tom yum mid spicy 🌶️ and it was on point. I saw this kind of restaurant before, but this was much easier and better than I expected, definitely repeat!

I always order the spicy stir-fry pot, and it's usually great. However, the quality this last time was terrible—it tasted like they barely put any seasoning in it. Even though they threw in a free drink, the quality control definitely needs improvement. Also, the tables are very small and packed a bit too closely together.

The line goes by really quickly as customers choose their fresh & varied ingredients and place them in their bowl.
The bowls are then weighed, you choose your broth and your malatang is brought to you by one of the staff people.
Very organized,  well thought out system with the entire staff working together to create an enjoyable relaxing dining experience
The atmosphere is quite lively as friends

This is a great deal if you’re looking to get an individual hotpot with a wide variety of options.

The hotpot is $14.99/lb, and they weigh your bowl by the amount of items you get (the broth is not part of the weight). There’s also so many options! Like definitely make sure not to get too many things in the first section, because there’s so many other sections left! They have so many types of mea

You select vegetables, noodles and thinly-sliced meat.  They put it in a soup bowl, and add a very hot soup of your choice.  The soup cooks everything, and they bring the bowl to your table.  You choose your spices.  Everything is fresh and high quality.

name: Mifen101幺零幺（原花溪王）
editorialSummary: Snug venue serving up rice noodles, braised dishes & hot pot specials packed with loads of toppings.
reviews:
One of the best rice noodle spots in the Bay Area — I come here almost every week.
The shop is small but very clean. They offer dining both inside and outdoor. The staffs are efficient and welcoming.
My favorite is their signature beef rice noodles — generous chunks of beef paired with pickled vegetables, making every bite incredibly satisfying. They also offer a great selection of starters, like

It is a small restaurant that always have the line outside on the narrow side street.  Inside is very small and tables are tight next to each other.  They take your orders while you wait in line outside.  As soon as you are seated, the food come out fast.  Service is decent.

Noodles are cooked well and the beef is tender.  Overall their noodle dishes are good.  The pork bun is tasty with lots of

It is really tasty food. The broth I think is eapeciallly tasty.

To start I think it’s pretty quick to get a seat, even though the restaurant seems quite busy. The service also seems quite quick and you order quite fast. Seems like there is also a lot of customization available on the menu for the noodle. Once we ordered it wasn’t too long till we got the food.

Overall the food is really good. T

This place is worth the hype! The food portion is big and the flavor is just right. Even if the flavor might be on the heavier side, it is still enjoyable (my friend hypothesizes that they put no MSG :) ). I am surprised by how the food is not greasy like many other Chinese places. The quality of the meat in both the soup and the side dish is very good. The lamb and the sliced beef are tender with

The rice noodles were very soft and smooth, and the soup base was excellent, but the beef pieces were small and not very tender.

Service was quick and good, and there was free public parking building on the corner .

name: Steins Beer Garden & Restaurant
editorialSummary: Festive spot with airy outdoor beer garden pairs hearty comfort grub with craft brews & cocktails.
reviews:
I visited this restaurant on a Sunday evening for dinner. It wasn’t very crowded, and we were seated right away. The atmosphere was relaxed , a comfortable spot for conversation over a meal.

We started with fried calamari. It was decent but fairly basic ; nothing particularly memorable. We skipped drinks and stuck with water. For the main course, my friend ordered a sandwich with fries, and I wen

This place has a nice medium size patio that’s hidden away. Lots of bees to pick from and food portions are pretty big. We didn’t expect soups to be this large. Overall food we tasted was pretty good.

Service was solid as well considering this place was busy.

Note: this place charges 5% small business fee.

Last I visited Steins was right before their announcement they were closing, and while initially was relieved they hadn’t, I now regret going back to see what they’re like now.

The menu is totally changed, but they did have pretzel and schnitzel, which I ordered. While the pretzel was good, the schnitzel was the worst I’ve eaten in my life. Pork cutlet was overcooked and tough, the breading burne
Good beer selection and atmosphere. Stopped on the way to the World Cup. Good walking area and nice patio.
