I haven't been to Steins post-pandemic, so returning after several years, I was sad to see the decline in service. I mean horrible service. Imagine a restaurant where the waitstaff doesn't want to work. It's this place. We had to get up twice to get a server--any server--to help us order food and ask for water 5 times. We were there between meals, and the restaurant was not very busy.

The food is

name: Yugen Ramen
editorialSummary: Busy Japanese eatery with sleek, loft-like decor offering ramen bowls & izakaya-style small plates.
reviews: Went for dinner. Had to wait almost 20-25 minutes for table of 4. Wait was worth it as the veggie ramen that we ordered was satiatingly delicious. It was hot, flavorful, comforting and also customizable. Even the edamame with salt was perfectly made. Order came fast and servers were very nice. Only reason I gave 4 star is because of lack of vegetarian options here. There is just one ramen to order

Be prepared for a long wait. We ordered the Geso Karaage, Vegetarian Ramen, and Tonkotsu Ramen, and everything was delicious. The standout for me was the vegetarian ramen—the broth was incredibly rich, flavorful, and satisfying, with a wonderful sesame flavor that really stood out. The Geso Karaage was also a great appetizer and paired perfectly with the ramen. I’m so happy to have found a place t

Had a great meal at Yugen Ramen on Castro St in Mountain View. We ordered the Spicy Tan Tan Ramen, the Assorted Vegetable Ramen, and a lychee soda, and everything was really enjoyable. The Spicy Tan Tan Ramen was rich, creamy, and flavorful with a nice level of heat. The Assorted Vegetable Ramen was amazing with fresh vegetables and a vegetable broth that felt balanced and well prepared. The lyche

Excellent service Team thanks🙏. Very cool shop and nice setting 😎. Ramen was amazing and I gulped down all the thick pork bone broth. One of the best!  Wifey had crazy spicy version and I just went “commando” to save my taste buds 🤣. Highly highly recommend 👍. Better than many others in San Mateo 😎

​Service
The service was quite slow. We were ignored for the first 10 minutes after being seated, and water was only served after we had placed our orders.
​Food
​Salad: The dressing was overwhelmingly sweet and tasted like a generic, pre-packaged plum sauce.
​Ramen: They didn't ask for our preferred noodle firmness when ordering, but they came out medium-firm with a nice bite. The broth was a ton

name: Udon Mugizo Mountain View
editorialSummary: Laid-back cafe with exposed-brick walls serving tempura & hearty bowls of topped udon noodles.
reviews: This is a premium experience I would say. The food is too notch, the environment is pleasing, and the people there are very kind. We got two udons, one soup one and another mentaiko cream one. Both were super yummy, but I prefer the mentaiko cream ramen. The flavour was super savory and the noodles had a good texture. We also had an appetizer which was alright too. We lighting in there is nice as

This is by far the best udon I have had. The flavors were very complex and the dishes were served shortly after ordering. I enjoyed it so much I went back the next day to try other menu items. I highly recommend the Tonkotsu udon deluxe, I opted for the large which was too much as it is filled with meat. The Katsu curry udon is also very delicious and comes in a large portion. If you are looking f

I love this spot!!! Especially the outdoor seating on a comfortable day.

The udon is freshly made in-house and wonderfully chewy. I got the curry katsu udon, my favorite! My parents got the Niki udon and nabeyaki udon which were delicious. 10/10 udon!

We met some friends for lunch, they say this is their favorite for noodles. We got seated right away, we ordered tempura appetizers as well as 4 different soups. I tried Tonkatsu Udon, the textures were very nice, I wished it could have been a hotter broth. Perhaps after adding a cool-ish topping, it cools down the broth. Also tried the Mentai Cream Sauce Udon. It was creamy with a seafood taste,

Delicious, flavor packed broth, perfect udon noodles, just the right amount of spice! Udon Mugizo will be my go to place for hot, delicious food.

Recommendations:
Vegetable Tempura (with Wasabi Dip) - Perfect crunch, delicious vegetables, and flavor packed dip. Must try for vegetarians

Vegetable Udon - It is listed under cold noodles but you can request the hot version. It is absolutely deliciou

name: Alexander's Patisserie
editorialSummary: Lit cases of tarts, pastries & macarons greet visitors to this upscale bakery & sandwich cafe.
reviews:
After attending an event in Mountain View that finished around dinner time, I had some yummy Asian food then I thought to myself…time for dessert.
I stopped into Alexander’s Patisserie.
It was busy at 7pm on a Wednesday night! I perused the dessert case and spotted several desserts that sounded very interesting. These are pricey…sometimes one needs to splurge on something special - that’s my motto

This is one of the well-known patisseries in the Mountain View area, and I stopped by this morning to grab a quick breakfast. The place was already bustling — full of people eating, chatting, and enjoying the cozy, welcoming space. It looked like a great spot to sit and spend some time, but I was in a hurry, so I ordered takeout instead.

They have an overwhelming selection of baked goods — truly

All the dessert are very elegant and made with great details.  They're almost too pretty to eat and great for taking pictures.

They are expensive - $15 each, definitely not cheap and overpriced, IMO.

Got a box of half a dozen macaroons and they are very good.

Also order a lavender-flavor tea.  Both the lavender and tea flavor is very weak, almost tastes like water.

The decor is nice and seatin
The shop is beautifully decorated, and they have an amazing selection of pastries and cakes that look incredible. Our favorite are the macarons.
Best pastry shop in the Mountain View area, pleasant ambiance with quick servicing. desserts are delicious and freshly baked. Must try coffee and tiramisu pastry

name: Ludwigs Biergarten
editorialSummary: German brews paired with dishes like schnitzel & pretzels in a festive beer garden setting.
reviews: Came here for Wednesday night trivia. Trivia was super fun and very casual. Lots of the teams seemed to comprise of coworkers. Plenty of time to talk between questions. The patio was a great place for it,  it was warm with all the heat lamps and had a really cozy vibe for hanging out for a couple hours. One heads up, the website says trivia runs from 6–9, but it actually went from about 6:30–8:30.

Ludwig’s Biergarten is such a delightful spot! We started with the pretzel, which was reasonably priced, though the selection of sauces felt a bit expensive. I ordered the pork schnitzel—it was delicious, but I was surprised that it came as pork tenders with scrappy pieces rather than one solid cut. I chose spaetzel as my side and thought it was very bland. Super disappointed and wished I ordered

What a delightful spot! The food was good for us, and my German colleague agreed it was authentic.  The schnitzel was delicious, and my favorite of the meal, until dessert arrived. Get the dessert sampler - it's worth it! We will be back. Service was very good too.
It’s a quaint little spot in downtown Mountain View. I like the music. The food is tasty. They have a nice lunch deal. The staff are friendly and fun to chat.

Good selection of beer and non-alcoholic malt drinks.  Had the pork schnitzel, it was not as thin and tender as I had them in Germany. But the fries were delicious.  Sourkraut was probably from a jar.  Good service, vibe, and location. Prices are slightly higher than what I am willing to pay if they wanted me to come often.  Just being honest. My bill was close to $40

name: Olympus Caffe & Bakery
editorialSummary: Cafe offering classic American & Greek eats for breakfast through dinner, plus baked goods & cakes.
reviews:
I stopped by this café for a quick afternoon coffee and snack and ended up enjoying some baklava with a Turkish coffee. I was initially thinking of staying for dinner, but I wasn’t quite hungry that day, although I’m definitely planning to return for a full dining experience.

The place has a lively, casual vibe and offers a mix of German and Mediterranean dishes such as gyros, large salads, schni

I always love coming here because they are friendly and the outdoor seating is comfy and fosters a good sense of community. They also have a great beer selection and really good beer prices for the South Bay area. Today, I have to give the food mixed reviews. I enjoyed my knockwurst with grilled onions, sauerkraut and brown mustard. The sausage was tasty and the bun was soft and sweet. The krinkle

The location couldn’t have been better!

We just finished the Sunday farmers market and decided to stop in to Olympus Café and bakery for brunch.

It was an amazing delicious decision. I’ve never gotten a more perfectly served French toast with Nutella, whipped cream and strawberry 🍓

Great idea Alan.

Having visited Olympus Beer Garden for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, I’ve found it to be a consistent staple of the iconic Castro Street scene in Mountain View. For a morning start, their omelette and coffee are top-tier, though the hash browns could definitely be crispier and more seasoned. Transitioning into lunch or dinner, the beer is undoubtedly amazing, capturing those authentic German flavo

Always a great experience. Good food and good beer. They sell Liters! 🍻
The gyro bowl is good and a good amount of food. The schnitzel is good, I like the plate more than the sandwich.

name: Sakoon
editorialSummary: Bright & polished eatery serving inventive Indian dishes & a popular lunch buffet.
reviews: The food was outstanding. This restaurant has wide menu featuring a wide variety of dishes. The appetizers and desserts are also good . I tried avocado chat for the first time and was impressed. As a vegetarian, I was happy to see so much  options available, with chole bature, bagan ki sabzi, and dal makhi standing out as my favorites. The service was exceptional. The waiters were attentive , maki

This has been our go-to North Indian spot for 10+ years 🌿

Food is fresh, hot, and reliably delicious. They had a slight dip during the pandemic (who didn’t 😅), but they’re fully back and it shows.

Veg staples for us: tandoori veggies, naan, paneer dishes, dal tadka, and the veg dum biryani — always a win. Manchurian… can be a bit moody.

Weekend buffet’s a win — great variety, especially for v

Location on Lovely Castro street. Beautiful ambience for groups, office meets, friends and families.
Well decorated, fine dining. Enjoyed
Various non veg dishes on my birthday party to friends and relatives.
Chicken dum biryani, chicken tikka masala, Sakoon special grill- platter of fish, chicken, meat as sizzlers  was appreciated by all.
Sunhari moorg the dish was ordered from its name.
Had enjoy

I'm glad they have vegan options, and they taste great 💚 it was a work dinner with 14 of us, and so I got to try all their vegan options! 💚

What I ordered:
1. Vegan Gobi starter (5/5): Incredibly tasty!
2. Avocado Bhel (3/5): Meh
3. Samosas (4/5): Normal for me but everyone non-indian absolutely loved it.
4. Vegan Bhindi (5/5): their best vegan option!
5. Vegan Chole pindi (4/5): their second b

I have visited Sakoon today with my team for their buffet, and it was a great experience. The spread was impressive with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. I enjoyed the roti, butter roti, paneer saag, paneer butter masala, dal, white rice, and desserts like kheer and carrot halwa. The chicken biryani, kebab, and other dishes were also flavorful. The buffet setup was neat, and the ambianc

name: Happy Lamb Hot Pot | Mountain View
editorialSummary: At this Mongolian chain eatery, diners cook meat & vegetables in broth at the table.
reviews:
Always wanted to try hot pot and finally got the chance to try it and happy I chose this for first time. Definitely a great experience.

We ordered both the spicy and mild broths to get the best of both worlds. The flavors were surprisingly addictive and the whole experience of cooking everything at the table made it even more fun.

Must try spot.

I always make it a point to visit Happy Lamb Hot Pot whenever I’m in town visiting family, and this location never disappoints. Honestly, I think it’s even better than the Vegas one.

It’s not all-you-can-eat, but the quality really makes up for it. The leg of lamb is absolutely delicious—super tender and flavorful. I’d skip the lamb skewers though, they weren’t as impressive.

One of my favorite

Solid hotpot restaurant.  Nice atmosphere and pretty clean.  We can for lunch and they don't have AYCE for lunch which was  a bummer, but the lunch specials were okay.  About $21 for lunch potluck.

The meats like ribeye, lamb, pork belly was pretty good.  It just was a little on the quantity side.  Quality-wise it was on par with  most Happy Lambs.

The service was great- and people helpful.  The

Excellent attentive service team and thank you for the help 🙏. Nice presentation of food that's fresh and tasty.  Desserts were cute and tasty.  One meat platter had dry ice effects with "smoke" and was very cool 🤣👍 and fun 😆. Excellent experience and will revisit. 😜

The hotpot here is pretty good. If you like spicy food, just order the spicy broth. I never use the non-spicy one. My recommendation is don't order a ton of food. Be sure what you want to eat. The seafood platter is pretty good.
If you don't taste the difference between premium and cheaper meat cuts, just order the cheaper ones 😀.
Ask for recommendations. It's better than wasting food. They do al

name: Mediterranean Grill House
address: 650 Castro St suit 110, Mountain View, CA 94041
editorialSummary: Casual Mediterranean restaurant offering classic fare like shawarma & falafel, plus outdoor seating.
reviews: I'm a regular, and should have left a review long ago. Food is great. Service is attentive and friendly.  I've enjoyed everything I tried. The falafel is wonderful - crispy (not hard) outside and fluffy inside. One of my favorites is the Falafel Wrap with Eggplant. The Chicken Shawarma is tender, juicy, and flavorful. Sides like hummus and babaganoush are very good. Once I took a selection of milk

We’re so glad they added Sanaa coffee here, it’s probably the best cafe in Mountain View due to the unique options. For drinks, I love the Adeni chai. Get it if you like milky tea—it’s similar to Indian masala chai but fewer spices, and more tea flavor. The Sanaani coffee is also good for the cardamom and coffee combo—ask for light sugar.
For food, the fatayer (turnovers) are lovely with a tea or

Comfortable space to enjoy good Mediterranean food and coffee with desert. Outside and Inside seating.  Service was pleasant. This time all I had was the Adeni tea which was strong and sweet. Also had the Turkish delight and another sweet.

Excellent relaxing spot for Mediterranean food and Sanaa Coffee.
Had the Adani Chai it was awesome.
Service was excellent!
We will definitely come back

Its wonderful, best food, service is fast, food is quality, what would make this place 5 stare is Arabic music, and the exterior glass to be clean because the smudges in windows makes you wonder about the cleanliness of the kitchen…. :)  but otherwise excellent!
This is a constructive review!  There was nothing else to pick on!

name: Keke's Breakfast Cafe
editorialSummary: Local chain serving American breakfasts & comfort-food lunches in a modern diner with booth seating.
reviews:
We had a really pleasant experience here. Since it was our first time visiting, we ordered the pancake combo, fruits, and chocolate chip pancakes. Everything was great, and our server, Sarah, was amazing incredibly kind and extremely helpful :).

A big shoutout to the owners as well. There was a delay with one of the items in our order, and since we had to leave in a rush, they kindly adjusted our

Food: I tried the brown sugar latte and it was delightful!! The cinnamon apple French toast didn't disappoint either!!

Service: staff were kind and attentive. They let me sit at the coffee bar so I didn't have to wait for a table

Atmosphere: it's a pretty chill atmosphere. This is a great spot for breakfast or brunch!

Conclusion: will definitely come back if I'm in the area!!

Good breakfast restaurant with a creative menu in the San Jose area. We only had to wait about 10 minutes for a table on a Saturday morning. The food was solid but not spectacular. The drinks were outstanding. Decent spot to grab breakfast. I would recommend

**UPDATED:**
Santiago, Jay and Thai are THE best, and we LOVE Keke’s.
Our FOREVER Go-To-Breakfast Place.
Beautiful, clean and bright breakfast/lunch spot very near to Downtown Sunnyvale. Easy, safe parking in attached garage, too. Thai, Jay and Josh were all fantastic and we really enjoyed our food, including: eggs, English muffins, oatmeal, fresh fruit, bacon, avocado and tomatoes. Josh made a de

Some friends and I went to Keke’s for breakfast after finishing a long night shift.  This was our first time going here.  The atmosphere was pleasant, the service was excellent, and the food was not only good but there was plenty of it for the price.  Seemed like a good value to me.  I ordered the pancakes and some home fries.  My friends all had omelets.  The pancakes were so big I couldn’t even

name: Fashion Wok
editorialSummary: Old-school eatery provides guests with a range of traditional Chinese meals in a low-key atmosphere.
reviews: Super chill lunch spot and unbelievably fast service. Huge menu options and still comes out flavorful. Lunch vibes are peaceful and layout allows to chill vibes while enjoying good food. If there Chinese dish you want, they will have it. Order at the table style so super easy for larger groups. Parking is in the middle of a shopping complex and Sunnyvale so when it gets busy hard to find parking b

Tried Home Eat and I’m so impressed! Their Chinese food is absolutely delicious, especially if you love bold, spicy flavors. The Szechuan dishes really hit the spot 🔥 I highly recommend the mapu tofu and the chicken wings.

On top of the great food, the atmosphere made it a really fun place to visit. Definitely coming back for more!

I was surprised to see they had a similar interior and menu to Home Eat, and found out they are likely the same restaurant chain.

We ordered a small hot pot, fried chicken wings, salt and pepper fried fish, and cumin lamb.

The fried chicken wings were made with Garlic, Pepper, and Sweet Soy Sauce.

The salt and pepper fried fish came with bell peppers and onions, and cumin lamb was served with o

This is the third location I visited. I have visited the Foster City one which now has closed( I missed it as I visited it regularly before). The second one called Home eat at Cupertino and I came to this location after watching movie at AMC.
This restaurant has many seating including many round table which usually for big group of people. It was pretty busy when we arrived but we got seated right

Tasty food with big portions and plenty of space. The appetizer were so filling. The location is nice as well, the pedestrian area has restaurants and cafes with outdoor seating. It’s nice for both lunch and dinner.

name: Hunan House
reviews: Tried several dishes here and everything was flavorful and very authentic. The grandma-style pickled vegetable fried rice with egg had a great smoky wok flavor, and the spicy stir-fried chicken gizzards were perfectly seasoned with just the right kick. The shredded potato was fresh and crispy, and the cilantro beef was tender and delicious. The signature spicy pork dish was also a standout. Portio
It tastes really good. I love the beef trio, it goes great with rice. The preserved vegetable with egg dish is also perfect with rice.

If you enjoy spicy food, this place is definitely worth a visit. The dishes are packed with bold flavors, and the heat is well-balanced rather than just being spicy for the sake of it. You can really taste the fresh ingredients beneath the spice. The portions are generous, the service is friendly, and the atmosphere is lively. Whether you’re a fan of mild heat or love food that really brings the f
Our most favourite Hunan cuisine restaurant. Almost come here every 2 week and the quality is stable and satisfying. The duck and pots are my personal favorites
Really authentic Chinese flavors. It’s spicy but so good, and the portions are generous and affordable. Recommend Pork & Chicken Soup for those who want something not spicy.

name: Dave's Hot Chicken
address: 118 E El Camino Real, Sunnyvale, CA 94087
reviews: I just wanted to give a huge shoutout to Camilo and Alexis, they truly went above and beyond for us. The food was amazing as always but the service was superb. Best service I’ve ever had, best customer experience I’ve ever had. Camilo and Alexis truly embody what it means to to have impeccable customer service. Always attentive and respectful.

Dave’s hot chicken is hands down the best halal fried chicken place in the west coast. I am yet to find another halal place that offers all spice levels, proper size portions, and good quality that stays consistent on every visit. In my opinion, the spice is necessary to get the full fried chicken experience, but if you really can’t handle a spice level below medium, there are other options like w

A friend raved about Dave’s, so I came in with high expectations as a first-timer. The vibe is fun, bright, loud, and perfect for a casual dinner. The service, unfortunately, dimmed the experience. The front counter felt cold and impatient while we tried to navigate the menu, and a simple request for a small drink was rung up as a large one. No guidance on spice levels. We also over-ordered. Inter

Really good fried chicken. I tried the one HOT and one Medium Spicy chicken slider. Definitely very flavorful and great quality meat. Sauce is gread too and Fries were seasoned. My first time ever trying Dave’s chicken and i was not at all disappointed. Must try if you are fried chicken fan.

First time coming here and it was amazing. The mozzarella bites were amazing, I would highly recommend. Also the food is halal. Quick service, outdoor and indoor seating as-well. This is subjective but it was a little cold inside. However like I mentioned they have outdoor seating.

name: Meyhouse Sunnyvale
editorialSummary: Light-filled, relaxed restaurant specializing in Turkish-inspired dishes served family style.
reviews: We got the 3 course lunch menu and it was worth it! We got dumplings and eggplant for starters, chicken and lamb chops for main course and baklava and kunefe for dessert. Everything was delicious! Chicken was really soft and juicy. Kunefe was a nice new dish to try out. We finished it with Turkish coffee which was great as well. One of my new favorites in Sunnyvale Downtown!
This time enjoyed appetizers with Armenian wine. The staff is very attentive and friendly. Thank you for a delightful food and opportunity to taste quality Mediterranean food in downtown Sunnyvale!

​I had a fantastic experience here! The Turkish food is incredibly flavorful and authentic,you can tell they use high-quality ingredients.
​The staff was very kind and welcoming, and I was impressed by how fast the service was without feeling rushed. It’s the perfect spot for a delicious, efficient meal. Highly recommend!
Food was excellent. My favorites were the lamb chops, tenderloin, and baklava. The cold mezzes went very well with the bread too. Highly recommended!

A fantastic experience with rich flavors and warm hospitality. Every dish we ordered tasted fresh and true to tradition. This is an easy recommendation for anyone interested in exploring Turkish food. The lamb chop stood out the most and was cooked perfectly. A place worth visiting again.

name: Tandoori Pizza - Sunnyvale
reviews:
We recently visited Tandoori Pizza in downtown Sunnyvale and had a great experience overall. We started with the masala potatoes as an appetizer, which were flavorful and well-seasoned, definitely a great way to kick things off.

For the main course, we tried the chilli paneer pizza, and it did not disappoint. The flavors were spot on, with a nice balance of spice and richness. That said, the pizz

Tandoori Pizza in Sunnyvale is a game-changer! Their pizzas are hands down the best I've had in the US ! The menu is a treasure trove of flavors, from the rich makhni sauce to the creamy sahi paneer pizza - every option is a winner.

The garlic bread with pesto sauce is a must-try, and the best part? You can customize it to your heart's content!

JASHAN, she is the staff, was incredibly helpful in

Tried Tandoori Pizza and really enjoyed the food. Ordered the Shahi Paneer pizza, which was very good, and the Veg Curry pizza, both were flavorful with a perfectly crispy base. Great fusion flavors done right.

Only downsides: the TVs play very loud music, which can be overwhelming, and the bathrooms are not well maintained.

Overall, great food, just needs some improvement in ambiance and cleanl

​We ordered an extra-large pizza with a half-and-half split of two flavors. The pizza tasted really good, and they generously provided extra sauces, chili flakes, and toppings on the side. The only unexpected thing was that both halves shared the same base flavor; I was hoping they would taste a bit more distinct from one another. Still, a solid meal!

They tried to scam us by applying gratuity when its not applicable (as it was just 2 of us and its applicable usually for 6 or more). It wasn’t even like they were ambient. They simply refused to refund and acted like they don’t even know what gratuity is and said thats tip when it is not. They are outting hidden fees in the bill and getting agressive when asked. But the pizza was fine.

name: Burma Taste
reviews: Nice atmosphere and service, but the food is incredibly mediocre. The garlic noodles had no flavor whatsoever and the vegetarian appetizer dip was bland. The paratha that came with the appetizer was phenomenal though! The eggplant dish was better than the noodles, but overall I would say the experience was below average.

Wonderful taste. Quick service with smile.

We were possibly last customer but they were not in hurry to clear dishes though they told us that kitchen is closing.

Staff mentioned that bear with us for utensil noise

Recomended dishes

Tea leaf salad
Samosa soup
Asian fried rice
Black pepper chicken

Decent food, good atmosphere. Went here for dinner to celebrate a birthday and they gave us a complimentary birthday vanilla ice cream with a candle, served with a sprinkle of edible birthday confetti flakes, a candy cherry 🍒, and orange 🍊 slices in a martini cocktail (triangular) glass!!  The ice cream was rich and creamy and had a gelato-like texture and consistency without feeling too thick o

I ordered the Chili Beef. It did not come with rice so I had to order it separately, and it wasn't cheap. The price was already very high, combined with the fact they did not include the rice (which is usually included), the meal turned out to be quite expensive. The taste of the beef was good and there was a good amount of it. The service was restaurant was just okay, nothing special. I might com
Pork belly and the sauce with the onions was phenomenal! Biryani was delicious. Garlic noodles could have used more garlic but was still amazing!

name: Fibbar MaGees
editorialSummary: Old-fashioned Irish pub with a back patio attracts crowds for sports-watching & occasional DJ sets.
reviews:
We had a nice time at Fibar MaGees Sports Bar on Murphy Avenue. It’s an awesome spot if you’re into watching soccer in the afternoon, the place streams all major matches, which really adds to the atmosphere.

The staff were incredibly helpful and went out of their way to stream the specific game we wanted, making sure we were comfortable throughout. That level of service really stood out.

Food wa
Overall a great Pub! The food is authentic and comforting. The staff is welcoming and personable. The atmosphere is classic and cozy for quality time with friends and community.

My son and I went in after golf and sat the bar.Ashley took our drink order and we looked over the food menu. I asked about the Shepherds Pie and she said it was good...she wasn't lying. It was really good and so was the Guinness I washed it down with. Ashley was great and she made sure we were doing Ok with drinks or anything else we needed. I asked her about their Chicken Curry and she said it w

Great spot, but not impressed with service.  Stopped in looking for Fish and Chips for a Friday dinner.  I arrived before the rush and sat at the bar.  I was able to order beer and food quickly, and food arrived in decent time and was very hot.  After that, it was busy and bar staff had no time for bar patrons and were filling orders for servers.  Myself and another patron I had a conversation wit

Such an amazing friendly and enjoyable place, the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, the atmosphere is just right, lively but also you can hold a conversation.
The food is delicious and the beer outstanding! Cannot recommend Fibbar Magees enough! If there is one place to visit in Sunnyvale it's this place!

name: Naan Point
reviews: If you are looking for authentic Indian cuisine, this place is one of the best. Their Naan is really good actually all in their menu taste really good. Very polite and nice staff. Place is very neat and pleasant for an indian restaurant. Over all, my experience to this place is beyond my expectation and i highly recommend this to everyone.

They were so kind to accommodate us even though we arrived at 245pm (we didnt know they closed at 3pm) I ordered the butter chicken lunch special and husband ordered chicken vinadaloo lunch special. They were both so delicious and served HOT! The naan was cooked perfectly. The vegetables were so flavorful and had a nice spiciness. I am pregnant and this was one of the few meals I finished. My baby

We love coming here! The service is fast and everyone is friendly. I very much appreciate the wide range in spice levels available. The menus are clearly marked for different dietary accommodations. There are daily and weekend specials in addition to a wide menu selection. Its clean and conveniently located with plenty of parking. My personal favorite touch is the hospitality of serving compliment

Good Indian restaurant near SFO international airport. We got the lamb thali with garlic Naan, butter chicken thali with garlic naan and kadhai chicken. Portions size is good and food is also good. Thali comes with choley and a tandoori chicken piece. I liked the lamb curry. We also got rose falooda which was amazing 🤩 quick and good service 😊
Delicious and free chai for dine-in! Extremely flavorful and hot fresh food.

name: Local Kitchens
address: 851 Cherry Ave Ste 2, San Bruno, CA 94066
reviews:
We’ve been coming here since they opened, literally. We braved the rain storm to come by on Opening Day, since we had been looking forward to it coming when it was first announced. We were previously fans of Local Kitchens (LK) from trying other locations in the past.

Over the years since they opened, the menu has changed a bit. There are still some of the original partners, but there has also be
First time ..and let me tell you the Chicken Adobada Burrito 🌯 😋  was Firee ✨️🗣🔥🔥🔥🔥. Good service clean store and restrooms .

I stopped by Local Kitchen for brunch on my way back from visiting San Francisco, and it was the perfect airport-nearby spot! I had the sweet onion beef burger, which was fantastic – juicy beef with a savory-sweet touch from the caramelized onions that made every bite delicious. The Thai bubble tea was refreshing and complemented the meal perfectly. Great flavors and a relaxing spot to fuel up bef
Came in late to pick up a burger and fries to take back to my hotel. It was very tasty, the meat was high quality, and the fries were perfect.  So tasty!  I will be back!!

I was searching for food options near sfo. I am definitely coming back to this place Everytime I come to sfo.
I loved their double burger. It was dripping and soft the meat was bigger than the buns. Fantastic.

name: Ichika Izakaya
reviews:
My husband and I had dinner here tonight, and overall it was a really memorable experience. We’ve traveled quite a bit and tried sushi in many different cities, including around the Los Angeles area where we live and have our favorite spots. So when we visit a sushi restaurant, we tend to evaluate everything as a whole — price, quality, service, and of course the flavors.

For dinner we ordered th

Food is amazing. Service is fast.
I like that you can see the one preparing our sushi and rolls, you know that it is prepared clean and properly. The Japanese-inspired ambiance ties it all together. On the expensive side.
Foods were tasty, ingredients were fresh. Service was friendly and attentive. Dinning area not really big.  Recommend make reservation on their website first. Nigiri order by pieces.

This spot is truly a hidden gem in the San Bruno neighborhood! The vibe is warm and welcoming, making it perfect for a casual dinner or a special night out. The sushi is fresh and flavorful, with a solid variety of traditional rolls and appetizers. If you’re into omakase, they offer that as well—an excellent option for those who want to sit back and enjoy the chef’s selections. Definitely worth a

honestly i was a little skeptical at first cause ive been burned by izakaya places before but this one totally delivered. the skewers came out fast and everything had this perfect char, especially the chicken thigh. i ordered the mentaiko udon on a whim and oh my god that creamy spicy sauce was so good i almost licked the bowl. my friend got the karaage and it was super juicy inside and crunchy, i

name: Hashes & Brews
editorialSummary: Relaxed place with a patio offering American grub from hashes with eggs to burgers, plus draft beer.
reviews: Great tasting food!! We loved the Dubai chocolate waffles would absolutely recommend to anyone. Thanks for the great service, happy new years!

Great little local spot with so many options--
Breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
My go-to is the turkey club sandwich, which is a generous portion served with fries...
Service is excellent too!!
Personally I don't sit at the bar, but it is there with several TV screens as an option.
There is also outdoor seating.
Take note-- if it is a hot day, they do not have air conditioning.🌞
Perfect place for a nice Sunday Brunch. Even a better place for dinner. The owner, Danny, was gracious and friendly. The staff is very professional. Great place to be, to eat with great scenery.
Friendly helpful service. Nice salad selection. Reasonable noise level for easy conversation.

Great atmosphere- bar seating, outdoor and indoor seating along with lots of parking. This restaurant is located in the Bayhill shopping center. Food was yummy. The service provided by Crystal was awesome! Stop by and get your breakfast lunch or dinner with a drink! 😊

name: bb.q Chicken San Bruno
reviews:
Was craving some Korean fried chicken and this chain is one of the best in my opinion for sizable, affordable, and tasty Korean fried chicken.

This location had about five booths or so, which is ample seating for the location. Ordering was simple and the chicken is made fresh so expect to wait.

They have a water station next to the cashier, which was a nice touch.

We ordered two smalls for our

Order 8pc original wing and got 8pc of all drums and not even a mix of drums and flats. Also one of the piece is super tiny and they counted it as one. Whomever was working the kitchen was giving me left overs or something. Called the store to see they will do anything about it and just said I don’t know what happened. Awful experience

I ordered the Secret Seasoned Chicken, but when I opened the box, it was just plain fried chicken.

This is a basic order accuracy issue. Customers trust that restaurants will at least check what they are sending out. If you cannot get the order right, it raises concerns about overall quality control.

Very disappointing experience. I hope the restaurant takes order verification more seriously in

My friend recommended I try out this place  Korean fried chicken. I’m a big fan of Korean fried chicken and I used to live in Korea. While looking this place up, they originated in Korea and they are a large international franchise. This location and area / shopping plaza has a lot of other restaurants that close early. We came here on a Wednesday night where online they say they close at 9pm. We

I have been ordering from bbq Chicken for over a year.  The food is consistently fresh, warm and delicious.  Staff is professional and friendly.  The only hiccup is the app.  It does not allow you to enter comments or a request.  As an example, two months ago,
I ordered Cheeseling Fries.  When I picked up they were too spicy.  I was told that I need to call and advise them, no sauce.  Other than t

name: SAJJ Mediterranean
editorialSummary: Modern counter-serve outlet featuring classic Middle Eastern comfort food in a relaxed space.
reviews:
This was my first visit, and honestly, I was a little confused at first. With the name “Sajj,” I was expecting baked pies or skillet-style dishes. Instead, I found out it’s more of a walk-up counter concept where you build your own Mediterranean-style bowl, wrap, or plate.

It’s actually a great concept. While the flavors didn’t fully stand out to me personally — mostly because of my background wi

This is my second visit in this location. It is relatively quiet every time I do come in. There are more online orders than people ordering here.
The workers are super nice! They really gave me the amount I wanted & they did not hesitate to do so.

On my first visit, I ordered a shawafel bowl which means two proteins which are shawarma & falafel. It was pretty abundant which means I did not finish

Inside the Bayhill shopping center, i found another lil hidden gem.  Picked up costco gift card promotion for SAJJ.  The shop is clean and open with helpful staff. We decided to try the chicken and steak shawarma bowls since it's our firsttime here. In a nutshell, you select the meat/prtein, rice, veggies and sauce. It also comes with a free lentil soup with the bowls.  We're pleasantly surprised

Best mediterranean food! I tried falafel salad bowl, baklava and a complimentary lentil soup. Best falafel I've had so far. Food tastes good, it's fresh and nutritious. They offer catering services too.

The taste of the food was far below my expectations. I wanted to have soup, but the soup had a burnt taste. It was definitely not good at all. Then I ordered a wrap, and the bread in the wrap was literally doughy. The meat was not good at all. I was definitely disappointed. I can’t describe it any other way. And this is my last visit here. I will definitely not come again.”

name: Big Mouth Burgers
editorialSummary: Compact counter-serve joint offering creative burgers & comfort eats in a basic interior.
reviews: Staff was friendly and the place was small and comfy. I had the Jalapeno burger and it was absolutely amazing. It looked good and I was scared it was all looks, no show. I was wrong. Bun is super fluffy, meat was tasty, and burger had a nice spice to it.

An excellent spot for the classics. They even make an excellent Cheese Steak! Fries are delicious, but I would recommend you ask them to make them well-done. They can be a little soggy if you don't get to them right away. Like for takeout or delivery. Excellent otherwise. Friendly staff and the place was immaculate and clean when I visited. Definitely pop in for a burger.

Let me start by saying the burgers are great!  If thats all that is important, read no more.

Still reading? Ok lets talk price. This place is expensive. Your basic burger WITHOUT cheese starts at $18, feed a family at $20 a pop adds up fast.

To compound this issue, if you order ahead online... you will pay $3 more per item, so that $17.95 burger is now a 20.95 burger... before cheese.

To be cle

I've been going here for years.   You can not go wrong with anything they have on the menu.  Burgers and sandwiches are solid.  I'm not a fan of their fries, but the onion rings are good.
The place itself is clean and service is ok.  One of the things we do love is the milkshakes here because they are made with Mitchell's ice cream.  An ice cream I grew up eating, hahaha.  There are rare occasions

Good Hamburger but only TWO criticism:
1. With bacon, $22 (is it me, or is that expensive??)
2. No Wifi, and weak cel signal, cant work and eat🙄

name: Town
editorialSummary: West Coast wines complement American takes on steaks, chops & seafood in a simple woody setting.
reviews: Quick & super friendly staff. Children's menu was provided without asking. It came with crayons to draw on it. Well heated outdoor seating. Very delicious starters and mains. Pretty decent serving sizes. We unfortunately couldn't do desserts anymore ;)

Really good food. They have everything from sushi to steak to chicken and waffles. We were seated immediately as a party of 4. Good service too, although the latte and orange juice came out long before the coffee which was strange.

We've been going to Town for years. Their food is generally very good. Recently I have been repeatedly having the power lunch 1/2 salmon BLT with warm cabbage salad, which is delicious and an excellent deal. My wife loved her fillet mignon, thinking it's on par with here favorite steakhouse abroad.

While visiting downtown San Carlos, I decided to stop in and try this restaurant, as it’s one of the most popular spots in the area. I thoroughly enjoyed both the Spring Salmon and the Espresso Martini. The salmon was fresh and well-prepared; while I personally am not a big fan of dill, I felt the dish could have used slightly less of it. That said, the overall flavor was well-balanced and enjoyab

Not too bad of a spot
Location is good with plenty to walk to and browse

Food was good. The meat was a bit "salty"
But still flavorful
Drinks were decent. Had to have my whiskey sour made again. But second time around it was delicious

Plenty of menu items to choose from

name: Blue Sky Café
editorialSummary: Bustling Chinese restaurant serves up traditional comfort dishes in a compact, simple dining room.
reviews:
They are well-known for their eel clay pot rice. It is flavorful with crunchy rice on the bottom. Their scallion oil chicken is very tasty and tender. Considering that each dish comes in a huge portion, their food is a very good value. No wonder there is always a line outside.

It is a good idea to call the restaurant 30 minutes ahead of time to place an order for the clay pot rice because it does

I'm going to regret writing this review.  This place is tiny but apparently very popular.  11:30 and it's packed with line out the door. Any positive review gonna... Oh well...

Milk tea. Legit! Better than some HK style restaurant.  👍🏼

Indonesian fried rice - Excellent wok air and huge portion.

Bake pork chop rice - Be mindful this is not baked pork chop over rice like usual one.  This one is

This is my second time dining here, and I’m just as impressed as the first. Both dinner and lunch are always packed, which really shows how popular this place is. I even noticed quite a few international customers!

I actually discovered this restaurant through a friend, and I’m so glad I did. The portions are incredibly generous, and the prices are very reasonable—especially for the Bay Area.

Ha

It's a small cozy shop that serves Excellent and tasty Hong Kong dishes, especially Clay pot rice.  Very authentic and tasty 👍🏼. Great milk tea and zero concern for peanut allergy 🤩 Highly recommend 😋. Service team was excellent, thanks 🙏🏼. And it's wonderful eating such good food with background music of smooth Jazz, which matches the super chilled and non-rushed dining experience , matchin

Blue Sky Café is a truly exceptional Cantonese spot that delivers authentic, high-quality dishes in a comforting, family-style setting; the service is warm, friendly and efficient, ensuring a pleasant dining experience even during peak hours when the simple dining room is bustling. The food is the real star, featuring generous portions of expertly prepared specialties like the beautifully Steamed

name: Blue Oak Brewing Company
reviews:
Just visited Blue Oak Brewery to meet a long-time friend visiting from Michigan, and it was an amazing experience! The moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm, inviting, and full of energy.

We sampled a wide variety of beers — from crisp lagers to hoppy IPAs — and every single one impressed us. You can really tell they care about quality and craft. The bartender went above and beyond, even t

At Blue Oak Brewing Co., we found the premise to be casual and welcoming. From the entrance, you will not be able to see it but upon entry, it leads to an arcade on the right, a bar with high ceilings with ample seats and walking past that, you’ll arrive at a row of tentage with more outdoor seating.

Blue Oak Brewing Co. doesn’t serve its own food but collaborates with food caterers in the area.

We celebrated my wife’s 40th birthday party here. What a great venue! Coordinating with Brad was super smooth and he was very responsive and the event itself was awesome. They rotate many different styles of beers so it’s easy to pick something for everyone. The private event space works well for larger groups. Highly recommend Blue Oak and coordinating with Brad.

We just had a birthday party here, and were so happy with the whole experience! The private event space is a good size, with high ceilings & a good sound system. Special shoutout to Brad who was professional, helpful & attentive throughout the planning process & night of the event.
if you're thinking about throwing a party at Blue Oak-- just do it!
PS- the sour beers are all delicious.

Found Blue Oak off of google maps.

Nice spot for beer. Lots of seating inside and outside with parking on site.

I ended up ordering a hazy and it was good.

name: Red Hot Chilli Pepper
address: 1125 San Carlos Ave, San Carlos, CA 94070
editorialSummary: The intensely spiced staples of Indo-Chinese cuisine showcased in a sleek black & red dining room.
reviews:
The food is very bad and expensive to boot.

I got the hong kong lamb which tasted gamey and was extremely salty.

The chilli baby corn was very lemony and otherwise had very little flavor.

The pepper chicken was not spicy and was bogged down with tons of corn starch.

The sechzwan fried rice had no umami and was once again poorly seasoned. The rice was not day old rice which is fried rice 101.

I had heard good things about this restaurant, but unfortunately it did not live up to the hype. I ordered the firecracker chicken, which surprisingly tasted more like fish to me. The chili chicken was okay, nothing mind blowing, and the chili garlic noodles were decent at best. For the price, I expected much more because this place is not cheap, but the food quality felt lacking.
It honestly tast

I absolutely love Red Hot Chilli Pepper! The blend of Indian and Asian fusion cuisine makes every dish flavorful with just the right touch of spice. The service was excellent, attentive, and friendly. I highly recommend starting with the Manchurian cauliflower appetizer—it’s incredible. Overall, Red Hot Chilli Pepper offers a fantastic dining experience that I can’t recommend enough!

This was, without question, one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve had in a long time.

Every dish was exceptionally flavorful - rich, vibrant, and deeply authentic. What stood out most was the balance of spice: bold enough to excite the palate, yet thoughtfully controlled so it never overwhelmed the integrity of the ingredients. It’s clear that each plate is crafted with precision and

Hot n Sour Soup was delicious and very loaded, just the way we like it.
Manchow soup was loaded too but it was very bland, had to put a lot of sauces to make it edible.
Chicken Lettuce Cups were not so exciting, some lettuce leaves with the same chicken mixture that was used in Manchow Soup with sweet chili sauce on the side. They should really dress up the lettuce cups with different toppings and

name: The Refuge
editorialSummary: Casual pub drawing attention for its pastrami sandwiches, hearty burgers & variety of Belgian beers.
reviews: Fun place with indoor-outdoor seating. Found this place after wonderful time at Filoli Gardens. Trivia contest was starting inside and it sounded fun. Had pastrami 1/2 sandwich, fries and drink combo. Very tasty.

We came with our son and friends who also have a younger son and we all loved the food. They shared a Philly cheese steak, their son got a grilled cheese which came with fries and a pickle, our son got the Mac and cheese and I got the sandwich of the week. The portions are generous enough that you can easily share a meal between two adults or take half home like we did lol so wonderful to the kids

Really good sandwich piled high with juicy pastrami. The grilled rye helps keep the sandwich from falling apart and adds a nice crunch to complement the soft pastrami. The pastrami was just how you want it: fresh, tender, slightly fatty, and full of flavor. I have been to Katz Delicatessen a handful of times and I can tell you this is close as you can get on the west coast. Would definitely recomm

The Refuge is known primarily for their pastrami sandwiches which are actually just out of this world!!!
It is also known for the extensive and incredible beer list, especially Belgian beers. Generally speaking, anybody should be able to find a beer here that they like. I'm not a fan, but I made sure that Pilsner was on the list because I was bringing my dad and they had two choices.
I did order t

Saw them on triple d, and was excited to try the pastrami. Didn't want to order too much, because my family and I wanted to check out another spot. Even with a half sandwich and sharing fries, we ended up all being too full to eat anything else after. The food is very filling. We all enjoyed our food. A few of us had reubens and we're wowed by how soft the pastrami was. The pastrami was delicious

name: Isarn Garden Thai Cuisine
address: 1050 El Camino Real, San Carlos, CA 94070
editorialSummary: Easygoing Thai restaurant serving stir-fries & curries, plus noodle & rice dishes.
reviews: The restaurant gets pretty loud when it is full, so our kids had a hard time. You also need to know what to order, standard dishes like Prig King and Seasonal Vegetables weren't great but more unusual dishes like Isarn Sausage were delicious. While the servers were largely dismissive of us, there was an amazing dining room attendant who thankfully helped us throughout the meal.

Isarn is a charming family-run restaurant located in San Carlos, California, known for its authentic Northeastern Thai (Isan) and Laotian cuisine. The interior exudes a cozy, traditional Thai ambiance, which I found quite appealing. Although it was my first visit, despite the restaurant having been established for some time, I was invited for lunch, and we found the place pleasantly half full.

Th

It was my first time visiting this restaurant, and we went for lunch close to their closing time. Despite that, the staff was welcoming and managed to accommodate and serve everyone without any issues. We ordered several dishes, most of which were delicious except the pineapple fried rice, which was a bit bland and lacked salt. Hopefully, that can be improved. Everything else — including the servi

SUCH good food!! I'm a huge fan of Isarn Garden, here are my favorites: pad broccoli, red curry, pad see ew, pad thai, green papaya salad, tom yum soup, and the curry dumplings. Their food is to die for, so good. The vibe is pretty cute, and the staff was all very kind. I usually do takeout, but eating there is also fun!

I’ve been to Isarn Garden twice now—one with my brother and another with a friend.

Absolutely tasty food. This Thai restaurant is a find! 100% recommend trying out this place for yourself.

I would come back here again to dine-in. I have no dietary restrictions while my friend who came here with me only consumes seafood for meat and he still had a great time here.

My most recent experience:

• D

name: Groovy Goose
address: 1221 San Carlos Ave a, San Carlos, CA 94070
reviews:
Skip the matcha
​Love the vibe and service here, but the unsweetened matcha latte was a big miss. As you can see in the photo, it was a dull, swampy brown instead of vibrant green, indicating oxidized or low-grade powder. It also wasn't whisked or sifted properly, leaving an incredibly powdery, chalky texture with thick residue stuck to the cup. Their coffee is great, but the matcha needs a major

I’ve been coming to Groovy Goose since the day they first opened, and they never cease to amaze me. Even with two Starbucks nearby, it’s clear why this shop continues to thrive—it’s all about the vibes, the lovely people, and the incredible quality of the coffee.

Every time I walk in, I’m greeted by a friendly cashier, and the baristas are so kind; they always take a moment to ask how my day is g

​Popped into this coffee shop for a light lunch. I have to say, the pesto sandwich was absolutely yummy! Fresh ingredients and great flavor, definitely a win. However, the strawberry matcha fell a little below par; it lacked the vibrant flavor I was hoping for. I'd highly recommend sticking to the food items, especially the sandwiches, for a reliable, tasty experience here!

A cool coffee shop serving a wide range of espresso drinks and great sandwiches including all day breakfast.
Oh and it has a disco ball!!

Normally I really love the groovy goose! 3 stars instead of a 1.

Although.. they came up short like a dry puddle in the middle of a rainstorm. The last couple of times the coffee has been as tasty as mud in other words coffee= water. I didnt see the disco sparks as I once had. Please bring back the migration of groovyness!

name: Doppio Zero San Carlos
reviews: Great food. Doppio zero pizza is da bomb. The margarita with a popsicle was fun. Gnocchi and short rib pasta. But I miss the Napoli gin drink (purple with the empress gin). The zabaglione dessert was fantastic.

Had a great time here! I sat at the bar and enjoyed some excellent drinks. Melanie, the bartender, was kind enough to indulge my request for an off-menu cocktail: a black rum Manhattan made with Diplomático and Luxardo Amaro Abano. She even suggested smoking the drink, which added a fantastic bruléed flavor! Melanie clearly knows her stuff and was a pleasure to chat with. If you're stopping by, I'

Absolutely amazing pizza! The Mortadella Pizza and the Doppio Zero Pizza are both incredible. The flavors and crust reminded me of the pizza I had in Italy—fresh, authentic, and delicious. Easily one of the best pizza spots in the Bay Area. Highly recommend!

Excellent authentic Italian food, served in a lovely Laurel St. environment, sunny and bright. Efficient service, good cool glass water bottles freely and efficiently served. Free fresh bread with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. We had good vegan options, I highly recommend their truffle fries, garlic broccolini and the vegan pizza with the yummy yellow tomatoes paste. Wow.

Beautiful inside and out — this is the kind of place that works for everything from a casual brunch to a fancy romantic dinner. Definitely a spot you can dress up for if you want to.

The space is huge, with plenty of indoor seating and a large, dog-friendly outdoor patio. Their squid ink pasta seems to be a favorite here, and I’d definitely recommend giving it a try. I also loved that they offer

name: Drakes
address: 1101 San Carlos Ave, San Carlos, CA 94070
reviews:
January 2026 visit for late breakfast:
Arrived around 10am with a reservation and seated immediately. Table was not the most convenient with the high banquet style seats and really tight spacing next to a wall, especially when the place was still fairly empty with any other options. Regardless, we were 4 adults: we and our things were able to squish.

We ordered plates with both hash and tater tot
Good brunch place, def order their California Benedict. Portion sizes could be a bit small but taste is good.

I recently went to Drakes in San Carlos for breakfast and it was honestly one of the best brunch spots I’ve been to on the Peninsula. The atmosphere is really nice — modern but still cozy — and the location right by the train station gives it a cool vibe. The staff was friendly and the service was quick even though it was busy.
The food was amazing. The Eggs Benedict was perfectly cooked, the tate

What a wonderful breakfast spot!  The restaurant is charming, with a lovely historic feel.  The staff is so attentive and alert.  We sat at the bar, and the bartender (who was very busy) noticed right away that my meal was not prepared as I had asked, so she ask the kitchen to correct it.  The drinks were delicious,  as were our meals, but the biscuits were perfect.  I will visit in the future jus

This was a great place for Sunday brunch. Make reservations as it will fill up. Cool atmosphere with the old building. Nice efficient service, food came quickly. I had the corned beef hash Benedict. It was great. The hash was different from what I expected (prob a little more authentic than the canned type I was expecting). The tater tots though - wow! Super crispy, so I guess they were fried. So

name: Saffron
address: 1143 San Carlos Ave, San Carlos, CA 94070
editorialSummary: Restaurant with a seasonal take on Northern Indian fare presented in chic, sophisticated surrounds.
reviews:
Visited for their weekend brunch and had the brunch special thali, channa bhature, and the Chef’s Choice mixed tandoori platter.
The channa bhature was definitely our favorite. the bhature was fresh and fluffy, and the channa was full of flavor without being too heavy.

The brunch special thali was also a great way to try a variety of dishes, with generous portions and well-balanced flavors.

Ende

Delicious, high-quality Indian food that preserves the authentic flavors of North Indian cuisine without overwhelming heat. The dishes are well balanced and thoughtfully prepared.

I tried the brunch thali which was generous, good variety of dishes, and very filling. The chaat starters were excellent, and the biryani is a must-order! deeply flavorful and aromatic. Haven’t tasted such a delicious b

Decided to try this based on the fact it's listed in the Michelin guide and was very pleasantly surprised. Food was an excellent upscaled take on standard Indian fair than doesn't lose sight of its roots. We can recommend everything we tried, especially the onion critters and Indian form of ice cream. We are excitied to have something a bit different than your average Indian meal so close by. Can'

Upscale and lively Indian fine dining spot right in downtown San Carlos. The space feels modern, polished, and intentionally curated, with a smaller focused menu built around quality dishes rather than quantity.

I tried the dahi aloo puri to start. It was tasty, but leaned a bit too sweet for my preference compared to similar versions elsewhere. For the main, I went with the home-style chicken cu

Cozy ambience, serving staff is very polite and checked in our meal often. Situated right by the San Carlos, parking in front of the restaurant might be difficult but there's enough parking around the block.

Coming to food - food is uniquely presented. Chaat was beautifully presented on a papad with microgreens and butterfly cutout, but chana jor garam in the chaat was a little soggy. Latte art o

name: Kabul Afghan Cuisine
address: 135 El Camino Real, San Carlos, CA 94070
editorialSummary: Warm, polished dining room for kebabs & traditional Afghan cuisine, plus wine, beer & desserts.
reviews: Amazing experience! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Afghan flavors. The portions were generous and definitely worth the price. The service was friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere made the whole dining experience even better. I highly recommend trying the Qabuli Pallaw and kebabs—they were outstanding. I’ll definitely be coming back next time I’m in the area!

I got the KABUL’S COMBINATION KABAB with lamb and chicken. The meat was really good and flavorful. It also paired well with both of the sauces they give on the side. The restaurant is decorated very nicely. Definitely worth it with how much food they give you!

I recently ate at Kabul Afghan Cuisine in San Carlos, and it was one of the best and freshest meals I’ve had in a long time. We ordered the salmon kebab, chicken kebab, and the soft pumpkin topped with a flavorful ground lamb meat sauce and yogurt sauce. Every dish was outstanding.
The kebabs were incredibly delicious. The chicken was juicy, tender, and full of flavor, but my absolute favorite was
Amazing food! One of the few places I'll order lamb. The kebab combo (lamb + beef) is my go too dish.
Overall the quality was good. We had Mango Lassi, and rose lassi, and ghabeli palaw, and firnee as desert, all good.

name: Noelani's Island Grill
editorialSummary: Casual spot with Hawaiian fusion fare & tropical drinks, as well as outdoor seating.
reviews: 1st time at Noelani's and certainly won't be last time! Excellent Mai Tai, Mahi Mahi tacos and the  ice cream cake, oreo base with chocolate sauce and macadamia nuts and toasted coconut was wonderful. I ate the entire plate of hurricane fries myself. They were addictive!  My dog and I chilled out on a sofa basking in the sun talking to owner Noelani. Thank you Noelani for bringing the feel, warmth

A mini-vacation meal brought back memories of our island escapes. We ordered shrimp lunch with the garlic sauce and came with rice, cabbage slaw with mango and a mac salad. We also ordered fried pork belly, poke with taro chips, pork lumpia and Korean-style BBQ ribs. All were flavorful, I had forgotten about the shoyu flavor in a couple of items. Service was nice and efficient. The drinks were pre

Very nice Hawaiian themed restaurant. We went here for a mother’s day brunch. If it weren’t  pricey I’d definitely come more often. I love the diverse menu, and I was really happy to see some Filipino foods like Lumpia. I got the Hawaiian Breakfast for $16. At first it didn’t seem like much but it was, I only finished half and had to take the rest home. The rice and egg were tasty but I could make

We came hungry. It was just shy of start of happy hour 3-6, but we didn't think we'd order from it. Greeted and seated right away, waiter was quick to stop over with carafe of water and 2 ice cold glasses.  My partner order kalua pork and cabbage it came with mac salad and scoop of rice &, it was not too salty, salad was a bit different than I've had but pretty yummy, I had the Spicy chicken tuna

We had a good experience at Noelani’s Island Grill in San Carlos. We ordered the keiki katsu with Spam fried rice, shaka chicken, and the Hawaiian short ribs. The portions were GENEROUS and the flavors were solid, especially the Spam fried rice and the chicken. We also appreciated the heated outdoor seating, which was comfortable even in January. The only downside was parking, which was a bit diff

name: Nursel Central Asian Cuisine
address: 601 Old County Rd, San Carlos, CA 94070
reviews:
Nursel Restaurant remains a favorite for me and my best friend. We visited on May 1, 2026- our fourth time visiting as we both are always craving Russian and Uzbek flavors.

The main drawback is a strong cleaning-product scent in the dining area upon entering and on the napkins, which is distracting for someone like myself who has a sensitive sense of smell.

We ordered spinach and cheese samsy, c

I’m very upset. I ordered takeout and was hoping to enjoy my lunch, but I feel completely disappointed. These syrniki are 100% ruined — they’re burnt! This is spoiled food. It shouldn’t be served to guests at all. If I had been eating at the restaurant, I would have asked for a replacement immediately. But since it was a takeout order, it seems like no one cared about the quality of what was given

Awesome experience at Nursel!!! My wife and I ate here and we started with the pelmini, my wife had the chicken stroganoff and I had the lamb shish kabobs, then we had the Napoleon cake for dessert. All fantastic!  We’re definitely looking forward to coming back!

Went to this place for dinner during my stay at Belmont, CA. The place good a decent atmosphere and ambience. I tried their Samsa, and some chicken and beef items. The food was served at a good temperature. The taste was decent too. However, I feel there is room for improvement on taste. Service was very satisfactory.
Food was ok. I like their eggplant salad. There was no service but we didn't mind.

name: Sushi Kazoku
address: 920 El Camino Real, San Carlos, CA 94070
reviews: Unassuming sushi spot with excellent tasting sushi! Highly recommend the nigiri here especially the salmon belly, o-toro and hamachi belly! Pretty on par with Sushi Maruyama but easier access (not super long wait/walk-ins more welcome) and less speciality fish selection, but still great on par quality. Would definitely recommend if you are in the area.

Outstanding quality & freshness, staff was friendly, polite, and professional service was very expeditious, and I was able to have my food, allergies, accommodated, and appropriately handled

Chef’s knife work was fantastic. The rice was perfectly seasoned with a great texture. The menu had wonderful variety and the prices were phenomenal, especially given how dense each roll was!

The salmon was

Great food & good value - we picked this place over the ones in downtown. The server was very nice and recommended great dishes. We were there for a light dinner - all turned out to be great. I particularly liked the pork belly. The interior was very homey and cozy. The dishes they use was very cute. Will definitely return!

This place was recommended to me by multiple friends and honestly was amazing. The rolls were very tasty, you could tell the fish is fresh. We tried 3 specialty rolls and one classic, they were all delicious. We also got the spicy edamame which was messy but worth it and the gyoza which I loved very much. They seem to offer a nice lunch special bento box so I’ll be coming back for it. The service

Offering a warm and inviting atmosphere that makes you feel right at home from the moment you walk through the door. The service is exceptional attentive, friendly and genuinely hospitable ensuring that every part of the meal flows seamlessly. The fish quality is top tier, featuring melt in your mouth fresh selections that are artfully presented. Standout dishes like the Kazoku Roll and the Papill

name: Mylapore - Fremont
reviews:
We had Masala Dosa, Mysore Masala Dosa, and Onion Uttapam. The Masala Dosa was perfectly crisp and served with flavorful chutneys and sambar. The Mysore Masala Dosa had just the right amount of spice and Onion Uttapam was soft and delicious.
A great place for authentic South Indian food. One of the best places to enjoy dosa and uttapam. Highly recommended! 😊

Great food, one of the best dosas in the bay! I always get the ghee Podi masala dosa, and their filter coffee is really good too (and free on rainy days)!! Only thing I hate is weekends have a long wait so best thing to do is waitlist on yelp app before.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Mylapore Express in Fremont has been our family’s culinary sanctuary since day one! Whether it’s a standard Tuesday dinner, hosting out-of-town relatives, or introducing my non-Indian colleagues to the "real deal," this is the spot. I’ve made it my personal mission to show my coworkers that Indian food is so much more than just naan and butter chicken—South Indian cuisine is a vibrant, flavo

A restaurant providing authentic south Indian food in the Fremont. The quality of cuisines is reasonably good, not oily or excessive spicy. I loved the Rava Dosa and Vada. Overall a place for change of your palates.

I had Ghee Masala Dosa and Filter coffee and Mylapore, both were good. The masala dosa was a bit more crunchier than I usually like, it was tasty and I enjoyed it nevertheless. The coffee was also good.

name: Din Ding Dumpling House Fremont
reviews: Food 5/5 - Ordered Pork Xiao Long Bao, salt & pepper pork chops, shrimp & pork pot stickers, and dry-fried string beans with pork. Everything was delicious. Pork XLB skin was thin and had a good amount of soup. Salt & pepper pork chops were fried nicely and well seasoned, not too fatty. Shrimp & pork pot stickers were juicy and pairs well with the dipping sauce. Dry-fried string beans with pork ha

A friend recommended this spot, so I swung by to try a few things. The soup dumplings were easily the highlight—super homey, warm, and hit the spot. I also had the spicy noodles, which were solid.

However, I’d skip the sliced beef next time. It was served cold and felt pretty bland. I was surprised by the thick layer of cold fat on the meat; without any tendon or seasoning to balance it out, the

This has a more upscale ambiance than the older one, but the resturant is smaller, so fewer large tables which is what this food is best for. Servers are also newer, seems less coordinated.

Same great food though! Go for dumplings and noodles.

I ordered pickup with food that isn’t watery. The containers were extremely poorly packed. I didn’t notice and put the bag in the truck. When I got home, the vinegar and some other watery sauces filled the bag and leaked into the truck. I was luck the truck mat is waterproof otherwise I have to deal with interior cleaning. But be aware that they don’t pack your stuff well and you could end up gett
Amazing food. Great atmosphere. There is waiting at peak time. The soupy dumplings were amazing. Would go there again and recommend the place.

name: Khaati Peeti Restaurant & Bar (formerly Sankalp Fremont)
reviews: I’m so glad that we had a doctor appointment today in Fremont or we would’ve missed one of the most delicious meals I have ever eaten and I have much experience in this category. The cheese garlic naan and butter paneer curry was authentic and wasn’t lacking flavor. My wife had the Indichin sizzler. Again the flavor carried throughout the entire dish. Masala tea -authentic. Tried the Indian single

Visited Khaati Peeti Restaurant and had a really good experience! The food was flavorful and well-prepared, with a nice mix of comfort snacks and interesting fusion items on the menu.

I especially loved their Ferrero Rocher shake — it was rich, creamy, and perfectly indulgent with a strong chocolate-hazelnut taste. A real treat for dessert lovers!

We also tried a few other dishes, and everything

Our late Sunday afternoon lunch was disappointing here.

Appetizers: Excited about the sizzlers, we tried both veg and non-veg north-Indian versions and found them to be tasteless. The non-veg had a pungent smell from the fish that got to all the other meat in the platter. Wouldn’t recommend either. Additionally we tried the sev poori chaat option, was sweet but good.

Mains: absolutely have to tr

We came on a Wednesday night, celebrating my grandma’s birthday and it was beyond our expectations. They accommodated our reservation before it became busy, allowing us to be 30 minutes late. I believe it was the owner and our server Riha who I spoke with and they were so sweet. The plus was they had fresh jamun shots, masala cokes and nimbu pani, which were top tier. We ordered so many things inc

Very Disappointing Experience

We visited Khati Peeti with family and honestly, this turned into one of the worst dining experiences we’ve had.
First issue started with the order itself. We clearly ordered butter chicken, 4 naan, half tandoori chicken, and veg sizzler. Naan arrived first, but butter chicken never came. By the time we asked, naan was already cold. Then we were told we never ordered

name: Sala Thai Restaurant
reviews: Everything we ate was amazing. I’ve never had sole made this way, it was so crispy and the sauce was delicious. The pad Thai, mango chicken and the basil fried rice was off the hook. And probably the best angel wings I’ve ever eaten.

We visited for a Sunday dine-in lunch. The food is always reliable at Sala Thai. Our favorite dish is the Crispy Fish with Sweet Garlic Sauce. The battered fish is fresh and pairs perfectly with the sauce. You also cannot go wrong with the chicken Pad Thai, which was flavorful and delicious.

The photos I took do not do the food justice because we started eating immediately. We also ordered the Sh

I tried takeout from here on a Friday evening.
I got the spring rolls, drunken noodles and red curry.
I love the spring rolls from here. The crunch..the filling.. amazing 💯
Spring Rolls from here are a must try.
The drunken noodles and curry is a good combo.
I was feeling adventurous so I tried the medium spice and boy was it spicy.
But it was spicy good 👍🏽
The noodles were well cooked, the veg

The food was good and yummy. However, I gave it a 4 stars because of 2 reason one the restroom smelled bad and barely had any hand soap. My friend did tell the employee but they didn't do anything. Second the seating are too close to each other if you are seated in the aisle, and the seats are ripped. It's better to be seated in a booth.

We ordered Angel Wings, Drunken Noodles, and Pineapple Fried Rice. The Angel Wings were crispy and tasty. The Drunken Noodles and fried rice were good as well, though a bit too salty and saucy for my taste. I’d still come back to try other dishes. The restaurant is spacious, I barely had to wait even during peak dinner hours, and the staff was very attentive. The food also came out fairly quickly.

name: Idly Express - Fremont
reviews:
We had Mylapore Kitchens cater our housewarming lunch, and they truly made the day special. From the start, Hameed sir took the time to understand exactly what we wanted and handled our 50-person order with the same care and attention as a much larger event.
The food was outstanding and felt deeply nostalgic. The rasam on a rainy day was perfect, the tangy tamarind rice and creamy vegetable kootu

A simple meal turned out a bit disappointing. Paid $18 for two vegetarian curries — sambar and potato fry — but the taste and freshness were lacking. It seemed like the food might have been stored in the fridge, as the flavors and texture felt dull. The sambar was okay but could be much better. Hope the restaurant revisits its storage and preparation methods to maintain freshness and authentic fla

I am a regular customer and even have purchased their gift cards. However, recently when I purchased ready to eat curry (Saag Paneer), I found a small green color piece of plastic in it while eating.
Sharing for awareness and correction for future.

I ordered catering for my daughter’s birthday party. The food was excellent and I highly recommend catering from here. Hamid was effective at planning the delivery precisely on time. All my guests enjoyed the thatte idly, Vada, bisibele bath and all the other items. Excellent quality, quantity, service and communication. Overall I was very impressed!

This is a takeout place.  One should order online and pick it up or delivered??? One can place order in person, however long wait to pickup.  No place to sit and wait, unless do few errands and come back.  They also have few prepared dishes in the refrigerator ready to go.  Lots of spice powders available as well.  Food is pretty ok. Although it’s under Mylapore restaurant chain they don’t have a

name: Bill's Cafe
editorialSummary: Homemade baked goods & scratch-made soups on a menu of classic American breakfast & lunch fare.
reviews: Everything was fresh, super tasty, came out fast, and piping hot. The lemon blueberry pancakes were delicious and chock-full of blueberries. Great omelettes. The link sausage were super-sized and both the hash browns and country potatoes were really good. We didn't try the bread pudding French toast but will on a future trip. Service was terriffic. The area around the restaurant is nice and clean.

My wife family wanted to come here for breakfast before we headed back home to Los Angeles. When we came, we were lucky to find parking because this place got busy. We had to wait like maybe ten minutes to be seated since we were a big party.

My wife got the Mexican Omelette which I shared with her since I was holding our baby. I thought the omelette plate was decent. My wife like it more than I

the service was good.

The eggs and overall food has stale smell of canned egg whites. U can tell the food isn't fresh. I DO NOT like to pay for fake or liquid eggs outta a carton.

We ordered
Mexican omelet
Blueberry lemon pancakes
Beef benedict.

Also, the mexican omelet had NO veggies but the menu listed out a few. The only vegetable in it was pickled jalapeños and THAT'S it. Look at the pictur

I’ve been coming to Bill’s Cafe for almost a year now, mostly for breakfast, and it never disappoints! As a Muslim, my options are usually eggs and pancakes, and they are always fresh and delicious. The quality and taste are always great.

I bring my friends and family here often since it’s very close to our house, and everyone loves it. Every time I see other people’s orders, especially the steak

Bills Cafe is my go-to spot on the weekends. The food is great and flavorful and the portion size is perfect for the price. The fresh squeezed orange juice is the cherry on top. I always join the waitlist through Google to ensure my spot in line is secured. Great place to bring family and friends for a good bite to eat. The staff is friendly and the service is quick. Would recommend!

name: RĀW Superfood Café | Fremont
address: 3768 Capitol Ave Unit D, Fremont, CA 94538
reviews: Walking into RAW Superfood Café in Fremont, I immediately noticed how clean, modern, and calming the space feels, blending minimalist design with warm greenery throughout. The atmosphere strikes a balance between a wellness-focused café and a comfortable neighborhood spot where you can actually sit and enjoy your time. Everything feels intentionally designed, from the soft lighting to the organize

We really have liked all the food we e tried here - umami toast & veggie burgers we like truffle avocado burger, chipotle burger a lot. Açaí bowls & smoothies are consistently good too.
The owners were there one night as we were there near closing & they were so patient & nice. Only made us bigger fans than we already were. Gets busy sometimes but I’ve sat & chilled in there on quiet weekdays. Nea

The food is pretty amazing! Even when I am disappointed by some service incidents that I run into I still come back for the food! The drinks didn't really light up my taste buds like the food, but I like the healthy ingredients in them and the wide selection. Pretty comfy dine in ambiance also.

They were able to customize my order on request to remove ingredients from my salad. I have quite a few dietary restrictions and it makes it difficult for me to usually eat from any restaurant. They did a fantastic job in accommodating for me :)
