I am completely obsessed with the banh mi sandwich. Whenever I’m in town, I get it at least a couple times in a week. So so good. The adaptogenic mushroom toast and magic matcha lattes are also good. Service is friendly and fast. Little seating, semi-uncomfortable chairs, and the bright white lighting all encourage me to take my food to go, but it’s clean and never crowded so not a bad spot for a

name: Fresh Meat Factory
reviews:
I purchased 2 goat brains from Fresh Meat Factory and paid $13.98. but the total weight I received was only 40 grams, which is extremely low for two brains.

There was no clear disclosure about the weight at the time of purchase, which feels misleading. For the price paid, the quantity was disappointing.

I hope the store improves transparency around portion sizes and pricing so customers know wha

I had fresh korrameenu fish here which is literally so good when compared to frozen fish of the same
And also prices are so reasonable

Fresh meat, great quality, and excellent customer service. The store is clean, well-organized, and has a wide selection of halal meats. Staff are friendly and helpful, and the prices are fair for the quality offered. Highly recommended!

This was the worst experience I’ve ever had buying chicken. The store presented the chicken as local and high quality, but from the very beginning, the raw meat had a very strong, unpleasant, and unusual odor. Even after cooking it with plenty of seasoning, onion, saffron, and other ingredients, the bad smell and unpleasant taste did not go away.

The food was basically inedible, and we had to thr

Buyer beware. I purchased baby goat meat here on Saturday, May 9th, and when I opened the package on May 12th, the smell was overwhelmingly foul — a clear sign the meat had already spoiled. What troubled me most is that I now recall noticing that exact same smell inside the store the day I bought it!

I paid $43 for 2 pounds of meat that was not fit to eat. Selling expired or spoiled meat at premi

name: Sushi Ken
reviews:
Absolutely loved this place! They start you off with free edamame, and it was so good I devoured the entire bowl in 4 minutes flat. For the main event, the Mango Secret Roll and the Secret Love Roll were incredibly tasty and fresh.

They have basketball playing on the TV in the corner, which gives the place a nice, casual vibe. Service can be a little on the slower side, but the food is absolutely

Sushi Ken is a great option if you’re looking for a satisfying amount of sushi at reasonable prices. While it wasn’t the most memorable sushi I’ve ever had, it offers solid quality for the value. The dinner/bento boxes in particular seemed like the best deal. Overall, it’s a reliable spot for a filling and affordable meal, would recommend.

This restaurant is one of our favorite even after the ownership has changed a few years ago. The food is always reasonable price and quality. The restaurant is always occupied and it’s a popular local joint in Fremont. I think for the value I will highly recommend this place. It’s not a fancy place but good enough to bring family and friends too.

The restaurant is conveniently located in the midd

Had dinner at this place and it was fantastic. I tried the katsu combo, which came with rice, a California roll, chicken cutlet, cabbage salad, wasabi, teriyaki sauce, and miso soup. The chicken cutlet was perfectly fried and tasted super fresh.

I also ordered the spicy tofu roll, which was great. They offer plenty of vegan sushi options, which is a huge plus.

As soon as we were seated, they bro

I have gotten takeout from here on a couple of times !
They have reasonably priced sushi rolls and tons of vegan options!
And that was soo great. The taste is always good , I tried a few of the rolls Big daddy, Mango on fire, Saishoku roll and  L&V roll.
The online ordering system is very simple and sends a notification that the order is accepted. The rolls hit the right notes in terms of sweet an

name: Joyful Dim Sum Bistro
reviews:
The prices are inexpensive. For example, porridge for $7 vs other places for $15. It isn’t crowded and the service was fast. I like how they gave me a huge pitcher of hot water and cold water.
My other go to is Kung Fu Dim Sum but it’s getting so crowded there so this is a good alternative.
The porridge at Joyful is better than Kung Fu. But I like the hot chili oil at Kung Fu better. The sticky ri

I went there in a Sunday morning to pick up a couple of Dim Sums, preserved egg & pork congee and pan fried turlip/radish cakes, to go.  There were plenty of parking spaces.  There were 8 or 9 tables inside and the plenty of tables outside.  The lady behind the counter was very friendly.  The food was steaming hot when I arrived at my destination.  Very tasty as well!

We hadn't had dim sum in a long time, so after a car meet, we were really craving it and found this place near Ohlone College.

We ordered some of our usual dim sum favorites, including shiu mai, har gow, chicken feet, steamed pork ribs in black bean sauce, and the shrimp spring rolls.

Everything tasted really good, and the portions were generous! Even though they don't have a huge selection, the

Slightly above average quality, really good value casual dim sim place. Satisfies the dim sum craving and would go again if in the area, but would go out of my way just to eat there again

Walked in around noon on a Saturday and waited about 20 minutes for a party of 2. They are really busy on weekends. I actually made a reservation on their website days prior, but they did not honor it, saying th

Interesting restaurant in a neighborhood close to Mission San Jose. Space is bright and clean, with not too many tables. Serves good Dim Sum. Didn't see any Asian customers besides our table. Service was friendly and attentive. Food was good and well worth the price. Will go back and try other Dim Sum offerings

name: EE Home Cooking
reviews:
This business is often missed on Mission Blvd. because of how hidden it is -- but I would say this is one of the MANY hidden gems of Fremont by far.

EE Home Cooking whips up the most authentic southern style family dishes, ranging anywhere from veggies, to noodles, and more. They are a hole in a wall and is a restaurant that's quite convenient for the students at Ohlone to go to (due to its close

3 dishes for $30?! Can't get better than this. Definitely one of my favorite places to get Chinese food in Fremont.

Place is small with a few tables but most people seem to take it to go. If you dine in though, you get the soup of the day! Soup is typically a clear herby broth. Food is flavorful, portions are decent, and service is great and fast. I love the sweet shanxi fish fillet (tastes almos

This place is a total gem. The food and service exceeded our expectations. EE, was so attentive and sweet to us. We felt right at home. And the portions were generous and reasonably priced. We are definitely coming back.

We LOVE this place! It's amazing! Their orange peel chicken is amazing!!!
Still one of our favorite places! All their food is delicious!
We absolutely love this place and EE Fannie!
We still love it!

Ordered the seafood tofu hot pot with rice and soup.  The soup was an unusual bird's nest soup with yam and corn on the cob.  Before I was half done with the soup, the hot pot was ready!  The squid was tender and the shrimp tasted fresh.  The fish filet wasn't overcooked.  It was served piping, burning hot - perfect.  Note that you can ask the chef for less salt or less oil - professional Chinese

name: California Craft Beer
editorialSummary: A vast selection of local, domestic & international beers offered in a relaxed, low-key setting.
reviews: Found this place while on my regular cycling route, and always have to make a stop. It’s a nice cozy low key place with a great beer selection. And if I’m hungry, I just order from the burger place down the block and bring it over. So nice to have in Fremont.

A brave pub, well kept with a variety of small brand beers. In a cooler with a large selection.

The place is located in an otherwise distinctly un-buzzy strip of closed down stops on the mission blvd just outside the old Mission San Jose.

It almost feels like a cafe, except for beers. Large TVs all around show sports channels, cricket included.

If you happen to visit the mission or just a local

A very welcoming environment and reasonable pricing for a local establishment that's in a very safe area. Great tasting drinks with enough options that doesn't feel overwhelming. You'll find yourself wanting to hangout here all day once you're cozied in.
I'm so glad this place is still open. Please visit with your favorite noms ( yes you can bring food ) and enjoy a wonderful craft beer hangout!!!

There is no food here, only wine and beer with good selection of both. This place is perfect if you want to throw a small party (35 people) and don't want to pay for drinks. You can bring your own food but purchase drinks at the establishment. Good for you (save money and cleaning effort) and good for the owner (people will purchase drinks)

name: Ohlone Deli
editorialSummary: No-frills fixture offering an array of deli sandwiches & casual eats in a compact, old-school venue.
reviews: Well when I spotted the Ohlone Deli sign out front I thought ..Oh good a real honest to goodness deli with selections of foods from the Indigenous Natives that occupied this land hundreds of years ago!  Was I excited  ...Yes I was!  I studied the sandwich menu carefully, and decided on two sandwiches from the list of authentic Native American options.  I got the Honey Roasted Turkey with Avocado a

I tried this place for the first time just now on my lunch break since it’s down the road from work. This place was disappointing and the food was nasty. I paid $17 for a hot pastrami sandwich combo and the ingredients just did not taste fresh at all. It was so dry, with no flavor. On top of that, the older man that runs the deli literally was cross contaminating with his same dirty gloves from ma

I ordered a French dip and fries  And I was very surprised at quality and quantity of fries I got as well as the meat in sandwich was pretty good.  Better than togos for sure.  Place looks cluttered but guy was friendly enough and my food was great!

Heard this deli made good pastrami sandwiches, tried it out, as well as fish & chips with my husband! We both loved the chips which were tasty and very crisp. That’s how a fresh crinkle chip should be! Fish crisp and fresh! Wish pastrami was home made, but is was fresh as well.  The gentleman from the Mediterranean knows his way around a deli. Say what, baklava, too? All right! Baklava heaven now!

Been coming here since 2007. Every time I hope it's better, but it's not. Everything I order is extremely subpar. There's not a single stove in sight. Nothing is made in house. Every ingredient is ordered in bulk pre-made from a commercial warehouse and then shoved into a microwave or a toaster oven. The salmon burger, fish and chips, nachos fries, cheese burger, French onion dip. All of these are

name: Renegade by Devout Coffee
reviews:
Always been a big fan of Devout Coffee ☕️ and their pastries when I was first introduced by my coworker suggestions. By the time I came through the afternoon, the pastries were almost gone !

I’m glad they were able to open a second location with more parking spots around the vicinity.

I enjoyed how they are trying to change the way modern coffee shops are operating, where they are emphasizing co

Coffee and food here was great! I got the ice latte with house syrup and my girlfriend got a decaf cappuccino. Usually I get iced lattes, I find that most of them taste watered down and disappointing, but Renegade was one of the few places that exceeded my expectations and had an exceptional iced latte. Food there was also very tasty! My girlfriend was a big fan of the buckwheat pancake and I love

This coffee location is unique and one that I could hang out at to meet up with friends for something warm on a cold day. Reminds me of NY. I believe this used to be a bank back in the day and they turned it into a nice two story coffee joint but the outside decor is still ugly. The parking is scarce. They have their own parking but only 8 spots and 1 handicap space. The rest are all street parkin

The coffee and food are awesome. Some of the food is expensive for what it is, but all of the food is good. The burgers are some of the best I’ve had in my life.

The coffee itself is great if you’re a coffee person. If you’re a Starbucks girlie this is not the place for you.

Parking situation is a little weird, but given the scarcity of real estate in Fremont there really isn’t anything they can

I wanted to stop by this place to try their coffee. We went around 1:30 p.m., which is usually when they stop serving coffee in cups, so I hesitated to ask. But when I did, the owner was very kind and happily agreed, which genuinely made me happy.

The coffee itself tasted really good. Beyond that, it was such a lovely experience—being in a cozy space, enjoying the music, sipping my cappuccino, an

name: Billy Roy’s Burger Co
reviews: The way this restaurant work is you order from the counter,  then a table number will be given to you, and you choose your own seat. The service was super fast. We ordered and in less than 5 minutes our food was served.  We ordered a large onion ring, El Diablo burger, The Haystack burger, and The Billy Roy burger. The burgers were big and super delicious. If you're in the mood for a burger this i

Had a great ride out here for lunch today with 14 folks.
Great food served within 25 minutes of us ordering. You get a Moutain of food for the price. Staff was great as well. Plenty of seating available for all us us.
We will definitely make it another destination for our short ride schedule.

Been here twice to celebrate my colleague's birthday or achievements. Both times we were on a time crunch. Both times Billy Roy's took amazing care of us. Food was served to us on time without skipping their famous quality or standards. We ate well, the good was delicious. And we had a great time with the staff who are amazing. We made it back to our jobs in time. The only thing we needed to do be

might be the best deal in Fremont! Happy hour all day everyday 🤯

Better than In-N-Out animal fries with the best meat. The Chile relleno reminded us of a better version of jalapeno poppers 🔥

Also shout out to the wonderful @prisilly_penelope_ for the perfect recommendations and hospitality. ❤️

They will be seeing us again; absolutely worth a visit if you’re in the east bay 🙌

#foodie #bayare

This restaurant offers a sports bar vibe, with tables for larger parties. The food was on point with a nice vibe surrounding the bar scene with a large TV on the wall showing sports. The people make this place what it is, including the cool bartender.

name: Suju's Coffee & Tea
editorialSummary: Arabica coffee beans roasted in-house paired with sandwiches, pastries & free WiFi.
reviews: Great experience at Suju's! What really made the visit stand out was the exceptional service from Melina. She was friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond by making my custom sandwich exactly the way I wanted it and bringing it to my table. The coffee was delicious, the sandwich was fresh and perfectly made, and her outstanding customer service made the whole experience even better. I highly
The cookies and cream frappe we tried here was just okay but  it's a nice place to hang out, study, or work. They also have a nice selection of coffee blends, mugs, and tea cups too.

A good place with lot of options in drinks, snacks and sandwiches. Had the lavender oat milk latte and morning roll. Both of them were not two sweet and it was really good.

The morning roll has cinnamon, chocolate and hint of sugar. Unfortunately, I didn’t take pics of the drink and morning roll.

I also ordered after typing the above review a sausage, egg and cheese bagel. 😂 It was for approx $

Not sure why this doesn't have 5 stars, it's AMAZING, the smoothie was so good not sweet at all. I got a sandwich and OH MY WORD if you want a good sandwich spot with BEST coffee AND dessert come here!! So friendly and nice the atmosphere was chill and welcoming. I will be back with my family this time.

Wish I discovered the vast menu and quality of the sandwiches, pastries and coffee served here sooner. The atmosphere is great and has that perfect mix of small cafeteria seating and cozy coffee shop. I ordered the iced mocha espresso, tremendous! I won't say how many pastries I took home with me. Support local business!

name: Dosa Express
reviews:
We had a fantastic first lunch here with the family. We tried a little bit of everything: the thattai idli, vada, masala dosa combo, thakkali thokku dosa, gonkura chutney dosa, and a plain dosa. The main dishes were all incredibly authentic and delicious. The idlis and vada, in particular, were perfectly soft with a great texture.

While the sambar and chutneys were good, they weren't the absolute

I ordered from Dosa Express in Fremont via DoorDash, hoping for a solid South Indian meal, but what I got was a complete letdown. The sambar was essentially flavored water, lacking any richness or depth. Every single chutney—the coconut, the spicy, the green—were equally diluted. It was as if someone had taken actual sauces and thinned them out beyond recognition. The flavors were nonexistent, and

Today we tried the Masala Dosa and their new Malaysian Hawker dish, Roti Canai and they were both delicious! Quite large portions so the prices are reasonable. (dosa was huge!) we also got to try the Rose Coconut milk drink and it was very nice, not too sweet and refreshing. Great service and was very helpful with dish recommendations. Highly recommend a try if you are in the area for Indian food.

We’ve visited twice now, and this place has quickly become a family favorite. Everything we tried tasted fresh, flavorful, and surprisingly light — not greasy at all, which we really appreciated.
The idli was soft and fresh, the variety of dosas were crispy and delicious with great flavor, and the mango lassi was perfectly refreshing. We also loved the filter coffee and badam milk — both were auth

I visited Dosa Express with my friends, food was very delicious and we would definitely drop off very often. Very good taste at affordable price. Staffs were really welcoming, polite and customer service was great👍. We also purchased their idly batter which apparently is preservative free. Taste of this batter came out way good than expected and it doesnt bloat your tummy like other batters do. T

name: De Afghanan Kabob House
reviews:
Yesterday evening I ordered 4 portions of Shor Nakhut (chickpeas) and it was extremely disappointing. The food was overwhelmed with vinegar to the point it was barely edible, with no real balance of spice or chickpea flavor.

I spoke with a staff member and then the owner after a long discussion, but instead of a refund I was given replacement food from a nearby restaurant. Unfortunately, it had t

We’ve been customers of this Afghan Kabob House for about 20 years now. We used to order regularly, and even dined at the main De Afghanan Restaurant, but as prices increased over the years, we’ve limited our visits to once or twice a year for the past decade. I regret not leaving a review earlier—I didn’t want to simply echo what everyone says: that this is the best kabob. Unfortunately, today th

This is a to-go place. Service is ok. There is no atmosphere as you have to stand outside the store even in the rain.

But really, you come here for the food because you don’t want to sit down at the De Afghanan Cuisine place which is just across the side road alley. Go there for a more authentic Afghan vibe.  And because you are here for the food, the food is good!  However you can not get the la

I will say, this food changed my life! I had never had Afghani food before and this was such a good introduction to the food! I loved everything I ate. What I don't like so much is that is that it's cash only and the plates are quite pricey. When we handed over the cash we didn't get the remainder back- he just automatically took what was left over and put it in the tip jar with out asking. I was

Got their lamb kabob - juicy, tender, lots of it. This place is legit, literal hole in the wall. It’s the same as the sit down restaurant a few steps away, but the take out option (faster, less wait time). They grill it to order, so best to call ahead. Cash only.

name: Momo & Kebab
address: 37100 Fremont Blvd Ste K, Fremont, CA 94536

name: DeAfghanan Cuisine
editorialSummary: Corner spot offering kebabs & other Afghan classics in an earth-toned, stone-walled space.
reviews:
Overall Rating: 4.5/5

If you are looking for authentic, flavorful, and incredibly generous portions of Afghan food in Fremont, De Afghanan Cuisine is an absolute must-visit. The quality of the food stands tall alongside the massive quantity.

Here is a breakdown of what we ordered:

Butternut Squash Bolani
The Good: The portion size is huge, making it more than enough for two people to share. The

Large portions, good flavor. Can be a little disorganized but very homey style. Even other patrons are very friendly.

Charbroiled meats were fantastic. Must get. Perfect char, juicy meat, and great texture on the patty. I also really enjoyed the potato bolani. Crispy bread and creamy potato. Huge portion. What's not to love! Had free chutney at the table.

The slow cooked lamb in the pallow was f

The Afghan cuisine here is delicious, but the restaurant itself is very small and has a few drawbacks for dine-in guests. When they cook, the dining area often fills with smoke, so I wouldn’t recommend sitting inside if you are sensitive to smoke or have breathing issues. There are a few tables outside, but when we visited, the outdoor heaters were off, making it too cold to sit comfortably.
The s

​We visited for an early weekend dinner and found the place quite busy. The atmosphere was a bit smoky with a strong aroma of grilled meats.
​The appetizers were the highlight—the Mantu and Aushak were both delicious and authentic. However, the main courses were a bit hit-or-miss. My Lamb Kabab specialty was unfortunately tough and overly chewy, though the chicken in my friend's Triple Kabab combo

I'm forgiving of mistakes but this one was definitely intentional. I stopped by on a Saturday night for dinner and we were served this bread. They gave us these small and dry end pieces which look like scraps and there were even pieces of plastic in it. This should have never left the kitchen. Don't eat here unless you're ok with being served literal garbage.

name: PAV BHAJI HUT
address: 37100 Fremont Blvd Suit A, Fremont, CA 94536
reviews:
My first time at this place, and I was thoroughly impressed. The food was delicious, and the service and ambiance were top-notch. They only offer Pav bhaji and a few other specials, which is a good sign. We ordered the spicy Pav bhaji with cheese and a Bombay sandwich.

The Pav bhaji was outstanding and flavorful. They did a great job balancing the spice level, but I regret adding the cheese. It d

If you want the original street style Pav Bhaji experience go here..
i absolutely love going here, a little pricier but I’d say worth it. We go for the spicy one but, regular for kids..& my kids love it too!
Introduction of Vada Pav was for sure a hit.. usually go for the Szechwan one but the chura that comes with it is amazing.
Great set up with city names from India & some pictures.. casual vibe
Ordered the aloo and veg sandwich. It’s a nice option if you’re very hungry and looking for something filling. The bread was so crunchy and well toasted in butter. Loved it!

Very tasty Pav Bhaji. We liked Vada Pav as well. Staff is very friendly. They gave us complementary Pani Puri also to test which had nice two different flavors, normal and passion fruit and grape mix. Overall good experience and would like to visit again with friends!

Tried a couple of their items.
Pani Puri which were served street style one at a time, crispy puris filled with potato and absolutely fantastic authentic spicy, tangy&sweet waters and chutney.
Pav Bhaji with Pav butter toasted to perfection and Buttery spicy Bhaji were delicious.
Enjoyed their fresh squeezed cane sugar juice infused with lemon and mint.
All items 10/10.
Customer Service 10/10
Must

name: Kyain Kyain
reviews: A small but cozy Burmese restaurant with good, flavorful food at reasonable prices. Plenty of menu choices to suit different tastes. Parking can be a bit hit-or-miss, but the food and value make it worth the visit.

The parata and seasonal veggie curry (which I took to go for dinner) were way too oily. Unhealthy amounts of oil. The tea leaf salad was great. Samosas were great also. Both of these I had in the restaurant. But the amount of oil in the other food kind of ruined my experience

Love love love this place. I had never tried Burmese food before and this is the first time I tried it here. It's delicious.We Loved the soup, the tea leaves salad so much. I believe it's a family owned restaurant where the Mom/Dad are the chef and the boys are servers. They serve food in proper serving bowls but you have to eat in disposables. Pretty small joint but authentic.  They even offered

So stoked to discover this restaurant. Native Burmese here and I gotta say this is the best and most authentic Burmese food I’ve had in the Bay so far. They are better than restaurants several times the price. Look past the humble restaurant or the paper plates and the taste will bring one right back to Yangon. The star of the show at this restaurant is their Kyay Oh which is a famous rice noodle

First time ordering here . Horrible and food draining in OIL , pls see the pictures , very badly done, I specifically spoke to Patrick at the restaurant, he said he check up on my order . Bad taste and unhealthy to eat, we trashed these food ! Never ordering from here again

name: Satomi Sushi
editorialSummary: The clever menu at this sushi spot features rolls with witty names like Cherry Blossom & Two Timer.
reviews:
I rarely leave one-star reviews because I understand how hard the industry is, and for the record, the staff here were wonderful—very friendly and attentive. However, the experience was overshadowed by major issues.
First, the smell was overwhelming. I sat to the left of the entrance, and there was a persistent odor resembling a dirty restroom floor throughout my entire meal. Additionally, the cut

The seafood salad here was delicious, and the salmon skin was baked to a perfect crisp – it was fantastic!

The bento box took a little longer to arrive, but the salmon was grilled perfectly, although the tempura was cold .

Service is friendly and fast !

I grew up going to Satomi a good 20+ years ago, then ended up moving out of state about 5 years ago. I came back for a visit, in the mood for some serious sushi after a Mission Peak hike, and oh boy was Satomi just as good as I remembered it. Not only were the rolls delicious, but the service was incredible. UE was quick, attentive, and very friendly. I can't wait to visit again.
-Lion King: rich

The sushi was good, beautifully presented. The jalapenos were hot tonight.

It is busy. We lucked out and had no wait but we did see people have to wait outside after us. The servers are hard to catch because they're busy, but they're good. However the kitchen is forgetful. We ordered gyoza and agedashi tofu. But we had to ask for them 3 times!

Also it's stuffy in the back corner with no AC or ai

Satomi - Thornton. Went here around 2pm Saturday. No wait and got our food and drinks right away. Fast friendly service. We ordered Tempura mixed, Satomi roll, Japanese cowboy, Spicy crunchy, and Fremont.  All orders were flavorful and fresh.

name: Gangnam Tofu House
reviews:
If you are looking for the gold standard for Korean food in the Bay Area, look no further. This spot has, without a doubt, some of the best banchan I’ve experienced - the variety is impressive, and the freshness is clear in every bite.

The kalbi is truly phenomenal - perfectly marinated, tender, and grilled to perfection. Beyond the food, what really sets this place apart is the hospitality. The

20$ Seafood pancake, barely any seafood. Thick Greasy flour. no side dishes. Specs of tiny burnt pieces dusted everywhere. (must not be good for health). Sauce too sweet. When I spoke to the lady, I couldn’t get any side dishes to make up for it. Though, the kitchen was closed. It smelled good from outside, but the food was so sad. I came here years ago, and had good memories of it. But seem to ha

I went to this place for the first time last weekend and I did enjoyed the food a lot. The service was good and the food was also decent. They have so many different kinds of banchan, and they all tasted fresh and delicious. The hot stone bibimbap was good and not oily. We also ordered a kimchi pancake, I thought the flavor was good but since it was on the thicker side, so it lost a bit of the cru

This is our go to place for korean food in Fremont for years. The food has been consistently good. We always order beef bulgogi & tofu soup combo for our family. We love the beef bulgogi. It has sweet savory sauce with tender beef. The tofu soup can be hit or miss. We got seafood white soup (not spicy) for our kiddo - it was good but I personally prefer medium spice for more depth of flavor.

The

So disappointed!  My daughter is visiting from back east and I thought this place would be great for her to have again since she’s been away for a year.
What happened???  Been eating here regularly for 15 years. Ordered take out.
Seafood pancake had barely any seafood!  It was greasy and chewy, we literally threw it out after a few bites!
Kimchi wasn’t even marinated! 😝
Mushrooms in the bibimbop

name: Dino's Family Restaurant
editorialSummary: Stalwart family-friendly diner featuring sizable portions of American comfort food.
reviews: 10/10 experience! very friendly customer service, the portions are big (i love leftovers lol), & pretty spacious. bathrooms are around the corner. my favorite go-to’s are the small Iced Vanilla latte & the Bill Dino Scramble? i forgot the name of it 😭😭

Absolutely perfect breakfast! Everything was delicious, fresh, and cooked just right. Generous portions, great coffee, and super friendly service. Classic diner vibes done perfectly! Can’t wait to come back.

I have to start off with saying - the vibes here are phenomenal! We visited on a Saturday and got seated quickly. This place feels like a well oiled machine with how efficient servers take your order and bring your food out in record time. I wasn’t able to get the name of our server but he was kind and checked in on us often. The food is so good and comforting and they definitely don’t skimp out o
Dion's Family Restaurant is the place I miss the most. The cozy interior is still well maintained, and the food is delicious and satisfying. I highly recommend Dina's Special and the pancakes.

SEP2025
The quality has gone down. My burger was burned. Fries were great. Good service.

MAR2024
Great food still, tried ther burger, outstanding!!!!

JAN2024
Outstanding and very reasonably priced!!!

My fish and chips were perfect, fries perfectly extra crispy as I ordered. Large portion of perfectly cooked fish with great flavor.

My wife's Philly Cheese Steak Sandwich was good, but here salad

name: Matzip Korean Restaurant
reviews:
Went here for a late lunch and there was a little bit of a wait, but we were seated within 15-20 minutes.

We ordered two iced teas (mango and blueberry lemonade), the assorted pancakes and popcorn chicken (hot & spicy). They also served us some sides. All the food items were delicious! Food came out reasonably fast and service was really good - although I could tell they were a little short staff

​I absolutely love Korean Fried Chicken, and Matzip is by far my favorite spot for it! The honey and cheese flavored KFC is incredible. We also ordered the Bibimbap in the stone grill, and it was excellent. All of their side dishes—including the kimchi, cucumber, daikon, and bean sprouts—were fresh and delicious. To top it all off, our server was very pleasant and attentive. Highly recommend!

We ordered half and half Supream and Soy & Garlic fried chicken. It was v crispy and also juicy. We’ve also had the honey cheese one and that one is pretty good too. They were pretty understaffed tonight (2 servers on a Saturday night), so I hope they hire more people to work on a weekend night!

pros:
-HIGHLY recommend this bomb korean restaurant that just opened one month ago! bring all your friends and family. you will love it and will leave wanting more.we’ve been here multiple times!!
-thank you to the friendly staff. shoutout to winston for the best service.
-food is SO YUMMY and super flavorful with really big portions.
-we love the rose tteokbokki and soy garlic friend chicken!!
-m

How to order the best meal here:

🍗 Chicken: Get the large (14 pcs) and ask for the sauce on the side to maximize the crispiness.
Rosé Tteokbokki: Perfect for those who want a cheesy, non-spicy version of the classic.
🍤 Shrimp Toast: Easily the star of the show. It’s "out of this world" crunchy, so just mind the roof of your mouth!

name: Mr. Pickle's Sandwich Shop - Union City, CA
editorialSummary: Regional chain serving hot & cold specialty sandwiches & salads over the counter.
reviews: Way over priced and sandwiches are small. The old lady working today asked twice what I wanted on my sandwhich and still messed it up. Poor attitude and sloppy sandwhich. Horrible customer service.

I ordered from ubereats but the food was awesome tastey and fresh. I would definitely order again. If I had to choose between subway and togos. I would choose togos. But I feel like mr pickles is at the top of my list for a fresh sandwich. The avocado was fresh a well.
Delicious fresh sandwiches. Fast friendly service. Clean interiors.
Ordered food on the app. Was ready on time.  Food was delicious and fresh!
Reannah was amazing. I came in with a large sandwich order. She handled all my sandwiches personally and with great care

name: Aama's Kitchen
reviews:
Food was flavorful. I had the Garlic and Cheese Naan, Tandoori wrap, and Chicken Chowmein. Surprisingly their Chowmein was more flavorful than most of the Chinese restaurants where you would need to add soy sauce to bring out the flavor.

Their tandoori wrap is a little slim for the $18 price tag, but i wrapped it in a garlic naan and it filled me up. If you're a chilli head like me ask for the sp

We went there during the weekend But to my surprise being highly rated the food quality was not upto the mark. Being the vegetarian we ordered noodles, the food quality wasn’t great I would say the taste of noodles was too bad. And then we ordered dal and tandoori roti but the taste of dal was most of garlic like and we have to call server multiple times to provide dishes and all and then he did n

The food here is decent, but the service was not.

We waited at least 30 minutes for the appetizers and even longer for the (not) generously portioned vegetarian tikka masalas, which we ate in minutes because we were famished at that point. We tried to ask the waiter several times for assistance but he never looked our way and when he did assist to help with a request, he did not return again unti
Wonderful experience today at Aama’s. Momo and chow mein were delectable I’m still licking my fingers. Warm service and delicious and spicy food!

Extremely disappointed with my order from here. I ordered tadka dal and chicken biryani, but they completely messed up the order and the quality was awful. Instead of chicken, they gave me mutton biryani. To make matters worse, I found noodles mixed inside my tadka dal, which makes no sense and tasted absolutely terrible. Zero attention to detail and very poor food quality. Will not be ordering ag

name: El Pollo Loco
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain outpost known for Mexican classics made with fire-grilled chicken.
reviews:
Satisfying ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
​I’ve been to many fast-casual spots, but El Pollo Loco consistently hits the mark when I want a meal that feels "real" and flavorful.

​The Highlights:

​The Chicken: The star of the show. The citrus-marinated, fire-grilled flavor is unbeatable. I especially loved the glaze on the drumstick—it was perfectly juicy and had just the right amount of char.

​The Sides: Their Mac & Che

This location is off Mission Boulevard corner lot. I for sure bummed into some very friendly service with a smile. Their menu has quite a bunch of options that took my brain a while to process. Food coma!
I ordered just for me, the 2 piece fire grilled chicken, leg and thigh, which comes with your choice of corn or flour tortillas, and 2 sides. Food ordered is made available almost immediately. No

This is a staple in the neighborhood, good clean eating for hitting the macros. Make sure you get the app, use coupons, and El Pollo Loco will keep you full. The staff is very professional and helpful. Chicken is delicious, not as crispy when the lines and drive thru are long, but usallly hits the spot. Salsa is usually fresh and they are generous. Only recommendation is the interior can be cleane

In the bustling heart of Hayward, I found solace at El Pollo Loco. The Classic Double Chicken Chopped Salad, a testament to simple pleasures, was both hearty and refreshing. Each bite of the tender chicken, complemented by the cilantro creamy dressing, was a reminder of the richness found in life's small moments. The patio area, bathed in gentle sunlight, offered a serene backdrop, turning a meal

Food was OK. Chicken was dry but edible. Staff was friendly and service was good. Didn't take long to get our order after we placed it. This was our first time here, not sure if I will try it. again or not, kind of on the fence.

name: Khao Hom
reviews: The service was pretty slow. They can't get seating for us right away even though there are seats available. The food though came out quickly. The best recommendations are any stir fried dishes and papaya salad. Their signature dish hasn't quite done right.

Chicken Satay (3/5): decent flavor. Was expecting more of a skewer style chicken
Pad Eggplant (5/5): Great flavor; note that it is on the spicier side.
Pad Kee Mao (4.5/5): Good flavor with decent assortment of veggies and tofu.
Pumpkin Curry (4.5/5): a nice change from the typical red or panang curry. Had a few chunks of kabocha squash.
Mango Sticky Rice (3/5): Mangos were sweet and delicious. A

I recently dined at a modern Thai cuisine restaurant in Hayward. We had made a reservation in advance, which turned out to be a great decision as the restaurant is quite spacious and perfect for group dining. The interior is beautifully decorated, creating a pleasant ambiance.

The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, giving us plenty of options to choose from. For appetizers, we ordered the pump

Came here and ordered the Fried Calamari, Siracha Wings, Chicken Pad Thai and Prawn Thai Fried Rice.  Loved the fried rice and the fried calamari.  Enjoyed the pad thai.  The wings did not wow me.  The sauce on the wings was good, but it wasn't penetrated into the wings.  Overall, I had an enjoyable experience.  Would return.

Love the vibes, food and staff!
It feels bougie in here and I adore it, the mimosas are awesome, and the food is so filling. I was a walk in with no reservation but it was easy peasy :) everyone is very kind

name: Casa Del Toro - Cocina & Tequila
reviews: Took a client here for lunch and didn't expect it to be this good. We had ceviche tacos first as an appetizer. For the main course we had the Tomahawk steak. I didn't expect them to have such a fine cut of meat. Impressive. I'll definitely come back. The place was a little pricey but well worth it. The bartender was cool and the beers were cold.
Husband brought me here because I was having a bad day. The empanadas, salad, and lamb chops with the perfect cosmo made the day all better. Come here, you’ll love it. And great service,

I'm confused. "Latin American" cuisine.
The restaurant looks nice didn't expect Hayward to have a restaurants like this.

I really like how the space is divided - almost like one side works as a sports bar while the other leans more toward a sit-down dinner vibe. It works well.

This is labeled as a Latin American restaurant, but the food felt more like American cuisine with a Mexican/Latin aesthe

I was frankly hesitant going jere because of some of the menu items - seeing deconstructed paella and Italian food at a Spanish restaurant were red flags in my mind.
That being said I was pleasantly suprised by my experience. Tje flld was good, staff was all great and the restaurant felt quite nice. I did find it to be a little on tje pricy side but not a rip-off.

Very good food with some unique items for a Mexican restaurant.
The Deviled Eggs were spot on and the Duo of Duck was very good. The confit leg fell off the bone and the breast had a beautiful crispy skin.
Overall good experience and I would return.

name: Chef's Experience China Bistro
editorialSummary: The standards of Chinese cuisine, including dim sum items, served in a spacious dining room.
reviews: So we ordered pick up for us from this restaurant.  We got the Mongolian shrimp, kung pao chicken and white rice. What I got looked nothing like the picture, there were absolutely no noodles of any sort and it tasted  like grease, there was no flavor outside of grease. I couldn't even eat it. And the vegetables in the kung pao chicken were cut up so huge. I don't understand, I'm not sure if it's b

A beautiful setting for a celebration with exceptional service and delicious food.

Attended a graduation lunch at Chef’s Bistro today and came away thoroughly impressed.

Our group was seated in one of their banquet rooms, which was spacious, beautifully decorated, and perfect for celebrating such a special occasion.

The service was exceptional throughout the event. The staff was attentive, frie

Went on a Saturday when they opened. Didn’t acknowledge us until almost 10 minutes in while waiting to be seated. There was only one person at the bar making a take out order. There were several servers visible on the floor.

Taste of food was decent. Har gow came raw in the center and they remade it for us. The sticky rice was small. Other than that, no further mentionables.

At first glance the

My Sister and I celebrated our 63rd bday with family. Was supposed to go 15 turned out to be 26 including babies. They did an awesome job serving us. The food excellent. Everything was hot and didn’t wait long.  5 stars

I can confidently say that this was the worst Chinese food I’ve ever had. I felt the familiar textures of the dishes I knew in my mouth, but without any flavor. It’s telling that 90-year olds were at every other table, since old people lose their sensation of taste.

name: The Gurkha Kitchen
reviews:
We came to this place on a Sunday morning.
It was clean and we were received by a refreshing / welcoming smile at the entrance by the staff Mahesh.

The food was really good. We got fresh hot butter naans and the presentation of the buffet was enticing and tasty.

Mahesh's personality and hospitality was exceptional.
They had veg and chicken momos, pani puris, amazing gulab jamun and fresh cut fru

I tried this place because I was craving butter chicken. Went there with my friends. Wasn't too full, and I noticed they have buffet section. We were seated quickly and the waiter was friendly. Food came out relatively quickly and we dug in. The butter chicken was great and the naan was solid. On the thinner side, but it was very tasty and it had a nice crisp texture on it. Overall, I will be retu

Here’s a polished Google review based on your experience:

As a big momo lover, I specifically came here because they offer unlimited chicken and veg momos on their buffet. Overall, the food was good and there were a few standout items.

I actually preferred the veg momos over the chicken momos. The chicken momos were decent, but not something that made me want to keep going back for more. The chi

My wife and I wanted to try Gurkha for a bit now. The afternoon we went, there was a protest at City hall. We found parking and walked over. The kids from Hayward High and Bret Hart was protesting ICE. The place was cozy, we sat in the back room as it was pretty busy for lunch. The staff was attentive, we ordered off menu. We had Thakali Thali veg, Chicken Momo, Chicken Tikka Kaba, Roti & Garlic n

I went to the farmers market and found this restaurant.  This is one of the best Indian buffet I had.  The dishes are all delicious. I liked the goat curry, the chicken dumplings, eggplant, and Tandoori chicken. Their chai is also excellent.  Beside the food, the waitresses were very friendly. Highly recommended

name: Acqua e Farina
editorialSummary: Informal, family-owned mainstay with traditional Italian entrees, desserts & a large wine selection.
reviews: We made a reservation but we got there 20 minutes late due to parking. The hostess was really nice and seated us right away. The food, atmosphere, and service were excellent.  Table spacing gives a lot of privacy. Our server was very attentive and recommended a good wine to match our order. The only food that we did not like was the side polenta.

Excellent food and service whenever we go. The steak was cooked perfectly and our pastas were delicious. Their homemade bread is also to die for along with their cream of asparagus! The drinks are made at the bar and straight to your table. Classic old school Italian aesthetics but very clean.
Took the future ex husband here for Father’s Day dinner. Lovely place for Italian food. Really delicious linguine and clams and the salmon was very fresh. Delicious carpaccio too.

Was my very first time ever! Atmosphere was amazing! Service was extremely friendly from the moment we walked in and sat at the bar.  Cocktails were good! I had an Old Fashioned and would rate it a solid 6.5/10 I'm picky when it comes to my drink.  My girlfriend got the espresso martini and we both gave a 9/10.  From presentation to taste.  We started with an order of Bruschetta and Calamari.  Abs

Royal treatment excellent hospitality! Great server outstanding selection! Celebrated mom’s birthday enjoyed the antipasto, calamari, wedge salad and couple other items for lunch. Topped it off with tiramisu with a candle . We were visiting from out of town but will return for sure !

name: Ghazni Afghan Kabobs & Restaurant
editorialSummary: Bright eatery featuring traditional Afghan beef, lamb & chicken kebabs in a casual, cozy setup.
reviews: Great spot for some halal afghan dining. The restaurant has decent amount of seating and is good place to eat especially by the windows. The staff/owners are very friendly and attentive. We tried triple (kebab) which comes with tandoori chicken pieces, beef pieces and chapli. All were quite good but the chicken was really good. Chapli perhaps could have been a more flavourful. All the meat is quit

Delicious food!! And warm service!
We ordered the Bolani with leaks - the portion size was really large, even for two people. It was absolutely delicious. I also got the subzi challaw. It was vegan and super flavorful. My partner tried the chicken kebab and didn’t have any complaints.

Fóod was quite delicious very fresh tasting I had the Shami kabob and my friend she had the murgh kabob. The bread was fresh and hot the salsas were tasting and the waitress was very nice . I intend to go back

had an extremely disappointing experience at Ghazni Kababs in downtown Hayward.

I ordered the Qabuli Palaw with Shorma Kebab and a Chicken Shawarma Plate. Unfortunately, the food quality was far below expectations. The rice tasted like it had been sitting for a long time, and the meat under the rice appeared undercooked, which was very concerning from a food safety standpoint. The meal did not ta

This an outstanding restaurant. Great atmosphere for eating inside or out. Great for spending a nice afternoon people, dog, car watching from the great view in the dining area. The service is prompt, courteous, kind, and inviting. The food is excellent and served very quickly and hot. This is for all, young, old, couples, families, friends. This is a must dine experience!!!

name: Shahi Darbar Indian Cuisine
address: 26953 Mission Blvd Ste F, Hayward, CA 94544
reviews: It was my first time here, and I thoroughly enjoyed my meal. We ordered a variety of dishes, including dhai bata dev puri, tandoori chicken, butter chicken, kulchas (onion and paneer), chole masala, and kadai paneer. The service was excellent, and the food was simply amazing. The meat was tender and flavorful, while the chaat was a delightful burst of taste. The kulchas were soft and fluffy, and t

We had a wonderful experience at Shahi Darbar Indian Cuisine in Hayward. From the moment we walked in, the hospitality stood out—warm, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. The food was absolutely delicious, especially the authentic Punjabi dishes, which were rich in flavor and beautifully prepared.
The service was excellent throughout our visit—quick, courteous, and thoughtful. It’s clear that they

Ordered food to pickup from here because we were in the area and it was so good! We got dahi batata sev puri, lamb biryani, tandoori mixed grill, amritsari saag, roti and carrot halwa. It was a bit different than our standard indian restaurant order but we were trying to lean into the restaurant's specialties and I'm so glad we did.

We ordered everything "spicy" level and the biryani was definite

This was our first time trying Indian food. Everything was great, especially the butter chicken! Our server, Gary, was also nice. He kindly gave us some recommendations and checked in on us several times. Overall, great experience!

Had a great experience at Shahi Darbar Indian Cuisine! We ordered Gobhi Manchurian, Paneer Tikka Makhani, Garlic Naan, and Dal Tadka—everything was absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich and authentic, and each dish was cooked really well.

The staff was polite and attentive, and they followed our request for spicy food perfectly, which made the experience even better. Overall, amazing food a

name: Lalo’s Taqueria
reviews: One of my new favorite spots for Mexican food. Only my second time here but I had to tell the streets about it. The Nachos Fries go crazy here! The tacos are gigantic and the asada is perfectly cooked. They have an orange salsa here that might be habanero or something but it's fire 🔥! Lalo is actually the cook and you can tell he loves what he does. This is a family owned restaurant so come see t

Went here for dinner with a group, its like a small restaurant meant more for pickup orders but they did have 5-6 tables there. Cashier was really nice, and I decided to get the super burrito with chicken. Burrito tasted really good, and so did their classic orange sauce but I personally really loved the other mango sauce as it was like mango-y and spicy! This is a great option in the area, and I’

Lagos food is super tasty served hot with plenty of salsa and Chipotle sauce if ya like that too. The tacos are meaty and burritos are packed bring your appetite. The plates are good size too!
This.little.place is a blessing especially when your cravi g some good tacos, burritos, torts and quesadillas they're all.yummy.

Very nice staff. Food was tasty but a little too mild, almost bland; there were different salsas on the side to add more flavor. Good portion sizes.  I might suggest having metal Utensils to make cutting food easier.

Lalo’s taqueria was so good! Food was delicious- we had a wet burrito and quesabirria. The red and green sauce are great but Lalo sauce is even better.  Lalo himself was very kind and loved sharing his thoughts of the menu. We plan to continue to go back.

name: Caravan Restaurant & Grocery Store Afghan Market
reviews: Whenever I'm in the eastbay, I make an extra effort to stop at Caravan to get some fresh hot food.  Today, I got bolani kachaloo and bolani gandana.  The bolani's are cooked to perfection.  You can tell they have a family kitchen and cook authentic food that you would get as if you are visiting someone's home.  They also have the best Afghan groceries, when I am there, I always find something uniq

This is hands down one of the best Afghan grocery and restaurants I’ve been to! The food is truly authentic, just like a home-cooked meal. You can tell everything is made with love—the flavors are rich, the ingredients fresh, and every dish is perfectly cooked.

The restaurant is run by a wonderful family—the mother prepares the food, and her sons and father help run the place. Their hospitality i

have come here coupe of times, Qabili pulav and chapli kabab are quite good. the meat (lamb shank) is so tender in the pulav and it falls off the bone, even the rice is so rich. Bolani is also something you get here which is quite good. Definitely one of the best afghan food spots.

I recently ordered 3 chicken kebabs and, unfortunately, they were not tasty at all — the quality was really poor and disappointing. On top of that, I was shocked to see children being encouraged to ask inappropriate personal questions like “Who’s that person with you always getting the same food?” or “Who is this person?” This is completely unacceptable and unprofessional in any setting, especiall

I visited this shop and had a great experience. Everything was excellent. The quality, the service, and the overall atmosphere. The staff were friendly and helpful, and everything was well organized. I’m very satisfied and would definitely recommend this shop to others. I will happily come back again.

name: Taqueria Senaida's
editorialSummary: No-frills fast-food spot for large portions of Mexican & Tex-Mex eats, plus outdoor seating.
reviews:
Ordered a Burrito Mojado, was not disappointed. It's mainly a drive through place and staff will come out to your car to take your order.

Very nice staff staff, even better food.

Senaidas...THE BEST CARNE ASADA TACO, BEST QUESIDALLA, BEST FREAKN BURRITO!!! i have been coming here since i was a kid with my mom, dad, and siblings. such great memories. food is always good u have never had an issue with any of my food. my daughter loves the steak fries big portion filling and you can share.

I heard on the radio that this place was good. I ordered a Carne asada burrito.  The flavor was very good.  Unfortunately it was 90 percent rice and beans.  I think that a normal taco would have more meat that what this burrito had.  It was good but "where is the beef?"

I like Senaida's. It is my wife's favorite spot. I always get the nachos with grilled chicken. The crispy super 🌮's are delicious as well. Only thing is that I do like the way theor guacamole is prepared. For me it is too creamy and not chunky enough. Besides that everything here taste really good! Best horchata as well!

Best place in the bay area in my opinion. People need to realize what they're known for and stick with it. I've been to places with smiles and bright lights only to sell me awful overpriced food. Senaida's has the best food and very little chat(unless you know the staff through the years) and they sell you good food.

I always get tacos or super nachos with extra guacamole and carne asada. Some pe

name: Los Dos Hermanos
editorialSummary: Homey, unassuming Mexican restaurant with a full bar serving generous portions of standard fare.
reviews: Its been a few years since visiting this place, but I'm pleased that I came today. Plenty of parking, was greeted & seated as soon as we walked in. The service was friendly, and always checking on us. Happened to be Happy Hour so why not order a House Margarita and a Paloma. Both were very well made and tasty! As for food, The Super Famoso steak was 10/10, all the right portioning, and the red sau

I’ve been here a few times now and everything about them is consistent. The flavor and quality of their food is consistently excellent. Their service is consistently excellent whether I’m eating in or taking out. Their friendliness can’t be beat and the cleanliness of the restaurant and the ladies room are always clean and well lit. This is definitely my new favorite restaurant 🩷

Great authentic food. Lots of choices. Service is a bit slow even when it's not so busy. I've been there when the restaurant is full and half full and it's the service is the same. But the food is consistent, good flavor and comes out hot. I did have slightly undercooked rice one time, i just didn't eat it. I like that they give a small bowl of beans with the chips & salsa. They can accommodate la

We have been patrons on LDH for a decade. When the ownership changed about a year ago, we knew there were changes coming but we still supported and spread the word. We have been there a few times since the ownership change. Owner is great and she has made positive changes, but the food flavors have definitely changed since then. The sauces are on the sweeter side which changes the overall flavor o
Amazing food. Try Tuesday tacos. They are great.

name: Cecil's Famous Burgers
editorialSummary: Modest, long-standing counter-serve joint featuring classic hamburgers, fries & milkshakes.
reviews: The food was decent. The staff was nice, the location seems pretty nice too but there are some unsavory people lurking around the area. The food was freshly made, the fries was delicious, the burger and sandwich can be more presentable. The prices are reasonable and also this establishment is one of the oldest food joints here in the city.

I used to eat here all the time when I was a kid and I remembered it as a great place for a good burger. I’ve heard this place changed ownership and wanted to see if it’s still good as I remember. I got the Double Bulky Bacon Cheeseburger, with Fries and a butterscotch milkshake. I have to say the burger did not let me down. It was a pretty good size burger the meat was still juicy inside and it w
The vibe was light weight chill. A few pan handlers but other than that is was mediocre not 2 bad. Kid enjoyed the birds begging 4 food.

Local iconic burger joint with a sneaky large amount of options on the menu.  My 11 year old was shocked about the value for the price (given that fast food has caught up to diner and restaurant prices) and he loved it on comparison to the golden arch place.

One kid got chicken nuggets. The other got a ribeye sandwich. The wife and I got burgers. There were a couple of orders of fries that were a

I've eaten here many times during the day, always very good.
Ordered there once at night.  It was like it was a completely different place 👎

name: Bob's Hoagy Steaks
reviews: The chocolate chip cookies here are delicious! Not overly sweet, perfect softness, they come fresh EVERY time. I’ve tried about half the sandwiches here and I can confidently say their cheese steaks (that they only serve on Thursdays) are a must try, sooo good!!

I came here on a whim on a Sunday and realized they are closed on Sundays. I decided to come back on a Tuesday and was not disappointed! It's a small place tucked away in the corner of a shopping center. The inside is clean and quaint. The staff is very nice, they greeted me when I came in and when I grabbed my food to leave. The prices are affordable, and the steak sandwiches come with fries incl
Absolutely wonderful food, seems like a nice family run place. One of the best cheesesteaks I've had.
When you walk in you just know the food here is going to be banger. A true community joint. Very reasonable prices. Food is made when you order. Service is great too.

I have to say that the sandwich was just okay it wasn't all that it was hyped up to be. The fries were okay I like that they give you a pickle with it because it creates a good balance with the peppers in the steak. But like any good food place you're craving more meat for what you pay for. So I'm still searching for a good hoagie spot.

name: Ping's Bistro
address: 2090 Warm Springs Ct Ste 140, Fremont, CA 94539
reviews:
Ping's Bistro Warm Springs made quite a splash when it first opened in Fremont. Their Yunnan-style cuisine was something you didn’t see much of in the area a few years ago, and the flavors were genuinely impressive. Even last year, there were still long lines out the door.

When we visited today—on a Saturday and Valentine’s Day—we were surprised to find no wait and the restaurant was only half fu

Even though we asked for little spicy, the dishes were still a little too spicy for me.  But over all, I like the food.  The place is clean.  We arrived early so no problem to find a space.  But by the time we were leaving there were cars circling around the parking lot looking for a space.

Absolutely one of the best Chinese meals I’ve had in the Bay Area.

We ordered the spicy noodle soup, stir-fried beef, and seasonal greens .everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The broth was rich and comforting with just the right level of heat, and the beef dish was tender, aromatic, and deeply satisfying. Even the greens were done beautifully — fresh, vibrant, and not overly oily.

Dude, my wife and I love your food so much, but we can’t afford it with 20%+ mandatory fees now🙂my bad, I am so poor. Let’s break up with overall 3 stars. We will miss you and go to Hometown Kitchen and Jun’s Bistro, two good alternative restaurants for Hunan cuisine and Yunnan cuisine. See you lala.
Very authentic Yunnan cuisine, a lot of variety of mushrooms cooked in different styles. The service is great, give us great recommendations and perfect size. The dishes are in very large portions.

name: Home Eat汉家宴 - Fremont
reviews:
Great food. Super high quality and amazing flavor. Family style eating. Loved the beef roll in scallion pancake and the lamb bone broth hot pot. Traditional Chinese food but they also have “American style Chinese food.”
Disclaimer: You order via the QR code and they then bring the food out to you. Everything is very hands off, no fuss no muss. They truly focus on the food and elevate your company

We visited Home Eat in Fremont during winter break and had a solid dine‑in experience.

We ordered:

• Beef Wrap ($9.75)
• Shrimp & Ham Fried Rice ($12.75)
• Chicken Noodle Soup ($13.75)
• Secret Lamb Wok ($18.75)

All dishes came out quickly, served hot, and portions were generous for the price.

One detail we really appreciated was the table setup: extra bowls, plates, and utensils were already

I had a great experience at 汉家宴. The cold dishes were especially impressive — super fresh, well-seasoned, and really appetizing. You can tell they put care into the quality. The garlic A-choy (蒜蓉A菜) was also a standout — simple but done perfectly, with great flavor and texture. Definitely a spot I’d come back to!

Good value for the amount at about $20 per pax.

Tasted fresh & not overly sweeten or salty.  Rather thirsty after an hour after dinner. Still a good meal for dinner. Overall 7/10.

Best dish is the guo tei or pot stickers; the spiced brown sauce made it 10/10.

A strong repeat for our group of 4. Unanimous decision. Why?

Super fast service in food delivery. Faster than McDonalds 10/10.

Good att

The honey walnut shrimp was good and enjoyable. However, the combination fried rice was noticeably under-seasoned and had no salt, which made it taste quite bland. The Tidu chicken meat pot was also disappointing in terms of seasoning and felt overly oily.

Overall, the service speed was great, but the food needs improvement in seasoning and balance of flavors.

name: Madras Idli Kadai - Fremont
address: 46356 Warm Springs Blvd Unit 848, Fremont, CA 94539
reviews:
We try different restaurants every weekend for breakfast. This place is #1 among the others we have been to!

The pongal, vadai, dosai - were absolutely perfect. Idly, idiyaappam, chutneys, sambar, kesari - no complaints at all. The masala chai was excellent! But it’s not available in the breakfast buffet. Only coffee is available. If the chai could be a part of the buffet, it would make the break

We visited as a group of 4 adults and 1 child. Two of us chose the buffet, while the others ordered à la carte. As soon as we walked in, the owner rudely told us there was no sharing. If sharing is a concern, put up signs or monitor the buffet and stop people if they're actually sharing. Making that the first thing you say to customers in a rude tone is not good hospitality.

The owner's behavior

The chocolate dosa quickly became a favorite for our kids. We were especially touched by the staff’s kindness; they patiently explained the menu items, which made it easy for us to try new dishes with confidence.

Looking for home like South Indian food, here in Warm springs, Fremont -Visit MIK. Excellent fresh & crispy Dosa made to order. Sambhar, Chutneys & Rasam vadai (can be spicy those favor it) - top notch. Fresh filter coffee, reminds u of Chennai! I get my dosa & rava dosa fix here! Neat happy hour menu and weekend specials. Do give a try.

We had an absolutely fantastic experience here! Right from the start, we were greeted with a welcome pudina (mint) drink part of buffet that was just too good such a refreshing and thoughtful touch. The buffet is amazing, packed with so many delicious, authentic choices. A huge standout for us was the chaat!

Beyond the incredible food, the owners are just wonderful, genuinely kind people who went

name: Spin A Yarn Steakhouse
editorialSummary: Classic haunt with warm decor and a meat-oriented menu that also includes seafood & pasta.
reviews: The food was good but not great. Unfortunately my steak was undercooked and underseasoned, I requested med rare and it came rare. I should have sent it back, but was hungry. The sauce provided was like a mix of A1 and Worcestershire sauce and wasn't a fan. Expected more flavor for the price I paid. The fried calamari wasn't crispy and needed more seasoning as well. The crab cake was delicious and

We were surprised about this place!!
We got steaks and wine for dinner, so delicious and tender.
I would say only the mashed potatoes wasn’t my fav, looks like was from a box.

But my overall experience was lovely! There was live acoustic music 🎶, the Cabernet 🍷 so perfect!

The attention from the waitress 10/10

I had a pleasant lunch at Spin A Yarn Steakhouse today! We ordered three burgers (8 oz Beef Burger), one filet mignon, angel pasta with pesto sauce, and a seafood linguine. The overall atmosphere of this place was quite vintage and old-timey, very traditional yet fancy. The lights were dimmed quite a lot, providing a cozy, intimate atmosphere here. The service was welcoming and very friendly! We w

Went there for a celebration of life held in a private room. Buffet lunch with appetizers, salads, rice and 3 meats, chicken, fish, and beef. All was delicious including desserts  chocolate cake and cheese cake. We had some music, singing, stories and servers were always present taking drink orders, refilling water, and cleaning empty dishes.

Excellent food. fantastic service. Old school steak house vibe. We went there between lunch and dinner and we were given the option to choose from the dinner menu which was much appreciated. The server was so pleasant and professional, I didn't ask his name but I believe it was Keith. I should have to give him praise where it is due. Our food was amazing and presented perfectly. I will attach some

name: R-HaaN Thai Restaurant
reviews:
This place is absolutely stunning -- from the presentation to the flavors, R HaanThai does not miss. Every dish came out beautifully plated with fresh orchid garnishes and you could tell the kitchen takes so much pride in their food.
We ordered the khao soi, pineapple fried rice, garlic shrimp, green curry with lamb shank, crispy pork, and drinks (thai iced tea, green thai tea, and a shirley templ

Amazing! We finally found a Thai spot in Fremont that makes amazing tom kha soup. The first time we ate here we were able to get a table! It’s a smaller place and was very busy. We ordered a variety of items to get a taste of the place. It was also a special meal as this was our last date night before our daughter was born. We were not disappointed. Besides the tom kha soup, we also ordered Thai i

Really loved the Koh Soi with the soft shell crab. The curry is deep delicious, creamy and rich, medium spice was perfect. The soft shell crab was totally worth it with 2 crabs in the dish. Crunchy noodles and the soft noodle texture was a nice contrast. Wouldn't hesitate to come back.

I'd say 4.5 is great, some items are soo good and others are pretty good.

Love the crab khao soi. Crab awesome. Soup awesome. I like the noodles, but not the best around. Great use of vegetables

The roti is a must that's a sleeper hit.

R-Haan Thai was such a cute and cozy area to dine during winter. The food was great; we ordered the drunken noodles, tom yum soup, green curry, and for dessert, matcha cake with Thai iced tea ice cream. The drunken noodles were perfect, but we were careful in which spice level we chose, which was medium out of the options mild, medium, hot, or Thai Spicy. The tom yum soup, however, was the only th

name: Julie's Noodle
reviews: Approved! They pile on the green onions and cilantro; broth was flavorful and not heavy; a balanced bowl (got the signature beef stew noodles). They give you plenty of options - type of noodle, firmness, spice and numbing level, and yes, the ability to opt out on the green onions, etc. Chinese comfort food in a bowl. My kids can’t handle the spice yet so got the items without any heat.

Got a take out order from this place during lunch hour rush. The order was done by phone, the staff was friendly and patient as she placed my order.

Upon arrival to my pickup, I was informed that the braised egg was not available so she took it out of my order.

Well packed noodles and soup separately!!!
The portion of the noodles was great!!! Beef texture was just perfect, melted in your mouth.
We went looking for a beef noodle place and came across Julie’s. Really enjoyed the texture and taste of the noodles. Can be quite spicy, so just be aware.

The highly recommended 招牌牛肉面Signature Beef Stew Noodles are truly delicious! I loved this. With incredibly tender beef chunks, the soup was full of flavor and not too oily. The broth is quite beefy and hearty. Even ordering it non-spicy was great, but I appreciated the waitress letting us know their spice levels are stronger than others. For noodles, I got the rice noodles! So chewy in texture. So

The most welcoming restaurant!
Friend and I went in for some soup on a cold night, we were greeted very kindly, and offered purse hooks. We felt so seen and comfortable!  We ordered with the scanner on the table, dumpling soup and chicken noodle [v typical, but we have soft tummy so we wanted to tip toe in] and the flavor was amazing ! The broth is tasty and the noodles were perfection. We had the

name: Amami Sushi Fremont
address: 46228 Warm Springs Blvd Ste 444 & 452, Fremont, CA 94539
reviews:
always on my rotation. used to go to the Cupertino one, now this one is slightly closer

we only order items on the white board and not the omakase because we know what we like

2 people with our fish selection and a bottle of sake is about $200+

With the server speaks both Mandarin, Cantonese and English in wonderful fluent level. I could tell many customers around my table are having a great time. That puts a positive and exciting atmosphere for the night immediately, we ordered lobster sushi, Hokkaido scallops, and sweet shrimp especially by seeing the tempting picture online. It did not disappoint at all with the huge portion of meat.

We went here for lunch with some friends and it was great. We had a smattering of different things: spicy tuna, salmon skin, rock and roll, and different special rolls. The Romeo and Juliet roll was tasty. I typically don’t order raw salmon for my rolls, but the texture of the salmon was very soft and nice.
They also had a nicely priced grilled fish collar and it was a good portion for the price w
This is definitely one of my favorite restaurants in town. The sushi is always exceptional, server was awesome! All the dishes were very flavorful.

I’ve come here about 5 times to give this restaurant the benefit of doubt. However the service and quality of care has been subpar consistently. The chefs and food are great! The servers and staff from entry to exit have been the worst. Every visit has often been filled with forgotten menu items ordered, inconsistent billing, and really confusing knowledge of their own menu. Wait times for orderin

name: Chicken Meets Rice (inside Fremont 99 Ranch)
reviews:
Exceptionally, this is one of the best restaurants we have ever been to. The employees are highly professional, demonstrate great leadership skills, and handle customers with care and respect. The team is very accommodating and easy to work with.

The food is always fresh, healthy, and served in generous portions. You can tell they prepare the food and drinks fresh every day, which makes a noticea

Disappointing portion sizes

I’ve been here very often and usually order the mixed Hainan chicken rice with a house salad as the side. This time I decided to try the mixed Hainan chicken rice with steamed broccoli, but the portions were a real letdown — the steamed broccoli was barely a few florets, and the chicken portion looked like only about half of what I’ve gotten in the past, even the numbe
🔥 chicken n rice. I got the half n half and it did not disappoint. The broth is good too- I mixed a little bit of the ginger sauce and it’s a good sipping broth.

So surprised! Didn’t expect much walking into a food court, but wow—this one seriously impressed me. The food was really good. Everything tasted fresh, like it was made right there and not sitting around. Every bite felt intentional and simple but really flavorful.  Definitely one of those hidden gems you don’t expect—will 100% be back!

I think it is better than most of the Hainan chicken rice in the USA. The rice is good and flavourful. The soup is ok. Chicken is kind of overcooked. It is little bit tough & chewy.
If i have it in Asia , I popular won’t go back. However, I think it’s not bad in the USA

name: Shanghai Flavor
editorialSummary: Casual spot serving classic Chinese eats such as dumplings & chow mein, plus curry dishes & dim sum.
reviews:
Small restaurant serves local people - expertise in Shanghainese food
I’ve been dining with this restaurant for decade already. Chef is still now enthusiastic about food and quality. Food quality is always fresh and clean. Make sure you tell them less greasy and less salt upon order. They can adjust and make a lot of fresh food.

My family likes this spot. It is out no.1 choice for family dinner s

okay, I love Sichuan and Hunan style because they have so much flavor. there's also Shanghai cuisine, which has flavor without the chillies of Sichuan/Hunan.

today, we went to Fremont to Shanghai Flavor. it's a super good Shanghainese restaurant.

it opens at 11.30 on Saturday. within 20 minutes, it was full. folks, it's a small place, but that's fine. great service.

if you can, get an order of

Food: Verified by our coworker from Shanghai: AUTHENTIC. The flavors are really great! Especially their pot! You get so many things, including glass noodles, vegetables, seafood and meat; and the broth! Best taste ever. Their steam rice is really good as well and definitely be mindful with their portion haha.

Ambiance: clean and comfortable!

Service: can’t describe how welcoming and attentive th
Very authentic Shanghai food. Very yummy. Highly recommended. Hole in the wall mom and pop shop.

First time visit at Shanghai Flavor.  On a whim, we were looking for Hong Kong Style food but ended up here, thanks to Google.  We sure are glad because food was delicious and service was excellent.  The server was impressed at our food selection cause it seemed like we knew what we were doing.  Thanks to the reviews, we simply chose what most reviewers order.  After enjoying our meal, we surveyed

name: Meet Rice Noodle 蒙自源米线大王
address: 46260 Warm Springs Blvd Unit 545, Fremont, CA 94539
reviews: Most attentive service I have had in years, perfection. Meats were not too tender but flavor was excellent. We ate and ate and left with a large container being full with our soups combined. I did add some chili oil to bring up the heat some in my bowl. The rice was great. The Lamb skewers were outstanding!! We will be returning!!

Ordered the spicy combination to go, so not sure about the service and dine-in atmosphere. But the food is great. The pork intestines are clean and well-seasoned, the blood sausage is very tender, and the most impressive part is the naba cabbage side dish—so tender and juicy. The portion is good too, more than enough meat and veggie for one person to eat.

The staff and team are super nice! It was too spicy for me and they offered to change the soup free of charge! 🤣🤣

Be careful! It’s not white people spicy!
Great food. I am from yunnan. It is not perfect but very decent rice noodles you can have in the US.

Authentic and delicious rice noodles! The broth is rich and flavorful, and the noodles have the perfect texture. I really like the freshness and traditional cooking. Simple, comforting, and definitely worth coming back for.

name: Bodo Lucky Japanese Restaurant
editorialSummary: Japanese standby offering ramen & other traditional fare in easygoing, compact quarters.
reviews:
A Chinese “Japanese Restaurant.”

The staff are very nice, portions are huge, they’re generous with the meat, and the Hong Kong style milk tea & sesame balls were pretty pleasant.

Despite these points, the food wasn’t that good, so I wouldn’t recommend this place. Also, our food didn’t come out all at once. By the time the third person got their food, the other two people’s food had cooled to war

Found this gem that serves excellent ramen, and other menu options.  We did try the vegetarian ramen, and chicken karage. The ramen was excellent and had great flavor, with a good quality. Chicken karage was more of batter and less of meat, wish they could improve it, but the taste was excellent. The best part is you are offered a drink to choose when you place an entre order, which compliments th

Fast service and friendly workers.
The food was extremely good and I definitely recommend the takoyaki. Would definitely come back again to try the different flavors of ramen.

Food was excellent. My brother and I ordered the Ramen combo with skewers. Each came with a free milk tea and almond tofu dessert. (We didn't realize the milk tea and almond tofu came with our meal. The server was very attentive to detail and made sure all our needs were met. Only gripe was it seemed that the chicken skewer only had sauce and wasn't seasoned. The mustard greens on the ramen was a

This is a hidden gem. Nothing fancy or trendy. Just very delicious Ramen and very friendly service that one would expect from a small family run business. The prices are very reasonable for the very high quality and fresh ingredient and the service was very fast despite of a busy Saturday evening. This was our first time and will visit again.

name: Garden Cafe
address: 20390 Lake Chabot Rd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
reviews:
