Amazing. Incredible. Very authentic Hong Kong style cafe.

Everything here is what you expect. And if you never been to a Hong Kong cafe then be prepared to have your world flip upside down. This style of food is fun and delicious compared to the traditional Asian food you may expect.

Good drunken food or good breakfast. Regardless of the time of day, the food here at Garden Cafe will be good. Th

A good little Hong Kong style Café… They have the French toast with peanut butter and condensed milk, the coffee/tea combo, great egg sandwiches and other good HK cafe stuff! The portions are quite large for the French toast so one should feed two people at least. Prices are a little high, but it’s good if you like the style of food
.

Went for dinner here with party of 9 after a school event, around 9:30 pm. There were three other large parties there in addition to us so it did appear under staffed. It took a while to get all our orders out, as expected.  We found it amazing that they ran out of extra bowls/plates and left to-go containers for us to use instead. This wasn't the first time eating here but it was apparent they st

Enjoyed some delicious beef congee and pork/preserved egg congee along with the house waffle.  The food was delicious.

The waffle is made with rice flour and was scrumptious. Pour a little condensed milk and maple syrup on it and munch away.

The beef was very tender and flavorful.

We were the only ones in there just after they opened at 810am on a Saturday. So if you want to avoid the crowd, co

Love this place. It is was crowded at dinner time. We try to find place for dinner and our friend recommended this. It was a good choice. It serves Hongkong style dishes and street food.  The menu is massive for food and drink. We ordered stir fry on choy, baked black pepper porkchop over rice, hainamese chicken rice and seafood pand fry noodle. All are yummy. It is just it takes a while for our o

name: 88 BaoBao
reviews:
88 Bao Bao is truly a hidden gem. This small dim sum spot may be modest in size, but it’s packed with big flavor. The dumplings are incredibly delicious—well-seasoned without being overly salty, letting the natural flavors shine through. One of the best parts is being able to watch the chef make the dumplings fresh, which adds to the experience.

When you walk in, you’re warmly greeted by the staf

There really aren't that many choices outside of Great Wolf Lodge especially passable Chinese food so this place kinda stands out. The food is not terrible but you shouldn't expect great authenticity. The restaurant feels more like they got the food from Costco and then heated up for you. My suggestion is that if you know what good Chinese food is, skip it but if you absolutely must have Chinese f

Food is good.  The (Xiao lung Bao) pork dumplings were juicy and flavorful better than the 88 Bao Bao in Dublin.  Beef rolls is good and the pan fried bao is juicy… could use a little less uncooked oil brushing the unfried part of the bao … I guess they have to keep the black sesame in place.

Small Chinese joint prefect for small groups. Friendly on the wallet compared to Ding Tai Fung and the like. Order first places are a bit weird for me because you tip up front and then receive service. Wasn’t too impressed by the cucumber or the soup dumplings although, I’ll very much order them again. The popcorn chicken was quite good. It reminded me of the flavors in Taiwan street markets. Stil

We mostly get take out from 88 bao bao and have enjoyed every dish we've tried (and we've tried a lot!). Favorites include the rice vermicelli with shrimp, beef noodle soup, pan fried dumplings, and chili oil wontons. If we are dining in, we get the steamed pork and shrimp xlb as well.

There can be a wait to dine in during dinner time, but it's usually less than 15 minutes. Tables seat 2-4 but ca

name: Nick The Greek
reviews: I had a spanakopita, but unfortunately, I have to say I've never eaten a worse pita. That's not a pita at all; if you want to eat delicious pita, then you have to get it from Try the dough made by an Albanian woman who makes it herself, then you can say, "That was super delicious, but unfortunately yours didn't taste good to me." My girlfriend had beef kebab and she said it was delicious, and she

First time have Dubai chocolate froyo it was delicious. Also I love the combo of their fries and burger. The customer service are plus which is Awesome.  Also enjoy coming here. Great vibe and music being played here are excellent.

Wonderful! Today (5/18/26), at around 4:30-5:00 PM, I was craving a fresh, not too heavy meal to satisfy my lunch cravings while on break. I was recommended this specific nick the Greek from a good friend of mine, as it was local, and was said to have great service and good food. When I entered the store, I was pleasantly surprised by how nicely decorated and clean the store was, along with its up

Great little neighborhood spot. One of those fun strip mall eateries that you're so glad to have found. The chicken souvlaki skewers was juicy and just right. The fries are perfectly seasoned, and the kids LOVED to dip them (and the cucumbers from the Prasini Salad) into their tzatziki - definitely order a side of it. Kid friendly in general, and although the atmosphere is pretty straightforward,
Big portions of chicken, salad is fresh and crunchy.  Fries are crispy and well seasoned.  Pita bread goes well with chicken, tomatoes, and red onions.

name: Lucca Italian Delicatessen
address: 3121 Castro Valley Blvd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
editorialSummary: Old-school market & deli known for its sandwiches, pastas & desserts, plus Italian specialty foods.
reviews:
Great sandwich and great spot. I ordered the roasted turkey sandwich and it was really good. The turkey tasted fresh, the bread was soft, and everything was well balanced. Simple but very flavorful.

Service was quick and the place has that classic Italian deli feel. Definitely a solid spot for a good sandwich. I’ll be back to try more.

Highly recommend their made to order sandwiches! Fresh deli meats, cheeses, bread & produce. Always delicious. They also offer Italian take & bake entrès like meat-filled ravioli w/ bolognase sauce & lasagna. Indoor seating, cold drinks, & a large offering of dry goods. Great place for hostess gifts ! I happily sacrifice sacrine-sweet customer service for quick efficiency 😁

Nice to be able to phone our order ahead to avoid the line. I threw the sandwich maker a custom curve ball and they handled it very well. The sandwiches were amazing and big enough for two meals! Still as good as ever - check 'em out!
The cheeses and meats were freshly sliced to order, giving the entire experience a wonderful sense of freshness and flavor.

I’m not normally a sandwich guy, but really great local deli!!  I bought a sandwich at 9 am for a day hike and it was delicious. Super neat as it acts as a small store as well. They offer lots of Italian to go foods beyond sandwiches too…

name: Nation's Giant Hamburgers & Great Pies
address: 3088 Castro Valley Blvd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain featuring oversized burgers, all-day breakfast & lots of pies in a retro setting.
reviews:
Nation’s Giant Hamburgers & Great Pies — Castro Valley, CA
This place is absolutely amazing! The breakfast is hearty and delicious — fluffy eggs, crispy hash browns, and their giant breakfast burrito will blow your mind. The burgers are huge, juicy, and packed with fresh toppings. Don’t skip the pies — every slice is pure perfection!
But what really makes Nation’s special is the outstanding custom

Had my first dine-in visit to Nation's and it was a great experience. I’ve had their pies before and they’re always delicious, The food came out fresh and the burger definitely lived up to expectations. The atmosphere was casual and clean. Elena was friendly and helpful when ordering.

When I get the urge for a burger, I think Nation's! I prefer this location because the sandwiches are always well put together. Generous amounts of FRESH lettuce leaves,
several large tomato slices ( look like beefsteak variety) and onions- sometimes too much :-)- I just remove the excess. Fresh bun, tasty burger meat... The fries USED to be some of the best- they aren't so special anymore. I saw

Probably not the best nations restaurants,  the food tasted like dirty rag water. Friendly staff but the food was not good. I should have went to dennys or wendys or burger king would be much better than this.

30 minutes for a single legit handful of fries with 1 customer inside is crazy. Thats all I ordered. They kept just chatting and standing around. They didnt even cook it till my friend went up and said something like 20 minutes into waiting. Y'all had me wait 30 minutes for fries with no customers and didnt even care to cook it till we said something. Horrible. If Y'all hate your job and just wann

name: MOD Pizza
editorialSummary: Counter-serve, industrial-chic chain restaurant known for build-your-own pizzas.
reviews:
Dropped by over the weekend.  The kiddo wanted to try the place as he's a fan of pizza.

There's plenty of parking as we went in a time slot that wasn't peak hours.  This plaza can get packed at times.

The pizza was okay, bit we found the pizza  crust to be very thin.  It was okay, but I think the kiddo wanted a thinker crust.

Ovall a 4 star place.

Love the 2 staff that help. Very friendly and helpful.
If youlove thin pizza and making it your own this is the place

The only reason for 4 stars is because of the location but that’s not a reflection of the food or staff. The staff is great they’re always attentive and kind! I also love mod pizza, however, this specific location draws some strange people. I have seen the cops in this parking lot multiple times and homeless people acting up and once was yelled at by a homeless person in the Mod patio! It’s probab

Can’t praise Aaron and Jocelyn enough for being so kind, supportive and loving. Seeing Aaron work and serving school kids like his own or probably more love just made me feel so happy and grateful! Love Mod Pizza

They have individual sizes something like 8 inches for $8 and we had standard MOD pizza (11.5”) with vegan cheese and cauliflower crust with unlimited toppings for $13! Strongly suggest this place, cheap and delicious! Staff is very friendly!!!

name: Rita's Italian Ice & Frozen Custard
address: 3200 Castro Valley Blvd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
editorialSummary: Italian ices & frozen custards star at this counter-serve chain with a range of other cold treats.
reviews: I don't know how I hadn't tried Rita's before but during the heatwave popped in.  So I've never tried Custard and figured I'd go with the classic twist which hit the spot perfectly.  Can wait to go back and try other variations
Excellent custard! I usually go for the swirl. Not sure how I feel about the Italian ice… Almost too many options to choose from!
Smooth delicious italian ice and frozen custard. We drive from Reno to get our favorites.
Very nice improvement. There is a lot of options for an icy. Small place but nice
It was our first time trying this and we loved it. Josie was really nice to us and patient taking our order. I love that it’s fresh and it’s an enjoyable place to eat Italian ice. 🍦🍧

name: Portales Taqueria
address: 3153 Castro Valley Blvd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
reviews: Food was good. We were given complimentary chips while dining in. There is an open salsa bar with a variety of salsa and toppings. The nice lady also asked us if we wanted refills for the side tortillas that came with the combo plates.

Had such a great experience here! From the moment we walked in, the sweetest abuelita was taking orders—so professional, warm, and genuinely grateful. You could feel the care in every interaction, with “thank you” going both ways all around the room.

We were told the wait would be about 18 minutes, but our food came out in just 7—such a pleasant surprise! And let me tell you, the food itself was

If you're looking for authentic Mexican food in Castro Valley, look no further than Portales Taqueria. This family-friendly spot aims to bring the true flavors of Mexico to your table, and they absolutely succeed. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home with their passion for traditional Mexican grilling. Portales Taqueria is a great choice for delivery, takeo

FOOD: really don’t know why the rankings are so high,  food was rather average. Had carne asada and pastor and they were ok. Had some of their fruit drink, and those were tasty.
SERVICE: was great. The cashier was a really nice, warm, and pleasant lady.

I won’t be back. It was too much for what it was. In my humble opinion, the street tacos in the area are way better.

Ellie was the sweetest, nicest and most awesome front of house customer service. She took our order and gave us her recommendations for the best flavor of Jarritos soda. The food was amazing! And we were able to sit outside in the nice weather today. Thank you Portales for a great experience 😎

name: Phulkari Indian Cuisine
reviews: Really great experience overall. The restaurant has a warm, cozy vibe that makes it perfect for a relaxed meal. I tried the thali set and it was absolutely delicious—authentic, fresh, and a very generous portion. I'll definitely be back.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | A Local Treasure for Authentic Indian Cuisine!
If you are looking for the best Indian food in the East Bay, look no further than Phulkari. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is warm and inviting, but it’s the food and the service that truly set this place apart.
The Food
The flavors here are incredibly authentic and layered. We tried the Butter Chicken and the Lamb Rogan Josh, and

Outstanding food, excellent service, and a wonderful atmosphere! Every dish was packed with authentic flavor and prepared with great care. The staff was friendly, professional, and made us feel truly welcome. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and a perfect place to enjoy a great meal. From the moment we walked in until we left, everything exceeded our expectations. Highly recommended to anyone

One of the best dining experiences I’ve had in a long time. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served perfectly. The staff was extremely welcoming and provided outstanding service from start to finish. The restaurant has a great atmosphere and is a wonderful place to sit back, relax, and enjoy a meal with family and friends. Every detail reflects quality and care. Highly recommended, and I’ll defi

I had the buffet. The chicken Tikka Massala and goat curry were delicious! I had a mango lassi which was a little thinner than I prefer but the flavor was delicious 😋 .

The young man that served was wonderful! I would definitely return.

My friend ordered a shrimp appetizer and I felt the shrimp were overcooked however we didn't let them know otherwise in certain they would've addressed it. We j

name: Tacos El Compa
address: 2788 Castro Valley Blvd, Castro Valley, CA 94546
reviews:
As someone who moved to Castro Valley from Hayward, I can honestly say that the choices for Mexican food isn't as plentiful. Im kinda particular about Mexican food because not many places has the more exotic meats choices like cabeza, lengua, and my favorite tripa. So as I was settling in to Castro Valley, I was very happy to have found Tacos El Campo.

I have been here about 10 times in the 7 or
